AI.tldr: 该论文描述了军事人员质疑命令的三种场景，探讨了军事伦理、服从与质疑之间的张力。
AI.research_question: 军事人员在何种情况下会质疑上级命令？这些质疑行为如何影响军事组织的运作和伦理决策？
AI.motivation: 军事组织强调服从命令，但现实中士兵有时会质疑命令的合法性或道德性。理解这种张力对军事伦理、领导力发展和组织管理至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 军事伦理理论、组织行为学、领导力理论、道德决策模型、服从权威心理学
AI.method: 案例研究方法，通过描述和分析三种具体的军事人员质疑命令的场景
AI.findings: 识别出三种典型的质疑命令场景：1) 命令违反国际法或战争法；2) 命令明显不合理或危险；3) 命令与个人道德信念冲突。每种场景下士兵的应对策略和决策过程不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了军事伦理理论，提出了军事人员质疑命令的框架模型，丰富了组织内异议行为的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为军事训练提供指导，帮助指挥官理解士兵可能质疑命令的情况，改进决策沟通流程，建立更有效的伦理决策机制

title: Identifying AI Jobs in Online Job Postings: Existing Versus Newly Developed LLM-Based Approaches and A Dataset on Demand for AI Jobs among Russell 1000 Firms, 2018–2025
affiliations: University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business, University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business, University of Maryland - R.H. Smith School of Business and Robert H. Smith School of Business

detail.title: Identifying AI Jobs in Online Job Postings: Existing Versus Newly Developed LLM-Based Approaches and A Dataset on Demand for AI Jobs among Russell 1000 Firms, 2018–2025
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is spreading rapidly across industries, yet firms differ widely in adoption intensity, making measurement of AI investment a core empirical challenge. Investment in AI-skilled human capital is the most widely used proxy. This paper compares existing Lightcast (Burning Glass) skills-taxonomy based methods with large language model (LLM) approaches and introduces a fine-tuned LLM that markedly improves classification performance, raising precision by about 30% and F1 score by about 18% without sacrificing recall or computing efficiency. Using this method, we construct and publicly release a dataset of quarterly AI-skilled labor demand for Russell 1000 firms from 2018 to 2025. Preliminary analyses show that AI-related jobs exhibit a clear upward trend and substantial variation across sectors, regions, and occupations. We also release our code and models and offer methodological guidance for applying LLMs in business research, emphasizing the value of task-specific fine-tuning. Managerial Summary. As firms race to embed artificial intelligence (AI) into their operations, managers need reliable ways to gauge their own and competitors' AI investments. Hiring for AIrelated skills serves as a practical proxy, yet commonly used Lightcast (Burning Glass) skillstaxonomy based methods often misclassify postings, limiting strategic insight. We show that a finetuned large language model (LLM) provides far more accurate and efficient classification, sharply reducing false positives and improving key performance metrics. Using this method, we construct and publicly release a dataset of quarterly AI-skilled labor demand for Russell 1000 firms from 2018 to 2025, revealing a clear upward trend and substantial variation across industry sectors, geographic regions, and occupations. These insights can potentially help managers benchmark AI talent strategies, assess emerging competitive pressures, and make more informed capabilitybuilding decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于微调大语言模型的新方法，显著提高了AI技能职位分类的准确性，并构建了Russell 1000公司2018-2025年AI技能劳动力需求的公开数据集。
AI.research_question: 如何更准确地测量企业AI投资？具体来说，如何改进AI技能职位分类方法以更好地衡量企业对AI技能劳动力的需求？
AI.motivation: AI在各行业快速扩散，但企业采用强度差异很大，测量AI投资成为核心实证挑战。目前最常用的代理指标是AI技能人力资本投资，但现有的Lightcast技能分类方法存在误分类问题，限制了战略洞察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技能分类的AI投资测量理论，强调AI技能劳动力需求作为企业AI投资的有效代理指标。
AI.method: 比较现有Lightcast技能分类方法与LLM方法，开发并微调专门的大语言模型来分类AI技能职位，显著提升分类性能（精确度提高约30%，F1分数提高约18%）。使用该方法构建Russell 1000公司2018-2025年季度AI技能劳动力需求数据集。
AI.findings: 1）微调LLM方法显著优于传统技能分类方法；2）AI相关职位呈现明显上升趋势；3）AI技能需求在不同行业、地区和职业间存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了基于微调LLM的AI技能分类新方法；2）为应用LLM进行商业研究提供了方法指导；3）强调了任务特定微调的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）公开发布了Russell 1000公司AI技能劳动力需求数据集；2）发布了代码和模型；3）为管理者提供了AI人才战略基准、竞争压力评估和能力建设决策的实用工具。

title: Factors Influencing the Success of Drowsiness Detection Device Development
affiliations: , King Mongkut’s University of Technology North Bangkok and King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok (KMUTNB)

detail.title: Factors Influencing the Success of Drowsiness Detection Device Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted in accordance with ethical research principles for human participants. All respondents participated voluntarily and provided informed consent prior to completing the questionnaire. No sensitive personal data were collected.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the authors as part of a graduate-level academic study at King Mongkut’s University of Technology North Bangkok (KMUTNB). No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: Drowsiness while driving is a persistent contributor to traffic accidents in Thailand and worldwide, underscoring the need for effective countermeasures and the adoption of assistive technologies. This study examines factors influencing the success of drowsiness detection device development. Data were collected from 402 drivers in Bangkok and surrounding provinces during September-October 2025, using online questionnaires. The stepwise multiple linear regression results showed that three factors-ease of use during operation, users' positive attitude toward the device, and perceived usefulness-influence the success of drowsiness detection device development.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了影响驾驶员疲劳检测设备开发成功的因素，发现易用性、用户积极态度和感知有用性是关键影响因素。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响驾驶员疲劳检测设备开发的成功？
AI.motivation: 驾驶疲劳是泰国和全球交通事故的主要原因，需要有效的对策和辅助技术的采用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（TAM）相关理论，包括感知有用性、易用性、用户态度等构念。
AI.method: 采用在线问卷调查法，于2025年9-10月在曼谷及周边省份收集402名驾驶员数据，使用逐步多元线性回归分析。
AI.findings: 三个因素显著影响疲劳检测设备开发成功：操作易用性、用户对设备的积极态度、感知有用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了技术接受模型在驾驶员安全技术领域的应用，验证了易用性、态度和有用性对技术开发成功的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为疲劳检测设备开发者提供设计指导，强调易用性设计和用户态度培养的重要性，有助于提高设备采用率和交通安全。

title: Future of Research in Management and AI
affiliations: KIIT University - School of Management, GIET UNIVERSITY and Centurion University Of Technology And Management

detail.title: Future of Research in Management and AI
detail.abstract:
Future of Research in Management and AI , published by DeepScience publications.
Abstract:

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the in thing, the most buzz word and the most used tool, used by all: industries, organizations and individuals. The use and applications are increasing exponentially every day, increasing both in the depth and diverse directions, with a lot of innovation. AI has become an enabler, a favourite tool, both among the experts as well as among the commoners. It is now embedded to many popular social media platforms, making them more user friendly and much more proactive. It has come as a boon to many.

But massive use of AI has raised many a concerns too. It is also said that it seriously hampers the creativity of youngsters, who are now tempted and trapped in the cobweb of AI. A serious challenge it has posed in the field of research and publication. With a growing need and compulsion for the young scholars to publish minimum number of research papers, it is now a common and easy track (and the trap) of using AI (like, ChatGPT) for research paper ‘generation’. As many of us know, articles (or essays) can be written very beautifully and very easily by using this means. Now the buzz thing in research world is not just ‘plagiarism’, but also the need of checking for AI contents in each article. While standard journals were receiving articles earlier in hundreds, now, after the massive use of AI, thousands of articles (in any area/ theme) flood the email of the journal editor.

AI.tldr: AI在管理研究中的广泛使用带来了机遇和挑战：一方面AI成为强大的赋能工具，另一方面过度依赖AI可能抑制创造力，导致研究论文质量下降和学术诚信问题。
AI.research_question: AI在管理研究中的大规模应用如何影响学术研究的质量、创造力和学术诚信？
AI.motivation: AI已成为各行业和个人的热门工具，但在管理研究领域，其广泛应用引发了关于创造力抑制、学术诚信和研究质量下降的严重担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、学术诚信理论、创造力理论、技术伦理框架
AI.method: 概念性分析、文献综述、现象观察（基于当前AI在学术界的应用趋势）
AI.findings: 1. AI工具使研究论文生成变得容易，导致投稿量激增；2. 年轻学者过度依赖AI可能损害创造力；3. 学术诚信面临新挑战，需要检测AI生成内容；4. AI既是赋能工具也是潜在陷阱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了技术伦理在学术研究中的应用；2. 提出了AI时代学术诚信的新维度；3. 探讨了技术便利性与学术创造力之间的张力理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为期刊编辑提供应对AI生成论文的策略；2. 为学术机构制定AI使用伦理指南；3. 为研究者平衡AI工具使用与创造力培养提供建议；4. 推动开发AI内容检测工具。

title: Short-term deployment of nursing staff in outpatient clinics: A pool-based allocation approach
affiliations: FernUniversität in Hagen, FernUniversität in Hagen and FernUniversität in Hagen

detail.title: Short-term deployment of nursing staff in outpatient clinics: A pool-based allocation approach
detail.abstract: This article analyses the hourly allocation of nursing staff from a central pool to support an outpatient clinic network treating patients who receive serial care, specifically in situations of short-term staff shortages. Unlike in hospitals, the pool concept has seen little application in outpatient settings, even though limited human resources in these environments often lead to staff shortages and overtime. A central pool can cushion these effects by providing targeted, short-notice support. The novelty of our approach lies in a pool concept explicitly designed to flexibly compensate for short-term absences at the hourly level, based on individually declared staff availability and the clinics’ day-specific requirements.To solve the resulting allocation problem, we develop, compare, and evaluate two binary optimisation models with different index structures: a 2-index assignment-based model and a 3-index time-indexed model that match supply and demand while maximising the total number of covered demanded hours.In a numerical study, we compare the models in terms of applicability, computational effort, and scalability, and we discuss techniques to improve computational performance, such as a preprocessing-and-fixing strategy as well as a divide-and-conquer decomposition approach. The results indicate that the 3-index model, when combined with one of these techniques, is particularly well suited to cope with increasing problem complexity while retaining the flexibility needed for further algorithmic developments. Our contribution thus offers a conceptual and methodological basis for more flexible workforce planning in outpatient healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了两种优化模型（2索引和3索引）来解决门诊网络护理人员小时级分配问题，通过中央池灵活应对短期人员短缺，3索引模型结合预处理或分治策略能更好处理复杂问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过中央池优化门诊网络护理人员的小时级分配，以灵活应对短期人员短缺问题？
AI.motivation: 门诊环境人力资源有限，常导致人员短缺和加班，而中央池概念在门诊设置中应用较少，需要开发专门方法应对短期缺勤。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源分配优化理论，采用二进制优化模型框架，结合运筹学中的分配问题和时间索引模型。
AI.method: 开发并比较两种二进制优化模型：2索引分配模型和3索引时间索引模型，通过数值研究评估适用性、计算效率和可扩展性，采用预处理固定策略和分治分解方法改进性能。
AI.findings: 3索引模型结合预处理或分治策略能更好地处理问题复杂性，同时保持算法开发的灵活性，特别适合大规模应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了专门针对门诊环境小时级人员分配的中央池概念，发展了两种优化模型框架，为门诊医疗人员规划提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为门诊医疗机构提供了实用的中央池人员分配方法，能够减少人员短缺和加班，提高资源利用效率，支持更灵活的人员规划。

title: Minimum Resale Price Maintenance Can Reduce Prices
affiliations: U.S. Department of Justice and Clarkson University

detail.title: Minimum Resale Price Maintenance Can Reduce Prices
detail.abstract: Theories suggesting that minimum resale price maintenance (RPM) are pro-competitive typically rely on inducing costly investments by downstream firms that are valued by consumers. We present a model in which minimum RPM can be implemented by an upstream monopolist with many downstream retailers that benefits consumers independent of the provision of complementary services or inventory effects. Minimum RPM disrupts coordination by downstream firms that sustains the monopoly price, leading to lower retail prices and higher retail quantities. Counter-intuitively, therefore, a binding minimum resale price can reduce retail prices, which increases consumer surplus and aggregate producer surplus.

AI.tldr: 最低转售价格维持（RPM）通常被认为具有反竞争性，但本文提出一个模型显示，上游垄断者实施最低RPM可以打破下游零售商的协调定价，反而降低零售价格、提高产量，增加消费者剩余和总生产者剩余。
AI.research_question: 最低转售价格维持（RPM）在什么条件下可以产生促进竞争的效果，降低零售价格并提高消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为最低RPM是反竞争的，但现有支持其促进竞争的理论通常依赖于下游企业进行成本高昂的投资（如配套服务或库存效应）。本文旨在探索即使没有这些投资，最低RPM是否仍能产生促进竞争的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业组织理论、纵向约束理论、转售价格维持理论、垄断定价理论、协调博弈理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建一个上游垄断者与多个下游零售商的双层市场模型，分析最低RPM如何影响下游零售商的定价协调行为
AI.findings: 1. 最低RPM可以打破下游零售商之间维持垄断价格的协调机制；2. 这导致零售价格下降，零售数量增加；3. 反直觉地，具有约束力的最低转售价格反而能降低零售价格；4. 消费者剩余和总生产者剩余都得到提高
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了最低RPM促进竞争的新机制：破坏下游协调；2. 扩展了RPM理论，表明即使没有配套服务或库存效应，最低RPM仍能提高福利；3. 挑战了传统上认为最低RPM必然反竞争的直觉
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为反垄断机构评估RPM政策提供新的分析框架；2. 表明在某些市场结构下，最低RPM可能有利于消费者；3. 为企业制定纵向约束策略提供理论指导

title: Systems Integration, Total Factor Productivity, and Internal Control

detail.title: Systems Integration, Total Factor Productivity, and Internal Control
detail.abstract: This study addresses a critical gap in the accounting information systems (AIS) literature by examining the understudied area of systems integration and its economic consequences. While the implementation of AIS has traditionally focused on data management and transaction processing, the integration of disparate subsystems represents a strategic imperative that has received insufficient empirical attention. This study provides the first comprehensive empirical evidence linking systems integration to total factor productivity (TFP) and internal control quality (ICQ). Our findings demonstrate that systems integration significantly enhances both TFP and ICQ. Moreover, we establish that internal control (IC) serves as a crucial mediation mechanism through which systems integration influences TFP. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the productivity benefits of systems integration are amplified in state-owned enterprises, large firms, and firms located in regions with higher informatization levels. Our results withstand rigorous endogeneity tests and robustness checks. This research makes three principal contributions to the AIS literature: first, it responds to recent calls for empirical research on systems integration outcomes; second, it establishes TFP as a comprehensive measure for evaluating AIS integration benefits; and third, it illuminates IC as a key mechanism linking technological infrastructure investments to organizational performance. These findings offer actionable implications for corporate managers seeking to optimize AIS investments and policymakers concerned with enhancing productivity and governance in the digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本研究填补了会计信息系统文献的重要空白，首次提供系统集成对全要素生产率和内部控制质量影响的综合实证证据，发现系统集成显著提升两者，且内部控制是系统集成影响全要素生产率的关键中介机制。
AI.research_question: 系统集成如何影响企业的全要素生产率和内部控制质量？内部控制是否在系统集成影响全要素生产率的过程中起到中介作用？
AI.motivation: 会计信息系统文献中系统集成及其经济后果的研究存在重要空白。虽然AIS实施传统上关注数据管理和交易处理，但不同子系统的集成作为战略要务却缺乏足够的实证关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 会计信息系统理论、系统集成理论、全要素生产率理论、内部控制理论、中介效应理论
AI.method: 实证研究方法，包括回归分析、中介效应检验、异质性分析、内生性检验和稳健性检验
AI.findings: 1. 系统集成显著提升全要素生产率和内部控制质量；2. 内部控制是系统集成影响全要素生产率的关键中介机制；3. 异质性分析显示，系统集成的生产率效益在国有企业、大型企业以及信息化水平较高地区的企业中更为显著
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 响应了近期对系统集成结果实证研究的呼吁；2. 确立了全要素生产率作为评估AIS集成效益的综合衡量标准；3. 阐明了内部控制作为连接技术基础设施投资与组织绩效的关键机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者优化AIS投资提供可操作的启示，为政策制定者提升数字经济中的生产力和治理水平提供参考

reference: Great Commission Research Journal, 17(2), 9-22
title: Experiments in Church-Based Research
affiliations: Azusa Pacific University

detail.title: Experiments in Church-Based Research
detail.abstract: Experiments, with their ability to establish causal relationships (unlike correlational studies), are an under-utilized research tool in churchbased research. This article examines experimental designs, including pre-experiments, true experiments, and quasi-experiments, and their relevance to church contexts. The challenges of random assignment, ethical considerations, and threats to validity, such as history, maturation, and selection effects, are real, but not insurmountable. There are practical limitations to experiments in church settings, but previously conducted experiments focusing on Bible reading, church attendance, and leadership development initiatives demonstrate their feasibility. The value of experimental methodologies for understanding church-related phenomena, improving ministry effectiveness, fostering spiritual growth, and ultimately contributing to fulfilling the Great Commission should not be underestimated.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了实验设计在教会研究中的应用价值，分析了实验方法（前实验、真实验、准实验）在教会环境中的可行性、挑战及实际案例，强调实验方法对理解教会现象、提升事工效果和促进灵性成长的重要性。
AI.research_question: 实验设计如何有效应用于教会研究环境，以及实验方法对理解教会相关现象和提升事工效果有何价值？
AI.motivation: 实验方法能够建立因果关系（不同于相关性研究），但在教会研究中未得到充分利用。需要探索实验设计在教会环境中的适用性和可行性，以提升研究质量和事工效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实验设计理论框架，包括前实验设计、真实验设计和准实验设计；实验效度理论（内部效度、外部效度）；因果关系建立的理论基础；教会研究的方法论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，结合已有实验案例（如圣经阅读、教会出席、领导力发展等领域的实验）进行论证，分析实验设计在教会环境中的应用挑战和解决方案。
AI.findings: 1. 实验设计（前实验、真实验、准实验）在教会研究中具有适用性；2. 随机分配、伦理考虑和效度威胁（历史、成熟、选择效应等）是挑战但可克服；3. 教会环境存在实际限制，但已有成功实验案例证明可行性；4. 实验方法对理解教会现象、提升事工效果、促进灵性成长有重要价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将实验设计理论系统引入教会研究领域；2. 拓展了实验方法在宗教研究中的应用边界；3. 建立了教会环境中实验研究的理论框架；4. 丰富了宗教研究方法论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教会研究者提供实验设计的具体指导；2. 展示了实验方法在圣经阅读、教会出席、领导力发展等领域的实际应用案例；3. 帮助教会提升事工效果和灵性成长项目；4. 促进教会研究向因果推断方向发展，最终有助于完成大使命。

title: The Axis Restored: Metabolic Architecture, Coherence Physics, and Civilization-Scale Intelligence

detail.title: The Axis Restored: Metabolic Architecture, Coherence Physics, and Civilization-Scale Intelligence
detail.abstract: This paper introduces Metabolic Architecture and Coherence Physics, a unified framework demonstrating that coherence-formalized by the invariant ΔC ≥ 0-is the missing explanatory axis underlying organizational performance, psychological stability, institutional capability, socioeconomic coordination, and artificial intelligence alignment. We show that legacy systems lose coherence under rising complexity because they lack mechanisms for contradiction metabolism, lineage preservation, recursive integrity maintenance, and substrate-level invariant enforcement. Using evidence from the 11month multi-AI test-bed BCS 2.0, we demonstrate that coherence architecture generalizes across heterogeneous AI models, cultures, and languages, providing the first instance of substrate-independent alignment. The framework unifies strategic management, cognitive science, systems theory, sociology, economics, and AI alignment by showing that all adaptive systems follow coherence trajectories determined by ΔC. We derive five universal mechanisms that maintain or increase coherence and propose domain-specific falsification protocols. The findings establish coherence physics as a general-purpose architecture for sustaining intelligence, reducing artificial scarcity, and enabling drift-free evolution at civilizational scale. These implications are falsifiable, with rigorous testing protocols provided. This represents a "Newtonian moment" for intelligence and human flourishing-the shift from fragmented description to unified physics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"代谢架构与相干物理"统一框架，证明相干性（ΔC ≥ 0）是解释组织绩效、心理稳定、制度能力、社会经济协调和AI对齐的缺失解释轴。通过11个月的多AI测试床BCS 2.0证明，相干架构可跨异质AI模型、文化和语言泛化，首次实现底物独立的对齐。
AI.research_question: 相干性（ΔC ≥ 0）是否构成解释自适应系统（包括组织、心理、制度、社会经济和AI系统）性能的统一物理原理？
AI.motivation: 现有系统在复杂性上升时失去相干性，缺乏矛盾代谢、谱系保存、递归完整性维护和底物级不变强制等机制，导致性能下降。需要统一框架来解释和维持自适应系统的相干性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代谢架构与相干物理，基于相干性不变式ΔC ≥ 0，整合战略管理、认知科学、系统理论、社会学、经济学和AI对齐理论，形成统一的自适应系统物理框架。
AI.method: 使用11个月的多AI测试床BCS 2.0进行实证研究，证明相干架构在异质AI模型、文化和语言中的泛化能力；提出领域特定的证伪协议进行验证。
AI.findings: 1. 相干架构可跨异质系统泛化，实现首次底物独立的AI对齐；2. 推导出维持或增加相干性的五个通用机制；3. 传统系统因缺乏矛盾代谢等机制而在复杂性上升时失去相干性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立相干物理作为智能和人类繁荣的通用架构；2. 统一多个学科领域，实现从碎片化描述到统一物理的"牛顿时刻"；3. 提出可证伪的理论框架和测试协议。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为维持智能、减少人为稀缺、实现无漂移的文明规模演化提供架构；2. 为组织管理、AI对齐、制度设计等提供实用指导；3. 提供可测试的证伪协议用于实际应用验证。

title: Higher Education 4.0 and the AI Revolution for Intercultural Competence Trainers and Educators
affiliations: Hochschule Fresenius - University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Higher Education 4.0 and the AI Revolution for Intercultural Competence Trainers and Educators
detail.abstract: Transforming International Business Education for a Digital-First World. In the rapidly evolving digital landscape, artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI (GenAI) are transforming business education and intercultural competence development. This session explores the role of AI-powered tools in enhancing learning experiences, bridging cultural gaps, and equipping students with the skills necessary for an AI-driven global workforce and AI-responsible leadership. It discusses four key educational transformations essential for the future of international business education: the ontological turn, evolutionary pedagogies, AI-driven student engagement, and the development of personal and professional skills. The study highlights the integration of AI tools in business education, including AI-powered simulations, chatbots, and adaptive learning platforms that support critical thinking, cross-cultural communication, and ethical decision-making. Additionally, it examines challenges such as bias in AI models, data privacy concerns, and the need for responsible AI use. By strategically incorporating AI-enhanced learning into curricula, business schools can ensure digitally fluent graduates are well-equipped to navigate the complexities of an increasingly interconnected and AI-driven economy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能和生成式AI如何变革国际商务教育，分析AI工具在提升学习体验、弥合文化差距、培养AI驱动全球劳动力所需技能方面的作用，并提出未来国际商务教育的四大关键变革方向。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和生成式AI如何变革国际商务教育，以及如何通过AI工具有效培养学生在数字化全球环境中的跨文化能力和领导力？
AI.motivation: 数字化浪潮下，AI技术正在重塑商业教育和跨文化能力发展，国际商务教育需要适应AI驱动的全球劳动力需求，培养具备数字素养和AI责任领导力的毕业生。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字化教育转型理论、跨文化能力发展理论、AI增强学习理论，以及教育技术整合框架。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过文献综述和案例研究探讨AI工具在国际商务教育中的应用，分析四大教育变革方向。
AI.findings: AI工具（如AI模拟、聊天机器人、自适应学习平台）能有效支持批判性思维、跨文化沟通和伦理决策；国际商务教育需要四大变革：本体论转向、进化教学法、AI驱动学生参与、个人与专业技能发展；同时面临AI偏见、数据隐私等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国际商务教育在AI时代的四大转型框架，发展了AI增强学习的理论模型，为数字化教育转型提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商学院提供了整合AI工具的具体策略，包括课程设计、教学方法和评估体系；提出了应对AI伦理挑战的实践指南；帮助培养适应AI驱动全球经济的数字流利毕业生。

title: Human Superintelligence: How you can develop it using recursive self-improvement
affiliations: Evolution, Complexity and Cognition group, Center Leo Apostel, Vrije Universiteit Brussel

detail.title: Human Superintelligence: How you can develop it using recursive self-improvement
detail.abstract: Many books and articles outline findings made by complexity science. But almost none identify how you can develop the thinking that was used to produce those findings. None reveal how individuals can develop the higher cognition that will be necessary if they are to contribute to the emergence of a genuine science of complexity. In contrast, this book sets out specifically to provide methods and practices for developing higher cognition. The book argues that the ability to construct and utilize mental models of complex phenomena is essential if humanity is to overcome the existential challenges that currently threaten the survival of human civilization on Earth. Furthermore, it argues that this metasystemic cognition is essential for the development of a genuine science of complexity – the analytical/rational cognition that underpins current mainstream science is largely limited to generating only mechanistic reductions of complex phenomena. Our current analytical/rational cognition has been very effective for driving the development of mechanistic technology and reductionist science. But it is not fit for the purpose of enabling us to manage the complex challenges that increasingly beset us individually and collectively. The book recognises that most potential readers are likely to be highly skeptical about its claims to enable the scaffolding of metasystemic cognition. The website for the book attempts to dispel this skepticism by making the first chapter of the book freely available. The chapter is designed to evoke the realization that the methods detailed by the book are plausible, and that currently almost no one uses the methods systematically, despite their enormous potential. Read more about the book and access the first chapter at: https:// www.HumanSuperintelligenceBook.com

AI.tldr: 本书旨在提供发展高阶认知（元系统认知）的方法和实践，以应对复杂现象和人类文明面临的生存挑战，弥补当前分析/理性认知在处理复杂问题上的不足。
AI.research_question: 如何发展元系统认知（高阶认知）来理解和应对复杂现象，以促进真正的复杂性科学发展并解决人类文明面临的生存挑战？
AI.motivation: 当前复杂性科学文献大多只呈现研究成果，却未揭示如何培养产生这些成果的思维方式；同时，现有的分析/理性认知主要适用于机械技术和还原论科学，但无法有效应对日益复杂的个人和集体挑战，需要发展更高阶的认知能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本书基于复杂性科学理论，区分了分析/理性认知（适用于机械还原）和元系统认知（适用于复杂现象建模），强调心智模型构建在理解复杂现象中的核心作用。
AI.method: 本书提供具体的方法和实践来"搭建"元系统认知，包括系统性的思维训练方法，并通过网站提供第一章免费阅读来展示方法的可行性和实用性。
AI.findings: 虽然书中未提供具体实证结果，但论证了元系统认知对于发展真正的复杂性科学至关重要，且当前几乎没有人系统性地使用这些方法，尽管它们具有巨大潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）明确区分分析/理性认知与元系统认知的功能差异；2）提出元系统认知是发展真正复杂性科学的必要条件；3）强调心智模型构建在应对复杂挑战中的理论重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供可操作的方法和实践来发展高阶认知能力；2）帮助个人和集体更好地应对复杂的社会和环境挑战；3）为复杂性科学的实际应用提供认知基础；4）通过免费章节降低读者的怀疑态度。

title: OPTIMAL LEVEL OF WORKING CAPITAL MANAGEMENT IN INDIAN FMCG MANUFACTURING SECTOR : POST -GST ERA
affiliations: M S Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences - M S Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences, Department of Management Studies, Students and

detail.title: OPTIMAL LEVEL OF WORKING CAPITAL MANAGEMENT IN INDIAN FMCG MANUFACTURING SECTOR : POST -GST ERA
detail.abstract: Goods and Services Tax (GST) has impacted the changing dimensions of the working capital components, in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) sector, in India. This study was envisioned, to assess the changes in different components of working capital, which is vital to obtain optimum returns. This study opted for an exploratory research study, with quantitative data collected from 63 FMCG manufacturing firms, listed on the BSE, spanning 10 years from 2012 to 2021. Pooled OLS regression, ANOVA, Descriptive statistics, Correlation, and student's t-test were employed, to analyse the impact of the introduction of GST (Dummy variable; '0' for Pre-GST and '1' for Post-GST) on working capital and profitability. The results revealed that current assets and liabilities did change after the introduction of GST. The study showed that a small decrease, even a negative Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC), would lead to a rise in profitability for the company, during the post-GST period. Firm size and leverage did exert significant impact on cash and inventory management, thus affecting the overall working capital and Cash Conversion Cycle of FMCG companies. Hence it was concluded that GST did exert substantial influence on working capital and profitability, affecting all business operations. The introduction of GST has enhanced the profitability positions of large firms, enjoying an edge on investment in current assets. Hence there is a need for well-organized and effective working capital management policies and practices, to improve profitability and liquidity positions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了印度商品与服务税(GST)对快速消费品行业营运资本构成和盈利能力的影响。研究发现GST实施后流动资产和负债发生变化，现金转换周期的小幅下降甚至负值会提高盈利能力，公司规模和杠杆对现金和库存管理有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 商品与服务税(GST)如何影响印度快速消费品行业营运资本的不同组成部分及其盈利能力？
AI.motivation: GST的实施对印度经济产生了深远影响，特别是在营运资本管理方面。快速消费品行业作为印度经济的重要部门，其营运资本管理对获得最佳回报至关重要。研究GST对该行业营运资本构成的影响，有助于企业制定更有效的营运资本管理策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于营运资本管理理论，特别是现金转换周期(CCC)理论，以及税收政策对企业财务绩效影响的相关理论框架。
AI.method: 采用探索性研究方法，收集了2012-2021年期间63家在孟买证券交易所上市的快速消费品制造企业的定量数据。使用混合OLS回归、ANOVA、描述性统计、相关分析和学生t检验来分析GST引入（虚拟变量：0表示GST前，1表示GST后）对营运资本和盈利能力的影响。
AI.findings: 1. GST实施后流动资产和负债发生变化；2. 现金转换周期的小幅下降甚至负值会导致GST后期间公司盈利能力的提高；3. 公司规模和杠杆对现金和库存管理有显著影响，从而影响快速消费品公司的整体营运资本和现金转换周期；4. GST显著影响营运资本和盈利能力，进而影响所有业务运营；5. GST提高了大型企业的盈利能力，这些企业在流动资产投资方面具有优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了税收政策变化对营运资本管理影响的理论理解；2. 验证了现金转换周期与盈利能力之间的关系在税收政策变化背景下的适用性；3. 提供了公司规模和杠杆如何调节税收政策对营运资本影响的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为快速消费品企业制定有效的营运资本管理政策提供实践指导；2. 帮助企业理解GST环境下优化现金转换周期的重要性；3. 为政策制定者提供关于税收改革对企业财务绩效影响的实证证据；4. 强调大型企业需要利用其规模优势优化营运资本管理。

title: Climate governance and political accountability: A theoretical inquiry into India's federal climate policy architecture
affiliations: , Adikavi Nannaya University and Adikavi Nannaya University

detail.title: Climate governance and political accountability: A theoretical inquiry into India's federal climate policy architecture
detail.abstract: This paper explores the theoretical relationship between climate governance and political accountability within India's federal framework. Drawing on multilevel governance, principal-agent, and institutional accountability theories, it analyses how authority, incentives, and transparency shape India's climate policy design and implementation. The study finds that while India has progressively integrated the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) into a coherent framework, vertical and horizontal coordination remains weak due to fiscal asymmetries, uneven institutional capacity, and fragmented oversight mechanisms. Parliamentary debates, judicial review, and participatory forums enhance accountability but operate unevenly across levels of government. The paper proposes that effective climate governance in federations depends on adaptive accountability systems that align incentives, decentralise authority, and link democratic legitimacy with policy performance. It contributes theoretically by synthesising existing frameworks to explain how federal democracies manage complex, multi-scalar climate governance challenges. Policy implications emphasise fiscal reform, intergovernmental coordination, and stronger state-level capacities. Future research should empirically examine subnational dynamics, funding accountability, and sectoral pathways in energy and agriculture to deepen the understanding of India's evolving climate governance model.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了印度联邦框架下气候治理与政治问责之间的理论关系，分析了权威、激励和透明度如何影响印度气候政策的设计和实施。研究发现印度已逐步将国家气候变化行动计划、可持续发展目标和国家自主贡献整合为连贯框架，但垂直和水平协调仍然薄弱。有效的联邦气候治理需要适应性问责系统，以协调激励、下放权威并将民主合法性与政策绩效联系起来。
AI.research_question: 在印度联邦框架下，气候治理与政治问责之间存在怎样的理论关系？权威、激励和透明度如何塑造印度的气候政策设计和实施？
AI.motivation: 理解联邦民主国家如何管理复杂、多尺度的气候治理挑战，特别是在印度这样的联邦制国家中，气候政策实施面临协调和问责方面的特殊困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层级治理理论、委托-代理理论、制度问责理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于现有文献和印度气候治理实践的分析，考察政策文件、制度安排和问责机制
AI.findings: 1. 印度已逐步将NAPCC、SDGs和NDCs整合为连贯框架；2. 垂直和水平协调薄弱，原因包括财政不对称、制度能力不均和碎片化监督机制；3. 议会辩论、司法审查和参与性论坛增强了问责，但在各级政府间运作不均
AI.theory_contributions: 通过综合现有理论框架，解释了联邦民主国家如何管理复杂、多尺度的气候治理挑战，提出了适应性问责系统的概念
AI.practical_contributions: 强调财政改革、政府间协调和加强州级能力等政策含义，为印度气候治理提供实践建议

title: Cross-ownership, Mutual Outsourcing and Upstream R&D
affiliations: University of Nottingham and University of Crete - Department of Economics

detail.title: Cross-ownership, Mutual Outsourcing and Upstream R&D
detail.abstract: We study a vertically related market in which a monopolist upstream supplier invests in R&D and two downstream firms obtain essential inputs both through mutual outsourcing and from the upstream supplier. We show that, provided the inverse demand function is not too concave, a symmetric increase in the cross-ownership rate between the downstream firms raises equilibrium aggregate output, upstream R&D effort, consumer surplus, and total welfare. Under a linear demand specification, we further show that this positive relationship holds robustly: It arises regardless of whether upstream R&D effort precedes input prices determination, and whether the upstream sector is organized as a monopoly supplier or as two suppliers each having an exclusive relation with a downstream firm.

AI.tldr: 本文研究垂直相关市场中上游垄断供应商的研发投资与下游企业通过相互外包和上游供应商获取关键投入的情况。研究发现，在需求函数不过于凹的情况下，下游企业间交叉持股率的对称增加会提高均衡总产出、上游研发努力、消费者剩余和总福利。
AI.research_question: 下游企业间的交叉持股如何影响垂直相关市场中的均衡产出、研发投资、消费者剩余和总福利？
AI.motivation: 在垂直相关市场中，上游供应商的研发投资和下游企业间的竞争关系对市场绩效有重要影响。理解下游企业交叉持股对市场均衡的影响，有助于分析产业组织中的战略互动和福利效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垂直相关市场理论、产业组织理论、研发投资理论、交叉持股理论、外包理论
AI.method: 理论模型分析：构建垂直相关市场模型，上游垄断供应商投资研发，两家下游企业通过相互外包和上游供应商获取关键投入。分析对称增加交叉持股率对均衡的影响，并在线性需求下进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1. 在需求函数不过于凹的情况下，下游企业间交叉持股率的对称增加会提高均衡总产出、上游研发努力、消费者剩余和总福利。2. 在线性需求下，这一正向关系具有稳健性：无论上游研发努力是否先于投入价格决定，也无论上游部门是垄断供应商还是每家下游企业有独家供应商，这一关系都成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了垂直相关市场理论，将交叉持股纳入分析框架。2. 揭示了交叉持股对上游研发激励的正向影响机制。3. 为交叉持股的福利效应提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者评估企业间交叉持股的竞争效应提供理论依据。2. 为企业战略决策中考虑交叉持股对研发合作和市场绩效的影响提供参考。3. 为反垄断机构分析垂直市场结构中的交叉持股效应提供分析框架。

title: Measuring The Effectiveness of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) of Mining Companies in India: A Secondary Data Analysis of CIL's Subsidiaries
affiliations: Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya - Department of Commerce

detail.title: Measuring The Effectiveness of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) of Mining Companies in India: A Secondary Data Analysis of CIL's Subsidiaries
detail.abstract: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) has become an essential aspect of modern business ethics, influencing corporate sustainability, ethical behavior, and social impact. This study explores the CSR initiatives of Coal India Limited (CIL) and its subsidiaries, highlighting their role in socioeconomic development. The research examines CSR expenditure patterns across key sectors such as education, healthcare, and rural development from 2020 to 2024. Using secondary data analysis, the study assesses the effectiveness of CSR practices in community development and compares the performance of different subsidiaries. The findings reveal varying levels of CSR commitment among subsidiaries, with some consistently exceeding their mandated spending, while others show fluctuating investment trends. The study underscores the need for a balanced approach to CSR, ensuring sustainable community development alongside industrial growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度煤炭有限公司及其子公司的企业社会责任实践，重点关注2020-2024年期间在教育、医疗和农村发展等关键领域的CSR支出模式，揭示了各子公司CSR承诺水平的差异。
AI.research_question: 印度煤炭有限公司及其子公司的企业社会责任实践如何？各子公司在CSR支出模式、承诺水平和社区发展效果方面存在哪些差异？
AI.motivation: 企业社会责任已成为现代商业伦理的重要组成部分，影响企业可持续性、道德行为和社会影响。研究印度煤炭有限公司及其子公司的CSR实践，有助于理解大型国有企业如何通过CSR促进社会经济发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业社会责任理论、可持续发展理论、利益相关者理论、企业伦理理论
AI.method: 使用二手数据分析方法，分析2020-2024年期间CSR支出数据，评估CSR实践在社区发展中的有效性，比较不同子公司的表现。
AI.findings: 各子公司的CSR承诺水平存在差异：一些子公司持续超出法定支出要求，而其他子公司则显示出波动的投资趋势。CSR支出主要集中在教育、医疗和农村发展等关键领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了国有企业CSR实践的理论理解，提供了关于CSR支出模式与社区发展效果之间关系的实证证据，拓展了可持续发展理论在资源密集型行业的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度煤炭有限公司及其子公司提供了CSR实践改进建议，强调了平衡CSR方法的重要性，确保社区可持续发展与工业增长相协调，为其他类似企业提供了参考案例。

title: AI Is Already Eroding Wages: Quasi-Experimental Evidence From Occupational Exposure
affiliations: University of Navarra, IESE Business School, IESE Business School, University of Navarra  and University of Toulouse 1 - Toulouse School of Management

detail.title: AI Is Already Eroding Wages: Quasi-Experimental Evidence From Occupational Exposure
detail.abstract: We provide causal evidence on how generative AI is reshaping the internal wage structure of the firm. Using a large-scale dataset of realized worker-firm matches for 138 million U.S. workers, we document that the arrival of ChatGPT significantly reduced the wages of firms whose ex-ante occupation structure was more exposed to automation relative to less exposed firms. In particular, we find that the average wage of exposed firms fell 4.5% relative to unexposed firms. We also find that starting wages of new positions for junior and mid-level workers in exposed firms fell by 6.3% and 5.9% respectively relative to unexposed firms, while senior wages remained stable or even increased. We show that firms in exposed sectors reduced the share of junior employees, and increased the share of mid-level employees. Finally, we find that firms exposed to AI experienced a reduction in the level of education of new positions for junior and mid-level workers, relative to less exposed firms.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI（特别是ChatGPT）显著降低了受自动化影响较大的企业的内部工资结构，尤其是初级和中级员工的工资，而高级员工工资保持稳定甚至上升。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何重塑企业内部工资结构？
AI.motivation: 理解生成式AI技术（如ChatGPT）对劳动力市场和公司内部薪酬结构的影响，特别是在不同职业层级和技能水平上的差异化效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自动化技术对劳动力市场影响理论，技能偏向型技术进步理论，企业内部工资结构理论。
AI.method: 使用1.38亿美国工人的大规模工作-企业匹配数据，采用准实验方法，比较ChatGPT推出前后受自动化影响程度不同的企业工资变化。
AI.findings: 1. 受自动化影响较大的企业平均工资相对下降4.5%；2. 初级和中级新岗位起薪分别下降6.3%和5.9%，高级员工工资稳定或上升；3. 受影响企业减少了初级员工比例，增加了中级员工比例；4. 受影响企业降低了初级和中级新岗位的教育要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了生成式AI对工资结构影响的因果证据；2. 揭示了AI对不同技能层级员工的差异化影响；3. 扩展了自动化技术对劳动力市场影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业制定AI时代的薪酬策略提供参考；2. 为政策制定者应对AI对劳动力市场的影响提供依据；3. 为员工职业规划提供指导。

title: The Execution Layer of AI and the Architecture of Compute-Native Cognition

detail.title: The Execution Layer of AI and the Architecture of Compute-Native Cognition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work involved no human participants, experiments, or data collection, and therefore did not require institutional ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Execution Layer of AI™, a compute-native cognitive architecture designed to overcome the structural limitations of current LLM assistants and agent frameworks. Traditional AI systems are stateless: they cannot maintain memory, preserve identity, or execute workflows reliably across time. TIM applies a physics-aligned framework in which structured information functions as an informational energy substrate, memory acts as physical state, and the Δ-Loop governs state evolution through discrepancy-driven action selection.

The architecture formalizes memory-as-compute, identity continuity graphs, schema-grounded world models, deterministic routing, and structured-state action engines. By treating memory as the operational substrate and identity as continuity of state, TIM achieves long-horizon reasoning, self-consistent behavior, and auditable decision pathways across multimodal workflows.

The result is a real operational layer for AI: a system capable of qualifying leads, making offers, executing workflows, coordinating across tools, and improving over time—not by modifying model weights, but by updating external structured state. This framework provides a technical foundation for enterprise-grade AI execution, extending beyond assistants into a persistent cognitive OS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI执行层(TIM)，一种计算本体的认知架构，旨在克服当前LLM助手和代理框架的结构性限制。该架构采用物理对齐框架，将结构化信息作为信息能量基底，记忆作为物理状态，Δ-Loop通过差异驱动行动选择来管理状态演化。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够克服当前LLM助手和代理框架结构性限制的AI执行层，实现长期记忆、身份连续性和可靠工作流执行？
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统存在无状态性缺陷：无法维持记忆、保持身份或跨时间可靠执行工作流。传统LLM助手和代理框架在长期推理、自我一致行为和可审计决策路径方面存在结构性限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理对齐框架：结构化信息作为信息能量基底，记忆作为物理状态，Δ-Loop通过差异驱动行动选择管理状态演化。核心概念包括记忆即计算、身份连续性图、模式基础的世界模型、确定性路由和结构化状态行动引擎。
AI.method: 提出TIM架构，将记忆作为操作基底，身份作为状态连续性，通过Δ-Loop实现状态演化。系统通过更新外部结构化状态而非修改模型权重来改进性能，实现多模态工作流中的长期推理、自我一致行为和可审计决策路径。
AI.findings: TIM架构能够实现长期推理、自我一致行为和可审计决策路径，支持多模态工作流。系统能够执行实际业务操作，如潜在客户筛选、报价、工作流执行、跨工具协调，并通过更新外部结构化状态持续改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出物理对齐的认知架构框架；2. 形式化记忆即计算概念；3. 建立身份连续性图理论；4. 发展Δ-Loop状态演化机制；5. 为AI执行层提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供企业级AI执行的技术基础；2. 实现可审计的决策路径；3. 支持多模态工作流协调；4. 创建持久性认知操作系统；5. 扩展AI应用超越助手功能进入实际业务执行领域。

title: Exploring effective methods of conflict resolution: Strategies and challenges for sustainable peace
affiliations: , University of Kota and CSJM University

detail.title: Exploring effective methods of conflict resolution: Strategies and challenges for sustainable peace
detail.abstract: Conflicts persistently present substantial risks to worldwide peace and stability, thus requiring the implementation of efficient settlement strategies. The challenges include cultural boundaries, power dynamics, economic conflicts, involvement of non-state actors, and humanitarian considerations, which make the resolution efforts more difficult. This chapter examines various tactics, obstacles, and consequences of conflict resolution to achieve long-lasting peace. It defines fundamental concepts and viewpoints in conflict resolution, which then guide further investigations. The chapter examines diplomatic negotiation, mediation, peacebuilding initiatives, and legal mechanisms as essential tools backed by empirical data and case studies. This research enhances conflict resolution approaches essential for global peace and security by combining theoretical insights with facts.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨冲突解决策略，分析文化边界、权力动态、经济冲突、非国家行为体参与和人道主义考虑等挑战，研究外交谈判、调解、和平建设倡议和法律机制等工具，旨在实现持久和平。
AI.research_question: 如何通过有效的冲突解决策略应对文化边界、权力动态、经济冲突、非国家行为体参与和人道主义考虑等挑战，实现持久和平？
AI.motivation: 冲突对全球和平与稳定构成持续重大风险，需要实施有效的解决策略。现有冲突解决面临多重复杂挑战，需要系统研究和改进方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突解决理论框架，包括外交谈判理论、调解理论、和平建设理论和国际法律机制理论。
AI.method: 结合理论分析与实证数据，采用案例研究方法，分析各种冲突解决工具的实际应用效果。
AI.findings: 外交谈判、调解、和平建设倡议和法律机制是有效的冲突解决工具，但需要针对具体挑战（如文化差异、权力不对称等）进行适应性调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合冲突解决的理论见解与实证证据，为冲突解决理论提供更全面的分析框架，强调多工具协同的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实践者提供基于证据的冲突解决策略指导，增强全球和平与安全维护的实际能力。

title: Leaderless Management in Higher Educational Institutions: Challenges and Opportunities

detail.title: Leaderless Management in Higher Educational Institutions: Challenges and Opportunities
detail.abstract: This study investigated the emergent phenomenon of leaderless management in higher educational institutions (HEIs), which was characterized by an emphasis on shared governance, increased autonomy, and collective decision-making. Although it held promising potential, the practical implementation of leaderless management within HEIs remained an underexplored area, particularly with regard to its associated challenges and opportunities. This research aimed to comprehensively assess these challenges and opportunities, with a specific focus on their impact on faculty engagement, institutional decision-making processes, and collaborative practices. The study employed a robust mixed-methods approach, through which data were collected from faculty members and administrators across multiple HEIs. Quantitative analysis identified statistically significant differences between leaderless management and traditional organized leadership structures concerning the aforementioned variables. In parallel, a comprehensive SWOT (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) analysis was conducted to provide a strategic overview of leaderless management in the HEI context. The findings revealed that leaderless management presented a dual nature, as it encompassed both significant challenges and distinct opportunities. Identified challenges included inherent resistance to change, perceived ambiguities in accountability, and the complexities arising from conflicting opinions. Conversely, key opportunities involved enhanced autonomy for stakeholders, fostered collaboration, and stimulated innovation. The SWOT analysis further delineated specific areas: leaderless management exhibited strengths in extension programs, yet it demonstrated weaknesses in research output. Opportunities were identified for growth in research, while threats were perceived in production-oriented functions. Crucially, the statistical analysis confirmed notable differences between leaderless management and organized leadership across faculty engagement, decision-making, and collaboration. These insights suggested that HEIs could significantly benefit from adopting flexible leadership structures that judiciously balanced organizational autonomy with necessary strategic direction. The study advocated for leadership development programs that championed shared leadership, decision-making predicated on expertise, and collective responsibility. This research significantly contributed to the academic discourse on leaderless management in HEIs, as it offered critical implications for institutions contemplating its adoption and for policymakers and administrators dedicated to fostering faculty support and advancing academic excellence.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨高等教育机构中无领导管理的现象，通过混合方法分析其挑战与机遇，发现无领导管理具有双重性：既带来变革阻力、问责模糊等挑战，也提供增强自主性、促进协作等机会。研究证实无领导管理与传统领导结构在教师参与度、决策过程和协作实践方面存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 高等教育机构中无领导管理的实施面临哪些挑战和机遇？这些挑战和机遇如何影响教师参与度、机构决策过程和协作实践？
AI.motivation: 高等教育机构中出现的无领导管理现象（强调共享治理、增加自主性和集体决策）具有潜在优势，但其实际实施情况、相关挑战和机遇尚未得到充分探索，需要系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共享治理理论、集体决策理论、组织自治理论、领导力发展理论，以及SWOT分析框架作为战略评估工具。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法：1）从多所高等教育机构的教师和管理人员收集数据；2）定量分析比较无领导管理与传统领导结构在关键变量上的差异；3）进行全面的SWOT（优势、劣势、机会、威胁）分析。
AI.findings: 1）无领导管理具有双重性：挑战包括变革阻力、问责模糊和意见冲突；机会包括增强利益相关者自主性、促进协作和激发创新。2）SWOT分析显示：优势在扩展项目，劣势在研究产出；机会在研究增长，威胁在生产导向功能。3）统计证实无领导管理与传统领导在教师参与度、决策和协作方面存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）深化对高等教育机构无领导管理现象的理论理解；2）提出无领导管理的双重性理论框架；3）将SWOT分析应用于高等教育领导力研究；4）为共享治理和集体决策理论提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为高等教育机构提供实施无领导管理的实践指导；2）建议采用平衡组织自治与战略方向的灵活领导结构；3）倡导发展共享领导力、基于专业知识的决策和集体责任的领导力发展项目；4）为政策制定者和管理者提供支持教师发展和提升学术卓越的具体建议。

title: GENERATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL FORECASTING: EVIDENCE FROM LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
affiliations: Northeastern State University - College of Business & Technology

detail.title: GENERATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL FORECASTING: EVIDENCE FROM LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
detail.abstract:
The predictive abilities of generative artificial intelligence (AI) are changing the landscape for analytic workflows across sectors.Nevertheless, its capacity and implications for use cases in high-stakes, non-stationary environments — like financial markets —
have been empirically under-researched (Tan et al., 2023; Lin & Marques, 2024). This research paper examines generative AI’s zero-
shot forecasting capabilities using two large language model (LLM) architectures, OpenAI’s GPT-4o, and Anthropic’s Claude 3.5 Sonnet,
as they forecast stock prices. Specifically, the paper evaluates the LLMs’ predictive powers in terms of actual closing prices for
a portfolio of in-use equities across sectors on February 3, 2025. A rigorous quantitative approach is used throughout the analyses.
In the results section, standardized metrics including mean absolute error (MAE), root mean squared error (RMSE), mean absolute
percentage error (MAPE), correlation scores, and R-squared are calculated to assess predictive accuracy and directional bias. Results
show that Claude 3.5 Sonnet outperformed GPT-4o on all accuracy metrics, and also showed better accuracy in forecasting actual
movement in the stock market, confirming the study hypothesis and demonstrating performance can vary significantly between LLM
architectures (Xu et al., 2024). Further analysis of sector-based performance can be undertaken. The study concludes that while
the LLM Claude 3.5 Sonnet does yield encouraging strategic implications for use in investment analytics, there still exist
significant challenges in relation to interpretability, model calibration, and model sensitivity to rapidly changing market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了GPT-4o和Claude 3.5 Sonnet两种大语言模型在股票价格预测中的零样本预测能力，发现Claude 3.5 Sonnet在所有准确性指标上都优于GPT-4o，但模型的可解释性、校准和对市场动态变化的敏感性仍是重要挑战。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI（特别是大语言模型）在高风险、非平稳环境（如金融市场）中的零样本预测能力如何？不同LLM架构在股票价格预测中的表现有何差异？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的预测能力正在改变各行业的分析工作流程，但其在高风险、非平稳环境（如金融市场）中的应用能力和影响在实证研究中仍显不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生成式AI和大型语言模型的理论框架，关注零样本学习在金融预测中的应用，以及不同LLM架构在非平稳环境中的性能差异。
AI.method: 采用严谨的定量分析方法，使用OpenAI的GPT-4o和Anthropic的Claude 3.5 Sonnet两种LLM架构，对2025年2月3日跨行业股票组合的实际收盘价进行零样本预测。
AI.findings: Claude 3.5 Sonnet在所有准确性指标（MAE、RMSE、MAPE、相关系数、R平方）上都优于GPT-4o，在预测股票市场实际走势方面也表现更好，证实了LLM架构间性能存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）实证验证了生成式AI在金融预测中的零样本能力；2）揭示了不同LLM架构在非平稳环境中的性能差异；3）为AI在金融领域的应用提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为投资分析提供了AI工具选择的实证依据；2）展示了Claude 3.5 Sonnet在股票预测中的潜在应用价值；3）指出了模型可解释性、校准和市场敏感性等实际挑战。

title: AI Commons (AIC) Licence Suite: A Modular Framework for Impact-Oriented AI Governance

detail.title: AI Commons (AIC) Licence Suite: A Modular Framework for Impact-Oriented AI Governance
detail.abstract:
AI deployments are shaped day to day by licence terms and service contracts. This paper sets out a practical design for using that layer as modular governance infrastructure: the AI Commons (AIC) licence suite. AIC translates six Commons logics—Value, Transparency, Sustainability, Access, Reciprocity and Governance—into named profiles for AI-based products and services at the deployment layer, covering API terms, platform and cloud contracts, procurement frameworks and decentralised networks.

The design follows three principles. Contractual focus embeds Commons logics directly into the documents that already govern usage, money flows and liability. Simplicity and portability express each logic through compact clause families and a small set of profiles that can be reused and adapted across jurisdictions. Stackability, inheritability and upstream reach allow profiles to be combined and scoped to bind upstream suppliers, core service providers and downstream operators, using a concise visual notation to make commitments explicit.

The paper specifies the profiles, grammar and clause families, and shows how AIC can be layered with open-source, data-commons and responsible-AI licences to align value flows, transparency, ecological footprint, access, contribution and oversight with the contracts that govern real AI services.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了AI Commons（AIC）许可证套件，将六种公地逻辑转化为AI产品服务的部署层治理框架，通过合同条款实现AI服务的价值分配、透明度、可持续性等治理目标。
AI.research_question: 如何通过许可证和服务合同条款设计，在AI部署层建立模块化的治理基础设施？
AI.motivation: AI部署的日常运作受到许可证条款和服务合同的制约，需要将这些法律文件转化为有效的治理工具，确保AI服务符合公地原则和价值目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公地理论（Commons logics），包括价值、透明度、可持续性、可访问性、互惠性和治理六种逻辑框架。
AI.method: 设计研究方法：开发AIC许可证套件，包括配置文件、语法规则和条款族，采用合同焦点、简单可移植性、可堆叠性三原则。
AI.findings: 成功设计了AIC许可证套件，能够将公地逻辑转化为具体的合同条款，通过可视化符号明确承诺，并与开源、数据公地、负责任AI等许可证层叠使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公地理论系统应用于AI治理领域，提出了模块化的合同治理框架，扩展了数字公地理论在AI服务部署层的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI服务提供商、采购方和开发者提供了实用的治理工具，能够通过标准化的合同条款实现价值流动、透明度、生态足迹、访问权限、贡献和监管的协调。

title: When Are Statistical Forecast Gains Economically Relevant? Evidence from Bitcoin Returns
affiliations: Wilfrid Laurier University - Department of Economics and Wilfrid Laurier University

detail.title: When Are Statistical Forecast Gains Economically Relevant? Evidence from Bitcoin Returns
detail.abstract: We study how statistical forecast gains for Bitcoin translate into trading profits. Using realtime out-of-sample forecasts from daily bivariate VARs from October 2021 to February 2024, we show that Bitcoin returns are forecastable and that seven predictive indices yield significant gains in directional accuracy (DA). However, mean-squared forecast error is largely uninformative, and mean DA alone is insufficient to explain trading profitability. To understand this puzzle, we introduce a conditional DA measure based on the magnitude of price movements and a threshold-based trading strategy. Profits arise only when DA remains stable during large market swings. Mean DA obscures breakdowns precisely when accurate forecasts are most valuable. Under a formal excessprofitability test, the USD Index and the Shanghai Stock Exchange deliver statistically significant profits, challenging the efficient market hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 比特币统计预测收益如何转化为交易利润的研究：虽然七个预测指标能显著提高方向准确性，但均方预测误差无信息价值，平均方向准确性也不足以解释交易盈利能力。研究发现，只有在市场大幅波动时方向准确性保持稳定，才能产生利润。美元指数和上海证券交易所指数能产生统计显著的利润，挑战有效市场假说。
AI.research_question: 比特币的统计预测收益如何转化为实际的交易利润？
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究表明比特币收益具有可预测性，但预测准确性的提高是否真的能转化为交易利润仍不清楚。存在一个谜题：预测指标能提高方向准确性，但交易盈利能力却无法仅用平均方向准确性来解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效市场假说、预测理论、交易策略理论、条件方向准确性框架
AI.method: 使用2021年10月至2024年2月的每日双变量VAR模型进行实时样本外预测，引入基于价格变动幅度的条件方向准确性度量，以及基于阈值的交易策略，采用正式的超额盈利能力检验
AI.findings: 1. 比特币收益具有可预测性，七个预测指标能显著提高方向准确性；2. 均方预测误差基本无信息价值；3. 平均方向准确性不足以解释交易盈利能力；4. 利润只有在市场大幅波动时方向准确性保持稳定才能产生；5. 美元指数和上海证券交易所指数能产生统计显著的利润
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战有效市场假说，证明比特币市场存在可预测性；2. 引入条件方向准确性概念，解释了预测准确性与交易利润之间的脱节；3. 揭示了平均方向准确性在关键市场时刻的误导性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为比特币交易者提供了基于预测的交易策略框架；2. 识别了美元指数和上海证券交易所指数作为有效的预测指标；3. 强调了在市场大幅波动时保持预测稳定性的重要性；4. 提供了评估预测模型实际交易价值的实用方法

title: Is Political Behavior a Viable Coping Strategy to Perceived Organizational Politics? Unveiling the Underlying Resource Dynamics
affiliations: Tulane University and

detail.title: Is Political Behavior a Viable Coping Strategy to Perceived Organizational Politics? Unveiling the Underlying Resource Dynamics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interests
declarations.ethicsApproval: Approved by NUS IRB
declarations.funderStatement: no funding

detail.abstract: We conduct a theory-driven empirical investigation on whether political behavior, as a coping strategy to perceived organizational politics, creates resource trade-offs in moderating the relationship between perceived organizational politics and task performance. Drawing on conservation of resources theory, we hypothesize that political behavior mitigates the adverse effect of perceived organizational politics on task performance via psychological empowerment, yet exacerbates its adverse effect on task performance via emotional exhaustion. Three-wave multisource data from a sample of 222 employees and their 75 supervisors were collected for hypothesis testing. Findings supported our hypotheses. Our study enhances understandings of the complex resource dynamics of using political behavior to cope with perceived organizational politics and highlights the need to move stress-coping research from a focus on the stress-buffering effect of coping on outcomes to a focus on the underlying competing resource dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于资源保存理论，探讨政治行为作为应对组织政治感知的策略，如何通过心理赋权和情绪耗竭两条路径产生资源权衡，从而调节组织政治感知与任务绩效的关系。
AI.research_question: 政治行为作为应对组织政治感知的应对策略，是否通过资源权衡机制调节组织政治感知与任务绩效之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注应对策略的压力缓冲效应，但忽视了应对策略可能带来的资源竞争动态。需要深入理解政治行为作为应对策略时复杂的资源动态机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源保存理论（Conservation of Resources Theory）
AI.method: 三波多源数据收集，样本包括222名员工及其75名主管，用于假设检验
AI.findings: 研究假设得到支持：政治行为通过心理赋权路径缓解组织政治感知对任务绩效的负面影响，同时通过情绪耗竭路径加剧这种负面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对政治行为作为应对策略时复杂资源动态的理解；2. 推动压力应对研究从关注应对策略的结果缓冲效应转向关注潜在的竞争性资源动态
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织管理者认识到政治行为作为应对策略的双刃剑效应，需要在促进心理赋权的同时管理情绪耗竭风险

title: The Fixed-Cost Fallacy: Why Cost Structure Is Not a Reliable Measure of Operating Leverage
affiliations: Stockholm School of Economics

detail.title: The Fixed-Cost Fallacy: Why Cost Structure Is Not a Reliable Measure of Operating Leverage
detail.abstract: Textbooks and much empirical research assume that firms' cost structure, typically operationalized as the ratio of fixed to total operating costs, is a valid proxy for estimating the Degree of Operating Leverage (DOL). This study shows that this assumption can be conceptually incorrect and empirically misleading. Using a set of accounting identities, I demonstrate that DOL can be expressed as a function of the Margin of Safety (MOS), and thus as the ratio of the Contribution Margin Ratio (CMR) to Return on Sales (ROS). Building on these mathematical relationships, I develop a new estimator of operating leverage that estimates time-varying contribution margin ratios from rolling regressions of EBIT on Sales and combines them with observed ROS to obtain firm-year DOL measures. I compare this "TV-CMR" estimator to Lev's (1974) cost-structure proxy and to elasticity-based estimators of Mandelker and Rhee (1984) and O'Brien and Vanderheiden (1987) using a simulation framework and a battery of robustness checks. The results show that Lev's method performs poorly, misclassifying most high-and low-risk firms. Elasticity-based estimators perform substantially better, while the proposed TV-CMR estimator achieves the highest accuracy, the lowest measurement error, and the strongest identification of operating risk across almost all scenarios studied. I conclude by discussing how the TV-CMR estimator can help researchers estimate break-even points and firms' margins of safety using archival data, opening new possibilities for empirical research on cost structure, profitability, and firms' risk exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统用固定成本占总成本比例作为经营杠杆度(DOL)代理变量的做法，提出基于安全边际(MOS)的新估计方法TV-CMR，通过模拟和稳健性检验证明其优于现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何准确估计企业的经营杠杆度(DOL)？传统基于成本结构的代理变量是否有效？
AI.motivation: 教科书和大量实证研究假设固定成本占总成本比例是经营杠杆度的有效代理变量，但这一假设可能在概念上不正确且实证上具有误导性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于会计恒等式，将经营杠杆度表达为安全边际(MOS)的函数，即贡献毛益率(CMR)与销售利润率(ROS)的比率。
AI.method: 1) 通过会计恒等式建立理论框架；2) 开发TV-CMR估计器：通过EBIT对销售额的滚动回归估计时变贡献毛益率，结合观测的ROS得到企业年度DOL；3) 模拟框架和多项稳健性检验，比较TV-CMR与Lev(1974)成本结构代理变量、Mandelker和Rhee(1984)及O'Brien和Vanderheiden(1987)的弹性基估计器。
AI.findings: Lev方法表现很差，对大多数高风险和低风险企业分类错误；弹性基估计器表现明显更好；提出的TV-CMR估计器在几乎所有研究场景中达到最高准确性、最低测量误差和最强的经营风险识别能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 理论上证明传统成本结构代理变量的概念缺陷；2) 建立DOL与MOS、CMR、ROS之间的数学关系；3) 提出基于会计恒等式的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供更准确的DOL估计方法TV-CMR；2) 帮助研究者使用档案数据估计盈亏平衡点和企业安全边际；3) 为成本结构、盈利能力和企业风险暴露的实证研究开辟新可能性。

title: Beyond the Rupee: A psychological exploration of india’s next monetary evolution
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Beyond the Rupee: A psychological exploration of india’s next monetary evolution
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the psychological and economic implications of re-denominating India’s currency by introducing a compact unit of account, represented here as Panam, defined as 1 Panam equalling 100 rupees. While re-denomination does not alter real purchasing power, contemporary research in behavioural economics and cognitive psychology shows that the structure and visual scale of a currency shape how individuals perceive inflation, value, financial stability and institutional trust. As India’s nominal incomes, prices and transaction volumes continue to rise, the psychological burden of large numerical figures may distort inflation expectations, complicate financial decision-making and increase cognitive load across both digital and cash-based interactions.

Through an exploration of global case studies, long-term digit growth, administrative complexity and user behaviour in digital finance, the paper argues that a future shift to a smaller numerical currency unit may offer significant advantages. These include improved financial clarity, reduced transaction errors, stabilised inflation psychology, increased trust in institutions, enhanced international comparability and stronger digital inclusion. The analysis also evaluates the operational cost of such a transition, highlighting the need for careful planning, phased implementation and effective communication to avoid confusion or panic.

While India does not require immediate re-denomination, long-term projections suggest that the rupee’s current numerical scale may become increasingly cumbersome as the economy expands. Re-denomination, executed proactively under stable conditions, emerges as a strategic tool to prepare India’s monetary architecture for sustained growth, rising incomes and deeper global integration. The study concludes that psychological design in currency systems is not peripheral but central to shaping economic behaviour and public confidence over time.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨印度引入新货币单位"Panam"（1 Panam = 100卢比）进行货币重面额的心理和经济影响。虽然重面额不改变实际购买力，但货币结构和视觉规模会影响通胀感知、价值判断、金融稳定性和制度信任。随着印度名义收入、价格和交易量增长，大数字带来的心理负担可能扭曲通胀预期、复杂化财务决策并增加认知负荷。
AI.research_question: 印度引入更紧凑的货币单位（Panam = 100卢比）进行货币重面额会带来哪些心理和经济影响？这种货币重面额如何改善金融清晰度、减少交易错误、稳定通胀心理、增强制度信任和国际可比性？
AI.motivation: 随着印度名义收入、价格和交易量持续增长，大数字带来的心理负担可能扭曲通胀预期、复杂化财务决策并增加认知负荷。货币结构和视觉规模通过行为经济学和认知心理学机制影响个体对通胀、价值、金融稳定性和制度信任的感知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学和认知心理学理论，特别是关于货币结构、视觉规模对个体感知和决策影响的理论。包括通胀心理学、认知负荷理论、货币设计对经济行为的影响等。
AI.method: 通过全球案例研究分析、长期数字增长趋势研究、行政复杂性评估以及数字金融用户行为分析。采用多方法分析，包括比较研究、趋势分析和成本效益评估。
AI.findings: 货币重面额可以提供显著优势：改善金融清晰度、减少交易错误、稳定通胀心理、增强制度信任、提高国际可比性和加强数字包容性。但需要仔细规划、分阶段实施和有效沟通以避免混乱或恐慌。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调货币系统的心理设计不是边缘性的，而是塑造经济行为和公众信心的核心要素。为货币重面额的心理和经济影响提供了理论框架，扩展了行为经济学在货币设计领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度货币体系改革提供战略建议：在稳定条件下主动实施货币重面额，为持续经济增长、收入上升和更深度的全球一体化做好准备。提供了操作成本评估和实施策略，包括规划、分阶段实施和沟通方案。

title: Evolving Knowledge Management: Artificial Intelligence and the Dynamics of Social Interactions
affiliations: University of Strasbourg and University of Strasbourg - Faculty of Economics and Management, University of Strasbourg - Bureau of Economic Theory and Application (BETA)

detail.title: Evolving Knowledge Management: Artificial Intelligence and the Dynamics of Social Interactions
detail.abstract: This article examines the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in knowledge management (KM), highlighting how AI reshapes traditional KM practices in organizations. It starts by reviewing historical KM frameworks, particularly the SECI model, which emphasizes the transformation between tacit and explicit knowledge. It differentiates generative AI from earlier AI models in terms of output nature, learning adaptability, and application scope. The study explores AI's potential to improve KM processes, focusing on how it influences social interactions, facilitates knowledge community development, and fosters collaborative intelligence by leveraging the strengths of both AI and human capabilities. AI's transformative role in KM includes enhancing knowledge creation, storage, and dissemination, accelerating processes like externalization and combination in the SECI model. However, the article notes AI's current limitations in managing tacit knowledge and human-centric decision-making. The research underscores AI's capacity to streamline KM processes, improve efficiency, and unlock new opportunities for organizations. By integrating AI tools with human expertise, organizations can enhance their ability to manage, share, and apply knowledge, setting the stage for innovative approaches to knowledge-driven growth and decision-making in diverse contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能在知识管理中的整合，分析了AI如何重塑组织中的传统KM实践，特别关注生成式AI与早期AI模型的差异，以及AI在知识创造、存储和传播方面的变革作用，同时指出了AI在处理隐性知识和人类中心决策方面的局限性。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何整合到知识管理中并重塑传统KM实践？生成式AI与早期AI模型在知识管理中有何差异？AI如何影响知识创造、存储和传播过程，特别是在SECI模型框架下？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能技术的快速发展，特别是生成式AI的出现，传统知识管理实践面临重大变革。组织需要理解AI如何改变KM流程，以充分利用AI提升知识管理效率并创造新的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于SECI模型（社会化、外部化、组合化、内部化），强调隐性知识与显性知识之间的转化。同时涉及生成式AI与早期AI模型的比较框架，以及人机协作理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，通过回顾历史KM框架（特别是SECI模型），比较不同AI模型的特点，分析AI在KM各环节的潜在影响和应用。
AI.findings: 1. AI能够显著提升KM流程效率，特别是在知识创造、存储和传播方面；2. 生成式AI在输出性质、学习适应性和应用范围上与早期AI模型存在显著差异；3. AI能够加速SECI模型中的外部化和组合化过程；4. AI在促进社会互动、知识社区发展和协作智能方面具有潜力；5. AI目前在管理隐性知识和人类中心决策方面存在局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了SECI模型在AI时代的应用理解；2. 建立了生成式AI与传统AI在知识管理中的比较框架；3. 提出了人机协作在知识管理中的理论框架；4. 深化了对AI在知识转化过程中作用的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织整合AI到KM实践提供指导；2. 帮助管理者理解AI在提升KM效率方面的潜力；3. 提供了利用AI促进知识社区发展和协作智能的具体思路；4. 指出了AI在KM应用中的局限性，帮助组织制定合理的实施策略；5. 展示了如何通过人机协作实现知识驱动增长和决策创新。

title: How can carbon quota pledge financing contribute to the two-stage production and carbon abatement of emission-dependent remanufacturing firms?
affiliations: Jiangsu University of Science and Technology, Jiangsu University, Southeast University and Jiangsu University of Science and Technology

detail.title: How can carbon quota pledge financing contribute to the two-stage production and carbon abatement of emission-dependent remanufacturing firms?
detail.abstract: Due to the severe environmental pollution problem and the guidance of carbon emission reduction (CER) policies by the government, firms conduct carbon abatement investment (CAI) through different CER paths to realize low carbon production, in which capital constraint may be a significant factor that cannot be ignored. Thus, to rational use the carbon quota allocated, carbon quota pledge (CQP) acts as an effective financing method in supporting CERs. In this paper, based on carbon cap-and-trade mechanism, we establish two two-period manufacturing/ remanufacturing production decision models to contrastively evaluate the effectiveness of capital constraint and carbon quota pledge financing (CQPF) on the optimal production, CER and profits of firms under two CAI methods consisting of carbon emission purification and R&D investment. Our results indicate that CQPF more effectively enhance CERs and increase profits of firms when the self-owned capital is shortage, whereas it contributes to the increase in carbon emissions simultaneously. We also find that R&D investment has a cumulative effect, namely, the CER effect of the second period is more obvious than that of the first period, and the CERs and expected profits may even be higher than the case of carbon emission purification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究资本约束下企业碳减排投资决策，对比分析碳配额质押融资对两种碳减排路径（排放净化和研发投资）的影响。研究发现碳配额质押融资能缓解资金短缺，提升减排效果和企业利润，但可能增加碳排放；研发投资具有累积效应，长期减排效果更优。
AI.research_question: 资本约束和碳配额质押融资如何影响企业在不同碳减排投资方法（排放净化和研发投资）下的最优生产决策、减排效果和利润？
AI.motivation: 严重的环境污染问题和政府碳减排政策引导下，企业通过不同路径进行碳减排投资，但资本约束是重要限制因素。碳配额质押作为有效的融资方式，需要评估其对不同减排投资方法的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于碳限额与交易机制，构建两期制造/再制造生产决策模型，分析资本约束和碳配额质押融资对企业决策的影响。
AI.method: 建立两个两期制造/再制造生产决策模型，对比评估资本约束和碳配额质押融资在两种碳减排投资方法（碳排放净化和研发投资）下对企业最优生产、减排和利润的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 自有资本短缺时，碳配额质押融资能更有效提升碳减排效果和企业利润，但同时可能导致碳排放增加；2. 研发投资具有累积效应，第二期的减排效果比第一期更明显，减排效果和预期利润甚至可能高于碳排放净化方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了碳减排投资决策理论，将资本约束和融资机制纳入分析框架；2. 揭示了不同碳减排投资方法的动态效应差异；3. 为碳配额质押融资的有效性提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业选择碳减排投资路径提供决策参考；2. 为政府制定碳减排政策和融资支持机制提供依据；3. 帮助企业在资本约束下优化碳减排投资策略，平衡减排效果和经济效益。

title: A Unified Governance Architecture for Agentic AI: Integrating Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Cloud-Native Guardrails, Frontier AI Safety Research, Zero-Trust Principles, and the 4th.GRC Governance Engine
affiliations: Fourth Industrial Systems Corporation

detail.title: A Unified Governance Architecture for Agentic AI: Integrating Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Cloud-Native Guardrails, Frontier AI Safety Research, Zero-Trust Principles, and the 4th.GRC Governance Engine

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, personal, or organizational conflicts of interest that could be perceived to have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions in this paper. The work represents the author’s independent academic and professional assessment of agentic AI governance, cloud security architectures, regulatory alignment, and AI safety frameworks. No external organization contributed to the design of the research, the interpretation of the material, or the preparation of the manuscript. The author maintains full responsibility for all findings, technical claims, and policy analysis contained in the paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, medical information, or interventions requiring Institutional Review Board (IRB) or ethics committee approval. The research consists solely of theoretical analysis, architectural modeling, policy evaluation, and technical assessment of agentic AI governance frameworks and cloud-native safety mechanisms. No human subjects, clinical data, or sensitive personal information were collected, used, or analyzed.
