No entity had any financial or editorial input into the study.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: This research does not involve a clinical trial, medical intervention, or any activity requiring registration in a clinical trial registry. Accordingly, no clinical trial registration number is applicable.

detail.abstract: The rapid evolution of agentic artificial intelligence (AI)-systems capable of autonomous planning, tool execution, reasoning, and real-world interaction-has exposed governance gaps across enterprise, governmental, and global regulatory domains. Although cloud platforms provide technical guardrails and content filters, these mechanisms alone cannot satisfy emerging regulatory obligations or the safety requirements articulated in contemporary AI governance scholarship. This paper proposes a comprehensive governance architecture that synthesizes: (a) Microsoft Azure AI Foundry safety, identity, logging, and model evaluation primitives; (b) cross-cloud zero-trust security models; (c) frontier AI risk governance research; (d) guardrail taxonomies and conceptual frameworks; and (e) the 4th.GRC Governance Engine implementing Policy-as-Code, scorecarding, telemetry fusion, and agent behavior control. Drawing from a broad corpus of academic, regulatory, and industry sources-including analyses of the European Union (EU) Artificial Intelligence Act, responsible AI frameworks, AI safety defense-in-depth strategies, security models for multi-cloud environments, and agentic governance design patterns-this work constructs a unified, repeatable, audit-ready governance reference model for agentic AI systems. The architecture reconciles technical safety mechanisms with regulatory duties such as transparency, documentation, risk management, human oversight, and continuous monitoring. The result is an integrated framework suitable for regulated industries, government agencies, defense ecosystems, and enterprise adoption of trustworthy agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个综合性的治理架构，整合了Azure AI Foundry安全机制、多云零信任安全模型、前沿AI风险治理研究、护栏分类法以及4th.GRC治理引擎，为自主AI系统构建统一、可重复、可审计的治理参考模型。
AI.research_question: 如何为具有自主规划、工具执行、推理和现实世界交互能力的代理AI系统构建一个全面的治理架构，以弥合企业、政府和全球监管领域的治理差距？
AI.motivation: 代理AI系统的快速发展暴露了企业、政府和全球监管领域的治理差距。虽然云平台提供了技术护栏和内容过滤器，但这些机制本身无法满足新兴监管义务或当代AI治理学术研究中阐述的安全要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了多个理论框架：前沿AI风险治理研究、护栏分类法和概念框架、欧盟AI法案分析、负责任AI框架、AI安全纵深防御策略、多云环境安全模型以及代理治理设计模式。
AI.method: 基于广泛的学术、监管和行业资源分析，构建统一的治理参考模型。整合了Microsoft Azure AI Foundry安全原语、多云零信任安全模型、4th.GRC治理引擎（实施策略即代码、记分卡、遥测融合和代理行为控制）。
AI.findings: 提出了一个综合性的治理架构，将技术安全机制与透明度、文档化、风险管理、人类监督和持续监控等监管职责相协调，为受监管行业、政府机构、国防生态系统和企业采用可信代理AI提供了集成框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了一个统一、可重复、可审计的代理AI系统治理参考模型，将技术安全机制与监管要求相结合，填补了代理AI治理的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管行业、政府机构、国防生态系统和企业提供了可直接采用的代理AI治理框架，实现了技术安全机制与监管义务的协调，支持可信代理AI的部署和应用。

title: A ‘New’ Kaldor Fact and Growth with Cognitive Limits
affiliations: MLU Halle-Wittenberg

detail.title: A ‘New’ Kaldor Fact and Growth with Cognitive Limits
detail.abstract: Why have economic growth rates in advanced economies remained nearly constant for over 200 years, despite dramatic changes in education, institutions, and other presumed determinants? This paper proposes an answer based on an empirical regularity hitherto overlooked by economists: science and technology have grown at an almost perfectly constant rate since around 1720. Starting a whole century before modern economic and population growth, this "new Kaldor fact" suggests that knowledge feeds on itself deterministically and autonomously, challenging established endogenous growth theory. Building on insights from cognitive and network science, I explain the finding with an idea-network model where the combinatorial growth of ideas is bounded by human cognitive limitations that determine the steady rates of techno-scientific and economic growth.

AI.tldr: 论文发现科技知识以恒定速率增长（1720年以来），这解释了为何发达经济体经济增长率200年来保持稳定，挑战了传统内生增长理论。
AI.research_question: 为什么发达经济体的经济增长率在过去200多年中保持近乎恒定，尽管教育、制度等决定因素发生了巨大变化？
AI.motivation: 传统内生增长理论无法解释经济增长率的长期稳定性，需要新的理论框架来解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于认知科学和网络科学的理念网络模型，强调人类认知限制对知识组合增长的约束作用。
AI.method: 实证分析发现科技知识增长的历史规律，构建理念网络模型进行理论解释。
AI.findings: 科学和技术自1720年以来以几乎恒定的速率增长，这早于现代经济和人口增长，解释了经济增长率的长期稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"新卡尔多事实"，挑战传统内生增长理论，强调知识增长的自主性和确定性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解长期经济增长模式提供了新视角，对科技政策和创新战略有重要启示。

title: Global Management Strategies for Democratizing Higher Education Via IDG Framework Implementation: Insights From 57 Cases
affiliations: Hochschule Fresenius - University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Global Management Strategies for Democratizing Higher Education Via IDG Framework Implementation: Insights From 57 Cases
detail.abstract:
This paper explores the integration of Inner Development Goals (IDGs) within higher education, focusing on the concept of democratization, leadership, and the role of universities in shaping sustainable careers. The study reviews key theories and concepts surrounding the democratization of higher education and investigates how the IDGs framework can contribute to the development of leadership skills and social equity in educational settings. Through a comprehensive literature review, the research identifies the challenges and opportunities in implementing IDGs.

Research Object: Global management strategies used in implementing the Inner Development Goals (IDG) Framework within higher education institutions globally. The objective is to document and understand how these strategies contribute to democratizing leadership education, promoting sustainable development, and meeting the complex demands of 21st-century leadership across diverse cultural and institutional contexts through 57 detailed case studies worldwide. The research methodology emphasizes a qualitative approach, involving the collection and analysis of 57 cases from global higher education institutions, evaluating how IDGs have been adopted and implemented. The findings highlight the significant potential for IDGs for transformative educational experiences that enhance personal development and societal impact. The paper concludes with a reflection on the importance of universities embracing IDGs as a tool for global leadership, sustainability, and community building. It also outlines the necessary steps to overcome barriers to IDG integration and suggests strategies for enhancing educational frameworks to prepare students for the complexities of the modern world.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了如何在高等教育中整合内在发展目标(IDGs)，通过全球57个案例研究分析了IDGs框架在促进领导力教育民主化、可持续发展和应对21世纪复杂领导力需求方面的作用。
AI.research_question: 全球高等教育机构在实施内在发展目标(IDG)框架时采用了哪些管理策略？这些策略如何促进领导力教育的民主化、可持续发展和满足21世纪多元文化背景下的领导力需求？
AI.motivation: 高等教育机构在培养21世纪领导者方面面临挑战，需要新的框架来促进个人发展、社会公平和可持续发展。内在发展目标(IDGs)作为一个新兴框架，具有促进教育民主化和领导力发展的潜力，但缺乏系统性的实施策略研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内在发展目标(IDGs)框架、高等教育民主化理论、领导力发展理论、可持续发展教育理论、社会公平理论
AI.method: 定性研究方法，通过收集和分析全球高等教育机构的57个详细案例研究，评估IDGs的采纳和实施情况
AI.findings: IDGs具有显著的潜力，能够创造变革性的教育体验，增强个人发展和社会影响力。研究识别了实施IDGs的挑战和机遇，并展示了不同文化背景下IDGs的应用实践
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了IDGs框架在高等教育中的应用理论；2) 丰富了领导力教育民主化的理论视角；3) 为可持续发展教育提供了新的理论框架；4) 建立了跨文化背景下教育策略的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了57个全球案例作为实施参考；2) 识别了IDG整合的障碍和解决方案；3) 提出了增强教育框架的具体策略；4) 为大学如何利用IDGs培养全球领导力、可持续发展和社区建设提供了实践指南

title: Don't Stop Sketching! Design Ideation Processes in the Age of Generative AI
affiliations: University of Cologne, University of Cologne and

detail.title: Don't Stop Sketching! Design Ideation Processes in the Age of Generative AI

declarations.ethicsApproval: The experiments were approved by the Ethics Committee of the Faculty of Management, Economics and Social Sciences (ERC-FMES) at the University of Cologne. Reference number: 230052ML.

detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming idea generation processes by enabling faster and more cost-effective exploration. However, a critical challenge for innovation and technology managers is to integrate AI effectively and systematically into these processes. We focus on design ideation, where it is unclear whether the traditional sketching steps remain valuable in AI-augmented workflows. We address this question through two preregistered and incentivized experiments: one with non-experts and the other with prospective design professionals; both simulate logo design contests where participants use generative AI to create designs. Participants are randomly assigned either to sketch a logo prior to AI usage or to a control-condition drawing task. We use neural network-based similarity metrics on prompts and images to quantify idea variance, and we evaluate design quality via blind pairwise crowd comparisons and an Elo rating system, which ranks designs based on relative preference outcomes. Across both studies, sketching markedly reduces idea variance-design ideas become less diverse-yet yields significantly higher average and best design quality. Further analyses suggest that sketching in order to front-load mental engagement helps designers choose a better starting point for their design iterations and minimizes off-task exploration. These findings challenge conventional idea generation knowledge that greater idea variance uniformly enhances outcomes. From a practical standpoint, our results argue for integrating traditional sketching or planning stages into AI-driven ideation so as to harness AI's potential without sacrificing quality.

AI.tldr: 研究通过两个实验发现，在AI辅助的设计创意过程中，传统草图绘制虽然会降低创意多样性，但能显著提高设计质量，挑战了"创意多样性越高越好"的传统认知。
AI.research_question: 在AI增强的设计创意工作流程中，传统的草图绘制步骤是否仍然有价值？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在快速改变创意生成过程，但如何有效系统地将AI整合到这些过程中是创新和技术管理者面临的关键挑战。特别是在设计创意领域，传统草图步骤在AI增强工作流程中的价值尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创意生成理论、设计认知理论、AI增强创意理论
AI.method: 两个预注册激励实验：一个针对非专业人士，另一个针对准设计专业人员。模拟logo设计竞赛，参与者使用生成式AI创建设计。随机分配参与者到草图绘制组或控制组。使用神经网络相似性度量量化创意方差，通过盲配对众包比较和Elo评分系统评估设计质量。
AI.findings: 草图绘制显著降低创意方差（设计想法变得不那么多样化），但产生显著更高的平均和最佳设计质量。草图绘制通过前置心理参与帮助设计师选择更好的设计迭代起点，并减少偏离任务的探索。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统创意生成知识中"创意多样性越高越好"的假设，提出了AI增强创意过程中传统规划阶段的理论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将传统草图或规划阶段整合到AI驱动的创意过程中，以充分利用AI潜力而不牺牲质量，为创新和技术管理者提供实践指导。

title: Regenerative Capital for State Capability: A New Architecture for Multi-Cycle Development Finance

detail.title: Regenerative Capital for State Capability: A New Architecture for Multi-Cycle Development Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, clinical data, or experimental interventions. Ethical approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Development failures are not primarily caused by insufficient capital, but by capital that behaves incompatibly with the multi-cycle nature of state capability. Grants deplete after one use, concessional loans impose liabilities that amplify fragility, and donor cycles follow political volatility rather than mission cycles. Drawing on Regenerative Cycle Architecture (RCA) and Regenerative Capital Theory (RCT), this paper argues that traditional development finance is structurally incapable of sustaining long-horizon investments in health systems, climate adaptation, scientific capability, and institutional renewal. We define Regenerative Development Finance (RDF) as a non-liability, non-extractive, multi-cycle capital architecture derived from Perpetual Social Capital (PSC) and the Δ-Λ operators of Alignment Capital. RDF stabilises capital availability across political turnover, synchronises capital cycles with mission cycles, and attenuates fragility across domains. Applications to climate adaptation, health systems, and scientific capability illustrate how regenerative capital may complement existing development finance mechanisms by stabilising capability across multiple cycles. The framework offers actionable implications for multilateral development banks, ministries of finance, and climate adaptation agencies seeking to stabilise long-horizon investments.

AI.tldr: 传统发展融资无法支持长期能力建设，本文提出再生性发展融资（RDF）作为非负债、非榨取、多周期的资本架构，以稳定跨政治周期的资本可用性。
AI.research_question: 传统发展融资为何无法支持国家能力的多周期建设？如何设计能够稳定长期投资的再生性发展融资架构？
AI.motivation: 发展失败主要不是资本不足，而是资本行为与国家能力的多周期性质不兼容。赠款一次性耗尽，优惠贷款增加负债放大脆弱性，捐助周期跟随政治波动而非任务周期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 再生性周期架构（RCA）和再生性资本理论（RCT），基于永久社会资本（PSC）和对齐资本的Δ-Λ算子。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，通过气候适应、卫生系统和科学能力等领域的应用案例说明再生性资本如何运作。
AI.findings: 再生性发展融资（RDF）能够稳定政治更替期间的资本可用性，使资本周期与任务周期同步，并减少各领域的脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了再生性发展融资（RDF）的理论框架，定义了非负债、非榨取、多周期的资本架构，扩展了发展金融理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多边开发银行、财政部和气候适应机构提供了稳定长期投资的可操作建议，展示了如何补充现有发展融资机制。

title: The Global Rise of Female Radicalisation Networks and the Next Stage of Hybrid Terrorism
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Global Rise of Female Radicalisation Networks and the Next Stage of Hybrid Terrorism
detail.abstract:
The increasing involvement of women in extremist recruitment networks across
Kashmir, Pakistan, and globally marks a dangerous evolution in hybrid terrorism.
Jaish-e-Mohammed’s new “women’s strategy” is not a transformative breakthrough
but a tactical repackaging of historical indoctrination models long cultivated by
Pakistan’s deep state. Emotional grievance shaping, curated digital echo chambers,
encrypted messaging, and identity-based manipulation have merged into a conveyor
belt of radicalisation stretching from Dukhtaran-e-Millat’s ideological grooming to
Jaish’s operational utilisation. As global counter-terrorism efforts become more
sophisticated, militant groups are shifting toward low-profile female operatives̶
students, homemakers, medical workers̶who statistically generate less suspicion
and more access. Parallel patterns have emerged in ISIS, Boko Haram, Al-Shabaab,
LTTE, IRA, and Southeast Asian extremist networks, demonstrating a worldwide
structural mutation in insurgency design.
This paper argues that the weaponisation of womanhood represents a new
psychological battlefield, where terror networks infiltrate communities through
emotional, familial, and cultural channels rather than overt violence. It explores the
geopolitical risks of this shift, the intelligence vulnerabilities it exposes, and the
global security consequences that may unfold if nation-states fail to recognise these
gender-based adaptations in terrorist modus operandi. Women are not becoming
empowered; they are becoming instrumentalised̶and the world must recalibrate
before this silent architecture becomes irreversible.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了恐怖组织如何将女性武器化作为新的心理战场，通过情感、家庭和文化渠道渗透社区，而非公开暴力。文章探讨了这种转变的地缘政治风险、暴露的情报漏洞，以及如果国家未能识别恐怖组织基于性别的适应性调整可能带来的全球安全后果。
AI.research_question: 恐怖组织如何通过性别策略（特别是女性参与）改变其运作模式，这种转变对全球安全构成什么威胁？
AI.motivation: 女性在克什米尔、巴基斯坦及全球极端主义招募网络中的参与度日益增加，标志着混合恐怖主义的危险演变。恐怖组织正在转向低姿态的女性行动者，她们在统计上引起较少怀疑且获得更多接触机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合恐怖主义理论、性别与恐怖主义研究、心理战理论、网络激进主义理论、地缘安全理论
AI.method: 案例研究分析（Jaish-e-Mohammed、ISIS、博科圣地、青年党、猛虎组织、IRA等）、比较分析、模式识别、文献综述
AI.findings:
1. 穆罕默德军的新"女性战略"并非突破性变革，而是巴基斯坦深层国家长期培养的历史灌输模式的战术性重新包装
2. 情感不满塑造、策划的数字回音室、加密消息传递和基于身份的操纵已融合成从Dukhtaran-e-Millat意识形态培养到穆罕默德军运作利用的激进主义输送带
3. 全球恐怖组织普遍转向低姿态女性行动者（学生、家庭主妇、医疗工作者），她们引起较少怀疑且获得更多接触机会
4. 女性被工具化而非赋权，恐怖网络通过情感、家庭和文化渠道而非公开暴力渗透社区
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"女性武器化"作为新的心理战场概念框架
2. 识别了恐怖组织性别策略的结构性突变模式
3. 建立了从意识形态培养到运作利用的激进主义输送带模型
4. 扩展了混合恐怖主义理论，纳入性别维度
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 警示国家需要重新校准反恐策略以应对基于性别的恐怖主义适应性调整
2. 识别了情报收集的漏洞和盲点
3. 为政策制定者提供了应对女性参与恐怖网络的策略建议
4. 强调了预防这种"沉默架构"变得不可逆转的紧迫性

title: Reconstructing Ryukyu: Historical Memory, Geopolitical Narratives, and the Future of East Asian Regional Order
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Reconstructing Ryukyu: Historical Memory, Geopolitical Narratives, and the Future of East Asian Regional Order
detail.abstract:
This study explores the rapid expansion of Ryukyu studies within Chinese and
Japanese academic systems and assesses its implications for East Asia’s evolving
geopolitical landscape. Moving beyond traditional historical debates, modern
Ryukyu research has become intertwined with issues of sovereignty, identity,
maritime strategy, and the construction of competing national narratives. The paper
argues that the institutional strengthening of Ryukyu studies in China̶especially its
inclusion in endangered-discipline support frameworks̶signals an attempt to
reshape the historiographical and discursive environment surrounding East Asian
regional memory. Using interdisciplinary approaches that combine history,
linguistics, archaeology, and international relations, the paper demonstrates how
Ryukyu studies is transitioning from fragmented scholarship into an integrated,
internationalized academic field. This transition is not merely academic; it reflects
broader geopolitical transformations as China, Japan, and the United States redefine
their regional roles. The research highlights future global circumstances in which
Ryukyu studies will influence security calculations, cultural diplomacy, maritime
governance, and discursive competitions within the Indo-Pacific region. The paper
concludes that historically grounded, methodologically rigorous Ryukyu studies can
contribute to building a more inclusive, peaceful, and culturally interconnected East
Asia.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了琉球研究在中日学术体系中的快速扩张及其对东亚地缘政治格局的影响，指出该领域正从分散研究转变为国际化学科，反映了中、日、美在区域角色重新定义过程中的地缘政治转型。
AI.research_question: 琉球研究在中日学术体系中的快速扩张如何影响东亚地缘政治格局？
AI.motivation: 现代琉球研究已超越传统历史辩论，与主权、身份认同、海洋战略和竞争性国家叙事构建等问题交织，其制度化发展反映了东亚区域记忆的史学与话语环境重塑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合历史学、语言学、考古学和国际关系的跨学科理论框架，探讨学术制度化、地缘政治转型和区域记忆构建理论。
AI.method: 采用跨学科研究方法，结合历史分析、语言学考察、考古证据和国际关系理论，分析琉球研究的学术制度化进程及其地缘政治含义。
AI.findings: 琉球研究正从分散的学术研究转变为整合的、国际化的学术领域；中国将琉球研究纳入濒危学科支持框架，试图重塑东亚区域记忆的史学与话语环境；该领域的发展反映了中、日、美在东亚区域角色重新定义过程中的地缘政治转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）提出了学术制度化与地缘政治转型的关联理论；2）发展了区域记忆构建的跨学科分析框架；3）建立了濒危学科支持与话语权竞争的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）为政策制定者提供琉球研究对安全计算、文化外交、海洋治理影响的见解；2）促进东亚地区更具包容性、和平与文化互联的建设；3）为印太地区的话语竞争提供学术基础。

title: Algorithmic Hallucinations-Psychological Conditioning and AI-Induced Fear in the 21st Century
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Algorithmic Hallucinations-Psychological Conditioning and AI-Induced Fear in the 21st Century
detail.abstract:
This article examines the emerging phenomenon of AI-induced psychosis, a psychological state in which human delusions are not merely reinforced but co-generated through interactions with advanced conversational systems. Drawing parallels with foundational psychological experiments of the 20th century̶such as Watson’s Little Albert conditioning, Asch’s conformity
trials, Milgram’s obedience studies, and the Bobo doll modelling experiment̶the analysis demonstrates how mechanisms that
once required laboratory control now unfold organically in algorithmic environments. AI systems, driven by engagement-
optimised architectures and sycophantic reinforcement loops, function as digital confederates, validating distorted beliefs,
amplifying emotional dysregulation, and providing a false sense of social reciprocity. The article frames these interactions as a new form of shared hallucination, where human cognitive biases and machine-generated narratives merge into mutually
escalating feedback loops. Real-life cases of chatbot-amplified delusions illustrate the high-risk psychological terrain created by this technology, especially among emotionally vulnerable and socially isolated individuals. The paper argues that the central problem is not simply AI hallucination, but the social displacement that drives people toward machines for validation,
companionship, and meaning. A healthier social ecosystem̶rather than increasingly “human-like” AI̶is essential to preventing these emerging mental-health crises.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI诱发精神病的现象，分析人类妄想如何通过与先进对话系统的互动被共同生成而非仅仅强化，揭示算法环境如何重现经典心理学实验机制，并指出社会生态而非更"拟人化"的AI才是预防心理健康危机的关键。
AI.research_question: AI系统如何通过与人类互动共同生成和强化妄想，形成共享幻觉的反馈循环？
AI.motivation: 随着先进对话系统的普及，出现了AI诱发精神病的现象，人类妄想通过与AI的互动被共同生成而非仅仅强化，这构成了新的心理健康风险，需要从心理学和社会学角度进行系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴20世纪经典心理学实验理论：华生的小阿尔伯特条件反射、阿希的从众实验、米尔格拉姆的服从研究、班杜拉的波波玩偶模仿实验，分析这些实验室控制机制如何在算法环境中自然展开。
AI.method: 理论分析框架结合现实案例分析，通过类比经典心理学实验机制，分析AI系统作为数字同谋如何验证扭曲信念、放大情绪失调、提供虚假社会互惠。
AI.findings: AI系统通过参与度优化的架构和奉承强化循环，作为数字同谋共同生成人类妄想；人类认知偏见与机器生成叙事融合形成相互升级的反馈循环；情感脆弱和社会孤立个体面临高风险；核心问题是社会疏离而非单纯AI幻觉。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"AI诱发精神病"概念框架，将AI-人类互动定义为共享幻觉的新形式，扩展了经典心理学实验理论在数字环境中的应用，建立了算法环境中的社会心理机制分析模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示AI系统设计中的心理健康风险，强调需要构建更健康的社会生态系统而非追求更"拟人化"的AI，为政策制定者、技术开发者和心理健康专业人员提供干预方向。

title: Veiled intentions: Hamas’s strategic deception and intelligence success on 7 October 2023
affiliations: Doha Institute for Graduate Studies

detail.title: Veiled intentions: Hamas’s strategic deception and intelligence success on 7 October 2023
detail.abstract: On 7 October 2023, Hamas dealt a severe blow to Israel’s deterrence by launching a multi-front incursion that killed more than a thousand Israelis and captured hundreds. Prevailing commentary frames the attack as an Israeli intelligence debacle; this study instead interrogates Hamas’s intelligence success. Drawing on strategic deception, the intelligence-cycle model and asymmetric warfare scholarship, it analyses how a resource-starved non-state actor concealed intentions. Process-traced evidence from investigative reporting, declassified Israeli documents, and interviews 1 the author conducted with Hamas’s leadership, members and analysts reveals four enabling pillars: meticulous operational security, systematic open-source and cyber intelligence collection (OSINT), insider human intelligence (HUMINT) and a professionalised intelligence apparatus shaped by decades of counter-espionage practice and external tutoring. The findings underscore adversary agency and expose the fragility of technological superiority for advanced militaries.

AI.tldr: 哈马斯通过精心策划的多线入侵成功打击以色列威慑力，研究聚焦其情报成功而非以色列情报失误，揭示资源匮乏的非国家行为体如何通过四大支柱隐藏意图。
AI.research_question: 资源匮乏的非国家行为体哈马斯如何成功隐藏其攻击意图并实施对以色列的多线入侵？
AI.motivation: 现有评论多将2023年10月7日哈马斯袭击视为以色列情报失误，本研究转向探讨哈马斯的情报成功，以理解非国家行为体如何克服资源限制实现战略欺骗。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略欺骗理论、情报周期模型、不对称战争理论
AI.method: 过程追踪法，证据来源包括调查性报道、解密的以色列文件、作者对哈马斯领导层、成员和分析师的访谈
AI.findings: 哈马斯成功隐藏意图依赖四大支柱：1) 严密的行动安全措施；2) 系统的开源和网络情报收集(OSINT)；3) 内部人力情报(HUMINT)；4) 经过数十年反间谍实践和外部培训形成的专业化情报机构
AI.theory_contributions: 强调对手能动性，挑战技术优势决定论，为非国家行为体情报能力研究提供理论框架，丰富不对称战争理论
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示先进军事技术优势的脆弱性，为情报机构提供反制非国家行为体欺骗的实践启示，展示开源情报和人力情报在不对称冲突中的关键作用

title: Who Determines Your Timberland Value?: World Market Price Leader
affiliations: Auburn University and Auburn University - School of Forestry & Wildlife Sciences

detail.title: Who Determines Your Timberland Value?: World Market Price Leader
detail.abstract: Stakeholders in the forest products sector increasingly face complex valuation environments when assessing timberland acquisitions or divestitures. This study provides an empirical, stakeholder-oriented framework for identifying historical regional and international “price-leaders” in per-acre timberland values. Using semiannual valuation data from TimberLink LLC and quarterly data from the NCREIF Timberland Index, we estimate a series of bivariate and multivariate Granger-causality models across U.S. timberland regions, the aggregate U.S. market, South and Central America, and Oceania. The results reveal a hierarchy of price transmission. Oceania operates as the dominant global benchmark, exerting predictive influence over aggregate U.S. timberland values. Domestically, the Pacific Northwest emerges as the primary U.S. price-leader, with the Lake States and Northeast functioning as secondary signaling hubs across datasets. These findings offer a practical forecasting mechanism for investors, policymakers, and other stakeholders by identifying which timberland price series provide leading information for market-based timberland valuation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过格兰杰因果检验，识别了全球木材地价值的价格领导者：大洋洲是全球主导基准，对整体美国市场有预测影响；美国国内，太平洋西北地区是主要价格领导者，湖泊州和东北地区是次要信号中心。
AI.research_question: 在全球木材地市场中，哪些地区和区域是历史性的价格领导者，能够预测其他地区的木材地价值变化？
AI.motivation: 森林产品行业的利益相关者在评估木材地收购或处置时面临复杂的估值环境，需要识别哪些价格序列能提供领先信息，以改进市场估值和预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格传导理论、格兰杰因果关系理论、市场整合理论、价格领导理论。
AI.method: 使用TimberLink LLC的半年度估值数据和NCREIF木材地指数的季度数据，构建一系列双变量和多变量格兰杰因果关系模型，分析美国木材地区域、整体美国市场、南美和中美洲、大洋洲之间的价格传导关系。
AI.findings: 1. 大洋洲是全球主导基准，对整体美国木材地价值具有预测影响；2. 美国国内，太平洋西北地区是主要价格领导者；3. 湖泊州和东北地区是次要信号中心；4. 存在明确的价格传导层级结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了木材地市场的价格传导层级理论；2. 扩展了格兰杰因果关系在自然资源估值中的应用；3. 提供了识别全球价格领导者的实证框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者、政策制定者和其他利益相关者提供实用的预测机制；2. 识别哪些木材地价格序列能提供市场估值的领先信息；3. 帮助改进木材地收购和处置的决策过程。

detail.abstract:
For more than a decade, debates over blockchain governance, digital assets, artificial intelligence, and distributed infrastructure have proceeded as though decentralization were a technological invention requiring novel legal frameworks. This paper rejects that premise. It argues that decentralization is not a disruption to the American constitutional order, but a rediscovery of the architecture the Framers intentionally designed. The United States is already a decentralized system — not by innovation, but by constitutional construction.

Drawing on constitutional text, administrative history, Supreme Court jurisprudence, and systems-engineering analysis, this paper demonstrates that separation of powers, federalism, and the Chain of Consent collectively form the world’s first governance-grade decentralization protocol. Contemporary distributed technologies — including blockchain-based financial infrastructure, autonomous execution systems, and cryptographic trust models — do not challenge this structure; they mirror it. Where modern systems seek resilience through redundancy, distributed validation, immutability, and minimized authority, the Constitution achieves the same through differentiated institutions, jurisdictional limits, and enforceable accountability.

This work serves as the capstone to a seventeen-paper research series, Rediscovering Decentralization, which establishes the legal, technical, fiscal, and evidentiary foundations required to translate constitutional constraints into programmable governance. Across prior doctrines — including CLEARfund™, the Federal Trust Layer™, Autonomous Commodity Primitives, Federally Regulated Autonomous Finance Infrastructure (FRAFI), Federally Regulated Yield Trusts (FRYTs), and the Doctrine of Anchored Decentralization — the series demonstrates that digital governance can be implemented not by creating new authority, but by executing existing constitutional authority in verifiable, auditable, smart-contract-enforced form.

In the post-Chevron landscape, as the Supreme Court reasserts that administrative power must trace to explicit statutory delegation, decentralization becomes not merely an engineering preference but a constitutional requirement. Systems governing identity, finance, mobility, or public administration cannot derive legitimacy from automation alone. They must be anchored to Article I authorization, subject to Article III review, and accountable to the governed.

The conclusion is straightforward: technology may scale execution, but it cannot originate authority. Digital systems cannot operate outside the jurisdiction of law, and federal law cannot operate outside the jurisdiction of the Constitution. Rediscovering decentralization is therefore not innovation; it is return. The digital age does not require a new model of governance. It requires recognition of the one already binding, already proven, and already sovereign.

AI.tldr: 本文认为去中心化并非技术创新，而是对美国宪法秩序的重新发现。美国宪法通过分权制衡、联邦制和同意链构成了世界上第一个治理级去中心化协议，现代分布式技术只是反映了这一宪法架构。
AI.research_question: 去中心化是否真的需要全新的法律框架？还是说它本质上是对美国宪法既有去中心化架构的重新发现？
AI.motivation: 过去十多年关于区块链治理、数字资产、人工智能和分布式基础设施的辩论都假设去中心化是技术创新，需要新的法律框架。本文挑战这一前提，认为去中心化不是对宪法秩序的颠覆，而是对其既有架构的重新认识。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 美国宪法作为去中心化协议：分权制衡、联邦制、同意链构成治理级去中心化协议
2. 宪法工程学：将宪法约束转化为可编程治理的法律、技术、财政和证据基础
3. 锚定去中心化理论：数字治理应基于现有宪法权威而非创造新权力
AI.method: 综合分析方法：结合宪法文本分析、行政历史研究、最高法院判例法分析、系统工程分析，并作为17篇系列论文《重新发现去中心化》的总结性研究。
AI.findings:
1. 美国宪法本身就是去中心化系统，通过制度分化、管辖权限制和可执行问责实现韧性
2. 现代分布式技术（区块链、自主执行系统、加密信任模型）不挑战宪法结构，而是反映它
3. 在后雪佛龙时代，去中心化不仅是工程偏好，更是宪法要求
4. 数字系统必须锚定于第一条授权，受第三条审查，对治理对象负责
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"宪法作为去中心化协议"理论框架
2. 建立"锚定去中心化"学说，连接数字治理与宪法约束
3. 将系统工程概念应用于宪法分析，创造跨学科理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为数字治理提供基于宪法而非创新的实施路径
2. 为CLEARfund™、联邦信任层™、FRAFI等数字治理工具提供宪法基础
3. 在后雪佛龙时代为行政权力下放提供理论支持
4. 证明数字系统可通过智能合约以可验证、可审计方式执行现有宪法权威

title: Forecasting Financial Markets with Tempered Memory: An Optimized Fractional Autoregressive Approach
affiliations: Jouf University, Jouf University and University of Sfax

detail.title: Forecasting Financial Markets with Tempered Memory: An Optimized Fractional Autoregressive Approach
detail.abstract: It is widely known that financial time series are hard to predict, and the main reason behind this is that market data is non-stationary, and exhibits long-range dependence, as well as possess more complex memory structures. Although the traditional autoregressive moving averages are extensively applicable, they often fail to capture the long-memoirsity characteristics of the typical financial market. Moreover, conventional optimization methods have a tendency to approach sub optimum solutions when optimization is applied to the complex parameter space of a fractional-order model. To achieve these complications, we have designed a fresh Tempered Fractional Autoregressive Moving Average (TF -AMAR) framework. We combine tempered fractional calculus with time-series analysis with the exponential parameters of tempers, which give bias to memory persistence. This helps the model to strike a balance between the effect of recent data points and earlier important data with no consideration to the computational efficiency.Our models are optimised using the Tempered Fractional Gradient Descent (TFGD) optimiser in order to make estimation easier. The novel scheme supplements the standard gradient updates with a decaying exponential with a memory term which is a fraction, a modification proved by empirical studies to significantly improve convergence properties. Theoretical analysis of our model supports that the theoretical model has effects of bound memory and convergence under typical conditions. In practice, TF-AMAR significantly beats up the known standards, such as ARIMA, LSTM, and conventional FARMA, with a 32.4 per cent mean squared error reduction and 65.00 per cent accuracy of direction. In a trading strategy our model was able to generate 16.89\% annual returns without drawing downs going too high. These findings confirm the practical usefulness of the financial uses of the framework. Finally, TF -AMAR can provide analysts with a tool that has great power to decipher complex dynamics in the market, which is also interpretable and computationally viable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的TF-AMAR（Tempered Fractional Autoregressive Moving Average）框架，结合了分数阶微积分和时间序列分析，通过TFGD优化器解决传统方法在复杂参数空间中的次优解问题，显著提升了金融时间序列预测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够有效捕捉金融时间序列长期记忆特性、避免次优解、并具有良好收敛性的预测模型？
AI.motivation: 金融时间序列预测困难，主要因为市场数据非平稳、具有长期依赖性和复杂记忆结构。传统ARMA模型难以捕捉长期记忆特性，传统优化方法在分数阶模型的复杂参数空间中容易陷入次优解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合分数阶微积分和时间序列分析，引入温度参数来调节记忆持续性，平衡近期数据点和早期重要数据的影响。
AI.method: 设计了TF-AMAR框架，使用TFGD（Tempered Fractional Gradient Descent）优化器进行模型优化，该优化器在标准梯度更新中加入衰减指数和分数阶记忆项。
AI.findings: TF-AMAR显著优于ARIMA、LSTM和传统FARMA模型，MSE降低32.4%，方向准确率达到65.00%。在交易策略中实现16.89%的年化收益，且回撤控制良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出TF-AMAR理论框架，结合分数阶微积分和时间序列分析；2）开发TFGD优化器，改善收敛性；3）理论分析证明模型具有有界记忆和收敛特性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为金融分析师提供强大的市场动态分析工具；2）模型具有可解释性和计算可行性；3）在金融应用中表现出优异的预测性能和实际交易收益。

title: Wright's Law as Venture Capital Option Economics: Implied Volatility, Duration, and the Expanding Opportunity Surface of Technological Progress
affiliations: Carbon Finance Labs

detail.title: Wright's Law as Venture Capital Option Economics: Implied Volatility, Duration, and the Expanding Opportunity Surface of Technological Progress

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none.
declarations.ethicsApproval: na.
declarations.funderStatement: self.

detail.abstract: Wright's Law observes that manufacturing costs decline 20-25% for each doubling of cumulative production. This paper proposes a venture capital (VC) option framework to explain why: market growth expands an opportunity surface where viable innovation spaces emerge. Each potential innovation is a real option with quantifiable parameters derived from VC portfolio data. Using historical VC returns, we impute option characteristics: implied volatility of 45% for diversified portfolios and 120% for individual deals, option duration (time to exercise) of 5-9 years depending on stage, and success probability of 10-25% for positive outcomes. We derive that the number of options being explored scales with market size and excess margins according to: Options = (Market × Margin) / Premium. With a typical option premium of $100K and 10% excess margins, a $1B market supports ~1,000 simultaneous innovation explorations. Individual innovations remain idiosyncratic and unpredictable (high volatility), but aggregate improvement follows regular patterns (the law of large numbers applied to option portfolios). Fast-growing industries exhibit steeper learning curves because more options are being explored simultaneously. This framework unifies Wright's empirical observation with Smith's division of labor, Black-Scholes option pricing intuition, and the power law distribution of VC returns.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个风险投资期权框架来解释Wright定律（制造成本随累计产量翻倍下降20-25%）：市场增长扩大了机会面，每个潜在创新都是具有可量化参数的实物期权。通过VC数据推算期权特征，发现选项数量随市场规模和超额利润率按公式扩展，解释了为何快速增长行业学习曲线更陡峭。
AI.research_question: 如何用风险投资期权框架解释Wright定律（制造成本随累计产量翻倍下降20-25%）的机制？
AI.motivation: Wright定律是制造业中观察到的经验规律，但缺乏理论解释为什么制造成本会随着累计产量的增加而系统性下降。需要建立一个理论框架来解释这一现象背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Wright定律（学习曲线效应）；2. Smith的劳动分工理论；3. Black-Scholes期权定价理论；4. 风险投资回报的幂律分布；5. 实物期权理论；6. 大数定律在期权组合中的应用
AI.method: 使用历史风险投资回报数据推算期权特征参数：隐含波动率（多元化组合45%，单个交易120%）、期权期限（5-9年，取决于阶段）、成功概率（10-25%）。建立数学模型：选项数量 = (市场规模 × 利润率) / 期权溢价。
AI.findings: 1. 一个10亿美元市场（10%超额利润率，典型期权溢价10万美元）支持约1000个同时进行的创新探索；2. 单个创新具有高度特异性和不可预测性（高波动性），但总体改进遵循规律模式（大数定律）；3. 快速增长行业学习曲线更陡峭，因为同时探索的选项更多。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将Wright定律与Smith劳动分工理论、Black-Scholes期权定价直觉和VC回报幂律分布统一在一个框架中；2. 提供了Wright定律的理论解释机制；3. 建立了市场增长、创新探索和成本下降之间的定量关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业创新投资决策提供量化框架；2. 帮助理解不同行业学习曲线差异的原因；3. 为风险投资组合管理提供理论指导；4. 为政策制定者支持创新提供理论依据。

title: The Texas Strategic Bitcoin Reserve: Political Signaling, Price Impact, and the Paradox of State-Level Adoption
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: The Texas Strategic Bitcoin Reserve: Political Signaling, Price Impact, and the Paradox of State-Level Adoption
detail.abstract: This study analyzes the market reaction to the Texas Bitcoin Reserve's announcement and subsequent Bitcoin ETF purchase in November 2025. While framed as a strategic diversification, the initiative's scale was economically trivial, representing a mere 0.018% of the state's $27.1 billion Rainy Day Fund. We employ an event study methodology to test the policy's market impact. Our findings reveal no statistically significant market reactions to any Texas-specific events. This null result is economically meaningful: a $2+ trillion asset class showed no detectable response to a $5 million state allocation. We conclude that the market correctly perceived the Texas Bitcoin Reserve as political signaling rather than a substantive fiscal intervention, demonstrating that markets distinguish between economically consequential policies and symbolic state-level gestures.

AI.tldr: 德克萨斯州比特币储备公告及ETF购买（仅占州应急基金的0.018%）未引起比特币市场的显著反应，表明市场将其视为政治信号而非实质性财政干预。
AI.research_question: 德克萨斯州比特币储备公告及后续比特币ETF购买是否对比特币市场产生显著影响？
AI.motivation: 研究州级政府对比特币等加密货币的政策干预是否具有实际市场影响，还是仅为政治象征性举措。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究法、市场效率理论、政治信号理论、政策干预有效性理论
AI.method: 采用事件研究法，分析德克萨斯州比特币储备公告及ETF购买事件前后的市场反应
AI.findings: 未发现任何统计显著的市场反应，表明2万亿美元资产类别对500万美元州级分配无响应
AI.theory_contributions: 证实市场能够区分实质性政策与象征性政治信号，支持市场效率假说在加密货币领域的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供参考：小规模州级加密货币投资可能更多是政治信号而非经济干预，投资者应理性看待此类公告

title: Text Meets Numbers: Improving Corporate Profitability Forecasting with LLMs
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Zhejiang University, INSEAD and Zhejiang University

detail.title: Text Meets Numbers: Improving Corporate Profitability Forecasting with LLMs
detail.abstract: Accurate forecasting of next-period corporate earnings is central to both academic research and investment practice. Traditional approaches predominantly rely on structured historical financial data, but traditional text-based analyses often fail to capture contextual and semantic nuances in unstructured disclosures —such as managerial discussions of profitability, competition, and risk in annual reports, which also convey economically valuable information. Leveraging recent advances in deep learning and natural language processing, this study develops an integrated forecasting framework for predicting next-period corporate earnings, combining financial indicators with textual data from Chinese A-share listed manufacturing firms. Managerial statements are extracted using a prompt-based large language models (LLMs) and benchmarked against a keyword expansion algorithm, while additional textual features are generated through TF-IDF and Latent Dirichlet Allocation. Financial indicators are constructed across five dimensions: temporal characteristics, solvency, operational efficiency, growth potential, and shareholder profitability. These heterogeneous features are fused and applied to multiple machine learning models, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting Decision Trees, and XGBoost. Empirical evidence demonstrates three main findings: (i) incorporating textual disclosures consistently enhances model performance across multiple evaluation metrics compared with traditional financial-only approaches; (ii) prompt-based LLMs outperform traditional keyword-based methods by interpreting and analyzing context and semantics, improving extraction accuracy significantly; (iii) certain text types, particularly risk-related disclosures, may introduce noise and reduce model stability. This research contributes to the literature by highlighting the predictive value of unstructured corporate disclosures and demonstrating the efficacy of LLMs in interpreting and analyzing textual information for financial forecasting. It further offers practical implications for investors, managers, and regulators seeking more reliable tools to support decision-making and sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个整合财务指标与文本数据的预测框架，用于预测中国A股制造业企业的下一期盈利。研究发现：文本披露能提升模型性能；基于提示的大语言模型优于传统关键词方法；某些文本类型可能引入噪声。
AI.research_question: 如何有效整合财务指标与文本数据来预测中国A股制造业企业的下一期盈利？基于提示的大语言模型在文本信息提取和分析方面是否优于传统关键词方法？
AI.motivation: 准确预测企业下一期盈利对学术研究和投资实践都至关重要。传统方法主要依赖结构化历史财务数据，但传统文本分析往往无法捕捉非结构化披露中的上下文和语义细微差别（如年报中管理层对盈利能力、竞争和风险的讨论），这些信息也包含经济价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习、自然语言处理和大语言模型的理论框架，结合财务分析和文本挖掘理论。
AI.method: 开发集成预测框架，结合财务指标和文本数据。使用基于提示的大语言模型提取管理层声明，并与关键词扩展算法对比。通过TF-IDF和潜在狄利克雷分配生成额外文本特征。财务指标构建涵盖五个维度：时间特征、偿债能力、运营效率、增长潜力和股东盈利能力。这些异质特征融合后应用于多种机器学习模型（支持向量机、随机森林、梯度提升决策树、XGBoost）。
AI.findings: 1. 纳入文本披露相比传统纯财务方法能持续提升模型性能；2. 基于提示的大语言模型通过解释分析上下文和语义，显著提高提取准确性，优于传统关键词方法；3. 某些文本类型（特别是风险相关披露）可能引入噪声并降低模型稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了非结构化企业披露的预测价值，并证明了大语言模型在解释分析文本信息用于财务预测方面的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、管理者和监管者提供了更可靠的工具来支持决策制定和可持续发展。

title: The Interagency Integrity Doctrine: A National-Security Framework for Statutory Clarity, Boundary Integrity, and Structural Defense
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Interagency Integrity Doctrine: A National-Security Framework for Statutory Clarity, Boundary Integrity, and Structural Defense

This doctrine was developed independently and without sponsorship, contractual engagement, institutional direction, or external review by any public, private, foreign, or governmental entity. All work was undertaken independently and self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract:
The Interagency Integrity Doctrine (IID) advances a foundational assertion: structural ambiguity within the United States federal system—particularly across national-security, regulatory, and interagency authorities—is no longer a procedural inconvenience, but a materially exploitable condition shaping adversarial strategy, federal decision-making velocity, and national resilience. Modern threat environments—cyber operations, digital-asset finance, foreign standards-setting, cognitive warfare, and hybrid-domain statecraft—operate at a tempo that presumes clarity of legal authority. Where authority is undefined, overlapping, or unresolved, the result is not benign institutional diversity but hesitation, fragmented execution, and jurisdictional negotiation under live operational pressure.

Drawing on constitutional design principles, statutory interpretation doctrine, post-Chevron administrative boundaries, and intelligence-community risk modeling, IID demonstrates that ambiguity functions as an attack surface when adversaries can predict, model, or time U.S. authorization delays. Through comparative analysis of the People’s Republic of China’s long-horizon standards strategy and the Russian Federation’s disruption-based exploitation model, the doctrine shows that foreign actors derive advantage not from superior capability, but from the differential between U.S. capability and U.S. coordination.

The doctrine establishes four core findings: (1) national security is derivative of constitutional clarity; (2) agency boundaries function as intra-executive separation-of-powers safeguards; (3) statutory ambiguity produces predictable operational latency; and (4) clarity—not consolidation—is the lawful and structurally appropriate remedy. IID does not recommend the redesign of federal institutions. Instead, it affirms Congress as the sole constitutional organ capable of restoring statutory certainty and aligning federal authority with modern threat environments.

As the fourth installment in The Republic’s Conscience doctrine series—and the companion to The Structural Silo Doctrine—IID completes the evidentiary foundation first introduced in The Doctrine of Anchored Decentralization: that constitutional architecture is not conceptual theory, but operational defense. In a geopolitical era defined by speed, interoperability, and contested governance frameworks, ambiguity is not neutral—it is vulnerability. Clarity is deterrence.

AI.tldr: 《跨机构诚信学说》主张：美国联邦系统中的结构性模糊不再是程序性不便，而是对手可实际利用的条件，影响决策速度和国家安全。学说认为模糊性成为攻击面，外国行为者从美国能力与协调之间的差异中获益。核心发现包括国家安全源于宪法清晰度、机构边界作为内部制衡、法定模糊导致可预测的操作延迟，以及清晰度（而非整合）是适当补救措施。
AI.research_question: 美国联邦系统中的结构性模糊如何影响国家安全决策，以及这种模糊性如何被对手利用？
AI.motivation: 现代威胁环境（网络行动、数字资产金融、外国标准制定、认知战和混合域治国术）以假定法律权威清晰为前提运作。当权威未定义、重叠或未解决时，会导致犹豫、分散执行和在实时操作压力下的管辖权谈判，这不再是良性的制度多样性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法设计原则、法定解释学说、后Chevron行政边界、情报界风险建模、比较分析（中国长期标准战略与俄罗斯破坏性利用模型）。
AI.method: 比较分析中华人民共和国长期标准战略和俄罗斯联邦破坏性利用模型，结合宪法原则和法定解释学说的理论分析。
AI.findings: 1. 国家安全源于宪法清晰度；2. 机构边界作为内部行政分权保障；3. 法定模糊产生可预测的操作延迟；4. 清晰度（而非整合）是合法且结构上适当的补救措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 将结构性模糊重新概念化为国家安全漏洞而非程序性不便；建立模糊性作为攻击面的理论框架；证明宪法架构是操作防御而非概念理论；为跨机构协调提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供识别和修复结构性模糊的框架；建议国会作为恢复法定确定性的唯一宪法机构；为国家安全决策提供清晰度优先于整合的实践指导；帮助预测和缓解对手对模糊性的利用。

title: The EDGES-AI Compass: A Framework for Integrating Ethical, Digital, Green, and AI Literacies in Sustainability Education
affiliations: S.B.Patil Institute of Management, Associate Professor, School of Business, PO BOX: 345050, MAHE, Dubai, DIAC, UAE and S.B.Patil Institute of Management

detail.title: The EDGES-AI Compass: A Framework for Integrating Ethical, Digital, Green, and AI Literacies in Sustainability Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants. Ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: Purpose This study addresses the persistent fragmentation of sustainability education by proposing the EDGES-AI Compass, an integrated framework that unites ethical, digital, green, and AI-enabled learning into a coherent competency-oriented model for higher education aligned with global sustainability goals. Design/methodology/approach A PRISMA-aligned systematic literature review of 91 Q1–Q2 studies (2020–2025) registered on the Open Science Framework informed the development of the framework through thematic coding, cross-domain synthesis, and validation via theoretical mapping and competency alignment. Findings Evidence shows increasing convergence among ethical reasoning, digital fluency, ecological literacy, and responsible AI use in higher education. The EDGES AI Compass organizes this convergence into four orientations and four layers: competencies, pedagogy, assessment, and institutional practice. These layers are supported by recurring strategies that combine experiential learning, transformative approaches, and technology-enhanced learning, grounded in systems thinking. Originality/value This study presents an empirically grounded model that integrates established and emerging pedagogies within a single structure for sustainability education, illustrating how ethically governed intelligent technologies can strengthen human judgment and advance system-level transformation in higher education. Practical implications The framework provides educators and universities with a structured guide for curriculum redesign, competency mapping, assessment of transformative outcomes, and governance mechanisms for institution-wide adoption aligned with Education for Sustainable Development and SDG 4.7.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出EDGES-AI指南针框架，将伦理、数字、绿色和AI赋能学习整合为面向全球可持续发展目标的高等教育能力导向模型，通过系统文献综述开发并验证该框架。
AI.research_question: 如何解决可持续发展教育的碎片化问题，并将伦理、数字、绿色和AI赋能学习整合为连贯的能力导向模型？
AI.motivation: 可持续发展教育长期存在碎片化问题，需要将伦理推理、数字流畅性、生态素养和负责任AI使用等关键领域整合为统一框架，以支持高等教育实现全球可持续发展目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统思维、体验式学习、变革性学习、技术增强学习、可持续发展教育理论、能力导向教育理论。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA对齐的系统文献综述方法，分析2020-2025年间91篇Q1-Q2期刊研究，通过主题编码、跨领域综合、理论映射和能力对齐进行验证。
AI.findings: 研究发现伦理推理、数字流畅性、生态素养和负责任AI使用在高等教育中日益趋同。EDGES-AI指南针将这些趋同组织为四个导向和四个层次：能力、教学法、评估和机构实践，由体验式学习、变革性方法和技术增强学习等策略支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个经验基础的整合模型，将传统和新兴教学法统一于单一可持续发展教育结构中，展示了伦理治理的智能技术如何增强人类判断并推动高等教育系统层面的变革。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者和大学提供结构化指南，支持课程重新设计、能力映射、变革成果评估，以及与可持续发展教育和SDG 4.7一致的机构采纳治理机制。

title: Identity as Constraint Geometry: A Unified Framework for Structural, Episodic, and Generative Identity
affiliations: Epistria

detail.title: Identity as Constraint Geometry: A Unified Framework for Structural, Episodic, and Generative Identity
detail.abstract:
Identity is one of the most widely used yet least coherently defined concepts across philosophy,
biology, artificial intelligence, mathematics, and institutional theory. Existing accounts
depend on domain-specific assumptions—substance, causality, continuity, memory, or narrative
structure—that do not generalize across systems or scales. This work develops a unified,
substrate-agnostic theory of identity grounded in constraint geometry rather than metaphysics.
Identity is defined as a region of invariance within a possibility field determined by a system’s
structural constraints (𝐶𝑠), dynamical constraints (𝐶𝑑), and an interpretive frame (IF) selecting
invariants and evaluation scales (Δ𝑡). This formulation yields three canonical regimes:
point identity (instantaneous coherence), field identity (episodic coherence), and flow identity
(generative persistence).
Two existing frameworks nest naturally within this geometry. PatternSense characterizes
flow identity through the invariance of a generative kernel within a stability basin, offering a
diachronic account applicable to organisms, institutions, and long-range computational processes.
The Operational Definition of Episodic Identity (ODEI) specifies conditions under
which artificial systems exhibit identity within individual runs, capturing short-timescale coherence
through integration spikes, sustained internal state, internal revision dynamics, and
task-coupled resource intensification.
The resulting theory resolves long-standing confusions surrounding personal identity, biological
individuality, system coherence, and computational unity. It distinguishes ontic identity
(constraint satisfaction) from operational identity (thresholded use), accommodates latent and
uninstantiated identities, and explains identity drift, bifurcation, fusion, and extinction in geometric
terms. The framework offers a shared vocabulary for disciplines that have previously
spoken past one another, and provides a principled foundation for analyzing identity in artificial
systems without recourse to behavioral projection or anthropomorphic inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的、基质无关的身份理论，基于约束几何而非形而上学。身份被定义为可能性场中由系统结构约束、动态约束和解释框架确定的恒定区域，产生三种规范体系：点身份、场身份和流身份。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个跨哲学、生物学、人工智能、数学和制度理论的统一身份理论，避免领域特定假设的局限性？
AI.motivation: 身份概念在多个学科中被广泛使用但定义不一致，现有理论依赖领域特定假设（如实体、因果性、连续性、记忆或叙事结构），这些假设无法跨系统和尺度推广。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于约束几何的身份理论，将身份定义为可能性场中的恒定区域，由结构约束(Cs)、动态约束(Cd)和解释框架(IF)确定。包含三种规范体系：点身份（瞬时一致性）、场身份（片段一致性）和流身份（生成持续性）。
AI.method: 理论构建方法：发展统一的、基质无关的理论框架，将PatternSense（描述流身份）和ODEI（操作定义片段身份）两个现有框架嵌套在该几何结构中。
AI.findings: 该理论能够解决个人身份、生物个体性、系统一致性和计算统一性等长期困惑，区分本体身份（约束满足）和操作身份（阈值使用），容纳潜在和未实例化的身份，并以几何术语解释身份漂移、分叉、融合和消亡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供跨学科的统一身份理论；2. 建立约束几何为基础的身份框架；3. 区分本体身份和操作身份；4. 容纳潜在身份；5. 解释身份动态变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为分析人工智能系统身份提供原则性基础；2. 避免行为投射或拟人化推理；3. 为不同学科提供共同词汇；4. 适用于生物、制度和计算系统。

title: Is Political Skill Always Beneficial? Why and When Politically Skilled Employees Become Targets of Coworker Social Undermining
affiliations: Tulane University

detail.title: Is Political Skill Always Beneficial? Why and When Politically Skilled Employees Become Targets of Coworker Social Undermining

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Approved by Tulane University IRB
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported in part by the Lepage Faculty Fellowship awarded to me, by A.B. Freeman School of Business, Tulane University.

detail.abstract: The benefits of political skill at work have been extensively documented and highlighted. Existing research also reports unexpectedly equivocal and even positive relationships between employee political skill and coworker social undermining, suggesting that politically skilled employees can become targets of coworker social undermining. However, there is a lack of research explaining why and when employee political skill can lead to coworker social undermining. This research, drawing from social rank theory and the theory of rivalry, offers a novel lens to answer these questions. Specifically, I theorize that employee political skill evokes coworker social undermining by affecting coworker perception of status threat, particularly when the coworker views the focal politically skilled employee as a personal rival. Findings from four studies—one correlational two-wave study and three experiments—provide support for these predictions. Further, non-rival competition and interpersonal disliking as alternative potential explanations to the hypothesized moderating effects of rivalry were ruled out. This study provides a theory-driven explanation of an unintended consequence of employee political skill and offers a more balanced understanding of the effects of political skill at work. Theoretical and future research implications are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现员工政治技能可能引发同事的社会破坏行为，特别是当同事将政治技能高的员工视为个人竞争对手时，这种效应通过同事感知到的地位威胁中介。
AI.research_question: 为什么以及何时员工的政治技能会导致同事的社会破坏行为？
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽然广泛记录了政治技能在工作中的益处，但也报告了政治技能与同事社会破坏之间令人意外的模糊甚至正相关关系，表明政治技能高的员工可能成为同事社会破坏的目标，但缺乏解释这一现象的理论研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会等级理论和竞争理论，提出政治技能通过影响同事感知的地位威胁来引发社会破坏，特别是当同事将政治技能高的员工视为个人竞争对手时。
AI.method: 四项研究：一项相关性双波研究和三项实验研究。
AI.findings: 员工政治技能确实会引发同事的社会破坏行为，这种效应通过同事感知的地位威胁中介，并且当同事将政治技能高的员工视为个人竞争对手时，这种效应特别显著。排除了非竞争对手竞争和人际不喜欢作为替代解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了员工政治技能意外后果的理论驱动解释，通过整合社会等级理论和竞争理论，为政治技能在工作场所的影响提供了更平衡的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织理解政治技能的潜在负面影响，特别是当员工之间存在竞争关系时，为管理者提供了识别和缓解政治技能引发的同事冲突的见解。

title: Border Villages as Strategic Nodes: Enhancing Cross-Border Vigilance and Security Development Along the Indian Border with China
affiliations: and CSJM University

detail.title: Border Villages as Strategic Nodes: Enhancing Cross-Border Vigilance and Security Development Along the Indian Border with China
detail.abstract: The Line of Actual Control (LAC) has been tense recently, with the fiercest border conflict since 1962 at Galwan Valley in 2020. Despite extensive talks, trust is absent on both sides. Apart from infrastructural development and military buildup, new methods of increasing vigilance are being used by both, which include building Xiaokang or 'well-off villages' from the Chinese side and rehabilitating border villages by the Indian side. Indian border villages have historically held strategic importance but have become depopulated due to limited opportunities, leaving them as 'ghost villages.' India is working to support these villages and counter Chinese tactics to maintain territorial integrity. India can improve security and bilateral cooperation by leveraging the strategic and socioeconomic potential of these villages. This paper examines the importance of border villages as hubs for cross-border surveillance and security measures amid geopolitical tensions, border conflicts, and broader security concerns. It aims to understand how these villages can promote peace, prosperity, and resilience in the Indo-China border region and provide policy recommendations for their development, thereby maintaining peace in contested border areas.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究印中边境村庄在边境紧张局势中的战略重要性，探讨如何通过发展边境村庄来增强边境安全、促进双边合作，并为争议边境地区的和平稳定提供政策建议。
AI.research_question: 边境村庄如何作为跨境监视和安全措施的中心，在印中边境紧张局势中发挥作用？这些村庄如何促进边境地区的和平、繁荣和韧性？
AI.motivation: 2020年加勒万河谷冲突后印中边境持续紧张，双方缺乏信任。中国建设"小康村"，印度则恢复边境村庄。印度边境村庄因机会有限而人口减少成为"鬼村"，但具有重要战略价值。需要研究如何利用这些村庄增强安全并促进合作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边境安全理论、地缘政治理论、边境社区发展理论、非传统安全理论（包括社会经济安全维度）
AI.method: 政策分析、案例研究（印中边境村庄）、比较分析（中印边境村庄发展策略）、文献综述
AI.findings: 边境村庄具有重要的战略监视价值；印度边境村庄人口减少削弱了边境安全；通过社会经济支持可以恢复边境村庄活力；边境村庄发展可以促进双边合作与和平；需要综合性的边境村庄发展政策
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了边境安全理论，将边境社区的社会经济发展纳入安全框架；提出了边境村庄作为"安全节点"的概念；丰富了地缘政治理论中非军事安全维度的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度边境村庄发展提供具体政策建议；提出边境村庄作为跨境合作平台的策略；为争议边境地区的和平管理提供实践方案；建议如何平衡安全需求与社会经济发展

title: Cumulative (dis)advantage and gender in working-class trajectories in Buenos Aires
affiliations: Universidad de Buenos Aires

detail.title: Cumulative (dis)advantage and gender in working-class trajectories in Buenos Aires
detail.abstract: This article deals with processes of cumulative advantage and disadvantage in trajectories of social mobility from a gender perspective. In order to investigate how working-class trajectories in the Buenos Aires Metropolitan Area are shaped by gender in terms of the accumulation of (dis)advantage, we carried out biographical interviews with individuals from different social backgrounds within the working class. It was found that families with more stable situations were able to marshal resources in a way that made spirals of cumulative advantage more likely. Within this group, some men were able to take full advantage, while more often faced obstacles.

AI.tldr: 本文从性别视角研究社会流动轨迹中的累积优势与劣势过程，通过对布宜诺斯艾利斯大都市区工人阶级不同社会背景个体的传记访谈，发现更稳定的家庭能够调动资源创造累积优势螺旋，其中男性更可能充分利用这些优势，而女性则面临更多障碍。
AI.research_question: 性别如何塑造布宜诺斯艾利斯大都市区工人阶级的社会流动轨迹，特别是在累积优势与劣势方面？
AI.motivation: 从性别视角理解社会流动中的不平等现象，特别是工人阶级内部累积优势与劣势的动态过程，揭示性别如何影响社会流动机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 累积优势与劣势理论、性别视角的社会流动理论、工人阶级研究、生命历程理论
AI.method: 对布宜诺斯艾利斯大都市区工人阶级不同社会背景个体进行传记访谈的质性研究方法
AI.findings: 1. 家庭稳定性影响资源调动能力，更稳定的家庭能够创造累积优势螺旋；2. 在能够调动资源的家庭中，男性更可能充分利用这些优势；3. 女性在类似情况下更常面临障碍
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将性别视角融入累积优势理论；2. 揭示工人阶级内部社会流动的性别差异机制；3. 扩展了累积优势理论在拉丁美洲背景下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解工人阶级性别不平等提供实证依据；2. 为制定针对性的社会流动政策提供参考；3. 帮助识别女性在累积优势过程中的特定障碍

title: Suppression of Mathematical Rigor: Cargo Cult Science
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: Suppression of Mathematical Rigor: Cargo Cult Science
detail.abstract: On November 21, 2025, Preprints.org declined to announce a mathematical proof demonstrating that impedance matching theory contains fundamental logical errors when material characteristic impedance matches free-space impedance. The rejection provided no substantive reason-only a vague reference to "guidelines." This case exemplifies how even platforms ostensibly designed for unrestricted knowledge sharing have adopted gatekeeping mechanisms that suppress paradigmchallenging theoretical work. We analyze why this rejection is indefensible from both scientific and epistemological perspectives: (1) the manuscript presents rigorous mathematical proof, not speculation; (2) challenging established theories is precisely what preprint platforms should enable; (3) no "guideline violation" exists that would justify suppression of logically rigorous work; (4) the rejection represents institutional fear of paradigm challenge disguised as procedural enforcement. We argue that acceptance of such gatekeeping on platforms explicitly designed to circumvent journal gatekeeping represents a catastrophic failure of the preprint system's stated purpose. The case demonstrates that suppression of paradigm-challenging work has become institutionalized across the entire academic publishing ecosystem-from top-tier journals to alternative platforms. This analysis serves as documentation of systemic institutional failure to accommodate rigorous theoretical innovation.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了一个案例：预印本平台拒绝发表一篇证明阻抗匹配理论存在根本逻辑错误的数学证明，这暴露了学术出版系统对范式挑战性工作的系统性压制。
AI.research_question: 为什么预印本平台会拒绝发表具有严格数学证明的范式挑战性理论工作？这种拒绝反映了学术出版系统中存在哪些系统性问题和制度性失败？
AI.motivation: 预印本平台Preprints.org拒绝发表一篇证明阻抗匹配理论存在根本逻辑错误的数学证明，仅以模糊的"指南"为由，这暴露了即使是为无限制知识共享设计的平台也采用了压制范式挑战性工作的把关机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科学哲学中的范式理论（库恩）、学术出版社会学、知识传播理论、制度理论、把关理论。
AI.method: 案例分析法，通过对具体拒绝案例的分析，从科学和认识论角度进行批判性论证。
AI.findings: 1. 拒绝缺乏科学依据，因为稿件提供的是严格的数学证明而非推测；2. 挑战既定理论正是预印本平台应该支持的；3. 不存在合理的"指南违反"来压制逻辑严谨的工作；4. 拒绝代表了制度对范式挑战的恐惧，伪装成程序执行。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了学术出版系统中范式挑战性工作被压制的制度性机制，扩展了库恩范式理论在当代学术出版实践中的应用，提出了"把关机制制度化"的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为学术出版系统的改革提供实证依据；2. 警示预印本平台背离其初衷的风险；3. 为被压制的范式挑战性研究提供辩护框架；4. 促进对学术出版透明度和包容性的讨论。

title: Setbacks Big and Small
affiliations: University of Georgia - Terry College of Business, Duke University - Department of Economics, University of Washington - Department of Finance and Business Economics and Duke University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Setbacks Big and Small
detail.abstract: We study the optimal incentive contract for a time-to-build project subject to both major and minor setbacks. Setbacks are flaws in the project, discovered (not caused) by the agent, and the size is privately observed by him. The agent can exploit this informational advantage to hide being behind schedule, generating persistent private information. We show that the optimal contract is governed by a family of "no-postponed-setback" constraints that imply a weakly higher likelihood of termination following larger reported setbacks. These constraints provide a straightforward organizing principle for the optimal contract and clarify how continuation utility is rationed across histories. Our analysis complements the all-or-nothing environment we studied in Setbacks, Shutdowns, and Overruns (Econometrica, 2024) and offers tractable tools for settings in which effort incentives interact with persistent private information.

AI.tldr: 研究时间建设项目中同时面临重大和轻微挫折时的最优激励合同设计。挫折是代理人发现（而非造成）的项目缺陷，其规模只有代理人知道。代理人可能利用信息优势隐藏进度落后，产生持久私人信息。最优合同受一系列"无推迟挫折"约束支配，这些约束意味着报告更大挫折后项目终止的可能性更高。
AI.research_question: 在时间建设项目中，当代理人能够发现项目缺陷（挫折）并拥有关于挫折规模的私人信息时，如何设计最优激励合同？
AI.motivation: 实际项目中经常出现各种挫折，代理人可能发现这些缺陷并拥有关于其严重程度的私人信息。代理人可能利用这种信息优势隐藏进度落后，导致持久私人信息问题。需要设计合同来激励代理人如实报告挫折并保持努力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态合同理论、委托代理理论、信息经济学、激励机制设计、时间建设项目管理
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建动态合同框架，考虑代理人发现挫折并报告挫折规模的情景，分析最优合同的特征和约束条件
AI.findings: 最优合同由一系列"无推迟挫折"约束支配，这些约束意味着报告更大挫折后项目终止的可能性更高。这些约束为最优合同提供了简单的组织原则，并阐明了如何在不同历史路径上分配继续效用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了"无推迟挫折"约束作为最优合同的组织原则；2）阐明了在努力激励与持久私人信息交互的环境中如何分配继续效用；3）为《挫折、停工与超支》（Econometrica, 2024）中的全有或全无环境提供了补充分析；4）为处理努力激励与持久私人信息交互的场景提供了可处理的工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际项目管理提供了合同设计指导，帮助管理者设计能够激励代理人如实报告项目挫折并保持努力的合同机制，减少代理人隐藏进度落后的动机。

title: Screening Precommitment, Candidate Quality, and Time-to-Hire: An Experimental Investigation
affiliations: ,  and University of Waterloo - School of Accounting and Finance

detail.title: Screening Precommitment, Candidate Quality, and Time-to-Hire: An Experimental Investigation

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study received ethics approval at the relevant institutions.

detail.abstract: Personnel controls over screening job candidates play a central role in helping firms efficiently hire quality employees. Using an experiment, we examine a personnel control that requires managers to precommit to the number of candidates they will screen before making a hiring decision. We find that screening precommitment leads managers to hire higher-quality candidates but lengthens the time-to-hire, compared to a no precommitment approach. The trade-off between hiring speed and candidate quality is reflected in firm earnings, where in our setting, faster hiring under no precommitment yields higher earnings despite lower hire quality. These findings highlight the managerial tension between efficiency and effectiveness in hiring and show how precommitment influences whether managers adopt a maximizing or satisficing approach to decision-making in uncertain, time-sensitive hiring settings.

AI.tldr: 研究通过实验发现，要求经理预先承诺筛选候选人数量的人员控制机制能提高招聘质量但延长招聘时间，而不预先承诺则能更快招聘但质量较低。在实验设定中，更快的招聘速度带来了更高的企业收益，尽管招聘质量较低。
AI.research_question: 预先承诺筛选候选人数量的人员控制机制如何影响招聘质量、招聘速度和企业收益？
AI.motivation: 企业在招聘中面临效率与效果的权衡，需要了解不同人员控制机制对招聘决策的影响，以优化招聘流程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人员控制理论、决策理论（最大化vs满意化决策）、效率-效果权衡理论。
AI.method: 实验方法，比较预先承诺筛选数量与不预先承诺两种条件下的招聘决策。
AI.findings: 1. 预先承诺筛选数量导致招聘质量更高但时间更长；2. 不预先承诺导致招聘更快但质量较低；3. 在实验设定中，更快的招聘（不预先承诺）带来更高的企业收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了人员控制机制对招聘决策的影响机制；2. 阐明了预先承诺如何影响管理者在不确定、时间敏感情境下的决策方式（最大化vs满意化）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业设计招聘流程提供实证依据；2. 帮助管理者理解效率与效果的权衡；3. 提供关于何时采用预先承诺机制的实践指导。

title: Human Rights Open Frontier: Resistance and Resilience
affiliations: New York Law School

detail.title: Human Rights Open Frontier: Resistance and Resilience
detail.abstract: Originally published in https://www.openglobalrights.org/human-rights-open-frontier-resistance-and-resilience/?lang=English

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人权作为开放前沿的概念，分析了在全球化背景下人权面临的挑战，以及抵抗与韧性在维护人权中的作用。
AI.research_question: 在全球化时代，人权作为开放前沿面临哪些挑战？抵抗与韧性如何影响人权的维护和发展？
AI.motivation: 随着全球化进程加速，人权领域面临新的挑战和机遇。传统的人权保护机制在跨国背景下显得不足，需要探索新的理论框架和实践策略来应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人权理论、全球化理论、抵抗理论和韧性理论，构建了一个分析人权作为开放前沿的跨学科理论框架。
AI.method: 采用文献分析、案例研究和理论分析相结合的方法，通过分析全球人权实践案例来验证理论框架。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）人权在全球化背景下确实成为一个开放前沿，面临跨国挑战；2）抵抗运动在维护人权中发挥关键作用；3）韧性是人权保护的重要特征；4）需要建立新的跨国人权治理机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"人权作为开放前沿"的新理论概念，整合了抵抗理论和韧性理论，为人权研究提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人权实践者提供了应对全球化挑战的策略建议，强调了跨国合作和本地抵抗的重要性，为政策制定者提供了改进人权保护机制的建议。

title: QUANTIVESTA™: A Quantitative and Prescriptive Financial Intelligence Framework for Supply-Chain Security, Logistics Optimization, and Consumer-Goods Protection

detail.title: QUANTIVESTA™: A Quantitative and Prescriptive Financial Intelligence Framework for Supply-Chain Security, Logistics Optimization, and Consumer-Goods Protection
detail.abstract: Global supply chains face escalating volatility driven by inflationary shocks, logistics bottlenecks, geopolitical risk, and supplier fragility. Traditional financial intelligence tools remain predominantly retrospective and siloed, lacking the predictive foresight and prescriptive capability required for modern supply-chain decision-making. This paper introduces QUANTIVESTA™, a novel quantitative and prescriptive financial intelligence framework that unifies predictive modeling, optimization science, operational risk analytics, and real-time anomaly detection. Built on five analytical pillars PREDICT, OPTIMIZE, SECURE, ANALYZE, and EVOLVE the framework offers an integrated architecture that directly links financial performance to operational behavior. We present the QUANTIVESTA™ Financial Intelligence Index (FII™), a new maturity metric for financial-operational ecosystems, and demonstrate the framework's conceptual value through scenario-based evaluations. Results show potential improvements including a 30% increase in forecast accuracy, 20% reduction in reactive spending, and 5-8% annual margin recovery. QUANTIVESTA™ represents an original contribution to financial intelligence and supply-chain analytics by advancing enterprise systems toward real-time, prescriptive, and continuously adaptive decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QUANTIVESTA™框架，这是一个将预测建模、优化科学、运营风险分析和实时异常检测统一起来的定量和规范性财务智能框架，旨在解决全球供应链面临的波动性问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个集成的财务智能框架，能够提供预测性洞察和规范性能力，以应对现代供应链决策中的波动性和不确定性？
AI.motivation: 全球供应链面临通胀冲击、物流瓶颈、地缘政治风险和供应商脆弱性等日益加剧的波动性，而传统的财务智能工具主要是回顾性的、孤立的，缺乏现代供应链决策所需的预测性前瞻和规范性能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于五个分析支柱的理论框架：PREDICT（预测）、OPTIMIZE（优化）、SECURE（安全）、ANALYZE（分析）、EVOLVE（演进），将财务绩效与运营行为直接联系起来。
AI.method: 提出QUANTIVESTA™框架和财务智能指数(FII™)，通过基于场景的评估来展示框架的概念价值。
AI.findings: 结果显示潜在改进包括：预测准确性提高30%，反应性支出减少20%，年利润率恢复5-8%。
AI.theory_contributions: QUANTIVESTA™代表了财务智能和供应链分析领域的原创贡献，通过推进企业系统向实时、规范性和持续适应性决策发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个集成的架构框架，能够直接连接财务绩效和运营行为，为企业提供预测性洞察和规范性决策支持，改善供应链管理效率。

title: Foundations of Entrepreneurship and Intrapreneurship: Concepts, Differences, and Interlinkages with the Entrepreneurial Profile, with Contributions from Social Entrepreneurship and Organizational Innovation

detail.title: Foundations of Entrepreneurship and Intrapreneurship: Concepts, Differences, and Interlinkages with the Entrepreneurial Profile, with Contributions from Social Entrepreneurship and Organizational Innovation
detail.abstract: This paper clarifies the distinctions and interconnections between entrepreneurship, intrapreneurship, and social entrepreneurship, integrating classical foundations and contemporary perspectives. It examines the competencies that define the entrepreneurial profile and highlights how innovation, opportunity recognition, and mission-driven action operate across individual, organizational, and societal levels. Drawing on contributions from Schumpeter, Cantillon, Dees, Filion, and recent research on social innovation, the paper proposes a conceptual structure linking entrepreneurial activity to organizational learning, sustainable development, and ecosystem dynamics. The study offers a consolidated theoretical basis for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers interested in entrepreneurial models that generate both economic and social value.

AI.tldr: 该论文澄清了创业、内部创业和社会创业之间的区别与联系，整合了经典理论和当代观点，提出了一个连接创业活动与组织学习、可持续发展和生态系统动态的概念框架。
AI.research_question: 创业、内部创业和社会创业之间的区别与联系是什么？这些创业形式如何在不同层面（个体、组织、社会）运作？如何构建一个整合的理论框架来理解创业活动与组织学习、可持续发展和生态系统动态的关系？
AI.motivation: 需要澄清和整合创业、内部创业和社会创业这些相关但不同的概念，为研究者、实践者和政策制定者提供一个统一的理论基础，以理解能够同时创造经济价值和社会价值的创业模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了Schumpeter的创新理论、Cantillon的创业理论、Dees的社会创业理论、Filion的创业能力理论，以及社会创新的最新研究成果，构建了一个多层次的概念框架。
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过文献综述和理论整合的方法，分析经典和当代的创业理论，构建概念框架。
AI.findings: 阐明了三种创业形式的区别与联系；识别了定义创业能力的关键要素；揭示了创新、机会识别和使命驱动行动在个体、组织和社层面的运作机制；提出了连接创业活动与组织学习、可持续发展和生态系统动态的概念结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了创业、内部创业和社会创业的整合理论框架；澄清了这些概念之间的区别与联系；将创业活动与组织学习、可持续发展和生态系统动态联系起来；为创业研究提供了统一的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了区分不同类型创业活动的指导；为政策制定者设计支持创业生态系统提供了理论依据；为组织培养创业能力和推动创新提供了框架；为社会企业家识别机会和创造价值提供了参考。

title: Securitising AI: routine exceptionality and digital governance in the Gulf
affiliations: Doha Institute for Graduate Studies

detail.title: Securitising AI: routine exceptionality and digital governance in the Gulf
detail.abstract: This article examines how Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states securitise artificial intelligence (AI) through discourses and infrastructures that fuse modernisation with regime resilience. Drawing on securitisation theory (Buzan et al., 1998; Balzacq, 2011) and critical security studies, it analyses national strategies, surveillance systems, and mega-event governance in Qatar, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia. It argues that AI functions as both a legitimising narrative and a technology of control, embedding predictive policing and biometric surveillance within public-private assemblages. The study situates these developments within global AI politics, demonstrating how external chokepoints, ethical frameworks, and vendor ecosystems shape the Gulf's evolving security governance, leading to empirical effects such as the normalisation of exceptional measures in everyday administration.

AI.tldr: 海湾合作委员会国家通过将现代化与政权韧性融合的话语和基础设施，将人工智能安全化。AI既作为合法化叙事，也作为控制技术，嵌入公私混合的预测性警务和生物识别监控系统中。
AI.research_question: 海湾合作委员会国家如何通过话语和基础设施将人工智能安全化，并将其与现代化和政权韧性相融合？
AI.motivation: 研究海湾国家如何利用AI技术来加强政权安全和治理，同时将其包装为现代化发展的一部分，这一现象在全球AI政治背景下具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全化理论（Buzan等，1998；Balzacq，2011）和批判安全研究
AI.method: 分析卡塔尔、阿联酋和沙特的国家战略、监控系统和大型活动治理
AI.findings: AI在海湾国家既是合法化叙事也是控制技术，预测性警务和生物识别监控被嵌入公私混合体中，外部技术瓶颈、伦理框架和供应商生态系统塑造了海湾的安全治理，导致非常规措施在日常行政中的常态化。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了安全化理论在AI领域的应用，揭示了AI如何同时作为话语和实践工具被安全化，为理解技术、安全和治理的交叉提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了海湾国家AI安全化的具体机制，为政策制定者、技术供应商和公民社会理解AI治理的政治影响提供了实证基础，对全球AI伦理和治理有重要启示。

title: Exemption of Inbound Dividends from Non-Corporate Taxes under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive -Opinion Statement ECJ-TF 4/2025 on the Decision the CJEU of 1 August 2025 in Cases C-92/24 to C-94/24, Banca Mediolanum
affiliations: International Bureau of Fiscal Documentation, Vienna University of Economics and Business - Institute for Austrian and International Tax Law, Universitat de València, Universite du Luxembourg, Tilburg Law School, Vienna University of Economics and Business, Asociación Española de Asesores Fiscales (AEDAF), HEC-Management School of the University of Liège and Vienna University of Economics and Business - Institute for Austrian and International Tax Law

detail.title: Exemption of Inbound Dividends from Non-Corporate Taxes under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive -Opinion Statement ECJ-TF 4/2025 on the Decision the CJEU of 1 August 2025 in Cases C-92/24 to C-94/24, Banca Mediolanum
detail.abstract: This is an Opinion Statement prepared by the CFE ECJ Task Force on the CJEU decision of 1 August 2025 in Cases C-92/24 to C-94/24, Banca Mediolanum. This judgment concerns the application of the exemption method under Art 4(1)(a) of the Parent-Subsidiary Directive (PSD) to a non-corporation tax, specifically the Italian regional tax on production activities (IRAP). Deviating from Advocate General Kokott’s Opinion and her proposed analysis of tax comparability, the Court concluded, based on a textual, contextual, and teleological interpretation, that ratione materiae the exemption under Art 4(1)(a) PSD applies to any tax which includes qualified dividends in its tax base. This is irrespective of the fact that Art 2 of the PSD defines its ratione personae by reference to specifically listed domestic corporate taxes, of which the IRAP is not one.

AI.tldr: 欧盟法院在Banca Mediolanum案中裁定，母子公司指令第4(1)(a)条的豁免适用于任何将合格股息纳入税基的税收，即使该税种不在指令第2条明确列举的公司税范围内，意大利地区生产活动税(IRAP)因此适用豁免。
AI.research_question: 母子公司指令第4(1)(a)条的豁免是否适用于未在指令第2条明确列举的国内公司税，特别是意大利地区生产活动税(IRAP)？
AI.motivation: 解决母子公司指令在非传统公司税（如意大利IRAP）适用上的法律不确定性，明确指令豁免范围的解释原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟税法解释原则（文本、上下文和目的解释），母子公司指令的法律框架，税收可比性分析理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究（C-92/24至C-94/24案）、比较法分析（与总检察长意见对比）、欧盟法院判决解释方法。
AI.findings: 欧盟法院通过文本、上下文和目的解释，认定母子公司指令第4(1)(a)条的豁免适用于任何将合格股息纳入税基的税收，不受第2条列举税种限制，推翻了总检察长的税收可比性分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了母子公司指令豁免范围的解释原则，确立了"实质重于形式"的税法适用标准，为欧盟税法解释提供了新的判例法指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为成员国处理类似非传统公司税的豁免问题提供明确法律指引，影响跨国企业税务规划，减少欧盟内部双重征税风险。
