title: Education Fever: Inequality, Fertility and Growth
affiliations: Ben-Gurion University of the Negev - Department of Economics

detail.title: Education Fever: Inequality, Fertility and Growth

publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Demand for skilled labor and social status accorded by educational achievements induce a race to acquire education, dubbed “education fever”. In conjunction with credit market constraints and in the context of quantity-quality tradeoff, this, in turn, may reduce fertility, especially in well-educated families, and create cross section inequality while limiting intergenerational mobility. The resulting inequality is persistent which, in turn, may have adverse implications for economic growth. It is argued that these phenomena are consistent with recent economic and social developments in China.

AI.tldr: 教育狂热导致技能需求与教育竞争，结合信贷约束和数量-质量权衡，降低生育率（尤其高教育家庭），造成不平等且限制代际流动，最终影响经济增长，这些现象与中国近期发展相符。
AI.research_question: 教育狂热如何通过信贷约束和数量-质量权衡影响生育率、不平等和代际流动，进而对经济增长产生长期影响？
AI.motivation: 解释中国等国家出现的教育狂热现象及其社会经济后果，特别是生育率下降、不平等加剧和代际流动受限的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育狂热理论、信贷市场约束理论、数量-质量权衡理论（Becker的生育理论）、不平等与代际流动理论、经济增长理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，结合中国社会经济数据的现象观察和理论推演
AI.findings: 教育狂热导致高教育家庭生育率下降，加剧横向不平等并限制代际流动，形成持久不平等，最终可能阻碍经济增长
AI.theory_contributions: 将教育狂热、信贷约束和数量-质量权衡整合为统一分析框架，解释生育率下降、不平等和代际流动受限的联动机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国等经历教育狂热的国家提供政策启示，如缓解信贷约束、促进教育公平、应对低生育率和不平等问题

title: Time to Think Systems in Difficult Airways: ‘The SCOOP on Safety in Thyroid Surgery’
affiliations: ,  and Bart's Health NHS Trust - The Royal London Hospital

detail.title: Time to Think Systems in Difficult Airways: ‘The SCOOP on Safety in Thyroid Surgery’
detail.abstract: Despite clear national guidance, patients who have complications where a difficult airway can be anticipated, continue to experience avoidable harm. This article explores the implementation gaps that contribute to this risk and highlights how systems thinking can illuminate the barriers, using post-thyroidectomy haematoma as an illustrative case. In this case, the patient experienced a “near miss”, despite a quality improvement project related to management of this airway emergency being successfully introduced. The near miss provides an opportunity for learning. Using systems tools to analyse the case, we demonstrate how deeper diagnostic work can reveal complexity, latent system vulnerabilities and opportunities for more effective, sustainable interventions. Moreover, by applying a systems lens, we demonstrate that organisations can better design, measure and monitor such patient safety initiatives to build genuine resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了尽管有国家指南，但可预见困难气道的患者仍遭受可避免伤害的问题。文章以甲状腺术后血肿为例，分析实施差距，并展示系统思维如何揭示障碍、发现系统脆弱性，以及如何设计更有效的患者安全干预措施。
AI.research_question: 为什么在有明确国家指南的情况下，可预见困难气道的患者仍会遭受可避免的伤害？系统思维如何帮助识别实施差距并设计更有效的患者安全干预措施？
AI.motivation: 尽管存在国家指南，但可预见困难气道的患者仍持续遭受可避免的伤害，这表明存在实施差距。通过一个甲状腺术后血肿的"接近失误"案例，揭示系统层面的问题，推动更有效的患者安全改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统思维、患者安全理论、质量改进理论、复杂系统分析、组织韧性理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以甲状腺术后血肿的"接近失误"事件为例，运用系统分析工具进行深入诊断，识别系统脆弱性和复杂性。
AI.findings: 即使成功引入了质量改进项目，仍可能发生"接近失误"事件。系统分析揭示了深层次的复杂性、潜在的系统脆弱性，以及传统干预措施的局限性。组织需要更全面的方法来设计、测量和监控患者安全倡议。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了系统思维在患者安全领域的应用，提供了分析医疗系统复杂性的框架，强调了组织韧性建设的重要性，为理解实施差距提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了使用系统工具分析医疗安全事件的具体方法，展示了如何从"接近失误"中学习，为医疗机构设计更有效、可持续的患者安全干预措施提供了实践指导，帮助组织建立真正的韧性。

title: Economic Benefits of Socio-Cultural Integration (The Experience of the Great Silk Road)

detail.title: Economic Benefits of Socio-Cultural Integration (The Experience of the Great Silk Road)
detail.abstract: This article analyzes the economic effects of socio-cultural integration processes among Turkic states using the example of the "Great Silk Road". Historical experiences, the impact of cultural ties on economic development, and the contribution of modern integration processes to tourism, entrepreneurship, and investment are highlighted. The research results show that socio-cultural integration is an important strategic factor in ensuring not only cultural unity, but also economic stability and growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了突厥国家间社会文化整合过程的经济效应，以"丝绸之路"为例，探讨历史文化联系对经济发展的影响，以及现代整合过程对旅游、创业和投资的贡献。
AI.research_question: 突厥国家间的社会文化整合过程如何影响经济发展？具体而言，历史文化联系（如丝绸之路）如何促进旅游、创业和投资等经济活动？
AI.motivation: 随着全球化进程加速，区域整合成为重要趋势。突厥国家间存在深厚的历史文化联系，但缺乏对这些社会文化整合过程经济效应的系统研究。理解这些联系如何转化为实际经济利益对区域发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区域整合理论、文化经济学和社会资本理论，探讨社会文化联系如何通过信任建立、网络形成和知识共享等机制促进经济发展。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，以"丝绸之路"为典型案例，结合历史分析、文献综述和实证数据，分析突厥国家间的社会文化整合过程及其经济影响。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）社会文化整合是确保文化统一和经济稳定增长的重要战略因素；2）历史文化联系显著促进旅游业发展；3）文化整合为创业和投资创造有利环境；4）现代整合过程强化了历史联系的经济价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）扩展了区域整合理论，强调社会文化维度的重要性；2）丰富了文化经济学研究，提供了历史文化联系转化为经济利益的实证证据；3）深化了对社会资本在经济发展中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为突厥国家政策制定者提供整合战略建议；2）为旅游和投资部门提供发展指导；3）为企业跨国经营提供文化整合策略；4）为区域合作项目（如新丝绸之路倡议）提供参考。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12316
title: European Regional Resilience to Supply Shocks Diffused Through Global Value Chains
affiliations: Luiss Guido Carli University, , Luiss Guido Carli University - Department of Economics and Finance and

detail.title: European Regional Resilience to Supply Shocks Diffused Through Global Value Chains

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The aim of this paper is to quantitatively assess the propagation of supply shocks across European regions, triggered by the COVID-19 pandemic and diffused through Global Value Chains (GVCs). By taking advantage of the cross-country variation in policy responses to the pandemic, as well as the heterogeneity in regional productive structures, we document how downstream transmission of shocks via GVC-induced backward linkages yields differences in terms of regional resilience. By combining and adapting datasets at the NUTS2 level, classifying EU regions according to the risk of falling into a development trap, and embedding inter-regional, inter-industry indicators in a regression model estimated with a local projection method, we show that regional responses of real value added to foreign (i.e., inter-country) and domestic (i.e., intra-country yet inter- and intra-regional) shocks are far from homogeneous. The nuanced picture emerging from our findings warns against withdrawing from GVCs as an attempt to insulate from foreign shocks, as this might hamper the very forces that allow dynamic regions to withstand them.

AI.tldr: 本文通过COVID-19疫情下的政策差异和区域生产结构异质性，定量评估了供应链冲击通过全球价值链在欧洲区域间的传播，发现区域对国内外冲击的响应存在显著差异，警告退出全球价值链可能削弱区域韧性。
AI.research_question: 供应链冲击如何通过全球价值链在欧洲区域间传播？区域对国内外冲击的响应有何差异？退出全球价值链是否有助于隔离外部冲击？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情引发了全球供应链冲击，欧洲各区域面临不同程度的冲击传播。理解冲击如何通过全球价值链在区域间扩散，以及区域韧性差异，对制定有效的区域发展政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链理论、区域韧性理论、供应链冲击传播机制、发展陷阱理论、区域异质性框架。
AI.method: 结合NUTS2级别数据集，根据陷入发展陷阱风险对欧盟区域分类，将区域间、产业间指标嵌入回归模型，使用局部投影方法估计。
AI.findings: 区域对国外（跨国）和国内（国内但跨区域）冲击的实际增加值响应远非同质。通过全球价值链引发的后向关联的下游冲击传播导致区域韧性差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对全球价值链冲击传播机制的理解，扩展了区域韧性理论，为发展陷阱理论提供了实证支持，揭示了区域异质性在冲击响应中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 警告退出全球价值链可能削弱区域抵御冲击的能力，为区域政策制定者提供基于证据的决策支持，帮助识别高风险区域并制定针对性干预措施。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12318
title: Public Preferences for Index Aggregation Imply Lower Ocean Sustainability
affiliations: , University of Hamburg - Faculty of Business, Economics, and Social Sciences, Students and ETH Zurich

detail.title: Public Preferences for Index Aggregation Imply Lower Ocean Sustainability

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Sustainability indices are essential to track development progress and guide policy. They often aggregate diverse dimensions into a composite index, requiring value-based choices about the importance of each dimension (weighting) and the extent to which weaknesses in some area can be offset by strengths in others (substitutability). Such choices strongly shape indices but lack empirical support. We introduce a preference-elicitation experiment to align aggregation choices with stakeholder views and apply it to the Ocean Health Index (OHI). Respondents from twelve coastal countries predominantly view OHI goals as complementary, challenging current assumptions of perfect substitutability. Incorporating these public preferences yields substantially lower OHI scores, suggesting that ocean sustainability may be overstated and that policy should focus more on improving the weakest-performing dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过偏好诱导实验，将海洋健康指数（OHI）的聚合选择与利益相关者观点对齐，发现公众普遍认为OHI目标具有互补性而非完全可替代，这导致OHI得分显著降低，表明海洋可持续性可能被高估，政策应更关注表现最差的维度。
AI.research_question: 如何将可持续性指数的聚合选择（权重和可替代性）与利益相关者的偏好对齐？公众对海洋健康指数各维度之间可替代性的看法如何影响指数得分和政策建议？
AI.motivation: 可持续性指数对跟踪发展进展和指导政策至关重要，但将不同维度聚合为综合指数时需要进行价值选择（如权重分配和可替代性假设）。这些选择强烈影响指数结果，但缺乏实证支持。现有指数如海洋健康指数假设各目标之间完全可替代，这可能不符合公众的实际偏好。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 可持续性指数理论：综合指数的构建涉及维度选择、标准化、权重分配和聚合方法
2. 可替代性理论：维度之间在多大程度上可以相互补偿（完全可替代vs互补性）
3. 偏好诱导理论：通过实验方法获取利益相关者的价值判断
4. 多准则决策分析：处理多个相互冲突目标的决策框架
AI.method: 采用偏好诱导实验方法，从12个沿海国家的受访者中收集数据，了解他们对海洋健康指数各维度之间可替代性的看法。通过实验设计让受访者在不同维度组合之间做出选择，从而推断他们的偏好结构。将获得的偏好信息应用于OHI的重新计算。
AI.findings:
1. 受访者普遍认为OHI各目标具有互补性，挑战了当前完全可替代性的假设
2. 纳入公众偏好后，OHI得分显著降低
3. 海洋可持续性可能被当前指数高估
4. 政策应更关注表现最差的维度，而不是依赖整体平均得分
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了将偏好诱导实验应用于可持续性指数构建的方法论框架
2. 挑战了可持续性指数中普遍采用的完全可替代性假设
3. 为基于实证偏好的指数聚合提供了理论基础
4. 扩展了多准则决策分析在环境政策中的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为海洋健康指数提供了基于实证偏好的改进方法
2. 揭示了当前OHI可能高估海洋可持续性的风险
3. 建议政策制定者应更关注表现最差的维度
4. 为其他可持续性指数的构建提供了可借鉴的方法
5. 增强了指数构建过程的透明度和民主合法性

title: Generating Combinatorial Salience: How Theory-Driven Experimentation Enables Organizational Innovation

detail.title: Generating Combinatorial Salience: How Theory-Driven Experimentation Enables Organizational Innovation
detail.abstract: Organizations face an astronomical number of potential innovation pathways, yet most successfully navigate toward useful combinations of ideas, technologies, and processes. This article examines how theory-driven experimentation generates combinatorial salience within organizational contexts, enabling practitioners to identify promising innovations among indefinite possibilities. Drawing on recent advances in combinatorial innovation theory and cognitive science, we argue that organizational innovation depends not merely on recombining existing elements but on the capacity of organizational actors to theorize, reason causally, and experiment systematically. We demonstrate how practical theorizing-treating employees as capable reasoners rather than mere tinkerers-can transform organizational innovation capabilities. Through examination of contemporary organizational cases spanning healthcare, manufacturing, and technology sectors, we identify evidence-based interventions for building theory-driven innovation capacity. The article contributes to practice by offering actionable strategies for cultivating organizational environments where theory-laden experimentation accelerates learning cycles and enables the discovery of novel yet feasible innovations.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨组织如何通过理论驱动的实验在众多创新路径中识别有前景的组合创新，强调将员工作为理性推理者而非简单试错者，从而提升组织创新能力。
AI.research_question: 组织如何通过理论驱动的实验在无限可能性中识别有前景的创新组合？
AI.motivation: 组织面临海量创新路径选择，但大多数能成功导航至有用的想法、技术和流程组合，需要理解这种导航能力背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组合创新理论、认知科学、实践理论化、因果推理、系统实验
AI.method: 通过医疗保健、制造业和技术领域的当代组织案例研究
AI.findings: 理论驱动的实验能产生组合显著性，使组织能够在无限可能性中识别有前景的创新；实践理论化（将员工作为理性推理者）能转变组织创新能力
AI.theory_contributions: 将组合创新理论与认知科学结合，提出理论驱动的实验如何产生组合显著性，扩展了对组织创新机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 提供基于证据的干预措施来构建理论驱动的创新能力，提供可操作策略培养组织环境，加速学习周期并发现新颖可行的创新

title: Integrating Virtual Assets into Public Sector Financial Statements: Strategic, Legal, and Accounting Implications for Sovereign Wealth and Fiscal Governance

detail.title: Integrating Virtual Assets into Public Sector Financial Statements: Strategic, Legal, and Accounting Implications for Sovereign Wealth and Fiscal Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental procedures; therefore, formal ethics approval was not required. All sources used are publicly available and appropriately cited
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any specific grant or financial support from public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agencies.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This research did not involve clinical trials, human participants, or medical interventions.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the strategic, legal, and accounting implications of integrating virtual assets (VAs) including tokenized commodities, regulated stablecoins, and blockchain-based securities into public sector financial statements within the framework of the International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS). Using the United Arab Emirates (UAE) as the primary case, the research develops an IPSAS-consistent model for recognizing, measuring, and disclosing digital assets as part of sovereign wealth portfolios. Comparative analysis with Singapore, Switzerland, and Estonia contextualizes the UAE's readiness to pioneer a public sector digital asset model. Drawing on secondary data from Q1-Q2 academic journals, IFAC/IPSASB standards, and international institutions (IMF, OECD, BIS, and World Bank), the paper evaluates fiscal, operational, and governance implications. Findings suggest that formal recognition of VAs could increase reported sovereign net assets by 3.5-7.2% over five years, enhance transparency through blockchain-based audit verification, and position the UAE as a global reference for sovereign digital finance. The study concludes with a phased implementation roadmap emphasizing legal codification, a dedicated IPSAS extension for Virtual Assets (IPSAS-VA), and capacity building to ensure fiscal sustainability, security, and accountability in the digital age.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个符合IPSAS标准的模型，用于在公共部门财务报表中确认、计量和披露虚拟资产，以阿联酋为主要案例，分析显示正式认可虚拟资产可在5年内使主权净资产增加3.5-7.2%，并提升透明度。
AI.research_question: 如何在IPSAS框架下将虚拟资产（包括代币化商品、受监管稳定币和基于区块链的证券）整合到公共部门财务报表中，并评估其战略、法律和会计影响？
AI.motivation: 随着虚拟资产在主权财富组合中的重要性日益增加，需要建立符合国际公共部门会计准则（IPSAS）的框架来规范其会计处理，确保财政可持续性、安全性和问责制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际公共部门会计准则（IPSAS）框架、主权财富管理理论、区块链技术治理理论、数字资产会计理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法（以阿联酋为主要案例）、比较分析法（与新加坡、瑞士、爱沙尼亚对比）、二手数据分析（来自Q1-Q2学术期刊、IFAC/IPSASB标准、国际机构如IMF、OECD、BIS和世界银行的数据）。
AI.findings: 正式认可虚拟资产可在5年内使报告的主权净资产增加3.5-7.2%；基于区块链的审计验证可增强透明度；阿联酋具备成为主权数字金融全球参考的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了IPSAS一致的虚拟资产会计模型；提出了IPSAS-VA（虚拟资产）扩展框架；丰富了公共部门数字资产会计理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿联酋提供了分阶段实施路线图；提出了法律编纂建议；为其他国家提供了主权数字资产管理的参考模型；强调了能力建设的重要性。

title: The Maqam Index: Quantifying Unrealized Economic Output

detail.title: The Maqam Index: Quantifying Unrealized Economic Output
detail.abstract: While GDP measures realized output, it fails to capture an economy’s unrealized productive potential. Many nations possess deep human capital, institutional capacity, and innovation potential, yet their true economic standing is not fully reflected in GDP. The Maqam Index, a quantitative methodology for calculating a nation's unrealized economic outputis defined as the difference between potential productive capacity and realized GDP. It’s presented in this study as a solution to this disparity. The model breaks down national performance into three quantifiable dimensions: Value Leakage (VL), which captures losses from corruption, capital outflow, and skilled emigration; Conversion Feasibility (CF), which represents the institutional and infrastructural capacity to convert potential into output; and Potential Capacity (PC), which represents latent resources like human capital, diaspora leverage, innovation, and cultural capital. The index is formally expressed as: Four efficiency bands are used to interpret Maqam scores: > 0.5 (undervalued economies with unrealized upside), 0.1–0.5 (balanced potential), 0–0.1 (mature efficiency), and < 0 (overvalued or extractive structures). Both cross-country comparison and longitudinal analysis are made possible by the framework's use of public, repeatable indicators that are in line with practical policy levers. The Maqam Index provides a new diagnostic for evaluating macroeconomic efficiency, directing investment strategy, and prioritizing structural reform, especially in emerging economies, by measuring the gap between a country's actual output and its potential economic standing—potential net of value leakage.

AI.tldr: Maqam指数是一种量化方法，用于衡量国家未实现的经济产出潜力，即潜在生产能力与实际GDP之间的差距。该指数通过价值泄漏、转换可行性和潜在能力三个维度评估国家经济效率，为新兴经济体提供投资策略和结构改革指导。
AI.research_question: 如何量化衡量国家未实现的经济产出潜力，即潜在生产能力与实际GDP之间的差距？
AI.motivation: GDP仅衡量已实现产出，无法反映经济体的未实现生产潜力。许多国家拥有深厚的人力资本、制度能力和创新潜力，但其真实经济地位并未在GDP中得到充分体现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于潜在生产能力与实际产出差距的经济效率理论框架，包含三个量化维度：价值泄漏（腐败、资本外流、人才外迁损失）、转换可行性（制度和基础设施能力）、潜在能力（人力资本、侨民资源、创新和文化资本）。
AI.method: 开发Maqam指数作为量化方法，使用公开、可重复的指标，通过三个维度计算国家未实现经济产出。采用四个效率区间解释分数：>0.5（被低估经济体）、0.1-0.5（平衡潜力）、0-0.1（成熟效率）、<0（被高估或榨取结构）。
AI.findings: Maqam指数能够识别不同经济体的效率状态，为跨国比较和纵向分析提供框架，特别有助于评估新兴经济体的宏观经济效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了衡量经济未实现潜力的新理论框架，将潜在生产能力与实际产出差距概念化，扩展了传统经济增长和发展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和国际组织提供新的诊断工具，用于评估宏观经济效率、指导投资策略、优先考虑结构改革，特别是在新兴经济体。

title: Salience Bias in Belief Formation
affiliations: and University of Mannheim - Department of Banking and Finance

detail.title: Salience Bias in Belief Formation
detail.abstract: We propose an experimental framework to study how salience shapes belief formation. In a controlled experiment, participants receive sequential signals, with some signals made more salient by design. Bayesian updating predicts that signals should be weighted according to their informativeness, yet we find that upsidesalient signals are overweighted, even when this reduces overall accuracy. This bias is driven by a subset of individuals, salient thinkers, whose behavior is consistent with salience theory. They overweight upside signals even more when such signals are rare and are more confident than other participants. Our findings provide direct evidence that salience distorts belief updating, highlighting attention as an important driver of deviations from rational expectations.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验框架探讨显著性如何影响信念形成。研究发现，参与者会过度重视设计上更显著的信号（特别是上行信号），即使这会降低整体准确性。这种偏差由"显著性思考者"驱动，他们的行为符合显著性理论，在罕见信号出现时过度重视程度更高且更自信。
AI.research_question: 显著性如何影响信念形成过程？参与者是否会过度重视设计上更显著的信号，即使这与贝叶斯更新预测相悖？
AI.motivation: 理解信念形成过程中的非理性偏差，特别是注意力驱动因素如何导致偏离理性预期。传统贝叶斯更新理论假设信号按信息量加权，但实际决策中可能存在显著性驱动的偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯更新理论（作为理性基准）与显著性理论（解释注意力驱动的偏差）。研究检验了显著性思考者的行为模式是否符合显著性理论的预测。
AI.method: 控制实验方法，参与者接收顺序信号，其中部分信号通过设计变得更为显著。比较实际信念更新与贝叶斯预测的差异，识别"显著性思考者"子群体。
AI.findings: 1. 上行显著信号被过度重视，即使这会降低准确性；2. 偏差由"显著性思考者"子群体驱动；3. 当上行信号罕见时，过度重视程度更高；4. 显著性思考者比其他参与者更自信。
AI.theory_contributions: 为显著性理论提供直接实验证据，证明注意力是偏离理性预期的重要驱动因素。扩展了行为经济学中关于信念形成偏差的理解，特别是显著性在信息处理中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解现实决策中的非理性偏差，对金融、市场营销和政策制定有启示。识别"显著性思考者"有助于设计更好的信息呈现方式，减少注意力驱动的决策错误。

title: Enforceability of Smart Contracts: A Comparative Study of India, the United Kingdom, and the European Union

detail.title: Enforceability of Smart Contracts: A Comparative Study of India, the United Kingdom, and the European Union
detail.abstract: Smart contracts are contracts inscribed in computer code that run automatically once specific conditions are met. Based on blockchain technology, they disintermediate, cut down on transactional expenses, and make commercial transactions transparent. With growing digital transactions in India, the role of smart contracts cannot be ignored. However, the Indian Contract Act, 1872 does not explicitly embrace such contracts, which creates doubt regarding their enforceability. The Act is based on traditional ideas such as offer, acceptance, free consent, and legal consideration, which were established in written form in regards to human-to-human contracts. Automatic enforcement of obligations by code questions whether these essentials are met. This research paper tests the enforceability of smart contracts in India by determining how far they align with the essentials of valid contracts under the Indian Contract Act. It brings to the fore opportunities provided by smart contracts like efficiency, accuracy, and facilitation of global trade, but also challenges like liability, code interpretation, and conflicts of jurisdiction. A comparative analysis is derived from international policies like the UK Law Commission's acknowledgment of smart contracts and digital legislation of the European Union to analyse potential models for India. The research concludes that smart contracts can revolutionize Indian trade, but in the absence of legislative reform, their enforceability will be questionable. It will be necessary to amend the Indian Contract Act by implementing smart contracts and provisions of the Information Technology Act in order to bring smart contracts into the law.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了智能合约在印度的可执行性问题，分析了其与《印度合同法》传统要件的兼容性，并建议通过立法改革来明确智能合约的法律地位。
AI.research_question: 智能合约在印度法律框架下的可执行性如何？它们是否符合《印度合同法》中有效合同的基本要件？
AI.motivation: 随着印度数字交易的快速增长，智能合约的作用日益重要，但《印度合同法》并未明确承认此类合约，导致其可执行性存在法律不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《印度合同法》的传统合同理论，包括要约、承诺、自由同意、合法对价等基本要件；同时参考英国法律委员会和欧盟数字立法等国际政策框架。
AI.method: 通过法律文本分析，比较智能合约特征与《印度合同法》要件的契合度；进行国际比较分析，借鉴英国和欧盟的相关政策经验。
AI.findings: 智能合约在效率、准确性和促进全球贸易方面具有优势，但在责任认定、代码解释和管辖权冲突方面存在挑战；当前法律框架下其可执行性存疑。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字时代合同法理论发展提供分析框架，探讨传统合同要件如何适应自动化执行的新型合约形式。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议修订《印度合同法》并完善《信息技术法》相关条款，为智能合约提供明确法律依据，促进印度数字贸易发展。

title: Global Plastic Waste Reallocation and Pollution: Evidence from China’s Import Ban
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore (NUS) and National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Real Estate

detail.title: Global Plastic Waste Reallocation and Pollution: Evidence from China’s Import Ban
detail.abstract: This paper examines the global spillover effects of China’s 2017 plastic waste import ban, which abruptly disrupted the world’s largest destination for plastic waste. Using monthly bilateral trade data and satellite-based PM2.5 pollution measures from 2015 to 2023, we implement a difference-in-differences strategy to estimate the ban’s impact on international waste flows and air quality in recipient countries. Approximately 50% of displaced waste was redirected to other Asian countries. In comparison to unaffected waste categories, the affected categories experienced a surge in monthly net imports of $1.088 million USD per average receiving country. The largest increases occurred in countries with limited recycling capacity and weak environmental governance, particularly from non-OECD exporters and countries with stricter environmental regulations. Areas near waste processing sites in high-import regions experienced higher PM2.5 concentrations, suggesting notable environmental and health costs. These findings underscore the unintended consequences of unilateral environmental regulation and the need for coordinated global waste management.

AI.tldr: 中国2017年塑料废物进口禁令导致全球废物贸易重组，约50%被转移废物流向其他亚洲国家，每月净进口增加108.8万美元，环境治理薄弱国家受影响最大，废物处理区PM2.5浓度上升，凸显单边环境规制的意外后果和全球协调必要性。
AI.research_question: 中国2017年塑料废物进口禁令对全球废物贸易流动和接收国空气质量的溢出效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 中国作为全球最大塑料废物目的地，其2017年禁令突然中断了全球废物贸易体系，需要研究这一单边环境政策如何重塑全球废物流动模式及其环境健康影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境规制溢出效应理论、污染天堂假说、全球废物贸易重组理论、单边政策的外部性理论
AI.method: 使用2015-2023年月度双边贸易数据和卫星PM2.5污染测量，采用双重差分法估计禁令对国际废物流动和接收国空气质量的影响
AI.findings: 1. 约50%被转移废物流向其他亚洲国家；2. 受影响废物类别每月净进口增加108.8万美元；3. 回收能力有限、环境治理薄弱国家受影响最大；4. 废物处理区PM2.5浓度显著上升
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证检验单边环境规制的全球溢出效应；2. 验证污染天堂假说在废物贸易中的适用性；3. 揭示全球废物贸易重组机制；4. 丰富环境政策外部性理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示单边环境政策可能转移而非解决污染问题；2. 强调加强发展中国家环境治理能力的重要性；3. 呼吁建立协调的全球废物管理体系；4. 为政策制定者提供环境规制设计参考

title: CAPM vs APT

detail.title: CAPM vs APT
detail.abstract: This paper examines the empirical validity of the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) and the Arbitrage Pricing Theory (APT) using a sample of ten S&P 500 firms. Applying multivariate time-series and panel regressions in STATA, the study investigates the explanatory power of market and macroeconomic risk factors, including the 10-year Treasury yield, inflation, and money supply growth. Diagnostic tests, such as the Breusch–Pagan and Hausman tests, were performed to ensure robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多元时间序列和面板回归分析，检验了CAPM和APT模型在10家标普500公司样本中的实证有效性，发现宏观经济风险因素对股票收益有显著解释力。
AI.research_question: 资本资产定价模型（CAPM）和套利定价理论（APT）在解释标普500公司股票收益方面的实证有效性如何？
AI.motivation: CAPM和APT是金融学中两个重要的资产定价理论，但它们在实证环境中的有效性需要验证，特别是考虑宏观经济风险因素时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本资产定价模型（CAPM）、套利定价理论（APT）、市场风险因素、宏观经济风险因素（10年期国债收益率、通货膨胀、货币供应增长）
AI.method: 使用STATA进行多元时间序列分析和面板回归，样本包括10家标普500公司，采用Breusch-Pagan和Hausman检验确保稳健性
AI.findings: 研究发现宏观经济风险因素（如10年期国债收益率、通货膨胀和货币供应增长）对股票收益具有显著解释力，为APT提供了实证支持
AI.theory_contributions: 为APT理论提供了实证证据，验证了多因素定价模型的有效性，并比较了CAPM和APT在解释股票收益方面的相对优势
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了识别和定价宏观经济风险因素的实证依据，有助于投资组合构建和风险管理决策

title: Constraint-Driven Macroeconomics: Integrating Modern Monetary Theory with the Theory of Constraints

detail.title: Constraint-Driven Macroeconomics: Integrating Modern Monetary Theory with the Theory of Constraints

declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded research under AIMS UK — Advisory Initiative on Monetary Sovereignty

detail.abstract: Monetarily sovereign governments do not face financial constraints in their own currency; they face real constraints: labour, energy, materials, logistics, technology, and time. Eliyahu Goldratt's Theory of Constraints (ToC) offers a disciplined method to identify and elevate bottlenecks in complex systems. Constraint-Driven Macroeconomics (CDM) fuses MMT's operational clarity about money with ToC's practical method for throughput management. The result is a replicable, data-driven policy framework that (1) identifies economy-limiting constraints, (2) aligns fiscal, regulatory, and credit tools to exploit and elevate those constraints, and (3) uses inflation as the macro signal of capacity stress. We set out concepts, metrics, an institutional design, and an implementation roadmap for the UK, with transferable lessons for other sovereign issuers.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出约束驱动宏观经济学（CDM），将现代货币理论（MMT）与约束理论（ToC）结合，为货币主权政府提供识别和缓解经济瓶颈的数据驱动政策框架。
AI.research_question: 如何为货币主权政府开发一个系统性的政策框架，以识别和缓解经济中的真实约束（而非金融约束），从而最大化经济产出？
AI.motivation: 货币主权政府面临的是真实资源约束（劳动力、能源、材料等），而非金融约束，但现有政策框架缺乏系统方法来识别和管理这些瓶颈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代货币理论（MMT）关于货币运作的清晰性 + 约束理论（ToC）关于复杂系统瓶颈管理的实用方法。
AI.method: 概念框架开发、指标设计、制度设计、实施路线图（以英国为例），具有可转移性。
AI.findings: 提出了CDM框架，包括：(1)识别经济限制性约束的方法，(2)协调财政、监管和信贷工具以利用和提升这些约束，(3)将通胀作为产能压力的宏观信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 将MMT与ToC理论融合，创建了新的约束驱动宏观经济学理论框架，为货币主权国家的经济管理提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可复制的、数据驱动的政策框架、具体指标、制度设计和实施路线图，可直接应用于英国等货币主权国家。

title: Pitching into a New "ERA" with DIPS: A Critical Analysis of Bradbury (2007)

detail.title: Pitching into a New "ERA" with DIPS: A Critical Analysis of Bradbury (2007)
detail.abstract: This paper summarizes and evaluates Bradbury (2007), who investigates whether Major League Baseball’s labor market properly values starting pitchers. Using a series of regressions, Bradbury compares fielding-dependent run-prevention metrics (e.g., ERA/RA, BABIP) with defense-independent pitching statistics (DIPS: strikeouts, walks, hit batters, home runs). He shows that DIPS variables explain a large share of contemporaneous and future run prevention and are stronger, more persistent predictors of salary than ERA-type measures. The results imply that ERA is polluted by fielding and context, while the labor market largely rewards pitcher-controlled skills. I review the three-equation framework (current-season run prevention; predictive power across seasons; compensation) and discuss implications for estimating pitchers’ marginal revenue product (MRP).

AI.tldr: 该论文总结评估了Bradbury(2007)的研究，该研究探讨MLB劳动力市场是否合理评估先发投手价值。通过回归分析比较防守依赖型失分指标(如ERA)与防守独立投球统计(DIPS)，发现DIPS能更好解释当前和未来失分，且对薪资预测更强更持久。表明ERA受防守和情境污染，而劳动力市场主要奖励投手可控技能。
AI.research_question: 美国职业棒球大联盟(MLB)的劳动力市场是否合理评估先发投手的价值？投手薪资是基于防守依赖型指标(如ERA)还是防守独立投球统计(DIPS)？
AI.motivation: 传统上使用ERA等指标评估投手表现，但这些指标受球队防守能力和比赛情境影响，不能准确反映投手自身技能。需要检验劳动力市场是否能够识别并奖励投手真正可控的技能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 防守独立投球统计(DIPS)理论：投手主要控制三振、保送、触身球、本垒打等结果，而安打等结果受防守影响。2. 劳动力市场效率理论：市场是否能够正确评估球员边际生产力。3. 边际收益产品(MRP)估计框架。
AI.method: 使用回归分析方法，构建三方程框架：1)当前赛季失分预测方程；2)跨赛季预测能力方程；3)薪资决定方程。比较防守依赖型指标(ERA/RA, BABIP)与防守独立指标(DIPS)的解释力和预测能力。
AI.findings: 1. DIPS变量能解释当前和未来失分的很大比例；2. DIPS比ERA型指标对薪资的预测更强、更持久；3. ERA受防守和比赛情境污染；4. 劳动力市场主要奖励投手可控技能而非受防守影响的指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了DIPS理论在劳动力市场评估中的适用性；2. 提供了评估投手边际生产力的新框架；3. 揭示了劳动力市场对球员技能评估的理性程度；4. 为体育经济学中球员估值研究提供了方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为球队管理层提供更科学的投手评估工具；2. 帮助球员经纪人基于DIPS指标谈判薪资；3. 为球迷和媒体提供更准确的投手表现评估标准；4. 为棒球数据分析实践提供实证支持。

reference: KIEP Research Paper, KIEP Opinions No. 324
title: From Trade to Tech: A New Era in Korea-Vietnam Relations
affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy

detail.title: From Trade to Tech: A New Era in Korea-Vietnam Relations

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIEP Research Paper, KIEP Opinions No. 324
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
On August 11, General Secretary Tô Lâm of the Communist Party of Vi- etnam paid a state visit to Korea to hold a summit with President Lee Jae Myung. During this meeting, the two leaders issued a joint statement lay- ing the foundation for deepening the “Comprehensive Strategic Partner- ship,” which was signed in the 30th anniversary year of diplomatic rela- tions between Korea and Vietnam. In the joint statement, the two countries agreed to enhance cooperation in seven major areas, as follows: 

1. Strengthening trust between leaders – A direct hotline between the two heads of state will be established, and annual summits will become a regular practice. 

2. Expanding strategic dialogue on diplomacy and security – A reg- ular “2+2” meeting between foreign and defense ministers will be launched.

3. Strengthening economic cooperation – Bilateral trade will grow from the current USD 86.7 billion to USD 150 billion by 2030 

4. Enhancing collaboration in advanced technology, energy, and supply chains – Joint development of semiconductors, batteries, and rare earth materials will be pur- sued.(The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文分析了越南共产党总书记杜林访韩期间与韩国总统李明博签署的联合声明，该声明在韩越建交30周年之际深化了"全面战略伙伴关系"，双方同意在七大领域加强合作。
AI.research_question: 韩越全面战略伙伴关系联合声明如何深化两国在政治、经济、安全等领域的合作？
AI.motivation: 韩越建交30周年之际，两国领导人希望通过高层互动和制度化安排，将双边关系提升到新的战略高度，应对区域经济和安全挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论中的战略伙伴关系理论、经济相互依赖理论、安全合作理论。
AI.method: 文本分析法，对联合声明内容进行系统性分析，识别合作领域和机制安排。
AI.findings: 联合声明确立了七大合作领域：1)领导人互信机制（热线和年度峰会）；2)外交安全战略对话（"2+2"部长级会议）；3)经济合作（贸易额从867亿增至1500亿美元）；4)先进技术、能源和供应链合作（半导体、电池、稀土材料）；5-7)其他领域合作。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了战略伙伴关系理论在亚洲国家间合作的应用，展示了经济相互依赖如何推动政治和安全合作。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩越关系提供了具体合作路线图，为其他亚洲国家间合作提供了参考模式，有助于区域经济一体化和供应链稳定。

title: Financial Decision-Making Across the Lifespan: Insights from Neuroeconomics
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Finance Area

detail.title: Financial Decision-Making Across the Lifespan: Insights from Neuroeconomics
detail.abstract: This review article highlights what we know from neuroeconomics regarding the effects of context, past experiences, and age on brain processes involved in decision-making and illustrates how finance research has built on these insights, and how it could continue to do so going forward.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述文章总结了神经经济学关于情境、过往经验和年龄对决策脑过程影响的研究，展示了金融研究如何借鉴这些发现并展望未来发展方向。
AI.research_question: 情境、过往经验和年龄如何影响决策的脑过程？金融研究如何借鉴神经经济学的这些发现？未来如何继续推进这一交叉研究？
AI.motivation: 神经经济学为理解决策的神经机制提供了重要见解，但金融研究对这些发现的整合和应用还不够系统。需要梳理现有成果并指明未来方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经经济学、行为金融学、决策神经科学、认知神经科学
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理神经经济学和金融研究的交叉成果
AI.findings: 1) 情境因素（如框架效应、参照点）显著影响决策脑区活动；2) 过往经验通过神经可塑性塑造决策模式；3) 年龄相关神经变化导致决策策略差异；4) 金融研究已开始应用这些发现解释市场行为
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 系统整合神经经济学与金融研究的理论框架；2) 提出跨学科研究范式；3) 深化对决策神经机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为金融产品设计提供神经科学依据；2) 帮助制定适合不同年龄群体的投资策略；3) 改进金融教育和投资者保护政策；4) 促进神经经济学在金融实践中的应用

title: Rooted Potential and Static Stability in Games
affiliations: Bar-Ilan University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Rooted Potential and Static Stability in Games
detail.abstract: Rooted potential is a generalization of (exact) potential that exists in every game. In a potential game, it coincided with the potential. In general games, it varies according to the choice of root, which is any strategy (in symmetric and population games) or strategy profile (in asymmetric games). Roots that are local maxima of the rooted potential have interesting stability features. Depending on the class of games considered, the set of equilibrium roots with this property may coincide with the evolutionarily stable strategies, ESS (in symmetric 𝑛×𝑛 games); with the continuously stable strategies, CSS (in symmetric games with a unidimensional strategy space); with the risk dominant equilibria (in finite symmetric 2×2 games); or with the strict equilibria (in bimatrix games). Local maximization of the rooted potential may thus be viewed as a general, unifying notion of static stability. Like the earlier notions of static stability it generalizes, it is formulated solely in terms of the players’ incentives to change their strategies close to the point in question. This differs from dynamic stability, which is specific to an extraneous law of motion that dictates the players’ reactions to the incentives. Depending on the choice of the latter, dynamic stability may be weaker than static stability or the two may be incomparable. Static stability is also connected with comparative statics of altruism. In general, internalization of the aggregate payoff or some other measure of social payoff by all players may paradoxically result in a decrease of that payoff. But this is never so if the equilibria involved satisfy static stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"根势能"作为静态稳定性的统一概念，它推广了潜在博弈中的势能概念，适用于所有博弈。根势能在局部最大化时具有稳定性特征，在不同类型博弈中分别对应演化稳定策略、连续稳定策略、风险占优均衡和严格均衡等经典概念。
AI.research_question: 根势能的局部最大化能否作为静态稳定性的一般统一概念？在不同类型博弈中，这一概念如何与现有的稳定性概念（如演化稳定策略、连续稳定策略、风险占优均衡等）对应？
AI.motivation: 现有博弈论中存在多种静态稳定性概念（如ESS、CSS、风险占优均衡等），但这些概念分散在不同类型的博弈中，缺乏统一的理论框架。本文旨在提出一个能涵盖这些概念的通用稳定性概念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于根势能理论，这是对传统势能概念的推广。根势能存在于所有博弈中，在潜在博弈中与势能一致，在一般博弈中依赖于根的选择。根势能的局部最大化提供了静态稳定性的统一框架。
AI.method: 理论分析方法，通过数学推导和概念比较，在不同类型博弈（对称n×n博弈、一维策略空间对称博弈、有限对称2×2博弈、双矩阵博弈）中分析根势能局部最大化与现有稳定性概念的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 根势能的局部最大化在不同博弈类型中分别对应：ESS（对称n×n博弈）、CSS（一维策略空间对称博弈）、风险占优均衡（有限对称2×2博弈）、严格均衡（双矩阵博弈）。2. 静态稳定性与动态稳定性不同，前者仅基于玩家激励，后者依赖于外部动态法则。3. 静态稳定性与利他主义的比较静态分析相关：当均衡满足静态稳定性时，内部化社会收益不会导致该收益下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出根势能作为静态稳定性的统一概念框架。2. 建立了根势能局部最大化与多种经典稳定性概念的对应关系。3. 区分了静态稳定性与动态稳定性，强调前者仅基于激励结构。4. 将静态稳定性与利他主义比较静态分析联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为分析各种博弈中的稳定性提供了统一工具。2. 有助于理解利他主义政策的效果：在静态稳定均衡下，内部化社会收益不会产生悖论性结果。3. 为政策制定者提供了判断均衡稳定性的新视角。

title: THE USE OF CENTRAL BANK TRUSTEESHIP SECURITIES AS AN INSTRUMENT OF MONETARY POLICY IN THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC BANKING SYSTEM
affiliations: Monetary and Banking Research Institute: Tehran, Tehran, IR and Monetary and Banking Research Institute (MBRI)

detail.title: THE USE OF CENTRAL BANK TRUSTEESHIP SECURITIES AS AN INSTRUMENT OF MONETARY POLICY IN THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC BANKING SYSTEM
detail.abstract: Purpose-The 'Central Bank Trusteeship Securities' (CBTS) represent a recent innovation of the Central Bank of the Islamic Republic of Iran for implementing open market operations within the Islamic banking framework. These trusteeship securities offer the advantages of simplicity and inflation protection, and do not require the central bank's involvement in real sector activities. The research explores the operational model and jurisprudential principles of using CBTS. Design/Methodology/Approach-This research employs the descriptive method and content analysis to assess the operational model and jurisprudential foundations of using CBTS in open market operations in the Islamic Republic of Iran. Findings-The findings indicate that trusteeship securities' holders have a contractual relationship with the central bank based on the trusteeship contract and not based on the qarḍ (loan) or debt contract. Collected funds are not owned by the central bank but are used solely for contractionary open market operations. Optional overpayment in trusteeship securities is not considered a contractual obligation; it is a surplus unilaterally paid by the central bank to encourage securities' buyers (hence, it is not ribā (interest)). Despite disputed jurisprudential issues related to compensation for currency value decrease, the approved model of trusteeship securities is acceptable on the basis of 'unconditional hibah (gift)' for overpayment. Originality/Value-This study adds value by examining Iran's experience in issuing CBTS for open market operations, the jurisprudential principles of the Central Bank's operational model and the potential risks associated with their Sharīah-compliant nature. Practical Implications-The research suggests that it is crucial to closely monitor the proper execution of trusteeship securities' agreements in practice. Additionally, steps should be taken to prevent the unconditional hibah from gradually transforming into an implied term over time, which could raise suspicions of ribā trick (ribā ḥiyal).

AI.tldr: 伊朗央行创新推出"央行托管证券"作为伊斯兰银行框架下的公开市场操作工具，该证券具有简单性、通胀保护特性，且无需央行参与实体经济。研究探讨了其运作模式和伊斯兰法理基础。
AI.research_question: 伊朗央行托管证券的运作模式和伊斯兰法理基础是什么？
AI.motivation: 在伊斯兰银行框架下，传统公开市场操作工具存在局限性，需要开发符合伊斯兰教法的创新工具来实施货币政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于伊斯兰金融法理，特别是托管合同(wakālah)、无条件赠与(hibah)等概念，避免高利贷(ribā)和债务合同。
AI.method: 采用描述性方法和内容分析法，评估伊朗央行托管证券在公开市场操作中的运作模式和法理基础。
AI.findings: 1) 证券持有人与央行基于托管合同而非贷款或债务合同；2) 募集资金不属于央行所有，仅用于紧缩性公开市场操作；3) 超额支付不是合同义务，而是央行为鼓励购买而单方面支付的盈余；4) 尽管存在货币贬值补偿的法理争议，但基于"无条件赠与"的超额支付模式是可接受的。
AI.theory_contributions: 为伊斯兰金融体系提供了创新的公开市场操作工具理论框架，阐明了托管证券在伊斯兰法理下的合法性基础，特别是通过无条件赠与解决超额支付的法理争议。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊斯兰国家央行实施货币政策提供了实践模型，建议密切监控托管协议执行，防止无条件赠与逐渐演变为隐含条款而引发高利贷规避嫌疑。

title: Job Description

detail.title: Job Description
detail.abstract: Job descriptions are an essential tool in all organizations, as they accurately define the tasks and responsibilities of each employee. This keenness on the principle of development comes as a first step towards building a successful work environment, as the presence of an accurate job description contributes to improving performance and increasing efficiency. Clarity in roles helps employees understand what is required of them, which enhances their ability to achieve set goals. However, the absence of this description can lead to major challenges that affect the management of organizations. When an organization lacks a clear job description, multiple problems may arise, such as overlapping responsibilities and role confusion, which creates an unstable work environment. Employees may feel uncertain about their tasks, which negatively affects team spirit and reduces the effectiveness of overall performance. Therefore, ensuring a comprehensive and specific job description is an essential step in the process of institutional development. Organizations that care about accurately defining roles and responsibilities ensure that their goals are achieved efficiently, and work to enhance trust between management and employees, which contributes to building a positive and motivating work environment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了工作描述在组织中的重要性，指出准确的工作描述能提升绩效和效率，而缺乏明确工作描述会导致职责重叠、角色混淆等问题，影响组织管理和发展。
AI.research_question: 工作描述在组织管理中的作用是什么？准确的工作描述如何影响员工绩效和组织效率？缺乏明确工作描述会导致哪些管理问题？
AI.motivation: 工作描述是组织管理中的基础工具，但许多组织忽视了其重要性。缺乏准确的工作描述会导致职责不清、绩效低下、团队士气低落等问题，影响组织整体发展。因此需要系统研究工作描述对组织管理的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织行为学理论、角色理论和工作设计理论，探讨工作描述在明确角色期望、减少角色冲突、提高工作满意度方面的作用。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，通过对现有研究的梳理，构建工作描述与组织管理关系的理论框架。
AI.findings: 1. 准确的工作描述能明确员工职责，提高绩效和效率；2. 缺乏工作描述会导致职责重叠、角色混淆，造成工作环境不稳定；3. 清晰的角色定义能增强员工对任务的理解，提升目标达成能力；4. 完善的工作描述有助于建立管理层与员工之间的信任，营造积极的工作环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了工作描述在组织管理中的理论意义；2. 扩展了角色理论在实践中的应用；3. 为工作设计理论提供了实证支持；4. 构建了工作描述与组织发展关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织制定和完善工作描述提供指导；2. 帮助管理者理解工作描述对绩效管理的重要性；3. 提供解决职责重叠和角色混淆的具体建议；4. 促进组织建立更有效的人力资源管理体系。

title: Intraday Market Reactions to Corporate Climate Disclosure: Evidence from CDP Score Announcements

detail.title: Intraday Market Reactions to Corporate Climate Disclosure: Evidence from CDP Score Announcements
detail.abstract:
This article examines how public climate information is absorbed within the trading day and how that absorption reshapes capital flows. It leverages the institutional design of CDP’s annual score cycle, in which results are released through a centralized window under formal embargo language that standardizes timing across firms. The synchronized, embargoed disclosure structure mitigates confounding from staggered firm announcements and creates quasi-experimental variation in the arrival of climate-related information.
Using a high-frequency panel on U.S. large-cap equities, the article aligns intraday abnormal net flows and liquidity metrics to the disclosure day and partitions the session into short blocks (1min and 20 mins throughout the day) to map where information is mostly impounded.

To distinguish information effects from latent traits and seasonality, the article deploys two complementary placebos. A random-score design permutes firms’ scores while preserving the true disclosure day, maintaining timing but severing the link between firm characteristics and flows. A random-date design assigns each firm’s true score to pseudo-event dates, preserving information content while cutting the synchronized timing channel. Together, these tests prove whether any intraday pattern is uniquely tied to the joint presence of credible information and its coordinated arrival, rather than to background liquidity cycles or auction mechanics.

Three findings emerge. First, it documents rapid capital reallocation within minutes. Sensitivity of abnormal buying pressure to higher climate scores is negligible or slightly negative at the open, near zero through midday, and becomes economically and statistically meaningful in the final trading block before the close. This late-session concentration is consistent with execution practices that target the closing auction to reduce tracking error while exploiting published imbalance data. Second, the intraday profile is robust to standard controls for liquidity and volatility and collapses under both placebo designs, indicating that the synchronized information is essential for the observed effects. Third, when the horizon is broadened to multi-day windows, the patterns show little persistence, aligning with semi-strong efficiency in which public signals are digested primarily through within-day order flow and depth rather than through prolonged post-event drift.
The article’s contribution is primarily on both data and identification. It assembles a minute-level panel that synchronizes embargoed CDP release times with intraday order-flow and liquidity for U.S. large-cap stocks, largely absent from the current climate-finance literature, in which the dominant designs evaluate disclosure effects with daily returns and multi-day CARs. By moving from day-level to trading-clock resolution, it isolates where within the session climate information is actually impounded and separates opening noise from pre-close rebalancing dynamics. The contribution is therefore twofold: first, it provides rare high-frequency evidence on climate disclosure, addressing a widely noted scarcity of comparable, decision-useful ESG data; second, it shows that the salient market response concentrates within the day rather than in extended post-event drifts, a pattern that daily studies can easily miss or misattribute. By aligning minute-level flows to CDP’s strict embargo window and exploiting closing-auction microstructure, the article closes a key empirical gap on how, when, and through which microstructure channels climate transparency moves capital within the day.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用CDP气候信息披露的同步发布机制，通过高频数据分析发现：市场对气候信息的反应集中在交易日收盘前的最后交易时段，而非开盘或盘中；这种日内模式依赖于同步信息发布，而非流动性周期；气候信息主要在日内消化，而非产生持续多日的价格漂移。
AI.research_question: 公共气候信息如何在交易日内被吸收？这种吸收如何重塑资本流动？
AI.motivation: 当前气候金融文献主要使用日度回报和多日累计异常回报评估披露效应，缺乏高频数据研究。需要了解气候信息在交易日内何时、通过何种微观结构渠道影响资本流动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半强式有效市场理论、微观结构理论、信息披露理论、收盘拍卖机制
AI.method: 利用CDP年度评分周期的制度设计（同步、有禁运的披露结构），构建美国大盘股的高频面板数据（1分钟和20分钟间隔）。采用两种互补的安慰剂设计：随机评分设计（打乱公司评分但保留真实披露日）和随机日期设计（保留真实评分但分配到伪事件日）。
AI.findings:
1. 资本在几分钟内快速重新配置，对更高气候评分的异常买入压力在开盘时可忽略或轻微负向，午间接近零，在收盘前最后一个交易时段变得经济上和统计上显著。
2. 日内模式对流动性和波动性控制稳健，但在两种安慰剂设计下消失，表明同步信息对观察到的效应至关重要。
3. 扩展到多日窗口时，模式几乎没有持续性，符合半强式效率。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提供了气候信息披露的高频证据，填补了可比、决策有用的ESG数据稀缺的空白。
2. 揭示了显著的市场反应集中在日内而非延长的后事件漂移中，这是日度研究容易错过或错误归因的模式。
3. 通过将分钟级流动与CDP严格禁运窗口对齐并利用收盘拍卖微观结构，阐明了气候透明度如何在日内、通过何种微观结构渠道移动资本。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者提供了气候信息吸收的精确时间模式，有助于优化交易执行策略。
2. 揭示了收盘拍卖在气候信息定价中的关键作用，对执行实践有直接启示。
3. 为监管机构和信息披露机构提供了关于信息披露时机和同步性的实证依据。

affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy

detail.title: EU Labor Mobility: From Free Movement and Enlargement to New Talent Strategies

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIEP Research Paper, KIEP Opinions No. 326
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: EU enlargement in the 2000s, layered onto the free movement of workers under Article 45 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU), turned Europe into a de facto single labor market. The dominant adjustment was an east-to-west reallocation that relieved vacancies in construction, logistics, hospitality and care across the older Member States, while reducing unemployment in sending regions. Recent empirical work also finds that joint EU membership-even after accounting for the phasing-in of free movement-raised bilateral labor flows, as credible integration rules and expectations lowered frictions and encouraged mobility. When frictions fall, workers reallocate towards opportunity. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 欧盟东扩与工人自由流动创造了事实上的单一劳动力市场，主要通过东向西劳动力再分配缓解了西欧的职位空缺和东欧的失业问题，欧盟成员身份本身（即使考虑自由流动的阶段性实施）也增加了双边劳动力流动。
AI.research_question: 欧盟东扩和工人自由流动如何影响欧洲劳动力市场的整合与劳动力再分配？
AI.motivation: 理解欧盟东扩和《欧盟运作条约》第45条规定的工人自由流动如何共同塑造欧洲劳动力市场，以及这种整合对成员国劳动力供需的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场整合理论、自由流动经济学、欧盟一体化理论、劳动力再分配理论
AI.method: 基于现有实证研究的文献综述和理论分析
AI.findings: 1. 欧盟东扩创造了事实上的单一劳动力市场；2. 主要调整模式是东向西劳动力再分配；3. 缓解了西欧建筑、物流、酒店和护理等行业的职位空缺；4. 降低了东欧发送地区的失业率；5. 欧盟成员身份本身（即使考虑自由流动的阶段性实施）也增加了双边劳动力流动；6. 可信的整合规则和预期降低了摩擦并鼓励了流动性
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对欧盟劳动力市场整合机制的理解，强调了制度可信度和预期在促进劳动力流动中的作用，扩展了劳动力市场摩擦理论在区域一体化背景下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟劳动力市场政策制定提供依据，帮助成员国理解劳动力流动的经济效应，为未来欧盟扩大和劳动力市场改革提供参考

detail.abstract: The supply chain for rare-earth permanent magnets has become one of the principal fronts in strategic competition between the United States and China. China has used this supply chain as a strategic lever when necessary, while the United States increasingly views it as a structural risk with implications for industrial capacity and national security. As NdFeB (neodymium–iron–boron) magnets underpin the performance of electric vehicles, wind turbines, defense systems, and industrial motors, the competition surrounding this supply chain has moved beyond trade disputes and now reflects a series of deliberate strategic choices by both sides. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文分析了中美在稀土永磁体供应链上的战略竞争，探讨了中国如何将其作为战略杠杆，而美国则视其为工业能力和国家安全的结构性风险。
AI.research_question: 中美在稀土永磁体供应链上的战略竞争如何影响两国的工业能力和国家安全？
AI.motivation: 稀土永磁体（特别是钕铁硼磁体）是电动汽车、风力涡轮机、国防系统和工业电机的关键材料，其供应链已成为中美战略竞争的主要前沿之一。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治经济学、供应链安全理论、战略竞争理论、资源民族主义理论。
AI.method: 基于文献综述和案例分析的定性研究，可能包括政策文件分析、供应链映射和战略决策分析。
AI.findings: 中国已将稀土永磁体供应链作为战略杠杆，而美国则将其视为结构性风险；双方的竞争已超越贸易争端，成为一系列深思熟虑的战略选择。

detail.abstract: Machine learning (ML) methods are highly flexible, but their ability to approximate the true data-generating process is fundamentally constrained by finite samples. We characterize a universal lower bound, the Limits-to-Learning Gap (LLG), quantifying the unavoidable discrepancy between a model's empirical fit and the population benchmark. Recovering the true population R 2 , therefore, requires correcting observed predictive performance by this bound. Using a broad set of variables, including excess returns, yields, credit spreads, and valuation ratios, we find that the implied LLGs are large. This indicates that standard ML approaches can substantially understate true predictability in financial data. We also derive LLG-based refinements to the classic Hansen and Jagannathan (1991) bounds, analyze implications for parameter learning in general-equilibrium settings, and show that the LLG provides a natural mechanism for generating excess volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"学习极限差距"(LLG)概念，量化了机器学习模型在有限样本下不可避免的预测误差，并发现金融数据中的LLG很大，表明标准ML方法会显著低估真实可预测性。
AI.research_question: 机器学习方法在有限样本下预测金融数据的真实可预测性存在多大偏差？如何量化这种不可避免的预测误差？
AI.motivation: 机器学习方法虽然灵活，但在有限样本下逼近真实数据生成过程的能力受到根本性限制，需要量化这种不可避免的预测误差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学习极限差距(LLG)理论框架，基于有限样本下的统计学习理论，扩展了Hansen和Jagannathan(1991)的经典界限。
AI.method: 理论推导LLG的普适下界，使用包括超额收益、收益率、信用利差和估值比率在内的广泛金融变量进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 金融数据中的LLG很大，表明标准ML方法会显著低估真实可预测性；LLG为生成超额波动性提供了自然机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了LLG理论框架，推导了Hansen-Jagannathan界限的LLG修正，分析了一般均衡设定中参数学习的含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融预测提供了校正观测预测性能的方法，帮助更准确地评估真实可预测性，对投资策略和风险管理有实际意义。

detail.abstract: Debates on Korea’s digital economy often focus on how to defend domes- tic firms from global platforms. But the real challenge is not defense—it is expansion. In the 21st century, the scarcest resource is time and attention. In the past, these were viewed mainly as limited resources to be allocated by consumers. Today, with advanced digital technologies—powered by AI and big data—platforms extract valuable insights from user activities and feed them back into global digital value chains. In such an environment, success depends not only on attracting domestic customers but also on securing audiences worldwide. In this sense, cross-border online viewer- ship is not just traffic. detail.abstract: South Korea's official development assistance (ODA) reached approximately USD 3.16 billion (KRW ≈ 4.78 trillion) in 2023, reflecting steady growth and Korea's ambition to play a more prominent role in the global development agenda. Yet in one critical area-mobilizing private capital through Private Sector Instruments (PSI)-Korea remains almost entirely absent. PSI, which includes equity investments, guarantees, and loans designed to catalyze private finance, accounted for just 0.33 percent of Korea's total ODA in 2024, compared to an average of 2.65 percent across Development Assistance Committee (DAC) members in 2023. This disparity is not the result of limited resources or insufficient investment expertise. Korea has built a dynamic domestic venture capital and private equity ecosystem with a strong record of public-private co-investment. The difference lies in institutional design and political will. Many DAC members have dedicated development finance institutions (DFIs) that invest directly in businesses, infrastructure, and financial systems in developing countries. (The rest omitted.)

detail.abstract: What if a familiar hand posture were already a piece of learning technology? This paper introduces "somasign"-a learned sensorimotor signature that functions as an underrecognized cognitive switch we already possess and can cultivate to a high degree of refinement. Building on an intensive LSAT self-study and research on neuroplasticity, body schema, and embodied cognition, I draw on a first-person probe of finger awareness and shifting handedness to suggest how subtle changes in sensation can signal underlying cortical reorganization. Emerging from independent study rather than institutional laboratory work, this paper offers an open invitation to colleagues across fields to engage, interpret, or experimentally investigate its proposed mechanisms within their own disciplinary frames. On this view, learning approaches a distinctly Deweyan, early-twenty-first-century conception: a form of guided neuroarchitectural redesign through which students train not only the contents of knowledge, but the somatic conditions by which their thinking bodies remember, coordinate, and reconfigure themselves.
