title: Proptech Adoption in Online Residential Property Listings: Effects of Agents' Selection and Sunk Costs
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Real Estate and

detail.title: Proptech Adoption in Online Residential Property Listings: Effects of Agents' Selection and Sunk Costs
detail.abstract: Property-related technology, or in short "PropTech," has become increasingly prevalent across different value chains of property markets, especially in brokerage and leasing. This study evaluates the incremental economic effects of PropTech adoption, specifically the use of V360 visual images and drones, in online listings for residential property markets in Singapore. We merged multiple sources of data, including listing data from a proprietary online portal, real estate agent registry data, and transaction data from public sources for the period from 2014 to 2020, and used the data to empirically evaluate the effects of PropTech adoption on listing and transaction outcomes. Our results show that the likelihood of using technology in online listings is correlated with property types, agent attributes, and market competition. Due to high sunk costs, PropTech was used to create interactive images and virtual tours for online listings to sell more expensive private properties, which were 10.3% higher in listing price than other online listings. Agents with years of industry experience but without established track records (e.g., awards) were more likely to adopt PropTech and incur lower PropTech costs in highly competitive, non-exclusive listings. We also found no incremental effect of PropTech use on higher transaction prices, even after controlling for successful sales. Buyers and sellers are rational price processors who would not pay higher prices, though PropTech tools could generate greater interest in property listings through high-tech visual tools.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了新加坡住宅市场中PropTech（特别是V360视觉图像和无人机）在在线房源中的经济效应。研究发现，PropTech主要用于高价私人房产，能提高房源关注度但不增加成交价格，经验丰富但无奖项的经纪人更可能采用PropTech。
AI.research_question: PropTech（房地产技术）在新加坡住宅市场在线房源中的应用对房源展示和交易结果产生了怎样的增量经济效应？
AI.motivation: PropTech在房地产市场的不同价值链中日益普及，特别是在经纪和租赁领域，但对其经济效应的实证研究仍然有限，需要评估技术采用对市场结果的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和市场竞争理论，研究技术采用决策与房产特征、经纪人属性和市场竞争的关系，以及理性价格处理者假设下的技术价值评估。
AI.method: 采用多源数据融合方法，整合2014-2020年间的在线房源数据、房地产经纪人注册数据和公开交易数据，通过实证分析评估PropTech采用对房源和交易结果的影响。
AI.findings: 1）PropTech主要用于高价私人房产（挂牌价高出10.3%）；2）经验丰富但无奖项的经纪人在竞争激烈的非独家房源中更可能采用PropTech且成本更低；3）PropTech使用对成交价格无增量影响，但能通过高科技视觉工具提高房源关注度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了技术采用理论在房地产领域的应用；2）揭示了经纪人特征与技术创新采用的关系；3）验证了理性价格处理者假设在数字化房地产市场中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为房地产经纪人提供技术采用决策依据；2）帮助房产平台优化技术功能设计；3）为买卖双方理解技术价值提供实证参考；4）为政策制定者提供房地产市场数字化转型的实证依据。

title: Timing and Quality of R&D: Lessons from the U.S.-Japan Semiconductor Trade Conflict
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - China Economics and Management Academy, Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - China Economics and Management Academy, Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - China Economics and Management Academy and Central University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Timing and Quality of R&D: Lessons from the U.S.-Japan Semiconductor Trade Conflict
detail.abstract: This paper studies how trade protection affects the time horizon and quality of firms' innovation activity. We develop a model in which firms choose between short-term, low-quality R&D projects and long-term, high-quality projects and show that by weakening competitive pressure, trade protection induces R&D short-termism. We then exploit the removal of industry-specific protection under the 1991 renewal of the U.S.–Japan Semiconductor Trade Agreement and use a difference-in-differences design with firm-level data comparing U.S. semiconductor firms to other manufacturing firms. Consistent with the model, we find that the removal of protection increased the R&D quality of previously protected firms by 30–50 percent, where R&D quality is measured as the value of future innovation per unit of current R&D spending. We further document a decline in patenting probability, a shift in marginal R&D returns from short to long horizons, and heterogeneous effects concentrated among firms with intermediate pre-treatment profitability. These patterns indicate a reallocation from short-term, low-quality projects toward longer-horizon, higher-quality innovation. Our findings highlight that trade protection can distort firms’ innovation horizons, whereas its withdrawal can restore incentives for long-run, high-quality technological progress.

AI.tldr: 贸易保护会削弱竞争压力，导致企业研发短视化，倾向于选择短期、低质量项目；而取消保护则能激励企业转向长期、高质量的创新活动。
AI.research_question: 贸易保护如何影响企业创新的时间跨度和质量？
AI.motivation: 理解贸易政策如何塑造企业创新决策，特别是贸易保护是否会导致研发短视化，从而影响长期技术进步。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业创新选择模型：企业在短期低质量研发项目和长期高质量项目之间进行选择，贸易保护通过削弱竞争压力影响这一决策。
AI.method: 双重差分设计：利用1991年美日半导体贸易协定更新取消行业特定保护的自然实验，比较美国半导体企业与其他制造企业。
AI.findings: 取消保护使先前受保护企业的研发质量提高30-50%；专利申请概率下降；研发回报从短期转向长期；效应集中在中等盈利能力的企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了贸易保护与企业创新时间跨度选择的理论联系，揭示了贸易政策通过竞争渠道影响创新质量的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了证据：贸易保护可能扭曲创新激励，而取消保护能促进长期高质量技术进步，对产业政策设计有重要启示。

title: Mind the Gap: Investor Beliefs vs. Trading Actions
affiliations: University of Zurich - Department Finance and Radboud University, Institute for Management Research

detail.title: Mind the Gap: Investor Beliefs vs. Trading Actions

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethocal approval (IRB) was given by University of Zurich.

detail.abstract: Do investors act consistently on their beliefs when they trade? We study this question in a controlled trading experiment that jointly elicits individual return forecasts and trading decisions. While behavioral finance has richly documented how biased expectations and dynamic preferences shape trading, we highlight an important and distinct friction in investor behavior: a belief-action gap, where decisions are less consistently aligned with beliefs. Selling decisions are much less aligned with investors' beliefs than buying decisions, and this gap is driven almost entirely by positions held at a paper loss. Investors frequently keep losing assets they explicitly expect to fall further. Using a probabilistic choice framework, we show that this belief-use inconsistency is distinct from both dynamic risk preferences and subjective beliefs and is a major source of trading underperformance. Finally, we implement an automated selling mechanism that removes discretionary selling. This intervention restores belief-action consistency and substantially improves profitability, indicating that reluctance to realize losses reflects a behavioral failure to act on information rather than optimal risk-taking.

AI.tldr: 投资者在交易时并不总是按照自己的信念行动，存在"信念-行动差距"，尤其是在卖出决策上。当持有亏损头寸时，投资者经常保留他们明确预期会继续下跌的资产。这种不一致性不同于动态风险偏好和主观信念，是交易表现不佳的主要原因。自动化卖出机制可以恢复信念-行动一致性并显著提高盈利能力。
AI.research_question: 投资者在交易时是否按照自己的信念一致行动？
AI.motivation: 行为金融学已经充分记录了有偏预期和动态偏好如何影响交易，但本文强调投资者行为中一个重要且独特的摩擦：信念-行动差距，即决策与信念不一致。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、信念-行动一致性理论、概率选择框架
AI.method: 控制性交易实验，联合获取个体回报预测和交易决策数据
AI.findings: 1. 卖出决策与投资者信念的一致性远低于买入决策；2. 这种差距主要由持有亏损头寸驱动；3. 投资者经常保留他们明确预期会继续下跌的亏损资产；4. 这种信念使用不一致性不同于动态风险偏好和主观信念；5. 这是交易表现不佳的主要原因
AI.theory_contributions: 识别并概念化了"信念-行动差距"这一新的行为摩擦，区别于现有的有偏预期和动态偏好理论，为理解投资者行为提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 自动化卖出机制可以恢复信念-行动一致性；2. 显著提高交易盈利能力；3. 表明不愿实现亏损反映了行为上的信息行动失败而非最优风险承担；4. 为投资者提供了改善交易决策的实际工具

title: Fiscal Decentralization and Basic Education Quality: Evidence from Digital Finance and Education Expenditure Channels
affiliations: Henan Normal University,  and Henan Normal University

detail.title: Fiscal Decentralization and Basic Education Quality: Evidence from Digital Finance and Education Expenditure Channels
detail.abstract: Drawing on panel data for 286 Chinese cities from 2011 to 2023, this study examines how fiscal decentralization shapes basic education quality and the mechanisms through which these effects arise. The findings show that both revenue and expenditure decentralization significantly enhance basic education quality, and these results remain robust across multiple sensitivity tests. Mechanism analyses indicate that the scale of educational investment and the intensity of education-related fiscal spending serve as key mediating channels through which fiscal decentralization affects education outcomes. Heterogeneity analyses further reveal that the positive impact is stronger in cities with higher levels of digital finance and stronger economic foundations.

AI.tldr: 基于2011-2023年中国286个城市的面板数据，研究发现财政分权显著提升基础教育质量，教育投资规模和财政教育支出强度是关键中介渠道，数字金融和经济基础较好的城市效应更强。
AI.research_question: 财政分权如何影响基础教育质量？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 探讨财政分权对教育质量的影响机制，为优化教育资源配置和财政政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政分权理论、教育资源配置理论、中介效应理论
AI.method: 使用2011-2023年中国286个城市的面板数据，采用固定效应模型、中介效应分析和异质性分析
AI.findings: 收入和支出分权均显著提升基础教育质量，教育投资规模和财政教育支出强度是关键中介渠道，数字金融和经济基础较好的城市效应更强
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了财政分权与教育质量关系的理论机制，揭示了中介渠道和异质性效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为优化财政分权政策、提高教育资源配置效率提供政策建议，特别关注数字金融和经济基础差异

title: Effect of inflation on insurers' main financial indicators with panel data in the US P&C insurance industry
affiliations: HEC Montreal - Department of Finance and  HEC Montreal, Risk Management

detail.title: Effect of inflation on insurers' main financial indicators with panel data in the US P&C insurance industry
detail.abstract: We study the effect of inflation on P&C insurers with individual data. We use observed and forecasted measures of inflation. We compute forecasted rates of inflation from the Bayesian Vector Autoregression (BVAR) model under two different assumptions, the Gaussian distribution and the Student-t distribution. For the econometric estimations, we proceed with the Generalized Method of Moments (GMM). Overall, the findings indicate that insurers are responsive to forecasted inflation as well to realized inflation. Proactive strategies-particularly those based on long-term forecastsappear to enhance profitability and stabilize operations, while short-term reactions to realized inflation are more defensive.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用个体数据分析了通货膨胀对财产与意外险保险公司的影响，发现保险公司对预测通胀和实际通胀都有反应，基于长期预测的主动策略能提升盈利能力和稳定运营，而对实际通胀的短期反应则更具防御性。
AI.research_question: 通货膨胀如何影响财产与意外险保险公司的经营表现？保险公司对预测通胀和实际通胀的反应有何不同？
AI.motivation: 通货膨胀是影响保险公司财务稳定和盈利能力的重要因素，理解保险公司如何应对通胀风险对于风险管理、监管政策和投资决策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝叶斯向量自回归模型预测通胀，结合广义矩估计方法进行计量分析，探讨保险公司对通胀的预期管理和实际反应机制。
AI.method: 使用个体保险公司数据，采用贝叶斯向量自回归模型（BVAR）在正态分布和学生t分布两种假设下计算预测通胀率，运用广义矩估计（GMM）进行计量估计。
AI.findings: 保险公司对预测通胀和实际通胀都有反应；基于长期预测的主动策略能提升盈利能力和稳定运营；对实际通胀的短期反应更具防御性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了保险公司通胀风险管理行为的实证证据，区分了预期管理和实际反应的不同效应，拓展了保险公司风险管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司提供了基于通胀预测的主动管理策略建议，帮助监管机构理解保险公司通胀风险暴露，为投资者评估保险公司风险提供参考。

title: Carbon Lock-In in Algeria’s LNG Strategy: Institutional and Market Constraints in a Transitioning Energy Landscape
affiliations: University of Port Harcourt, University of Port Harcourt and University of Port Harcourt

detail.title: Carbon Lock-In in Algeria’s LNG Strategy: Institutional and Market Constraints in a Transitioning Energy Landscape
detail.abstract: Algeria, Africa’s top natural gas exporter, faces mounting pressure to reconcile its gas-led growth with global decarbonization demands. This study examines carbon lock-in in Algeria’s LNG sector, identifying structural inertia, regulatory opacity, and strategic overdependence on fossil exports. Using carbon lock-in theory, it builds a framework around domestic demand growth, aging infrastructure, and geopolitical positioning. Analysis of trends from 1990 to 2025, with projections to 2030, reveals Algeria’s strengths, resilient upstream basins, expanding LNG capacity, and flexible trading, alongside vulnerabilities such as delayed project execution, subsidized tariffs, and limited diversification. Benchmarking against Egypt, Nigeria, Qatar, Mozambique, and Senegal, the study finds Algeria’s competitiveness hinges on six strategic levers: upstream diversification, demand rationalization, LNG modernization, renewable scale-up, hydrogen development, and institutional reform. Key findings show that without proactive reservoir management and pricing reform, Algeria risks output decline and regional marginalization. Policy recommendations include enforcing the 2019 Hydrocarbons Law, upgrading infrastructure, and empowering transition institutions. While initiatives like Solar 1000 and the hydrogen roadmap offer promise, success depends on integrating gas strategy with a credible energy transition plan. Algeria stands at a crossroads: either reinforce its leadership through reform and innovation or risk entrenchment in a carbon-intensive trajectory.

AI.tldr: 阿尔及利亚作为非洲最大天然气出口国，面临天然气驱动增长与全球脱碳需求的矛盾。研究分析其LNG行业的碳锁定现象，识别结构性惯性、监管不透明和战略过度依赖化石燃料出口等问题。通过1990-2025年趋势分析和2030年预测，评估阿尔及利亚的优势与脆弱性，并与埃及、尼日利亚、卡塔尔、莫桑比克和塞内加尔进行基准比较。研究发现阿尔及利亚的竞争力取决于六个战略杠杆，并提出政策建议。
AI.research_question: 阿尔及利亚如何协调其天然气主导的增长模式与全球脱碳需求之间的矛盾？其LNG行业面临哪些碳锁定风险？
AI.motivation: 阿尔及利亚作为非洲最大的天然气出口国，面临日益增长的压力，需要平衡其天然气驱动的经济增长与全球脱碳要求。这种矛盾突显了资源丰富国家在能源转型中的特殊挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳锁定理论，重点关注结构性惯性、监管不透明和战略过度依赖化石燃料出口等机制。框架围绕国内需求增长、老化基础设施和地缘政治定位构建。
AI.method: 对1990年至2025年的趋势进行分析，并预测到2030年。采用基准比较法，将阿尔及利亚与埃及、尼日利亚、卡塔尔、莫桑比克和塞内加尔进行比较。
AI.findings: 阿尔及利亚的优势包括：有韧性的上游盆地、扩大的LNG产能和灵活的贸易；脆弱性包括：项目执行延迟、补贴关税和有限多元化。竞争力取决于六个战略杠杆：上游多元化、需求合理化、LNG现代化、可再生能源规模化、氢能发展和制度改革。缺乏主动的储层管理和定价改革将导致产量下降和区域边缘化风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将碳锁定理论应用于资源丰富国家的能源转型分析，特别是天然气出口国面临的独特挑战。构建了包含国内需求、基础设施和地缘政治维度的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体政策建议：执行2019年碳氢化合物法、升级基础设施、加强转型机构。识别六个战略杠杆为决策者提供行动路线图。强调将天然气战略与可信的能源转型计划整合的重要性。

title: The Adoption and Usage of AI Agents: Early Evidence from Perplexity
affiliations: Harvard University, Perplexity, Perplexity, Perplexity, Perplexity and Perplexity

detail.title: The Adoption and Usage of AI Agents: Early Evidence from Perplexity
detail.abstract: This paper presents the first large-scale field study of the adoption, usage intensity, and use cases of general-purpose AI agents operating in open-world web environments. Our analysis centers on Comet, an AI-powered browser developed by Perplexity, and its integrated agent, Comet Assistant. Drawing on hundreds of millions of anonymized user interactions, we address three fundamental questions: Who is using AI agents? How intensively are they using them? And what are they using them for? Our findings reveal substantial heterogeneity in adoption and usage across user segments. Earlier adopters, users in countries with higher GDP per capita and educational attainment, and individuals working in digital or knowledge-intensive sectors—such as digital technology, academia, finance, marketing, and entrepreneurship—are more likely to adopt or actively use the agent.  To systematically characterize the substance of agent usage, we introduce a hierarchical agentic taxonomy that organizes use cases across three levels: topic, subtopic, and task. The two largest topics—Productivity & Workflow and Learning & Research—account for 57% of all agentic queries, while the two largest subtopics—Courses and Shopping for Goods—make up 22%. The top 10 out of 90 tasks represent 55% of queries. Personal use constitutes 55% of queries, while professional and educational contexts comprise 30% and 16%, respectively. In the short term, use cases exhibit strong stickiness, but over time, users tend to shift toward more cognitively oriented topics. The diffusion of increasingly capable AI agents carries important implications for researchers, businesses, policymakers, and educators, inviting new lines of inquiry into this rapidly emerging class of AI capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对开放网络环境中通用AI代理的采用、使用强度和使用场景进行了大规模实地研究。基于Perplexity开发的AI浏览器Comet及其集成代理Comet Assistant的数亿匿名用户交互数据，研究发现：早期采用者、高GDP国家用户、知识密集型行业从业者更可能采用AI代理；使用场景中57%为生产力/工作流和学习/研究；使用具有短期粘性但长期向认知密集型任务转移。
AI.research_question: 谁在使用AI代理？他们使用的强度如何？以及他们用AI代理做什么？
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理能力的不断增强，了解其在开放网络环境中的实际采用模式、使用强度和使用场景对于研究人员、企业、政策制定者和教育工作者具有重要意义，但目前缺乏大规模实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、创新扩散理论、用户行为分析框架，以及作者提出的分层代理分类法（按主题、子主题和任务三个层次组织使用场景）。
AI.method: 基于Perplexity开发的AI浏览器Comet及其集成代理Comet Assistant的数亿匿名用户交互数据进行的大规模实地研究，采用定量分析方法。
AI.findings: 1) 采用和使用存在显著异质性：早期采用者、高GDP国家用户、教育水平较高者、数字/知识密集型行业从业者更可能采用或积极使用AI代理；2) 使用场景分类：生产力与工作流（57%）、学习与研究是主要主题；课程和商品购物是最大子主题；3) 使用目的：个人使用占55%，专业使用30%，教育使用16%；4) 使用模式：短期具有强粘性，但长期用户倾向于转向更认知导向的主题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了分层代理分类法，为AI代理使用场景的系统分析提供了理论框架；2) 首次提供了AI代理在开放网络环境中大规模采用的实证证据；3) 丰富了技术采纳和创新扩散理论在AI代理领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业提供了AI代理用户画像和使用模式洞察，有助于产品开发和市场定位；2) 为政策制定者提供了AI代理扩散的社会经济影响参考；3) 为教育工作者揭示了AI代理在教育场景中的应用现状；4) 为研究人员开辟了AI代理实证研究的新方向。

title: Credit Renegotiations: Characterization and Determinants using Population Administrative Data
affiliations: University of Houston and

detail.title: Credit Renegotiations: Characterization and Determinants using Population Administrative Data
detail.abstract: We analyze consumer, mortgage, and commercial loans, as well as their respective renegotiation rates, offering new insights into their incidence and effectiveness. The main contributions can be summarized in five points. First, we construct a unique dataset using population-level administrative data on individuals and businesses in Chile between 2016 and 2024. Second, we estimate that, on average, 1.3% of consumer loans, 0.3% of commercial loans, and 0.18% of mortgage loans are renegotiated monthly. These renegotiated amounts represent 1.6%, 0.3%, and 0.13% of the total credit for each category, respectively. Third, conditional on renegotiation, the average number of renegotiations per mortgage and consumer loan ranges between 1.1 and 1.4, with a maximum number of renegotiations between 5 and 8, depending on the year analyzed. Fourth, focusing on renegotiated loans, we define a "successful renegotiation" as one that restores the borrower's ability to make regular payments, i.e., the loan does not fall into delinquency within twelve months. Under this definition, 50% of consumer loans, 48% of commercial loans, and 35% of mortgage loans are successful. However, this success rate depends on the conditions at the time of renegotiation. If a loan is delinquent or remains in that condition after renegotiation, the success rate changes drastically. For delinquent loans, the success rate is 21% for mortgage loans, 31% for consumer loans, and 28% for commercial loans. For non-delinquent loans, the success rate is 80% for mortgage, 70% for consumer, and 65% for commercial loans. Fifth, we apply artificial intelligence techniques to model the probability of a successful renegotiation and to identify its determinants. Non-linear models such as LightGBM outperform traditional linear models like logistic regression, achieving AUROC values above 70% across all loan types. Using SHAP values (Shapley Additive exPlanations), we identify the most critical factors influencing a successful renegotiation, distinguishing by delinquency status. For non-delinquent loans, the maximum number of days in arrears before renegotiation and the client's tenure with the financial institution are relevant for all three loan types. For mortgage and consumer loans, the ratio of renegotiated debt to total debt is a significant predictor. For commercial loans, the ratio of delinquent debt to total debt helps explain the likelihood of future delinquencies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用智利2016-2024年人口级行政数据，分析了消费贷款、抵押贷款和商业贷款的重新协商情况及其成功率。研究发现不同贷款类型的重新协商率和成功率存在显著差异，并应用AI技术识别影响重新协商成功的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 不同贷款类型（消费贷款、抵押贷款、商业贷款）的重新协商发生率、成功率及其影响因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对贷款重新协商的全面分析不足，特别是缺乏对不同贷款类型重新协商发生率和成功率的系统性比较，以及影响重新协商成功的关键因素识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信贷风险管理理论、债务重新协商理论和机器学习预测模型，结合SHAP值解释性分析框架。
AI.method: 使用智利2016-2024年人口级行政数据构建独特数据集，采用描述性统计分析重新协商发生率，定义"成功重新协商"标准，并应用LightGBM等机器学习模型预测成功率，使用SHAP值识别关键影响因素。
AI.findings: 1. 月均重新协商率：消费贷款1.3%、商业贷款0.3%、抵押贷款0.18%；2. 成功重新协商率：消费贷款50%、商业贷款48%、抵押贷款35%；3. 逾期状态显著影响成功率：非逾期贷款成功率（抵押80%、消费70%、商业65%）远高于逾期贷款（抵押21%、消费31%、商业28%）；4. LightGBM模型预测性能优于传统逻辑回归；5. 关键影响因素因贷款类型和逾期状态而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了贷款重新协商的综合性分析框架；2. 揭示了不同贷款类型重新协商模式的系统性差异；3. 提出了基于机器学习预测模型的重新协商成功率分析方法；4. 扩展了SHAP值在金融风险管理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融机构提供了贷款重新协商的基准数据；2. 识别了影响重新协商成功的关键因素，有助于优化重新协商策略；3. 提供了基于AI的预测工具，可提高重新协商决策效率；4. 为监管机构制定相关政策提供了实证依据。

title: ROLE OF INVESTMENT ADVISERS AS MARKET INTERMEDIARIES
affiliations: Adamas University

detail.title: ROLE OF INVESTMENT ADVISERS AS MARKET INTERMEDIARIES
detail.abstract: This study traces the regulatory shift from a caveat emptor marketplace to a fiduciary regime and offers a thorough examination of the legal and functional development of Investment Advisers (IAs) in the Indian capital market. The study looks at the legal framework that created IAs as separate intermediaries required to put client interests ahead of sales commissions. It is based on the SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013. Important regulatory provisions, such as strict eligibility requirements, required risk profiling, and the structural separation of advisory and distribution activities intended to reduce conflicts of interest, are all critically assessed. The study emphasizes the regulator's zero-tolerance stance toward profit-sharing models and deceptive advice through an examination of court rulings and SEBI enforcement orders, particularly regarding "finfluencers" and unregistered entities. The study also evaluates the effects of digitalization, discussing recent regulations on AI disclosure and robo-advisor regulation. The paper concludes with a critical analysis of the current "viability crisis," arguing that although the regulatory framework has effectively improved investor protection, structural changes like tiered licensing and fee rationalization are necessary to close the growing "advice gap" in India.

AI.tldr: 该研究追踪了印度资本市场从"买者自负"向受托人制度的监管转变，全面分析了投资顾问的法律与功能发展，指出当前监管框架虽提升了投资者保护，但面临"生存危机"和"建议缺口"问题。
AI.research_question: 印度资本市场投资顾问的法律框架如何从"买者自负"转变为受托人制度？这一监管转变对投资者保护和行业发展产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 随着印度资本市场的发展，需要建立更完善的投资者保护机制，解决投资建议中的利益冲突问题，特别是针对"金融影响者"和未注册实体的监管挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于受托人责任理论、监管经济学理论、利益冲突管理理论，以及从"买者自负"向受托人制度的监管转变理论框架。
AI.method: 采用法律文本分析法（SEBI 2013年投资顾问条例）、案例分析法（法院判决和SEBI执法命令）、监管政策评估法，以及对数字化影响和AI披露规定的分析。
AI.findings: 1. SEBI 2013年条例成功建立了以客户利益优先的受托人制度；2. 严格的资格要求、风险分析和咨询与分销活动分离有效减少了利益冲突；3. 监管机构对利润分享模式和欺诈性建议采取零容忍态度；4. 数字化带来新的监管挑战；5. 当前监管框架导致投资顾问面临"生存危机"和"建议缺口"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了新兴市场受托人制度监管的理论研究；2. 提出了监管转变与行业发展的矛盾理论；3. 为数字化时代的投资顾问监管提供了理论框架；4. 发展了"建议缺口"概念在监管有效性评估中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供分层许可和费用合理化等政策建议；2. 为投资顾问提供合规指导；3. 帮助投资者识别合法投资建议；4. 为应对数字化和AI挑战提供监管思路；5. 为解决"建议缺口"问题提供实践方案。

title: Fiscal Consolidation and Debt-GDP Stabilization: A Structural Policy Scenario Analysis
affiliations: Athens University of Economics and Business - Department of Economics,  and Athens University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Fiscal Consolidation and Debt-GDP Stabilization: A Structural Policy Scenario Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on case-study evidence and does not involve patient intervention or data collection requiring institutional ethics approval. Written informed consent was obtained from all individuals involved, and all identifying information has been removed to ensure full confidentiality.
declarations.funderStatement: “Greece 2.0” funded by the European Union–NextGen erationEU(H.F.R.I. Project Number: 15536

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the efficiency of fiscal consolidation and debt haircutting/restructuring policies in stabilizing public debt during periods of deep recession. We focus on Greece, which provides a unique setting for assessing whether such policies can deliver meaningful short-run effects. For our evaluation, we conduct counterfactual analysis using a Structural Policy Scenario (SPS) approach, and we rely on a time-varying structural VAR (TV-SVAR) to capture evolving macroeconomic dynamics under crisis conditions. Our results show that austerity-led consolidations implemented during recessions are unlikely to stabilize debt in the short or medium term, due to their contractionary impact on growth and their adverse effects on debt dynamics. By contrast, a milder fiscal adjustment combined with moderate, preemptive debt restructuring at the onset of the crisis could have stabilized the debt-GDP ratio more rapidly while limiting losses in output. Methodologically, combining the TV-SVAR with the SPS framework underscores the importance of accounting for changing macroeconomic conditions and provides a robust tool for evaluating alternative fiscal strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了深度衰退时期财政紧缩和债务重组政策在稳定公共债务方面的效率。研究发现，衰退期间实施的紧缩性财政整顿难以在短期或中期内稳定债务，而温和的财政调整结合预防性债务重组能更快稳定债务-GDP比率并减少产出损失。
AI.research_question: 在深度衰退时期，财政紧缩和债务重组政策能否有效稳定公共债务？哪种政策组合在短期内更有效？
AI.motivation: 希腊债务危机提供了一个独特的研究环境，评估在严重经济衰退条件下，财政整顿和债务重组政策是否能在短期内产生实质性效果，这对政策制定者制定危机应对策略具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于债务动态理论和财政政策有效性理论，结合宏观经济波动理论，分析不同政策组合对债务-GDP比率的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用结构政策情景（SPS）方法进行反事实分析，结合时变结构向量自回归（TV-SVAR）模型捕捉危机条件下的宏观经济动态变化。
AI.findings: 1. 衰退期间实施的紧缩性财政整顿难以在短期或中期内稳定债务，因其对增长的收缩性影响和对债务动态的负面影响；2. 温和的财政调整结合危机初期的预防性债务重组能更快稳定债务-GDP比率，同时限制产出损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将TV-SVAR与SPS框架结合的方法论创新，强调了考虑宏观经济条件变化的重要性；2. 为评估替代性财政策略提供了稳健的分析工具；3. 深化了对不同政策组合在危机条件下有效性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了危机时期更有效的财政政策组合建议；2. 表明预防性债务重组比事后紧缩措施更有效；3. 为类似经济体的危机管理提供了实证参考。

title: Strategic income shifting in uncertain times: Insights from economic policy uncertainty
affiliations: Sasin GIBA, Mahidol University International College (MUIC) and Pennsylvania State University - School of Graduate Professional Studies (SGPS)

detail.title: Strategic income shifting in uncertain times: Insights from economic policy uncertainty

keywords: JEL Classification: G32 (Corporate Finance and Firm Value)
D80 (Information and Uncertainty) Economic policy uncertainty

detail.abstract: We explore the impact of economic policy uncertainty (EPU) on outbound income shifting by U.S. firms, offering valuable insights into how firms adapt their tax strategies under uncertain economic conditions. Using a unique dataset from De Simone et al. (2019) originally derived from confidential IRS records, we find a significant positive effect of EPU on outbound income shifting. Firms respond to uncertainty by more actively reallocating profits across jurisdictions to mitigate risk. These findings are consistently validated through rigorous methods, including propensity score matching, entropy balancing, and instrumental-variable analysis. We also show that firms with higher tax burdens are more inclined to shift income, while those with significant dividend commitments tend to adopt conservative approaches. Income shifting attributable to EPU is shown to erode firm value and profitability, possibly due to regulatory scrutiny and reputational risks. However, strong governance, particularly independent and gender-diverse boards, helps mitigate income shifting during uncertain times.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了经济政策不确定性对美国企业境外收入转移的影响，发现EPU会显著促进企业进行跨境利润转移以规避风险，但这种行为会损害企业价值和盈利能力，而良好的公司治理（特别是独立和性别多元化的董事会）可以缓解这种影响。
AI.research_question: 经济政策不确定性如何影响美国企业的境外收入转移行为？
AI.motivation: 在经济政策不确定性日益增加的背景下，理解企业如何调整税务策略以应对风险具有重要的理论和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险管理理论和公司治理理论，探讨企业在不确定性环境下的税务规划行为。
AI.method: 使用De Simone等人（2019）基于美国国税局机密数据的独特数据集，采用倾向得分匹配、熵平衡法和工具变量分析等严谨方法进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 1. EPU对境外收入转移有显著正向影响；2. 税负较高的企业更倾向于转移收入；3. 有重大股息承诺的企业采取保守策略；4. 由EPU驱动的收入转移会损害企业价值和盈利能力；5. 独立和性别多元化的董事会能够缓解不确定性时期的收入转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将经济政策不确定性纳入企业税务策略分析框架；2. 揭示了不确定性环境下企业风险管理的微观机制；3. 拓展了公司治理在税务规划中的作用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供监管启示；2. 为企业管理者提供风险管理建议；3. 为投资者评估企业税务风险提供参考；4. 强调良好公司治理在不确定性时期的重要性。

title: Empiricism in Nonlinear Adaptive Systems
affiliations: Korea University

detail.title: Empiricism in Nonlinear Adaptive Systems
detail.abstract: This project develops a minimal empirical framework for studying nonlinear adaptive systems in financial markets, where equilibrium and linear econometric assumptions systematically fail. In reflexive systems, agents’ expectations recursively shape the environment that informs those same expectations, causing large models and high precision to obscure generative structure. I combine minimal nonlinear models with structural lenses—targeted diagnostics that isolate feedback mechanisms under conditions of stress. Across speculative bubbles, futures market reversibility, and organizational hierarchy, I show that extreme events and regime shifts function as empirical microscopes for hidden structure. The framework replaces prediction with structural diagnosis and equilibrium optimization with stability analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个用于研究金融市场非线性自适应系统的简约实证框架，在均衡和线性计量经济学假设系统失效的情况下，通过结合简约非线性模型和结构透镜（针对压力条件下反馈机制的诊断工具），将预测替换为结构诊断，将均衡优化替换为稳定性分析。
AI.research_question: 如何在金融市场中研究非线性自适应系统，特别是在均衡和线性计量经济学假设系统失效的情况下，如何揭示隐藏的结构机制？
AI.motivation: 传统金融模型基于均衡和线性假设，在反射性系统中（代理人的期望递归地塑造环境，环境又反过来影响期望）会系统性地失效，大模型和高精度反而会掩盖生成性结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反射性理论（索罗斯）、非线性自适应系统理论、结构诊断框架、稳定性分析理论。
AI.method: 结合简约非线性模型与结构透镜（针对压力条件下反馈机制的诊断工具），利用极端事件和制度转换作为"经验显微镜"来揭示隐藏结构。
AI.findings: 在投机泡沫、期货市场可逆性和组织层级等案例中，极端事件和制度转换能够有效揭示隐藏的结构机制，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个简约的实证框架来研究非线性自适应系统；2. 将预测替换为结构诊断；3. 将均衡优化替换为稳定性分析；4. 发展了"结构透镜"作为诊断工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者提供了在传统模型失效时分析市场的新工具，特别是在极端事件和制度转换期间，有助于更好地理解市场动态和风险管理。

title: Innovation Management at the Fuzzy Front End: AI, Business Cases, and Product Portfolios
affiliations: University of Strasbourg, University of Strasbourg and University of Strasbourg - Faculty of Economics and Management, University of Strasbourg - Bureau of Economic Theory and Application (BETA)

detail.title: Innovation Management at the Fuzzy Front End: AI, Business Cases, and Product Portfolios
detail.abstract: This chapter examines the strategic management of the Fuzzy Front End (FFE) in innovation, emphasizing its role in new product development for mature firms with extensive product portfolios. We show how FFE shapes competitive advantage and how artificial intelligence (AI) redefines early-stage decisionmaking, business case development, and business model innovation. AI reveals emerging opportunities, enhances decision-making under uncertainty, and strengthens risk assessment. We underline its impact on resource allocation, balancing disruptive innovation with operational stability. AI accelerates business model evolution, sharpening project selection, portfolio management, and strategic alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了成熟企业在创新模糊前端（FFE）的战略管理，重点分析人工智能如何重塑早期决策、商业案例开发和商业模式创新，从而增强竞争优势。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何重新定义成熟企业在创新模糊前端（FFE）的战略管理，包括早期决策、商业案例开发和商业模式创新？
AI.motivation: 成熟企业拥有广泛的产品组合，但在创新模糊前端面临决策不确定性、风险评估困难和资源分配挑战，需要探索人工智能如何优化这一关键创新阶段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模糊前端（FFE）创新理论、战略管理理论、资源分配理论、竞争优势理论、人工智能在创新管理中的应用理论
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于现有文献和理论构建，探讨人工智能在FFE创新管理中的潜在应用和影响
AI.findings: 人工智能能够：1）揭示新兴机会；2）增强不确定性下的决策能力；3）强化风险评估；4）优化资源分配，平衡颠覆性创新与运营稳定性；5）加速商业模式演进；6）改进项目选择和投资组合管理
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了模糊前端创新理论，将人工智能整合到战略管理框架中，提出了AI增强型FFE管理模型，丰富了创新管理和战略决策理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为成熟企业提供：1）AI驱动的FFE管理实践指南；2）改进早期创新决策的工具；3）优化资源分配的方法；4）平衡创新与稳定性的策略；5）加速商业模式创新的路径

title: Revisiting the determinants of sovereign ratings and spreads in developing and emerging economies
affiliations: Laval University and African Development Bank

detail.title: Revisiting the determinants of sovereign ratings and spreads in developing and emerging economies
detail.abstract: This paper reexamines the determinants of sovereign ratings and spreads in developing and emerging economies. Recently, many critics have questioned the ratings assigned to these countries and the associated spreads. They argue that the credit risk assessment of these economies is overstated in the international lending market. Using sovereign ratings from the three major credit rating agencies and sovereign bond spreads from JP Morgan EMBI, we identify factors that influence both countries’ ratings and their bond spreads. Our findings show that higher external debt and debt service, higher unemployment rates, and higher inflation tend to lower sovereign ratings, with external debt being the most influential factor. Conversely, higher GDP growth rates, larger fiscal surpluses, greater FDI inflows, larger reserves, and greater credit to the private sector are associated with higher credit ratings. Additionally, our results indicate that credit ratings have the most significant effect on sovereign credit spreads. When analyzing by region, the results reveal that the Middle East and North Africa, along with Sub-Saharan Africa, exhibit the largest bias in the effect of ratings on bond spreads.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了发展中国家和新兴经济体主权评级和利差的决定因素，发现外部债务是最影响评级的负面因素，而信用评级对主权信用利差影响最大，中东、北非和撒哈拉以南非洲地区的评级对债券利差影响存在最大偏差。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家和新兴经济体主权评级和利差的决定因素是什么？信用评级对主权信用利差的影响程度如何？不同地区是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 近年来许多批评者质疑发展中国家和新兴经济体的信用评级及其相关利差，认为国际借贷市场对这些经济体的信用风险评估被高估了，因此需要重新审视主权评级和利差的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权信用评级理论、债券利差决定因素理论、国际金融风险评估理论
AI.method: 使用三大信用评级机构的主权评级数据和JP Morgan EMBI的主权债券利差数据，识别影响国家评级和债券利差的因素，并进行区域比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 较高的外部债务和债务偿还、失业率和通胀会降低主权评级，其中外部债务影响最大；2. 较高的GDP增长率、较大的财政盈余、更多的FDI流入、较大的储备和更多的私人部门信贷与较高的信用评级相关；3. 信用评级对主权信用利差影响最显著；4. 中东和北非以及撒哈拉以南非洲地区在评级对债券利差影响方面存在最大偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了发展中国家和新兴经济体主权评级决定因素的实证证据；2. 明确了信用评级对主权信用利差的关键作用；3. 揭示了地区差异在评级-利差关系中的重要性；4. 验证了批评者对国际借贷市场风险评估过高的质疑。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了改善主权评级的明确方向；2. 为投资者提供了评估主权信用风险的重要参考；3. 为评级机构提供了改进评级方法的实证依据；4. 为国际金融机构提供了区域风险评估的差异化视角。

title: Inflation and monetary policy in October 2025
affiliations: Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy, Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy and Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy

detail.title: Inflation and monetary policy in October 2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors have no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not require ethics approval
declarations.funderStatement: Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy funded this research paper

detail.abstract: At its meeting on October 24, 2025, the Bank of Russia lowered the key rate by 50 basis points to 16.5% per annum. In October, annual inflation over the past 12 months was 7.7% y/y, the lowest since March 2024. Compared to the previous month, the overall consumer price level increased by 0.5%. Pro-inflationary risks continue to prevail over disinflationary ones. The main pro-inflationary factors include: growth in lending, inflationary expectations and the budget deficit, continued tension in the labor market, lower oil prices, indexation of housing and communal services tariffs and VAT.

AI.tldr: 俄罗斯央行在2025年10月24日将关键利率下调50个基点至16.5%，尽管通胀风险仍占主导地位，但通胀率已降至2024年3月以来的最低水平。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯央行在通胀风险仍然存在的情况下，为何选择在2025年10月降低关键利率？
AI.motivation: 分析俄罗斯央行货币政策决策的背景，理解在通胀压力依然存在的情况下利率调整的动因和考量因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策理论、通胀目标制、利率传导机制、风险平衡框架
AI.method: 基于俄罗斯央行会议决议、通胀数据、风险因素分析的政策决策分析
AI.findings: 俄罗斯央行在通胀率降至7.7%（2024年3月以来最低）的背景下，决定降息50个基点，尽管通胀风险仍然存在，包括信贷增长、通胀预期、预算赤字、劳动力市场紧张等因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了在通胀风险依然存在但通胀数据改善情况下的货币政策决策案例，丰富了通胀目标制框架下的政策灵活性研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他央行在类似经济环境下制定货币政策提供参考，帮助理解通胀数据改善与风险因素并存时的决策权衡。

title: Molecular identification of fall Armyworm, Spodoptera frugiperda (Lepidoptera: Noctuidae) strains, through exuviae- based DNA extraction
affiliations: Cagayan State University and University of the Philippines, Los Baños - University of the Philippines Los Banos

detail.title: Molecular identification of fall Armyworm, Spodoptera frugiperda (Lepidoptera: Noctuidae) strains, through exuviae- based DNA extraction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: For language and Readability Enhancement, like grammar and style, authors utilized AI tools. h t t p s : / / c h a t g p t . c o m / c / 7 b a 8 a 2 9 b - 6 f 6 a - 4 2 d 6 - 9
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.

detail.abstract: Traditional DNA barcoding methods in entomology often rely on destructive sampling, posing ethical challenges, particularly in ecological and conservation research. This study aimed to develop and optimize a non-lethal DNA extraction technique using exuviae from fall armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda). Exuviae, especially from the pre-pupal stage, provide a non-invasive and readily available source of genetic material. Samples were collected from S. frugiperda populations across seven locations representing different provinces. DNA was extracted using the Animal and Fungi DNA preparation Kit, followed by PCR amplification and sequencing of the COI gen. the resulting sequences were analyzed using BLAST for species and strain identification. Phylogenetic analysis of the cytochrome oxidase 1 (COI) gene successfully differentiated between the rice (R) and corn (C) strains of S. frugiperda, with two distinct genetic clusters observed. Fresher and well-preserved exuviae can be serve as a reliable, ethical, and effective alternative to traditional DNA sampling methods. The approach supports sustainable pest surveillance, genetic diversity assessment, and integrated pest management (IPM), contributing a valuable tool for non-destructive insect molecular diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种利用草地贪夜蛾蜕皮进行非致死DNA提取的技术，成功区分了水稻和玉米品系，为昆虫分子诊断提供了伦理友好的替代方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种基于草地贪夜蛾蜕皮的非致死DNA提取技术，并验证其在品系鉴定和遗传分析中的有效性？
AI.motivation: 传统DNA条形码技术需要破坏性取样，在生态和保护研究中存在伦理挑战，需要开发非侵入性的遗传材料获取方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于昆虫蜕皮作为非侵入性遗传材料来源的理论，结合DNA条形码技术和系统发育分析框架。
AI.method: 从7个地点采集草地贪夜蛾蜕皮样本，使用动物和真菌DNA制备试剂盒提取DNA，PCR扩增COI基因并测序，通过BLAST进行物种和品系鉴定，进行系统发育分析。
AI.findings: COI基因的系统发育分析成功区分了草地贪夜蛾的水稻(R)和玉米(C)品系，观察到两个明显的遗传簇；新鲜保存良好的蜕皮可作为可靠的DNA来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了昆虫蜕皮作为非侵入性遗传材料来源的理论可行性，扩展了DNA条形码技术的应用范围，为昆虫分子生态学提供了新的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为害虫监测、遗传多样性评估和综合害虫管理提供了伦理友好的工具，支持可持续农业实践，减少研究中对昆虫的伤害。

title: Crowded Career Ladders? Intra-Firm Spillovers of Raised Retirement Age
affiliations: Charles University in Prague - CERGE-EI, a joint workplace of Charles University and the Economics Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences

detail.title: Crowded Career Ladders? Intra-Firm Spillovers of Raised Retirement Age

declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by Charles University, GAUK project No. 333221.

detail.abstract: I study how delayed retirements reshape firms' internal labor markets, leveraging a German reform that raised women's early retirement age by at least three years. The reform increased retention of older women and reduced both internal promotions and external hiring of younger coworkers, with strongest losses among middle-aged workers close by on career ladders to retained older workers. Spillovers are structured: promotion crowd-outs arise in thick internal labor markets with intense competition, while hiring declines are largest in thin external markets with high turnover costs. Crowd-out effects concentrate within jobcells, whereas coworkers in other jobcells can benefit when retained older workers possess specific human capital. Taken together, the evidence supports slot-constraint theories-augmented by firm-specific human-capital mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 德国一项提高女性提前退休年龄的改革，增加了老年女性员工的留任，减少了年轻同事的内部晋升和外部招聘，对中年员工影响最大。溢出效应具有结构性：在竞争激烈的内部劳动力市场出现晋升挤出，在流动成本高的外部市场出现招聘减少。这些效应集中在特定工作岗位内，但当留任老年员工拥有特定人力资本时，其他岗位的同事可能受益。
AI.research_question: 延迟退休如何重塑企业内部劳动力市场？具体而言，老年员工留任的增加如何影响年轻同事的晋升和招聘机会？
AI.motivation: 随着人口老龄化，许多国家都在提高退休年龄，但延迟退休对企业内部劳动力市场的具体影响尚不清楚。了解老年员工留任如何影响年轻员工的职业机会对于政策制定和企业管理都很重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要理论框架是"职位约束理论"（slot-constraint theories），并结合企业特定人力资本机制。该理论认为企业内部职位数量有限，老年员工占据职位会限制年轻员工的晋升机会。
AI.method: 利用德国提高女性提前退休年龄的改革作为准自然实验，采用断点回归设计或差异中的差异方法，分析改革前后企业内部劳动力市场的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 改革增加了老年女性员工的留任率；2. 减少了年轻同事的内部晋升机会；3. 减少了外部招聘；4. 对中年员工（在职业阶梯上接近老年员工）影响最大；5. 溢出效应具有结构性：在竞争激烈的内部市场出现晋升挤出，在流动成本高的外部市场出现招聘减少；6. 挤出效应集中在特定工作岗位内；7. 当留任老年员工拥有特定人力资本时，其他岗位的同事可能受益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为职位约束理论提供了实证支持；2. 扩展了该理论，加入了企业特定人力资本机制；3. 揭示了延迟退休对企业内部劳动力市场的结构性影响；4. 区分了内部晋升和外部招聘的不同影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供延迟退休政策影响的实证证据；2. 帮助企业管理者理解老年员工留任对年轻员工职业发展的影响；3. 建议企业在设计人力资源政策时考虑不同劳动力市场的结构性差异；4. 强调企业特定人力资本在缓解延迟退休负面影响中的作用。
