title: Understanding Sampling Techniques and Determining Sample Size in Qualitative Research. A Novice Guide
affiliations: Mzumbe University

detail.title: Understanding Sampling Techniques and Determining Sample Size in Qualitative Research. A Novice Guide
detail.abstract: This study intended to deepen the understanding of qualitative sampling techniques and how to determine sample size among students and early-career researchers. Methods: A narrative approach was used to simplify the understanding of the sampling techniques and the method for determining sample size in qualitative research. Together with the use of secondary sources, the researcher's own experience is used to argue and discuss. Findings: The study identified in detail purposive sampling, convenience sampling, snowball sampling, and quota sampling as common sampling techniques for qualitative research. Furthermore, the study pointed out the concept of data saturation as a key determinant of sample adequacy in qualitative research, and it can be affected by factors such as subjectivism, scope of the research, research design, researchers' experience, and data collection methods. Originality: This study expands the methodological literature coverage on qualitative research, which also serves as a guide to both students and emerging researchers in social science research. Practical Implications: This study enhances the common understanding of emerging researchers on the appropriateness of using various qualitative sampling techniques and sample size determination to achieve qualitative study goals.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了定性研究中常用的抽样技术（目的抽样、便利抽样、滚雪球抽样、配额抽样）和样本量确定方法，重点介绍了数据饱和度的概念及其影响因素，为社会科学领域的学生和早期研究者提供了方法论指导。
AI.research_question: 定性研究中应采用哪些抽样技术？如何确定定性研究的样本量？
AI.motivation: 加深学生和早期研究者对定性抽样技术和样本量确定方法的理解，填补方法论文献的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定性研究方法论，特别是抽样理论和数据饱和度概念。
AI.method: 采用叙述性方法，结合二手资料和研究者自身经验进行论证和讨论。
AI.findings: 识别了目的抽样、便利抽样、滚雪球抽样和配额抽样四种常用定性抽样技术；指出数据饱和度是定性研究样本充分性的关键决定因素，受主观性、研究范围、研究设计、研究者经验和数据收集方法等因素影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了定性研究的方法论文献覆盖范围，为社会科学研究提供了系统的抽样方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会科学领域的学生和新兴研究者提供了实用指南，帮助他们理解如何选择适当的抽样技术和确定样本量以实现研究目标。

title: Event-Driven Alpha from Large Language Models: A Theoretical Framework for Contrastive Financial Representation Learning

detail.title: Event-Driven Alpha from Large Language Models: A Theoretical Framework for Contrastive Financial Representation Learning
detail.abstract: This paper develops a purely theoretical framework for extracting financial alpha from eventdriven text using Large Language Models (LLMs), with a particular focus on tail-risk-sensitive prediction. We argue that conventional approaches based on directional classification of abnormal returns are fundamentally misaligned with the true economic objective of risk-aware portfolio optimisation, especially under the heavy-tailed return distributions characteristic of financial markets. We introduce a formal theory of event-conditioned alpha that shifts the modelling emphasis from binary return direction to the conditional structure of tail risk. Within this framework, textual representations are interpreted as informational operators that deform the tail geometry of future return distributions. We derive analytical conditions under which LLM-induced embeddings influence downside risk concentration, Expected Shortfall sensitivity, and tail asymmetry, without reliance on empirical backtesting or explicit geometric embedding constructions. The resulting theory establishes a principled connection between language-based event interpretation and coherent risk measures, providing a mathematically rigorous foundation for LLM-driven alpha under extreme and stress-driven market regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个纯理论框架，利用大语言模型从事件驱动文本中提取金融阿尔法，特别关注尾部风险敏感预测。该框架将建模重点从二元收益方向转向尾部风险的条件结构，建立语言事件解释与一致性风险度量之间的原则性联系。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个理论框架，使大语言模型能够从事件驱动文本中提取尾部风险敏感的金融阿尔法，而不依赖于经验回测或显式几何嵌入构造？
AI.motivation: 传统基于异常收益方向分类的方法与风险感知投资组合优化的真实经济目标存在根本性错配，特别是在金融市场的厚尾收益分布特征下。需要建立理论框架将语言事件解释与尾部风险结构联系起来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件条件阿尔法理论，将文本表示解释为信息算子，这些算子会改变未来收益分布的尾部几何结构。该框架关注尾部风险集中度、期望损失敏感性和尾部不对称性，建立语言事件解释与一致性风险度量之间的数学联系。
AI.method: 纯理论推导方法，不依赖经验回测或显式几何嵌入构造。通过分析条件推导LLM诱导嵌入如何影响下行风险集中度、期望损失敏感性和尾部不对称性的条件。
AI.findings: 建立了文本表示作为信息算子的理论框架，这些算子会变形未来收益分布的尾部几何。推导了LLM诱导嵌入影响尾部风险结构的分析条件，为极端和市场压力驱动机制下的LLM驱动阿尔法提供了数学严谨的基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了事件条件阿尔法理论，将建模重点从二元收益方向转向尾部风险条件结构；2. 建立了文本表示作为信息算子的理论解释；3. 推导了LLM嵌入影响尾部风险几何的分析条件；4. 建立了语言事件解释与一致性风险度量之间的原则性联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为LLM在金融风险预测中的应用提供了理论指导；2. 为开发尾部风险敏感的文本分析工具提供了理论基础；3. 为极端市场条件下的投资策略设计提供了理论框架；4. 减少了对经验回测的依赖，增强了模型的理论可靠性。

title: General M-estimators of location on Riemannian manifolds: existence and uniqueness
affiliations: Pusan National University and Seoul National University

detail.title: General M-estimators of location on Riemannian manifolds: existence and uniqueness
detail.abstract: We study general M-estimators of location on Riemannian manifolds, extending classical notions such as the Frechet mean by replacing the squared loss with a broad class of loss functions. Under minimal regularity conditions on the loss function and the underlying probability distribution, we establish theoretical guarantees for the existence and uniqueness of the associated population M-functional and the corresponding sample M-estimators. In particular, we provide sufficient conditions under which the population minimizer set is nonempty and reduces to a singleton, and under which the corresponding sample M-estimator is likewise uniquely defined. Our results offer a general framework for robust location estimation in non-Euclidean geometric spaces and unify prior uniqueness results under a broad class of convex losses.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了黎曼流形上位置参数的广义M估计量，将经典概念（如Frèchet均值）扩展到更广泛的损失函数类别，建立了存在性、唯一性的理论保证，为非欧几里得几何空间中的鲁棒位置估计提供了统一框架。
AI.research_question: 在黎曼流形上，对于广义的M估计量（使用非平方损失函数），其总体M泛函和样本M估计量的存在性和唯一性条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统Frèchet均值使用平方损失，对异常值敏感且缺乏鲁棒性。需要扩展经典概念，为黎曼流形上的位置估计提供更一般、更鲁棒的框架，统一现有研究结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 黎曼几何、M估计理论、凸分析、概率论。将欧几里得空间中的M估计理论推广到黎曼流形上，研究在非欧几里得几何空间中的统计推断问题。
AI.method: 理论分析方法，在最小正则性条件下，通过数学推导建立存在性和唯一性定理。研究损失函数和概率分布的充分条件，确保总体最小化集合非空且为单点集，以及样本估计量唯一确定。
AI.findings: 建立了黎曼流形上广义M估计量的存在性和唯一性理论保证。提供了损失函数和概率分布的充分条件，确保总体M泛函存在且唯一，相应的样本M估计量也唯一确定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将M估计理论扩展到黎曼流形；2. 建立了广义损失函数下的存在性和唯一性定理；3. 统一了凸损失函数下的现有唯一性结果；4. 为非欧几里得空间中的鲁棒统计推断提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非欧几里得几何空间（如球面、双曲空间等）中的鲁棒位置估计提供了通用框架；2. 允许使用各种损失函数处理异常值；3. 为计算机视觉、医学成像、机器学习等领域的非欧几里得数据分析提供了理论支持。

title: Bridging Data and Culture: A Comprehensive Framework for Real-Time Project Monitoring in the East Asia-Pacific Region
affiliations: Jahangirnagar University

detail.title: Bridging Data and Culture: A Comprehensive Framework for Real-Time Project Monitoring in the East Asia-Pacific Region

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that the research was conducted in the absence of any commercial or financial relationships that could be interpreted as a potential conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not require ethical approval or informed consent as it involved no human subjects, in accordance with institutional guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding: The author(s) received no financial support or specific grant from any funding agencies, whether public, commercial, or not-for-profit, for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: This paper explores the pivotal shift from traditional periodic monitoring to real-time, holistic project management systems in the East Asia and Pacific (EAP) region. As projects increase in complexity and scale, conventional lagging indicators are no longer adequate for managing risks and ensuring successful outcomes. This study proposes an integrated framework that combines hard metrics (quality, risk, financial controls) with soft indicators (stakeholder satisfaction, team morale, and communication effectiveness) via automated dashboard systems. Drawing upon project management literature, regional case studies, and empirical evidence from EAP infrastructure and technology initiatives, this research demonstrates that organisations adopting comprehensive real-time monitoring achieve better results in budget adherence, quality delivery, and stakeholder satisfaction. The paper offers practical recommendations for practitioners navigating the distinctive challenges posed by EAP's dynamic regulatory environments, cross-cultural teams, and the pressures of rapid urbanisation.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了东亚太平洋地区从传统周期性监控向实时、全面的项目管理系统的关键转变，提出了一个结合硬指标和软指标的集成框架，并通过区域案例研究证明实时监控系统能带来更好的项目结果。
AI.research_question: 在东亚太平洋地区，如何从传统的周期性监控转向实时、全面的项目管理系统，以应对日益复杂的项目挑战？
AI.motivation: 随着项目复杂性和规模的增加，传统的滞后指标已不足以管理风险和确保项目成功，特别是在东亚太平洋地区面临动态监管环境、跨文化团队和快速城市化压力的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于项目管理文献，结合硬指标（质量、风险、财务控制）和软指标（利益相关者满意度、团队士气、沟通有效性）的集成框架理论。
AI.method: 采用区域案例研究和东亚太平洋地区基础设施与技术项目的实证证据，通过自动化仪表板系统实现指标整合。
AI.findings: 采用全面实时监控的组织在预算遵守、质量交付和利益相关者满意度方面取得更好的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结合硬指标和软指标的集成项目管理框架，拓展了实时监控在复杂项目环境中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了应对东亚太平洋地区动态监管环境、跨文化团队和快速城市化压力的实用建议，包括自动化仪表板系统的实施指南。

title: Corporate Income Taxes Around the Globe
affiliations: and Virginia Tech - Pamplin College of Business

detail.title: Corporate Income Taxes Around the Globe
detail.abstract: We collect corporate tax rules data in 174 countries from 2004 to 2023. In addition to the top statutory corporate income tax rates, our data includes tax incentives for debt or equity financing, incentives for investment and innovation, and other aspects of the tax base such as tax loss carrybacks and carryforwards. Our empirical analyses reveal limited evidence consistent with the Desai, Dyck, and Zingales’s (2007) observation that corporate tax rate reductions are accompanied by tax base broadening. Among potential determinants of tax revenues for the government, the top statutory tax rate is the most important in the full sample. Firms’ effective tax rates are additionally positively associated with tax reforms broadening the tax base and negatively associated with reforms narrowing the tax base. However, these relationships become weaker when tax evasion is more prevalent in a country. In high tax evasion countries, the signing of Anti-Tax Evasion Directives is followed by increased tax revenue and firms’ effective tax rates. By contrast, investor protection and political leaning do not appear to affect the impact of tax reforms in a meaningful way.

AI.tldr: 本文收集了174个国家2004-2023年的公司税规则数据，研究发现：公司税率降低并不必然伴随税基扩大；法定税率是政府税收最重要的决定因素；企业实际税率与税基扩大改革正相关，与税基缩小改革负相关，但这种关系在逃税严重的国家会减弱；反逃税指令能提高税收和企业实际税率；投资者保护和政治倾向对税收改革影响不大。
AI.research_question: 公司税改革（特别是税率降低与税基扩大的关系）如何影响政府税收收入和企业实际税率？哪些因素调节了这种影响？
AI.motivation: Desai、Dyck和Zingales（2007）观察到公司税率降低通常伴随着税基扩大，但这一观察是否在全球范围内普遍成立？税基改革如何影响政府税收和企业税负？特别是在逃税严重、投资者保护和政治环境不同的国家，这些影响有何差异？
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Desai、Dyck和Zingales（2007）的税制改革理论，结合税收政策、企业避税行为、制度环境（逃税程度、投资者保护、政治倾向）对税收改革效果的影响。
AI.method: 收集174个国家2004-2023年的公司税规则面板数据，包括法定税率、债务/股权融资激励、投资创新激励、亏损结转等税基要素。采用实证分析方法检验税率与税基改革的关系，并考察逃税程度、反逃税指令、投资者保护和政治倾向的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 有限证据支持税率降低伴随税基扩大的观察；2. 法定税率是政府税收最重要的决定因素；3. 企业实际税率与税基扩大改革正相关，与税基缩小改革负相关；4. 这种关系在逃税严重的国家减弱；5. 反逃税指令能提高税收和企业实际税率；6. 投资者保护和政治倾向影响不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 对Desai等（2007）的税制改革理论提供了全球实证检验；2. 揭示了税基改革对企业实际税率的影响机制；3. 强调了制度环境（特别是逃税程度）对税收改革效果的调节作用；4. 为税收政策设计提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供税制改革效果的实证证据；2. 强调在逃税严重的国家，反逃税措施比单纯税基改革更重要；3. 帮助投资者理解不同国家税收环境对企业税负的影响；4. 为国际税收协调提供政策参考。

title: A General Algorithm for Traffic Assignment Problems with Continuously Distributed User Attributes
affiliations: Northwestern University - McCormick School of Engineering and Applied Science, Southwest Jiaotong University, Southwest Jiaotong University - School of Transportation and Logistics, Northwestern University and

detail.title: A General Algorithm for Traffic Assignment Problems with Continuously Distributed User Attributes

declarations.funderStatement: This research is funded by US National Science Foundation's Civil Infrastructure System (CIS) Program under the award CMMI #2225087.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a general-purpose algorithm for solving traffic assignment problems with continuously distributed user attributes. Traditional methods often rely on discretization, which introduces behavioral distortions and limits scalability. The proposed algorithm simulates a cumulative logit (CumLog) day-to-day adjustment process, in which travelers iteratively revise their route choices based on accumulated travel experience. Aggregate route choice probabilities are computed via numerical integration, eliminating the need for arbitrary user grouping, closed-form objective functions, or restrictive problem structures. Using the continuous bi-criteria traffic assignment problem as a test case, we establish convergence and detail implementation strategies. The algorithm is further extended to accommodate multiple continuous attributes, non-separable travel times, and non-additive cost functions. Unlike classical zero-order methods, which struggle with infinite user heterogeneity, the CumLog algorithm obviates intractable class-specific operations. Numerical experiments validate its convergence, efficiency, and generality across a range of problem settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于解决具有连续分布用户属性的交通分配问题的通用算法，通过模拟累积logit逐日调整过程，避免了传统离散化方法的行为失真和可扩展性限制。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种能够有效处理连续分布用户属性的通用交通分配算法，避免传统离散化方法的行为失真和可扩展性限制？
AI.motivation: 传统交通分配方法通常依赖离散化处理用户属性，这会引入行为失真并限制算法的可扩展性，需要一种能够直接处理连续分布用户属性的通用算法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 累积logit（CumLog）逐日调整过程理论，连续分布用户属性下的交通分配理论，多连续属性、非可分离旅行时间和非加性成本函数的扩展理论。
AI.method: 提出基于累积logit逐日调整过程的算法，通过数值积分计算聚合路径选择概率，无需任意用户分组、封闭形式目标函数或限制性问题结构。
AI.findings: 算法在连续双准则交通分配问题中证明收敛，能够有效处理无限用户异质性，数值实验验证了其收敛性、效率和通用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了处理连续分布用户属性的通用交通分配理论框架，建立了累积logit调整过程的收敛性理论，扩展了多连续属性、非可分离旅行时间和非加性成本函数的处理能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了无需离散化的通用交通分配算法，提高了计算效率和可扩展性，为实际交通规划中处理复杂用户异质性提供了实用工具。

title: Household Food Handling Practices and Determinants among Adult Women in Gondar City, Northwest Ethiopia: A community-based cross-sectional study design

detail.title: Household Food Handling Practices and Determinants among Adult Women in Gondar City, Northwest Ethiopia: A community-based cross-sectional study design
detail.abstract: BackgroundPublic health in low-income nations is threatened by foodborne illnesses. In Ethiopia, research on safe food handling at home level has been scarce. This study aims to assess the household food handling practices of adult women in Gondar City, Northwest Ethiopia, and examines associated factors.MethodsA community-based cross-sectional study was conducted from May 20 to June 19, 2024. Women were asked about socio-demographic, behavioral, and environmental aspects using a standardized questionnaire. Composite indices for knowledge, attitude, and practice were created. Both binary and multivariable logistic regression analyses were employed. The Hosmer-Lemeshow test yielded a p-value of 0.72, and the variance inflation factor was less than 2.5.ResultsIn all, 53.8% of the women handled food safely. Good knowledge increased the odds by 2.30, a positive attitude 2.52, and access to food safety information 3.25. The model was well-fitting.ConclusionAlthough more than half of the women handled food safely, gaps remain in knowledge, attitude, and environment. Improving this requires access and strengthening interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了埃塞俄比亚贡德尔市成年女性的家庭食品安全处理实践，发现53.8%的女性安全处理食物，良好的知识、积极态度和食品安全信息获取是主要影响因素。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚贡德尔市成年女性的家庭食品安全处理实践现状如何？哪些因素与安全食品处理实践相关？
AI.motivation: 低收入国家的公共卫生受到食源性疾病的威胁，而埃塞俄比亚家庭层面的安全食品处理研究稀缺，需要了解现状和影响因素以制定干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识-态度-实践(KAP)模型，考察知识、态度、实践之间的关系，同时考虑社会人口学、行为和环境因素的影响。
AI.method: 社区横断面研究，使用标准化问卷收集社会人口学、行为和环境数据，构建知识、态度和实践综合指数，采用二元和多变量逻辑回归分析。
AI.findings: 53.8%的女性安全处理食物；良好知识使安全处理几率增加2.30倍，积极态度增加2.52倍，获取食品安全信息增加3.25倍；模型拟合良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了KAP模型在埃塞俄比亚家庭食品安全处理背景下的适用性，明确了知识、态度和信息获取对实践的关键影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生干预提供依据：应重点提升女性食品安全知识、改善态度、增加信息获取渠道，以改善家庭食品安全处理实践。

title: Circularity as Gendered Performance: The Impact of "Zero Waste" Attributes on Product Masculinity and Consumer Acceptance
affiliations: Faculty of Environmental and Urban Change, York University

detail.title: Circularity as Gendered Performance: The Impact of "Zero Waste" Attributes on Product Masculinity and Consumer Acceptance
detail.abstract: Despite the rapid expansion of circular economy (CE) infrastructure, consumer adoption of reusable and zero-waste systems remains a critical bottleneck. Traditional economic models attribute this resistance to "functional disutility"-the time and effort required to sort, wash, or maintain packaging. This study challenges that utilitarian view, positing that the barrier is largely semiotic: the performative labor of circularity is culturally coded as feminine "care work," creating an identity threat for men adhering to traditional masculine norms. Using a 2 (Linear vs. Circular) × 2 (Male vs. Female) experimental design with a stratified sample of North American consumers (N = 330), we investigated the impact of circular attributes on product perception and purchase intention. Results confirm that identical products are perceived as significantly more feminine when modified to be "zero waste." Crucially, a moderated mediation analysis revealed a bifurcation in male consumer behavior: while low-masculinity men evaluated products based on utility, men with high adherence to traditional norms exhibited a 24% decline in purchase intention for circular products (p < .001). We term this phenomenon "Social Disutility"-the perceived cost to social standing incurred by engaging in genderincongruent consumption. These findings suggest that scaling the circular economy requires "semiotic decoupling," moving design narratives away from domestic care toward industrial efficiency to bypass identity threat.

AI.tldr: 该研究挑战了传统经济学对循环经济采用障碍的解释，提出主要障碍是符号性的而非功能性的。研究发现循环产品被文化编码为女性化的"关怀工作"，对遵循传统男性规范的男性构成身份威胁，导致购买意愿显著下降。
AI.research_question: 循环经济基础设施迅速扩张，但消费者对可重复使用和零浪费系统的采用仍然是一个关键瓶颈。传统经济模型将这种阻力归因于"功能负效用"（分类、清洗或维护包装所需的时间和精力）。本研究挑战这种功利主义观点，提出障碍主要是符号性的：循环性的表演性劳动被文化编码为女性化的"关怀工作"，对遵循传统男性规范的男性构成身份威胁。
AI.motivation: 尽管循环经济基础设施迅速扩张，但消费者采用率仍然很低。传统解释（功能负效用）无法完全解释采用障碍，需要从社会文化角度理解消费者对循环产品的抵制。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 性别身份理论：传统男性规范与女性化活动的冲突
2. 符号消费理论：产品作为社会身份的表达
3. 社会认同理论：群体归属与行为一致性
4. 文化编码理论：特定活动被赋予性别意义
AI.method: 采用2（线性vs循环）×2（男性vs女性）实验设计，对330名北美消费者进行分层抽样。通过实验操作产品属性，测量产品感知、性别感知和购买意愿。使用调节中介分析检验传统男性规范的调节作用。
AI.findings:
1. 相同产品在改为"零浪费"时被感知为显著更女性化
2. 男性消费者行为出现分化：低男性气质的男性基于效用评估产品，而高传统规范的男性对循环产品的购买意愿下降24%
3. 存在"社会负效用"现象：参与性别不一致消费带来的社会地位感知成本
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"社会负效用"概念，扩展对消费障碍的理解
2. 挑战循环经济采用的功能主义解释，强调符号维度
3. 建立性别身份与可持续消费的理论联系
4. 引入文化编码视角解释消费者抵制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 建议通过"符号解耦"策略扩大循环经济规模
2. 将设计叙事从家庭关怀转向工业效率
3. 为营销人员提供针对性沟通策略
4. 帮助政策制定者设计更有效的干预措施

title: Shrinkflation, Unit Price Disclosure, and Consumer Welfare: Evidence from Canned Tuna
affiliations: , Iowa State University and

detail.title: Shrinkflation, Unit Price Disclosure, and Consumer Welfare: Evidence from Canned Tuna
detail.abstract: Shrinkflation, the downsizing of packages without proportional price cuts, raises effective prices in ways that are often difficult for consumers to detect under bounded attention. We exploit a documented episode of product downsizing, combined with preexisting state-level variation in unit price disclosure rules, to identify how information design affects consumer behavior and welfare. Using a matched sample of scanner data and a control function approach, we show that consumers in regulated states are 130% more responsive to unit price changes, consistent with disclosure increasing the salience of the relevant price metric. Counterfactual simulations indicate that nationwide disclosure would raise annual consumer surplus by $2.57 million in the short term and $5.82 million in the long term once retailers adjust prices strategically. At present, only 16 states regulate unit price labeling on food items. Our findings demonstrate that such labeling improves consumer decision-making under shrinkflation.

AI.tldr: 研究利用产品缩水（shrinkflation）事件和州级单位价格披露规则差异，发现单位价格标签能显著提高消费者对价格变化的敏感度，增加消费者福利。
AI.research_question: 单位价格披露规则如何影响消费者对缩水通胀（shrinkflation）的反应和福利？
AI.motivation: 缩水通胀通过减少包装尺寸而不成比例降低价格，以隐蔽方式提高有效价格，消费者在有限注意力下难以察觉。目前只有16个州要求食品标注单位价格，需要评估此类信息披露政策的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限注意力理论（bounded attention）、信息设计理论、消费者行为理论
AI.method: 利用产品缩水事件和州级单位价格披露规则差异，采用匹配样本扫描数据和控制函数方法进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 受监管州的消费者对单位价格变化的反应比未监管州高130%；2. 全国范围实施单位价格披露，短期年消费者剩余增加257万美元，长期增加582万美元（考虑零售商策略性价格调整）
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为有限注意力理论提供实证证据；2. 展示信息设计如何通过提高价格指标的显著性影响消费者行为；3. 量化信息披露政策在缩水通胀背景下的福利效应
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供单位价格标签有效性的证据；2. 支持全国范围推广单位价格披露政策；3. 帮助消费者在缩水通胀背景下做出更明智的购买决策

title: Working with Bertha Wilson: Perspectives on Liberty, Judicial Decision-Making and a Judge’s Role
affiliations: Faculty of Law, Queen's University

detail.title: Working with Bertha Wilson: Perspectives on Liberty, Judicial Decision-Making and a Judge’s Role
detail.abstract: This article examines the way in which Justice Wilson approached decision-making in several significant Charter cases concerning freedom of expression and liberty that came before the Supreme Court of Canada during its 1989-90 term. The author explores Bertha Wilson’s views on the constitutional constraints within which judicial decision-making must take place and her understanding of a judge’s role. The paper emphasizes her concern to develop sound methodological approaches to analyzing those aspects of the Charter rights at play in the cases that came before the Court. It also observes that she took great care not to deal with questions concerning the scope or substance of Charter rights that were not engaged in the cases before the Court. The paper stresses that much can be learned about her views on the constitutional limits to a judge’s role from an examination of paths that she did not go down when engaged in Charter analysis. The author concludes that Justice Wilson’s decisions were the outcome of a well-developed view of the constraints within which the judiciary must operate in order to maintain its legitimacy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析加拿大最高法院法官Bertha Wilson在1989-90年度多个重要《权利与自由宪章》案件中的决策方法，探讨她对司法决策的宪法约束和法官角色的理解。
AI.research_question: Bertha Wilson法官在1989-90年度加拿大最高法院涉及表达自由和自由的《权利与自由宪章》案件中如何理解司法决策的宪法约束和法官角色？
AI.motivation: 通过分析Wilson法官在具体宪章案件中的决策方法，揭示她对司法决策宪法约束的理解，以及她如何界定法官在宪法解释中的适当角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法解释理论、司法约束理论、法官角色理论、宪章权利分析方法论。
AI.method: 案例分析法，通过考察1989-90年度加拿大最高法院涉及表达自由和自由的多个重要《权利与自由宪章》案件，分析Wilson法官的判决推理和决策方法。
AI.findings: Wilson法官注重发展健全的方法论来分析案件中涉及的宪章权利，谨慎处理与案件无关的宪章权利范围或实质问题，她的决策体现了对司法约束的成熟理解。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对司法决策宪法约束的理解，提供了法官在宪章解释中保持司法合法性的方法论框架，强调通过"未走之路"分析来理解法官的宪法角色限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法官和律师提供了宪章权利分析的方法论指导，展示了如何在具体案件中保持司法克制，维护司法机构的合法性和公信力。

title: Financial Constraints and Employment Dynamics following Natural Disasters *
affiliations: , Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City and Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City

detail.title: Financial Constraints and Employment Dynamics following Natural Disasters *
detail.abstract: We use confidential loan-level regulatory data to show that financial constraints can weigh on credit access and employment after a natural disaster at both the local and national level. Banks cut back on lending in disaster areas, particularly to the most financially constrained firms, and these reductions in credit supply lead to larger initial declines and slower subsequent recoveries in employment. Bank profitability is a key driver of this result: Borrowers more reliant on less-profitable lenders obtain fewer loans and pay higher interest rates following disasters. These less-profitable lenders also respond by providing fewer loans and charging higher interest rates to financially constrained borrowers in other unaffected areas. We show that these financial spillovers ultimately distort employment growth. Our findings suggest a potential role for policies that improve access to credit in the aftermath of natural disasters.

AI.tldr: 研究发现自然灾害后，银行会减少对受灾地区企业的贷款，特别是对财务约束最严重的企业，这导致就业下降更严重、恢复更慢。银行盈利能力是关键因素：依赖盈利能力较差银行的借款人在灾后获得贷款更少、利率更高。这些影响还会溢出到未受灾地区，最终扭曲就业增长。
AI.research_question: 自然灾害如何通过银行信贷渠道影响企业的信贷获取和就业？银行盈利能力在这一过程中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 自然灾害对经济的影响不仅限于直接破坏，还可能通过金融系统传导。了解银行信贷在灾后恢复中的作用，特别是银行盈利能力如何影响信贷供给，对制定有效的灾后政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融约束理论和信贷渠道理论，研究自然灾害如何通过银行信贷供给影响实体经济，特别关注银行盈利能力作为信贷供给的重要决定因素。
AI.method: 使用保密的贷款层面监管数据，分析自然灾害后银行的信贷行为变化，通过识别策略区分信贷供给和需求效应，考察银行盈利能力对信贷分配的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 银行减少对受灾地区的贷款，特别是对财务约束最严重的企业；2. 信贷供给减少导致就业下降更严重、恢复更慢；3. 银行盈利能力是关键驱动因素：依赖盈利能力较差银行的借款人获得贷款更少、利率更高；4. 这些影响会溢出到未受灾地区，最终扭曲就业增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了自然灾害通过银行信贷渠道影响实体经济的机制；2. 识别了银行盈利能力在灾后信贷分配中的关键作用；3. 提供了金融约束在宏观经济冲击传导中的新证据；4. 扩展了信贷渠道理论在自然灾害背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了改善灾后信贷获取的政策依据；2. 强调了支持银行盈利能力对灾后经济恢复的重要性；3. 指出了需要关注金融溢出效应，避免未受灾地区受到负面影响；4. 建议设计针对财务约束企业的信贷支持政策。

reference: Brics Law Journal, Volume 12, No. 1, Pp. 80-114, 2025.
title: Struggling Against Violence and Harassment in the Workplace: A Legal Narrative of the BRICS Countries' Experience
affiliations: Pontifical Catholic University of Sao Paolo (PUCSP), University of Catania and FUNDACENTRO - Fundação Jorge Duprat Figueiredo de Segurança e Medicina do Trabalho

detail.title: Struggling Against Violence and Harassment in the Workplace: A Legal Narrative of the BRICS Countries' Experience

publicationDetails.detailsText: Brics Law Journal, Volume 12, No. 1, Pp. 80-114, 2025.

detail.abstract: The adoption by the International Labour Organization (ILO) of a special convention dedicated to the struggle against violence and harassment in the workplace, namely the Violence and Harassment Convention, 2019 (C190), is a special opportunity to research the level of protection against these phenomena granted by national legislations and to better understand the ways to improve it. The main objective of this article is to analyze the national approaches of the BRICS countries to the issue of harassment in the world of work in order to identify the current problems and the possible ways of solving them, including through the implementation of the norms of the C190 or following Violence and Harassment Recommendation, 2019 (No. 206) (R206). In the five sections of this article, each of which is dedicated to a separate member state of BRICS, the authors examine the national labor legislation and other laws that are relevant to the topic, the gaps in these norms as compared to the requirements of the C190, and the case law in this field. The research demonstrates that certain BRICS nations, such as South Africa, have implemented a legal framework to address and prevent harassment, having ratified C190. In Brazil, violence and harassment in the workplace are not regulated by a special law; instead, the country's norms are rather fragmented and tend to protect mostly women, in particular against sexual harassment. On the other hand, countries such as China and India, despite their focus on prohibiting sexual harassment against women, often overlook the aspect of moral harassment. Russia tends to neglect both issues, altogether disregarding the inclusion of specific norms in the labor law.

AI.tldr: 本文分析金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国、南非）在工作场所骚扰问题上的法律框架，评估其与国际劳工组织《暴力和骚扰公约》（C190）的差距，并提出改进建议。
AI.research_question: 金砖国家在工作场所骚扰问题上的法律保护现状如何？与C190公约要求相比存在哪些差距？如何通过实施C190或R206建议书来改进？
AI.motivation: 国际劳工组织通过C190公约为工作场所暴力和骚扰问题提供了重要国际标准，这为研究各国法律保护水平提供了特殊机会。金砖国家作为重要经济体，其法律框架对全球劳工保护具有示范意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际劳工标准理论、比较劳动法理论、性别平等理论、工作场所保护理论，以及国际公约在国内法实施的理论框架。
AI.method: 比较法研究：分析五个金砖国家的劳动立法、相关法律、案例法，并与C190公约要求进行对比分析，识别法律空白和不足。
AI.findings: 1. 南非已建立较完善的法律框架并批准了C190；2. 巴西法律分散，主要保护女性免受性骚扰；3. 中国和印度主要关注女性性骚扰保护，忽视道德骚扰；4. 俄罗斯劳动法缺乏具体规范，忽视这两个问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了国际劳工标准在国内实施的理论研究；2. 提供了金砖国家劳动法比较研究的新视角；3. 发展了工作场所骚扰法律保护的理论框架；4. 为国际公约与国内法协调理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金砖国家完善工作场所骚扰立法提供具体建议；2. 为C190公约实施提供参考路径；3. 为企业和组织制定反骚扰政策提供指导；4. 为国际劳工组织推动公约批准提供政策建议。

title: Deconstructing AI Power: From Political Capital to Algorithmic Control
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Deconstructing AI Power: From Political Capital to Algorithmic Control

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest that could influence the research. The study was conducted independently without external pressure or obligations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: I have reviewed each file and I have the right to upload this file. I agree to the terms.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted entirely by the author as an independent scholarly contribution.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a symbolic governance model that maps how political authorities (P1–P2, L, I), capital (F, C), and layered technical infrastructures (T1–T4) translate directives into recursive algorithmic control. Rather than treating AI as an autonomous or neutral technology, the model reframes it as an encoded structure of power operating across data (D), social interfaces (S1–S2), and global arenas (G1–G3). By compressing complex system interactions into an accessible symbolic language, the framework helps non-technical stakeholders trace influence from policy and finance to code, platforms, and behavioral feedback (R). Brief case snapshots illustrate how algorithmic logics shape information, decisions, and public life. The contribution is a practical lens for diagnosing power in AI ecosystems and a policy-oriented roadmap for oversight, transparency in optimization targets, and public-interest safeguards against algorithmic domination.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个符号治理模型，将AI视为编码的权力结构而非自主中立技术，通过符号语言映射政治权威、资本和技术基础设施如何将指令转化为递归算法控制，为诊断AI生态系统中的权力关系提供实用工具。
AI.research_question: 政治权威、资本和技术基础设施如何通过符号化治理模型将指令转化为递归的算法控制，从而塑造信息、决策和公共生活？
AI.motivation: 当前AI常被视为自主或中立技术，忽视了其作为编码权力结构的本质。需要开发一个框架来帮助非技术利益相关者追踪从政策、金融到代码、平台和行为反馈的权力影响路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 符号治理理论、算法权力理论、政治经济学框架、技术基础设施分层理论（T1-T4）、全球治理理论（G1-G3）
AI.method: 开发符号治理模型（映射P1-P2、L、I、F、C、T1-T4、D、S1-S2、G1-G3等要素），通过案例快照分析算法逻辑如何塑造信息、决策和公共生活
AI.findings: 算法逻辑通过数据（D）、社会界面（S1-S2）和全球领域（G1-G3）运作，将复杂的系统互动压缩为可访问的符号语言，揭示了从政策金融到代码平台的权力转化机制
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将AI重新定义为编码的权力结构而非自主技术；2. 提出符号治理模型作为分析AI生态系统中权力关系的理论框架；3. 建立了从政治权威到算法控制的系统性映射方法
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非技术利益相关者提供诊断AI权力的实用工具；2. 为政策制定者提供监督路线图；3. 促进优化目标的透明度；4. 建立防止算法支配的公共利益保障机制

title: GenAI-Based Index of Financial Constraints
affiliations: Nazarbayev University

detail.title: GenAI-Based Index of Financial Constraints
detail.abstract: I construct a new measure of financial constraints by applying a large language model to firms' 10-K MD&A disclosures. The model evaluates each filing as a finance expert and classifies the firm's external financing difficulty on an ordered scale, producing the GenAI FC Index. The index captures contextual signals-such as nuanced liquidity discussions - that traditional accounting-based and prior text-based proxies often miss. It behaves sensibly in both the time series and cross-section and shows only moderate correlations with existing measures, indicating that it contains distinct information. Behavioral tests reveal that firms classified as constrained recycle far less equity and are substantially more likely to omit-and less likely to increase-dividends. Across these settings, the GenAI FC Index consistently outperforms benchmark text-based measures. The results demonstrate that generative AI can extract economically meaningful information about firms' financing frictions at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型分析公司10-K报告中的管理层讨论与分析部分，构建了新的财务约束衡量指标GenAI FC Index。该指标能捕捉传统会计指标和文本分析工具常忽略的上下文信号，在行为测试中表现优于现有文本基准指标，证明生成式AI能大规模提取企业融资摩擦的经济意义信息。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型从公司10-K报告的MD&A部分提取信息，构建更有效的财务约束衡量指标？
AI.motivation: 传统基于会计数据的财务约束指标和现有文本分析工具往往无法捕捉MD&A中关于融资困难的细微上下文信号和流动性讨论的细微差别，需要更先进的自然语言处理技术来提取这些信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财务约束理论、信息不对称理论、文本分析在金融中的应用、生成式AI在金融分析中的潜力
AI.method: 使用大语言模型分析公司10-K报告中的MD&A部分，让模型像金融专家一样评估每份文件，将公司的外部融资难度按有序尺度分类，构建GenAI FC Index。通过时间序列和横截面分析验证指标的合理性，并与现有指标进行相关性分析，最后进行行为测试验证指标的有效性。
AI.findings: GenAI FC Index能捕捉传统指标常忽略的上下文信号（如流动性讨论的细微差别）；在时间序列和横截面上表现合理；与现有指标相关性适中，表明包含独特信息；被分类为受约束的公司股权再循环较少，更可能取消股息且不太可能增加股息；在所有测试中均优于基准文本指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了利用生成式AI构建财务约束指标的新方法；证明了生成式AI能提取传统方法难以捕捉的细微文本信号；为财务约束衡量提供了新的理论视角和方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、分析师和研究人员提供了更准确的财务约束衡量工具；帮助市场参与者更好地评估公司融资状况；展示了生成式AI在金融文本分析中的实际应用价值；为监管机构提供了新的公司财务风险评估方法。

reference: The Journal of World Investment & Trade, 2025[10.1163/22119000-12340373]
title: Structural Barriers and Power Dynamics in UNCITRAL WGIII: Upholding the Status Quo?
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Center on Sustainable Investment and Columbia University - Columbia Center on Sustainable Investment

detail.title: Structural Barriers and Power Dynamics in UNCITRAL WGIII: Upholding the Status Quo?

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Journal of World Investment & Trade, 2025[10.1163/22119000-12340373]

detail.abstract: This paper critically examines whether the UNCITRAL Working Group III reform process in investor-State dispute settlement (ISDS) is procedurally inclusive and meaningfully accessible to developing countries, which are disproportionately subject to ISDS claims. Drawing on attendance and participation patterns across five negotiating sessions between September 2022 and January 2024, the analysis reveals persistent disparities in engagement among States. While high-income countries continue to dominate the process, developing countries have nonetheless made strategic interventions and secured limited gains, despite facing significant obstacles. Their ability to participate meaningfully, however, is constrained by deeper systemic disadvantagesincluding resource disparities, language and expertise gaps, delegation instability, and limited access to regional preparatory processes. Rather than establishing causality, the paper traces how these conditions shape the terrain of participation, offering insight into the broader dynamics and limitations of multilateral investment treaty reform.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了UNCITRAL第三工作组ISDS改革进程中发展中国家参与的包容性与可及性问题，发现尽管发展中国家面临系统性障碍，但仍取得有限成果，揭示了多边投资条约改革的参与不平等问题。
AI.research_question: UNCITRAL第三工作组的ISDS改革进程是否对发展中国家具有程序包容性和实质性可及性？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家在ISDS案件中受到不成比例的影响，但在改革进程中可能面临参与障碍，需要评估改革进程的包容性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法中的程序正义理论、多边谈判中的权力不对称理论、发展中国家在国际治理中的参与障碍理论。
AI.method: 基于2022年9月至2024年1月期间五次谈判会议的出席和参与模式进行实证分析，追踪参与条件如何塑造参与格局。
AI.findings: 1. 高收入国家继续主导改革进程；2. 发展中国家面临资源差距、语言和专业知识缺口、代表团不稳定、区域筹备过程有限等系统性障碍；3. 尽管如此，发展中国家仍做出战略干预并获得有限成果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了多边投资条约改革中参与不平等的系统性根源；2. 提供了理解国际治理中程序包容性的分析框架；3. 挑战了形式平等掩盖实质不平等的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为改革进程提供改进建议以增强包容性；2. 帮助发展中国家制定更有效的参与策略；3. 为国际组织设计更公平的谈判程序提供参考。

title: How Does a Fraud Scandal Impact Trust in Science?
affiliations: University of Chicago,  and Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Sao Paulo School of Economics

detail.title: How Does a Fraud Scandal Impact Trust in Science?
detail.abstract: This paper studies how unethical behavior in scientific research impacts trust in science. We run an information delivery experiment with high school students in Brazil, where we present them with a summary of a suspected fraud scandal in behavioral sciences. We divide treated subjects into a "fraud" arm, where they only learn about the fraud accusations, an "accountability" arm, where they learn about the investigation and punishment processes involved, and a control group that does not learn about the fraud scandal. This allows us to tell apart the effects of learning about cheating from the effects of learning about the accountability process. We find that treated students are less likely to update their personal beliefs according to scientific evidence and are less interested in science-related books. We find suggestive evidence that they are less willing to share scientific evidence. Results are driven by decreased trust in behavioral sciences, spilling over to authors who were not suspected of fraud.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验发现，向高中生披露科学欺诈丑闻会降低他们对科学的信任，减少他们根据科学证据更新个人信念的意愿，并降低对科学相关书籍的兴趣。但展示问责过程可以部分缓解这些负面影响。
AI.research_question: 科学研究的欺诈行为如何影响公众对科学的信任？了解问责过程是否能缓解这种负面影响？
AI.motivation: 科学欺诈丑闻可能损害公众对科学的信任，但缺乏实证证据。了解这种影响以及问责机制能否缓解负面影响对维护科学公信力至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信任理论和社会心理学，探讨科学不端行为如何通过信任机制影响公众对科学的认知和行为反应。
AI.method: 在巴西高中生中进行信息传递实验，将参与者随机分为三组：欺诈组（仅了解欺诈指控）、问责组（了解调查和惩罚过程）、对照组（不了解欺诈丑闻）。
AI.findings: 1. 了解欺诈丑闻的学生更不愿意根据科学证据更新个人信念；2. 对科学相关书籍兴趣降低；3. 分享科学证据的意愿可能降低；4. 对行为科学的信任下降，并溢出到未被怀疑欺诈的作者；5. 问责过程能部分缓解负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证检验科学欺诈对公众信任的影响机制，揭示了信任溢出效应，为科学社会学和信任理论提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科学机构和媒体提供了处理科学不端事件传播的策略建议，强调透明问责过程的重要性，有助于维护科学公信力。

title: Alignment Capital: A Structural Framework for Synchronising Capital Cycles with Institutional Mission Cycles

detail.title: Alignment Capital: A Structural Framework for Synchronising Capital Cycles with Institutional Mission Cycles

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Institutions fail not primarily because they lack resources, technical expertise, or managerial capability, but because their capital cycles are structurally misaligned with their mission cycles. Drawing on Regenerative Cycle Architecture (RCA) and Perpetual Social Capital (PSC), A motivating example illustrates the issue. Consider a hospital whose imaging equipment requires renewal every four years. Despite competent planning, renewal windows are frequently missed because capital is tied to annual budget cycles and political priorities. The equipment follows a physical mission cycle; the capital follows a fragility cycle. Even with adequate funding overall, timing misalignment produces deterministic capability decay. This stylised dynamic is general across science labs, climate adaptation infrastructure, and civic organisations. We formalise alignment as a two-operator process. The Decoupling Operator (Δ) separates capital from the four universal fragility cycles—financial, political, capability, and civic—which otherwise impose volatility and temporal distortion. The Alignment Operator (Λ) then synchronises capital behaviour with the intrinsic mission cycles of long-lived public-good systems, including asset lifetimes, scientific throughput, climate adaptation windows, and civic continuity cycles. We show that alignment is the necessary and sufficient condition for regenerative institutional dynamics. We demonstrate that Perpetual Social Capital (PSC) is the first realised alignment technology: a capital architecture whose invariants—non-liability, non-extractiveness, multi-cycle regeneration, transparency, decentralised agency, and mission-aligned cadence—satisfy both Δ and Λ. We unify the PSC family of modes—PSC-F (financial), PSC-Cap (capability), PSC-Civ (civic), and PSC-C (political)—within a single alignment framework, showing how each resolves a distinct dominant fragility cycle by aligning capital to the mission horizon of the domain. The paper concludes by establishing Alignment Capital as a new category in institutional economics and public governance, and introduces the Cycle Constitution, a constitutional mechanism for protecting temporal alignment against political, financial, and civic volatility. Alignment Capital thereby provides the architectural foundation for regenerative, long-horizon public-good systems. This paper adopts a conceptual–formal methodology drawing on institutional economics, systems theory, and constitutional political economy. While the argument is theoretical in nature, its operators (Δ and Λ) yield falsifiable predictions and can be empirically tested against real-world PSC deployments in health, science, civic systems, and climate adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文认为机构失败的主要原因是资本周期与使命周期的结构性错配，而非资源或技术不足。通过解耦资本与脆弱性周期，并将资本与使命周期对齐，可以实现机构的再生性。永恒社会资本（PSC）是实现这种对齐的首个技术方案。
AI.research_question: 如何解决机构中资本周期与使命周期的结构性错配问题，以实现机构的再生性？
AI.motivation: 机构失败通常归因于资源、技术或管理能力不足，但论文认为根本原因是资本周期（受财务、政治等脆弱性周期影响）与使命周期（如设备更新、科学产出、气候适应等）的结构性错配，导致即使有充足资金也会出现能力衰退。
AI.theoretical_framework: 再生周期架构（RCA）、永恒社会资本（PSC）、制度经济学、系统理论、宪政政治经济学。提出两个核心操作符：解耦操作符（Δ）和对齐操作符（Λ）。
AI.method: 采用概念-形式化方法，结合制度经济学、系统理论和宪政政治经济学。虽然是理论论证，但提出的操作符（Δ和Λ）可产生可证伪的预测，并可通过现实中的PSC部署进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 1. 对齐是再生性制度动态的必要且充分条件；2. 永恒社会资本（PSC）是实现对齐的首个技术，其特性满足解耦和对齐要求；3. PSC的四种模式分别解决不同的主导脆弱性周期；4. 提出"对齐资本"作为制度经济学和公共治理的新类别。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出资本周期与使命周期错配的理论框架；2. 形式化解耦和对齐操作符；3. 建立对齐资本作为制度经济学新类别；4. 引入"周期宪法"作为保护时间对齐的机制；5. 统一PSC家族模式的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为医院、科学实验室、气候适应基础设施、公民组织等提供解决资本错配的实际方案；2. PSC技术可在健康、科学、公民系统和气候适应等领域部署；3. 为政策制定者提供保护长期公共物品系统的时间对齐机制。

title: Measuring Price Effects of Multilingual Global News with Large Language Models
affiliations: Royal Bank of Canada, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, Royal Bank of Canada, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto, Royal Bank of Canada, University of Toronto and University of Toronto

detail.title: Measuring Price Effects of Multilingual Global News with Large Language Models

declarations.funderStatement: The authors thank RBC Capital Markets for generous funding of the FinHub: Financial Innovation Lab. Ing-Haw Cheng thanks the Social Science and Humanities Research Council of Canada (SSHRC) for generous funding through SSHRC Insight Grant #435-2024-0365. The views expressed in this article are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the Royal Bank of Canada.

detail.abstract: We study how language boundaries affect price discovery, using multilingual large language models to analyze how quickly markets incorporate Bloomberg news across different languages for Japanese and U.S. equities. In Japan, both Japanese and English news predict next-day returns across individual stocks. By studying each sentence in detail, we show that English and Japanese sentences that match on content predict returns, indicating that investors do not efficiently aggregate highly similar news across languages. Unmatched English-only sentences provide additional predictive power while unmatched Japanese-only sentences do not, consistent with investors underweighting information available only in foreign-language coverage. In the U.S., we find similar, attenuated patterns when English serves as the domestic language. Overall, the evidence suggests that language boundaries slow the speed at which markets incorporate news, creating predictable returns for investors who process multilingual information streams.

AI.tldr: 使用多语言大语言模型分析语言边界如何影响价格发现，发现投资者未能有效整合不同语言的高度相似新闻，导致市场信息吸收速度变慢，为处理多语言信息流的投资者创造了可预测的收益机会。
AI.research_question: 语言边界如何影响价格发现？具体而言，投资者是否能够有效整合不同语言的高度相似新闻？
AI.motivation: 在全球金融市场中，新闻以多种语言传播，但投资者可能因语言障碍而无法有效处理所有相关信息。理解语言边界如何影响市场效率对资产定价和投资策略具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场效率理论、信息不对称理论和行为金融学，研究语言作为信息处理障碍如何影响价格发现过程。
AI.method: 使用多语言大语言模型分析彭博新闻在不同语言中的内容，比较日语和英语新闻对日本和美国股票次日收益的预测能力。通过详细分析每个句子，区分匹配内容（不同语言中相同内容）和不匹配内容（仅存在于单一语言）的预测效果。
AI.findings: 1. 在日本市场，日语和英语新闻都能预测个股次日收益；2. 内容匹配的英语和日语句子都能预测收益，表明投资者未能有效整合跨语言的高度相似新闻；3. 不匹配的英语句子提供额外预测能力，而不匹配的日语句子则没有，表明投资者低估了仅在外语报道中可获得的信息；4. 在美国市场，当英语作为母语时，存在类似但较弱的影响模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性地量化了语言边界对价格发现的影响；2. 提供了投资者未能有效整合跨语言相似信息的实证证据；3. 扩展了市场效率理论，将语言作为信息处理的重要障碍因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了利用多语言信息处理能力获取超额收益的策略；2. 为企业跨国信息披露和投资者关系管理提供指导；3. 为监管机构考虑多语言市场信息传播政策提供参考。

title: Designing a Policy Engine for Agentic AI Systems: From Governance Requirements to Runtime Enforcement
affiliations: Fourth Industrial Systems Corporation

detail.title: Designing a Policy Engine for Agentic AI Systems: From Governance Requirements to Runtime Enforcement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper. The study was conducted independently, without external pressure, sponsorship, or contractual obligations from any entity that might benefit from the findings. All interpretations, architectural models, and evaluations reflect the author’s own professional judgments and research contributions. No commercial products or vendors were given preferential treatment, and no undisclosed relationships exist that could reasonably be perceived as affecting the objectivity of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, clinical interventions, personal data collection, or experiments requiring institutional review board (IRB) approval. The research is entirely conceptual, architectural, and systems-engineering oriented, relying solely on technical design, formal modeling, and controlled software evaluation. As such, ethics approval was not required for this work.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any external funding. The work was fully self-supported by the author as part of ongoing independent research in AI governance, agentic systems, and policy-as-code architectures. No grants, contracts, institutional funds, or third-party financial contributions were used in the development of this manuscript.

detail.abstract:
Agentic AI systems—LLM-driven architectures capable of autonomous tool use, decision-making, and multi-step workflows—are rapidly expanding across enterprise, government, and safety-critical domains. While governance frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act provide high-level principles for trustworthy AI, there remains a critical gap between policy requirements and operational enforcement at runtime. This paper introduces a formal architectural model for governing agentic AI systems, emphasizing measurable risk quantification, explicit decision boundaries, and cloud-native enforcement mechanisms.

We propose a governed-action model that classifies all agent behaviors into inference, tool usage, data access, and external actuation. A multi-dimensional risk scoring function—aligned with AI RMF “Map–Measure–Manage–Govern” activities—evaluates actions across semantic, contextual, historical, tool, and model-based features. A deterministic enforcement state machine enables allow, deny, sanitize, or escalate decisions with auditable safety and liveness properties.

We implement a reference architecture using Open Policy Agent (OPA), Envoy filters, Kubernetes admission controls, and an append-only evidence store. Experimental evaluation demonstrates significant reductions in unsafe actions with minimal latency overhead. The paper offers a practical bridge between AI governance principles and real-time technical enforcement, contributing actionable patterns for policymakers, standards bodies, and engineering teams developing next-generation agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于治理自主AI系统的正式架构模型，通过可量化的风险评估、明确的决策边界和云原生执行机制，填补了AI治理政策要求与运行时操作执行之间的关键空白。
AI.research_question: 如何建立有效的技术架构来实现自主AI系统的实时治理，填补AI治理政策要求与运行时操作执行之间的空白？
AI.motivation: 自主AI系统在企业和关键领域快速扩展，现有治理框架（如NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001、欧盟AI法案）提供了高级原则，但在政策要求与运行时操作执行之间存在关键差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于治理行动模型，将代理行为分类为推理、工具使用、数据访问和外部驱动；采用多维风险评分函数，与AI RMF的"映射-测量-管理-治理"活动对齐；建立确定性执行状态机。
AI.method: 提出正式架构模型，实现参考架构（使用Open Policy Agent、Envoy过滤器、Kubernetes准入控制、追加式证据存储），并进行实验评估。
AI.findings: 实验评估显示，该架构能显著减少不安全行为，同时保持最小的延迟开销。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个正式的自主AI系统治理架构模型，包括治理行动分类、多维风险评分函数和确定性执行状态机，为AI治理提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的参考架构实现，使用现有云原生技术栈，为政策制定者、标准机构和工程团队提供了实用的实施模式，填补了AI治理原则与实时技术执行之间的桥梁。

title: Bank Balance Sheet Constraints and Municipal Finance: Evidence from Current Expected Credit Losses
affiliations: and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - School of Hotel and Tourism Management

detail.title: Bank Balance Sheet Constraints and Municipal Finance: Evidence from Current Expected Credit Losses
detail.abstract: This study examines how bank balance sheet constraints-the Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL) standard-affect municipal finance. By mandating lifetime loss provisions, CECL induces banks to reduce municipal bond holdings by 17.4 percent, with capital-constrained banks reducing their holdings more significantly. This contraction raises primary market yields, particularly for long-term and high-uncertainty bonds. Issuers respond by shortening maturities, increasing coupons, and shifting to negotiated sales, while curtailing debt issuance and expenditures, highlighting real spillovers to public finance.

AI.tldr: CECL会计准则通过要求银行计提全生命周期损失准备，导致银行减少市政债券持有量17.4%，资本约束银行减少更多。这推高了初级市场收益率，特别是长期和高不确定性债券。发行方通过缩短期限、提高票息、转向协商销售来应对，同时减少债务发行和支出，对公共财政产生实际溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 银行资产负债表约束（特别是CECL会计准则）如何影响市政融资？
AI.motivation: CECL会计准则要求银行对预期信用损失计提全生命周期准备，这可能影响银行对市政债券的投资行为，进而对市政融资产生重要影响，但目前相关研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行资产负债表约束理论、会计准则对投资行为的影响理论、市政融资理论，分析CECL如何通过资本约束机制影响银行投资决策和市政融资市场。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，利用CECL实施前后的数据，分析银行市政债券持有量的变化、市场收益率变化、发行方行为调整等。
AI.findings: 1. CECL导致银行减少市政债券持有量17.4%；2. 资本约束银行减少更多；3. 推高初级市场收益率，特别是长期和高不确定性债券；4. 发行方缩短期限、提高票息、转向协商销售；5. 减少债务发行和支出。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了会计准则对金融市场影响的理论；2. 深化了银行资产负债表约束对市政融资影响机制的理解；3. 提供了会计准则与公共财政关联的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构评估CECL政策效果提供依据；2. 帮助市政发行方理解融资环境变化并调整策略；3. 为银行管理CECL带来的投资约束提供参考；4. 对公共财政政策制定有重要启示。

title: Do Good Neighbors Lead to Lower Greenhouse Gas Emissions Across Countries? A Spatial Analysis
affiliations: Faculty of Business Administration and Accountancy, Khon Kaen University, Xiamen University Malaysia Campus and Xiamen University Malaysia Campus

detail.title: Do Good Neighbors Lead to Lower Greenhouse Gas Emissions Across Countries? A Spatial Analysis
detail.abstract: This study examines how spatial interdependence helps reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions across 68 countries from 1990 to 2023. The researchers hypothesized that a country's environmental policies and GHG emissions are influenced by its neighbors, and their findings support this. The study used spatial fixed effects, spatial pooled, and spatial random effects models to analyze the effects of several variables on GHG emissions. The results show that a neighbor's high GHG emissions can actually help a country lower its own. Furthermore, the study found that energy consumption increases emissions, whereas innovation (patents), renewable energy, and trade openness all decrease them. However, the study found no evidence to support the Environmental Kuznets Curve or the Pollution Haven Hypothesis. The findings emphasize the importance of regional cooperation and the diffusion of public policies and knowledge to combat climate change, aligning with the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goal 13. The study highlights the vital role of coordination between countries in addressing global warming.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过空间计量模型分析68个国家1990-2023年的数据，发现邻国的高温室气体排放反而有助于本国减排，能源消费增加排放，而创新、可再生能源和贸易开放减少排放，不支持环境库兹涅茨曲线和污染避难所假说。
AI.research_question: 空间相互依存如何影响68个国家1990-2023年间的温室气体排放？
AI.motivation: 应对气候变化需要理解国家间的相互影响，特别是邻国环境政策和排放行为的空间溢出效应，这对实现联合国可持续发展目标13（气候行动）至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间相互依存理论、环境政策扩散理论、环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）、污染避难所假说（PHH）
AI.method: 使用空间固定效应、空间混合和空间随机效应模型分析68个国家1990-2023年的面板数据，考察多个变量对温室气体排放的影响。
AI.findings: 1）邻国高排放反而有助于本国减排（空间溢出效应）；2）能源消费增加排放；3）创新（专利）、可再生能源和贸易开放减少排放；4）不支持环境库兹涅茨曲线和污染避难所假说。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）验证了空间相互依存在环境治理中的重要作用；2）挑战了传统环境库兹涅茨曲线和污染避难所假说；3）为环境政策扩散理论提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）强调区域合作对减排的重要性；2）建议加强创新、可再生能源发展和贸易开放；3）为政策制定者提供基于空间相互依存的减排策略；4）支持联合国可持续发展目标13的实现。

title: Types in Job Search Effort
affiliations: Utrecht University - School of Economics and Utrecht University

detail.title: Types in Job Search Effort

declarations.funderStatement: We thank Instituut Gak for financial support.

detail.abstract: Public employment services are increasingly using online job platforms to help unemployed job seekers find jobs. This paper shows that these policies implicitly target those who benefit the most from them. The reason is that search intensity on online job platforms is characterized by "types": more-educated job seekers with better language and digital skills use the online job platform more intensively throughout their unemployment spell. Moreover, these high-types in online search effort are also more likely to take-up in-person job search assistance and, if they do, are more responsive to it. Using data from a public employment service, the paper provides causal evidence for the existence of types and presents a job search model to rationalize its findings.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在线求职平台的使用存在"类型"差异：高学历、语言和数字技能更好的求职者更频繁地使用平台，且这些"高类型"求职者也更可能接受线下求职帮助并对其反应更积极，导致就业服务政策实际上更有利于那些最能从中受益的人群。
AI.research_question: 在线求职平台的使用模式是否存在系统性差异？这些差异如何影响公共就业服务政策的实际效果和受益群体？
AI.motivation: 公共就业服务越来越多地使用在线求职平台帮助失业者找工作，但需要了解这些政策是否公平有效地惠及所有求职者，还是主要服务于特定群体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 求职搜索理论，特别是关于搜索强度和类型的理论；数字技能差异理论；人力资本理论。
AI.method: 使用公共就业服务的数据进行因果分析，并构建求职搜索模型来合理化研究发现。
AI.findings: 在线求职平台的使用存在明显的"类型"差异：高学历、语言和数字技能更好的求职者在整个失业期间更频繁地使用平台；这些"高类型"求职者更可能接受线下求职帮助，且对其反应更积极。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在线求职搜索中的"类型"概念，扩展了传统求职搜索理论；揭示了数字技能差异如何影响就业服务政策的实际效果；为理解就业服务政策的隐性目标提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者认识到在线就业服务可能存在的公平性问题；建议设计更包容的就业服务方案，减少数字鸿沟的影响；为公共就业服务的优化提供实证依据。

title: Paying for Nature: Aligning Ecosystem Multifunctionality, Service Payments, and Rural Policy in Mountain Areas
affiliations: , , , ,  and

detail.title: Paying for Nature: Aligning Ecosystem Multifunctionality, Service Payments, and Rural Policy in Mountain Areas
detail.abstract: Mountain ecosystems provide essential ecological functions but are often overlooked in environmental planning. In northern Portugal, we assessed ecosystem services across six landscape types using a locally adapted participatory protocol with 17 robust indicators. Here we show that broadleaf forests scored highest in overall ecosystem service provision, particularly for regulation and support functions, while agricultural and urban areas performed lowest, especially in cultural services. Spatial analysis revealed that most areas achieved adequate levels for regulation (96%) and support (85%) services, but 93% of the region showed critical levels for cultural services. The dominance of shrublands and forested areas in the landscape supports conservation efforts, but low cultural service values highlight gaps in community engagement and accessibility. These findings can guide land management and regional policy to balance ecological function with human well-being in mountain regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了葡萄牙北部山区六种景观类型的生态系统服务，发现阔叶林在整体生态系统服务提供方面得分最高，而农业和城市区域表现最差。空间分析显示，96%的区域调节服务和85%的区域支持服务达到充足水平，但93%的区域文化服务处于临界水平。
AI.research_question: 葡萄牙北部山区不同景观类型如何提供生态系统服务？哪些景观类型在生态系统服务提供方面表现最佳/最差？
AI.motivation: 山区生态系统提供重要的生态功能，但在环境规划中常常被忽视。需要了解不同景观类型对生态系统服务的贡献，以指导土地管理和区域政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统服务框架（调节服务、支持服务、文化服务）；景观生态学；参与式评估方法
AI.method: 采用本地适应的参与式协议，使用17个稳健指标，评估六种景观类型的生态系统服务；进行空间分析
AI.findings: 1. 阔叶林在整体生态系统服务提供方面得分最高，特别是在调节和支持功能方面；2. 农业和城市区域表现最差，特别是在文化服务方面；3. 96%的区域调节服务达到充足水平，85%的区域支持服务达到充足水平；4. 93%的区域文化服务处于临界水平；5. 灌木林和森林区域在景观中占主导地位支持保护工作
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为山区生态系统服务评估提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了不同景观类型在生态系统服务提供方面的差异；3. 强调了文化服务在山区生态系统中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为土地管理和区域政策提供指导；2. 帮助平衡生态功能与人类福祉；3. 识别社区参与和可及性方面的差距；4. 支持山区保护工作

title: Measuring and Decomposing Diversity: Bridging Micro with Macro
affiliations: University of Tokyo - Graduate School of Frontier Sciences

detail.title: Measuring and Decomposing Diversity: Bridging Micro with Macro

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by a grant-in-aid from Zengin Foundation for Studies on Economics and Finance.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a conceptual framework to quantify heterogeneity in unobservable agent characteristics (e.g. preferences) using micro-level data. Drawing inspiration from biodiversity research, we adapt a hierarchical structure of diversity-encompassing within-agent diversification, cross-agent heterogeneity, and macro-level diversity. This framework allows us to empirically assess the macroeconomic implications of micro-level heterogeneity. In contrast to standard approaches in economics, which typically measure diversity in directly observable variables without structural hierarchy, our method offers a more nuanced and systematic way to capture and analyse hidden forms of diversity in the economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个量化不可观测代理人特征异质性的概念框架，借鉴生物多样性研究的分层结构，包含个体内多样化、个体间异质性和宏观多样性三个层次，为分析微观异质性的宏观经济影响提供了系统方法。
AI.research_question: 如何量化不可观测的代理人特征（如偏好）的异质性，并评估这种微观异质性对宏观经济的影响？
AI.motivation: 经济学中通常只测量可直接观测变量的多样性，缺乏对不可观测特征异质性的系统分析框架，而微观层面的隐藏异质性可能对宏观经济产生重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴生物多样性研究的分层多样性框架，构建包含三个层次的概念结构：1) 个体内多样化，2) 个体间异质性，3) 宏观层面多样性。
AI.method: 概念框架构建方法，基于微观层面数据，采用分层结构量化不可观测特征的异质性，与传统经济学方法形成对比。
AI.findings: 提出了一个能够更细致、系统地捕捉和分析经济中隐藏多样性形式的方法框架，相比标准经济学方法更具层次性和系统性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将生物多样性概念引入经济学异质性分析；2) 建立了分层异质性量化框架；3) 拓展了微观-宏观联系的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了分析微观异质性宏观经济影响的工具；2) 帮助企业更好理解消费者偏好多样性；3) 为实证研究提供了新的分析框架。

title: Fragmented Data-Driven Predictive Control: Towards smaller datasets
affiliations: Alma Mater Studiorum University of Bologna, Università di Bologna,  and

detail.title: Fragmented Data-Driven Predictive Control: Towards smaller datasets
detail.abstract: Data-driven control, exemplified by DeePC, enables controller synthesis directlyfrom data but remains limited when dealing with nonlinear or stochastic dynamics under scarcedatasets. Existing extensions such as S-DeePC mitigate these issues via problem decomposition,yet rely on surrogate formulations that restrict horizon flexibility. This paper presents F-DeePC,a fragmented DeePC approach that explicitly builds the constraint matrices and partitions theprediction horizon into independently adjustable segments. This direct formulation enhancesbothflexibilityandnumericaleﬃciency,yieldingimprovedtrackingperformanceespeciallywhendata is limited or the system features nonlinearities.

AI.tldr: F-DeePC是一种分段数据驱动预测控制方法，通过显式构建约束矩阵并将预测时域划分为独立可调段，提高了非线性或随机系统在数据稀缺情况下的控制灵活性和数值效率。
AI.research_question: 如何改进数据驱动控制方法（如DeePC），使其在处理非线性或随机动态系统且数据稀缺时，既保持灵活性又提高数值效率？
AI.motivation: 传统DeePC方法在处理非线性或随机动态系统且数据稀缺时存在局限，现有扩展方法（如S-DeePC）通过问题分解缓解这些问题，但依赖代理公式限制了时域灵活性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据驱动控制理论，特别是基于数据的预测控制（DeePC），以及其扩展方法如S-DeePC的问题分解框架。
AI.method: 提出F-DeePC方法：1）显式构建约束矩阵；2）将预测时域划分为独立可调段；3）直接公式化而非代理公式。
AI.findings: F-DeePC相比现有方法提高了灵活性和数值效率，在数据有限或系统具有非线性特性时，能显著改善跟踪性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了分段数据驱动预测控制的理论框架；2）建立了显式约束矩阵构建方法；3）发展了预测时域分段独立调节的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为非线性或随机系统在数据稀缺条件下的控制提供了更有效的解决方案；2）提高了控制器的数值计算效率；3）增强了实际工程应用中的跟踪性能。

title: Who Adopts and Where? Spatial Diffusion of Supplier-Obligation and Market-Led Retrofits in Scotland
affiliations: Heriot-Watt University and University of Aberdeen - Business School

detail.title: Who Adopts and Where? Spatial Diffusion of Supplier-Obligation and Market-Led Retrofits in Scotland
detail.abstract: Decarbonising Scotland's housing stock depends on accelerating retrofit, yet uptake remains uneven across programmes and places. This study provides spatial econometric analysis of Scottish retrofit diffusion by scheme and technology. It combines 2012-2024 Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) records with small-area housing and socioeconomic data. From EPC sequences we infer retrofit events for heat pumps (HP), solar photovoltaics (PV), and wall insulation (WI), attributed to either the supplier-obligation scheme (ECO) or market-led incentives (FiT, RHI, Green Deal) at small localities (Data Zone). Spatial dependence is strong but regime and technology dependent. Our result show that EPC data can underpin fine-grained monitoring of retrofit diffusion and equity outcomes. Market-led programmes generate strong peer and installer spillovers for visible technologies such as PV, but adoption remains concentrated among higher-value, credit-accessible households. ECO achieves deeper penetration into deprived, low-value, and off-gas homes, though area batching can cause "shadowing" across adjacent communities. Policy should sustain ECO-style obligations while improving regional coordination and complement market-led diffusion with affordable finance and installer network seeding, ensuring that retrofit benefits extend to all Scottish households.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过空间计量分析发现，苏格兰住房改造的推广在不同项目和地区存在差异。市场主导项目（如光伏）在富裕社区有强邻里效应，而供应商义务计划（ECO）能更好地渗透到贫困社区，但存在区域"阴影效应"。政策建议应结合两种模式并加强区域协调。
AI.research_question: 苏格兰住房改造（热泵、光伏、墙体保温）在不同政策项目（ECO vs 市场激励）下的空间扩散模式如何？这些模式如何影响改造的公平性？
AI.motivation: 苏格兰住房脱碳需要加速改造，但现有项目的推广在不同地区和项目间存在不均衡。需要理解改造技术在不同政策机制下的空间扩散模式，以评估政策效果和公平性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间计量经济学、技术扩散理论、邻里效应理论、政策评估框架
AI.method: 空间计量分析，结合2012-2024年能源绩效证书（EPC）数据与小型区域住房和社会经济数据，识别热泵、光伏和墙体保温的改造事件，并归因于不同政策项目（ECO或市场激励）。
AI.findings: 1. 空间依赖性很强但受政策和技术影响；2. 市场主导项目（光伏）在富裕社区产生强邻里效应和安装商溢出效应；3. ECO项目能更好地渗透到贫困、低价值和离网燃气家庭；4. 区域批处理可能导致相邻社区的"阴影效应"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证EPC数据可用于精细监测改造扩散；2. 揭示不同政策机制下技术扩散的空间模式差异；3. 提出政策项目与社区特征的匹配理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策应维持ECO式义务计划；2. 改进区域协调避免"阴影效应"；3. 市场主导扩散需配合可负担融资和安装商网络建设；4. 确保改造效益惠及所有苏格兰家庭。

title: Fair and Open Markets for Virtual Power Plants
affiliations: , Open Markets Institute,  and Open Markets Institute

detail.title: Fair and Open Markets for Virtual Power Plants
detail.abstract:
Electricity rates are increasing by 10% or more annually in many parts of the country. Millions struggle to pay their power bills and face regular threats of service disconnection. Investor-owned utilities are aggressive in seeking rate increases from their regulators, which are often granted, and the data centers of tech companies are fueling demand and threatening grid stability. Between this rapidly growing demand and power companies’ struggles to build new generation and transmission infrastructure, customers are facing increased risks of outages and area-wide blackouts.

 

Delivering reliable electricity at low costs will require a comprehensive approach that uses both expansion of supply and demand-side measures. “Virtual power plants” (VPPs), internet-connected devices controlled by utilities or third-party providers, can play an important role in shifting demand away from peak hours and reducing the strain on grid capacity. For example, VPPs can turn smart home devices, electric vehicle (EV) chargers, and Wi-Fi-connected appliances on and off automatically to modify the electrical load on the power grid.

 

Investor-owned utilities, however, are impeding the growth of VPPs through assorted illicit means. VPPs can only succeed if given a fair opportunity to compete against traditional utility investments in profitable peaking power plants and wires and poles. To preserve their lucrative supply-first business model, utilities have erected numerous roadblocks to VPPs, such as petitioning state regulators to prohibit independent VPPs and imposing a thicket of rules that raise their costs. They have also begun competing directly against independent VPPs by offering their own VPP-like services to appease regulators bullish on the potential of VPPs to lower customers’ electricity bills and more efficiently manage demand, all the while casting independent VPPs as unreliable.

 

In this paper, we examine utilities’ unfair conduct against independent VPPs and identify several antitrust pathways that can offer redress to VPPs and consumers. We believe that both federal, state, and private antitrust enforcers can make meaningful progress to address the restrictive and unfair practices of utilities. The antitrust laws are a powerful tool for ensuring open and vibrant VPP markets in which independent providers can compete and thrive, and customers have a wide range of choices for efficiently managing their power consumption.

 

Specifically, we detail how public and private enforcers can initiate antitrust claims challenging utilities’ tying arrangements, exclusive deals, and refusals to deal. We also examine how the Federal Trade Commission can use its Section 5 authority to address the identified practices. Last, we provide an overview of how enforcers can overcome the State Action Doctrine and the Filed Rate Doctrine, which can be obstacles to antitrust claims in regulated industries like electricity.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了投资者所有的公用事业公司如何通过反竞争手段阻碍虚拟电厂（VPP）的发展，并探讨了反垄断法如何为VPP和消费者提供救济途径。
AI.research_question: 投资者所有的公用事业公司如何通过不公平行为阻碍独立虚拟电厂（VPP）的发展？反垄断法如何为VPP和消费者提供救济？
AI.motivation: 电力费率在许多地区每年上涨10%以上，数百万人难以支付电费并面临服务中断威胁。数据中心需求增长威胁电网稳定，而公用事业公司难以建设新基础设施，导致停电风险增加。虚拟电厂（VPP）作为需求侧管理工具可以缓解电网压力，但投资者所有的公用事业公司通过反竞争手段阻碍其发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断法理论，包括捆绑安排、独家交易、拒绝交易等反竞争行为理论；联邦贸易委员会第5条权力理论；国家行为原则和已申报费率原则在受监管行业的适用理论。
AI.method: 法律分析和政策分析，通过识别公用事业公司的反竞争行为，分析现有反垄断法律框架下的救济途径，包括联邦、州和私人反垄断执法。
AI.findings: 公用事业公司通过多种不公平手段阻碍VPP发展：游说州监管机构禁止独立VPP；制定复杂规则增加VPP成本；提供自己的VPP服务同时诋毁独立VPP的可靠性。这些行为限制了市场竞争，阻碍了VPP降低电费和管理需求的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将反垄断法理论应用于受监管的电力行业，特别是VPP这一新兴市场；探讨了国家行为原则和已申报费率原则在VPP竞争环境中的适用性；提出了反垄断法如何确保VPP市场开放和竞争的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共和私人反垄断执法者提供了具体的执法路径：挑战公用事业公司的捆绑安排、独家交易和拒绝交易行为；利用联邦贸易委员会第5条权力；克服国家行为原则和已申报费率原则的障碍。为政策制定者、监管机构和VPP提供商提供了应对公用事业公司反竞争行为的实用策略。

title: FAF: A Feature-Adaptive Framework for Few-Shot Time Series Forecasting
affiliations: Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University and Zhengzhou University

detail.title: FAF: A Feature-Adaptive Framework for Few-Shot Time Series Forecasting
detail.abstract: Few-shot time series forecasting tasks are commonly encountered in cold-start scenarios. However, traditional time series forecasting methods are prone to overfitting under limited historical data, while meta-learning approaches often overlook task-specific features and thereby introduce feature conflict, resulting in suboptimal predictive performance. For the aforementioned challenges, we propose the Feature-Adaptive Framework for Few-Shot Time Series Forecasting (FAF), which consists of the Generalized Knowledge Module (GKM), the Task-Specific Module (TSM), and the Rank Module (RM). To more effectively extract generalization and task-specific features, FAF leverages the GKM to learn global trends shared across diverse tasks and  the TSM captures heterogeneous local dynamics through multiple functional regions, each specializing in task-specific patterns from individual tasks. As for the RM, it dynamically selects the most relevant functional region within the TSM based on input sequence features; the selected region's output is then combined with the generalized knowledge learned by the GKM to produce accurate forecasts. By effectively utilizing generalization and task-specific features, FAF achieves robust and personalized forecasting even when historical observations are sparse. Experimental results on five diverse real-world datasets in few-shot forecasting settings demonstrate that FAF consistently outperforms baselines spanning three major categories of time-series methods. In particular, on the CO2 emissions dataset, FAF achieves a 41.81% improvement over the strongest baseline, iTransformer.

AI.tldr: FAF是一个用于少样本时间序列预测的特征自适应框架，通过结合广义知识模块、任务特定模块和排序模块，有效利用泛化特征和任务特定特征，在历史数据稀疏的情况下实现鲁棒且个性化的预测。
AI.research_question: 如何在少样本时间序列预测场景中，有效结合泛化知识和任务特定特征，避免过拟合并解决特征冲突问题？
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列预测方法在有限历史数据下容易过拟合，而元学习方法往往忽视任务特定特征并引入特征冲突，导致预测性能不佳。冷启动场景下的少样本预测需求日益增长，需要新的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特征自适应框架（FAF），包含广义知识模块（GKM）、任务特定模块（TSM）和排序模块（RM）。GKM学习跨任务的全局趋势，TSM通过多个功能区域捕获异质局部动态，RM动态选择最相关的功能区域。
AI.method: 提出FAF框架：GKM提取跨任务共享的泛化特征；TSM通过多个功能区域专门学习各任务的特定模式；RM基于输入序列特征动态选择TSM中最相关的功能区域；将选定区域的输出与GKM的泛化知识结合进行预测。
AI.findings: 在五个不同的真实世界数据集上的少样本预测实验中，FAF在三个主要类别的时间序列方法基线中表现最佳。特别是在CO2排放数据集上，FAF比最强基线iTransformer提高了41.81%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出特征自适应框架，有效结合泛化知识和任务特定特征；2. 通过功能区域划分解决特征冲突问题；3. 动态选择机制实现个性化预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为冷启动场景下的少样本时间序列预测提供有效解决方案；2. 在多个真实数据集上显著优于现有方法；3. 框架具有鲁棒性和适应性，适用于稀疏历史数据的预测任务。

title: Capturing Killer Acquisitions in Digital Markets under the European Union Merger Control Rules
affiliations: Lund University

detail.title: Capturing Killer Acquisitions in Digital Markets under the European Union Merger Control Rules
detail.abstract: A few years ago, a novel development identified as "Killer Acquisitions" surfaced within the domain of EU Merger Control: incumbent undertakings were under suspicion of acquiring promising startups with the intent of eliminating prospective market competitors. Big Tech companies in digital markets are among the usual suspects in this kind of transaction. While this strategy can surely serve to cement incumbent platforms' dominant position in the digital markets, the issue resides in the impracticability of capturing these acquisitions within the framework of EU Merger Control regulations due to the impossibility of complying with the stipulated threshold requirements which respectively brought about the enhancement of the European Commission's toolbox. This paper will display the options to carry out those amendments and what options were opted for. It will address whether the proposed methodologies for addressing killer acquisitions represent viable solutions to the issue. This paper aims to clarify the challenges faced by digital platforms engaged in business operations and strategic merger and acquisition planning within the European Union. This work's focus is also on elucidating the challenges that digital platforms engaged in business operations and mergers and acquisitions within the EU may confront.

AI.tldr: 欧盟并购控制中的"杀手收购"现象：大型科技公司收购有潜力的初创企业以消除潜在竞争对手，但由于无法满足并购审查门槛要求，现行欧盟并购控制法规难以监管此类交易。本文探讨了应对此问题的修正方案及其可行性。
AI.research_question: 欧盟并购控制法规如何有效应对数字市场中大型科技公司实施的"杀手收购"行为？
AI.motivation: 数字市场中大型科技公司通过收购有潜力的初创企业来消除潜在竞争对手，巩固其市场主导地位，但由于无法满足现行欧盟并购控制法规的门槛要求，这些"杀手收购"难以被有效监管，需要探索解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟并购控制法规、竞争法理论、数字市场竞争动态、平台经济学、反垄断理论
AI.method: 规范性法律分析、政策评估、比较法分析、案例研究
AI.findings: 欧盟并购控制法规在应对"杀手收购"方面存在监管漏洞，主要问题在于门槛要求无法覆盖此类交易；欧盟委员会已提出工具箱增强方案，但具体修正方案的可行性和有效性需要进一步评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对数字市场中"杀手收购"现象的理论理解，拓展欧盟并购控制法规在数字竞争环境下的适用性理论，为竞争法理论在平台经济中的应用提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供应对"杀手收购"的具体修正方案建议，帮助数字平台企业了解欧盟并购控制法规的变化趋势，为竞争执法机构提供监管工具改进的实践指导。

title: Prevalence of Gastrointestinal Parasites in Broilers in Maseru District, Lesotho
affiliations: National University of Lesotho and National University of Lesotho

detail.title: Prevalence of Gastrointestinal Parasites in Broilers in Maseru District, Lesotho

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors have declared that no competing interests exist.

declarations.funderStatement: All authors would like to acknowledge the Department of Animal Science of the National University of Lesotho for funding this research.

detail.abstract: Gastrointestinal parasites remain a significant constraint in poultry production, particularly in resource-limited settings. This study assessed the prevalence and comparative incidence of gastrointestinal parasites in broilers reared under urban and semi-urban conditions in Maseru District, Lesotho. A total of 100 fecal samples were collected from broilers across six villages and examined using the McMaster flotation technique. Identified parasites included Eimeria spp. (coccidia), nematodes (Heterakis gallinarum, Ascaridia galli), and cestodes (Raillietina spp). Mixed infestations were also recorded, with coccidia-nematode combinations being most common. The prevalence of gastrointestinal parasites was higher in semi-urban areas (mean FEC = 1019.8) than in urban areas (mean FEC = 299.6).
