AI.tldr: 本研究评估了莱索托马塞鲁地区城市和半城市条件下肉鸡胃肠道寄生虫的流行率和比较发病率，发现半城市地区寄生虫感染率显著高于城市地区，球虫感染在不同生态区存在显著差异，年龄是重要影响因素。
AI.research_question: 莱索托马塞鲁地区城市和半城市条件下肉鸡胃肠道寄生虫的流行率和比较发病率如何？不同生态区和年龄对寄生虫感染有何影响？
AI.motivation: 胃肠道寄生虫是家禽生产的重要制约因素，特别是在资源有限的环境中。了解不同饲养条件下寄生虫的流行情况对于制定有效的控制策略至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于寄生虫流行病学理论，研究不同生态环境（城市vs半城市）和宿主因素（年龄）对寄生虫感染的影响。
AI.method: 从六个村庄收集100份肉鸡粪便样本，使用麦克马斯特浮选技术进行寄生虫检测和计数。
AI.findings: 1. 鉴定出艾美球虫（球虫）、线虫（鸡异刺线虫、鸡蛔虫）和绦虫（赖利绦虫）；2. 混合感染常见，以球虫-线虫组合为主；3. 半城市地区寄生虫感染率（平均FEC=1019.8）显著高于城市地区（平均FEC=299.6）；4. 球虫感染在不同生态区存在显著差异（P<0.05）；5. 年龄是显著影响因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为家禽寄生虫流行病学提供了实证数据，验证了生态环境和宿主因素对寄生虫感染的影响理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为莱索托地区家禽寄生虫控制提供科学依据；2. 强调半城市地区需要更强的寄生虫管理措施；3. 为不同年龄阶段的预防策略提供指导。

title: Implementation of the EU Damages Directive in Central and Eastern European Countries. Latvian Report
affiliations: Riga Graduate School of Law and Riga Graduate School of Law

detail.title: Implementation of the EU Damages Directive in Central and Eastern European Countries. Latvian Report
detail.abstract: As at the date of this publication, Latvia has only implemented the provisions of Article 17(2) of the Directive. Even though the transposition was due by 27 December 2016, the rest of the provisions of the Directive remains not transposed into the Latvian legal system. Since the process of transposition of the Directive is still ongoing, it is premature to assess the impact of the Directive. Some of the issues highlighted in this report may get resolved during the adoption process as numerous stakeholders will voice their concerns while it is not an unlikely scenario that a substantial number of others will remain without a specific clarification leaving this discretion to the courts. Thus, despite that one can assume that the Directive will be implemented in full, the challenge of litigating competition cases in Latvian courts will continue.

AI.tldr: 拉脱维亚仅部分实施了欧盟指令第17(2)条，其余条款尚未转化，指令影响评估为时过早，竞争案件诉讼挑战将持续存在
AI.research_question: 欧盟指令在拉脱维亚的转化实施现状如何？其对拉脱维亚竞争法诉讼实践将产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 拉脱维亚作为欧盟成员国，有义务将欧盟指令转化为国内法，但实施进展缓慢且不完整，需要分析当前状况及其对司法实践的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟法转化理论、指令实施理论、竞争法协调理论、司法裁量权理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、实施现状描述、利益相关者参与分析、司法实践预测
AI.findings: 1. 拉脱维亚仅实施了指令第17(2)条，其余条款尚未转化；2. 转化进程仍在进行中，影响评估为时过早；3. 部分问题可能在采纳过程中解决，但许多问题将留待法院裁量；4. 即使指令完全实施，竞争案件诉讼挑战仍将持续
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了欧盟指令转化过程中的现实挑战；2. 分析了成员国实施延迟对法律协调的影响；3. 探讨了司法裁量在指令实施中的补充作用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为拉脱维亚立法者提供实施建议；2. 为竞争法律师提供诉讼策略参考；3. 为欧盟机构监督成员国实施提供案例；4. 为企业了解拉脱维亚竞争法环境提供指导

title: A Simple Cross-Country Analysis of Total Factor Productivity with a Hidden Markov Model Application
affiliations: William & Mary and The Kinkaid School

detail.title: A Simple Cross-Country Analysis of Total Factor Productivity with a Hidden Markov Model Application
detail.abstract: We construct total factor productivity (TFP) series for 118 countries from 1980 to 2019 using a Cobb-Douglas production function and apply a standard growth-accounting framework to describe how movements in output relate to capital, labor, and TFP. Because TFP is defined residually, our analysis is descriptive. Across countries, the accounting decompositions indicate that year-to-year variation in real GDP growth is numerically closely aligned with movements in the residual component, while capital growth contributes additional explanatory power. Capital levels alone play a limited role in summarizing short-run output fluctuations. To complement these results, we use a simple two-state, left-to-right Hidden Markov Model (HMM) as a descriptive device to summarize changes in the statistical behavior of capital growth and TFP growth series. The inferred break dates exhibit broad regional clustering and, in many countries, occur within a similar time window for capital and TFP. These patterns should be interpreted cautiously, as they reflect model assumptions rather than identified structural shifts. Overall, the paper provides a comparative, accounting-based portrait of output, capital accumulation, and residual efficiency dynamics across a large set of economies, and highlights avenues for future work incorporating richer factor measures and more structurally grounded methods.

AI.tldr: 本文使用柯布-道格拉斯生产函数为118个国家构建了1980-2019年的全要素生产率(TFP)序列，通过增长核算框架分析产出与资本、劳动力和TFP的关系。研究发现短期GDP波动主要与TFP变动相关，资本增长提供额外解释力，而资本水平本身对短期产出波动的解释作用有限。作者还使用隐马尔可夫模型识别资本增长和TFP增长的统计行为变化。
AI.research_question: 在118个国家中，产出波动如何与资本、劳动力和全要素生产率(TFP)相关？资本增长和TFP增长的统计行为变化模式是什么？
AI.motivation: 为了提供基于核算的比较性视角，描述大量经济体中产出、资本积累和剩余效率动态的关系，为未来研究更丰富的要素衡量和更具结构基础的方法奠定基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 柯布-道格拉斯生产函数和标准增长核算框架，将产出分解为资本、劳动力和全要素生产率(TFP)的贡献。
AI.method: 1. 使用柯布-道格拉斯生产函数为118个国家构建1980-2019年的TFP序列；2. 应用标准增长核算框架分析产出与各要素的关系；3. 使用简单的两状态、从左到右隐马尔可夫模型(HMM)描述资本增长和TFP增长序列的统计行为变化。
AI.findings: 1. 各国实际GDP增长的年度变化在数值上与剩余成分(TFP)变动密切相关；2. 资本增长提供额外的解释力；3. 资本水平本身在总结短期产出波动方面作用有限；4. HMM识别的断点日期显示出广泛的区域聚类特征；5. 在许多国家，资本和TFP的断点发生在相似的时间窗口内。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于核算的跨国比较分析框架，强调了TFP在解释短期产出波动中的主导作用，为理解不同经济体增长动态提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解各国经济增长驱动因素的实证依据，特别是TFP在短期波动中的重要性，以及资本增长和TFP变化的同步性模式，有助于制定更有效的经济增长政策。

title: What’s the Price of Monotonicity? A Multi‑Dataset Benchmark of Monotone‑Constrained Gradient Boosting for Credit PD

detail.title: What’s the Price of Monotonicity? A Multi‑Dataset Benchmark of Monotone‑Constrained Gradient Boosting for Credit PD
detail.abstract: Financial institutions face a trade-off between predictive accuracy and interpretability when deploying machine learning models for credit risk. Monotonicity constraints align model behavior with domain knowledge, but their performance cost – the “price of monotonicity” – is not well quantified. This paper benchmarks monotone-constrained versus unconstrained gradient boosting for credit probability of default across five public datasets and three libraries. We define the Price of Monotonicity (PoM) as the relative change in standard performance metrics when moving from unconstrained to constrained models, estimated via paired comparisons with bootstrap uncertainty. PoM in AUC ranges from essentially zero to about 2.9%: constraints are almost costless on large datasets (typically <0.2%, often indistinguishable from zero) and most costly on smaller datasets with extensive constraint coverage (around 2–3%). Thus, appropriately specified monotonicity constraints can often deliver interpretability with small accuracy losses, particularly in large-scale credit portfolios.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了在信用风险机器学习模型中添加单调性约束的"单调性代价"，通过五个公开数据集和三个梯度提升库的基准测试发现，在大型数据集上单调性约束几乎无成本（<0.2%），而在小型数据集上代价最高（约2-3%）。
AI.research_question: 在信用风险预测中，单调性约束对机器学习模型预测性能的具体代价是多少？
AI.motivation: 金融机构在部署信用风险机器学习模型时面临预测准确性与可解释性之间的权衡。单调性约束能确保模型行为符合领域知识，但其性能代价尚未得到充分量化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 单调性约束理论、梯度提升模型、信用风险预测模型、模型可解释性与准确性权衡框架
AI.method: 使用五个公开数据集和三个梯度提升库，比较有约束和无约束模型的性能。定义"单调性代价"为从无约束模型转向有约束模型时标准性能指标的相对变化，通过配对比较和自助法估计不确定性。
AI.findings: 单调性代价在AUC指标上从几乎为零到约2.9%不等：在大型数据集上约束几乎无成本（通常<0.2%，通常与零无显著差异），而在约束覆盖广泛的小型数据集上代价最高（约2-3%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化了信用风险模型中单调性约束的性能代价；2. 提出了"单调性代价"的正式定义和测量方法；3. 建立了数据集规模与约束代价之间的理论关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融机构提供了决策依据：在大型信用组合中可放心使用单调性约束；2. 提供了具体的代价量化指标，帮助权衡可解释性与准确性；3. 指导了不同规模数据集上约束策略的选择。

title: W.H. Hutt’s Constitutional Warnings and the Comparative Political Economy of Majoritarian Transitions: Rhodesia, South Africa, and the Vindication of Classical Liberal Caution
affiliations: Liberty University

detail.title: W.H. Hutt’s Constitutional Warnings and the Comparative Political Economy of Majoritarian Transitions: Rhodesia, South Africa, and the Vindication of Classical Liberal Caution
detail.abstract: This paper integrates a defense of W.H. Hutt against accusations of defending apartheid with an empirical comparative analysis of two critical transitions in Southern Africa: Rhodesia's transformation into Zimbabwe (1980) and South Africa's transition from apartheid (1994). The paper argues that Hutt's warnings about the dangers of "deplorable reactions" and his advocacy for constitutional safeguards in majoritarian transitions were vindicated by Zimbabwe's post-1980 economic and social collapse and partially vindicated by South Africa's persistent structural inequality and service delivery crisis despite democratic reforms. Rather than defending apartheid, Hutt offered a prescient constitutional political economy of democratic transitions in divided societies. The paper demonstrates this through: (1) a detailed refutation of Nancy MacLean's mischaracterizations of Hutt, (2) evidence of Hutt's genuine and consistent anti-apartheid work, and (3) empirical analysis showing that transitions lacking Hutt's recommended safeguards produced outcomes he predicted-autocratic capture, economic dysfunction, and renewed inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文为W.H. Hutt辩护，反驳其支持种族隔离的指控，并通过比较分析罗德西亚-津巴布韦（1980）和南非（1994）两个转型案例，证明Hutt关于民主转型中宪法保障重要性的警告具有预见性。
AI.research_question: W.H. Hutt是否真的支持种族隔离？他的宪法政治经济学理论在南部非洲民主转型中的预测准确性如何？
AI.motivation: 澄清对Hutt的误解（被指控支持种族隔离），并通过实证分析验证其关于民主转型中宪法保障理论的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法政治经济学、民主转型理论、多数主义民主的风险、少数群体权利保障、制度设计理论。
AI.method: 1) 文献分析：反驳Nancy MacLean对Hutt的误读；2) 历史分析：展示Hutt真实的反种族隔离工作；3) 比较案例研究：分析津巴布韦（1980）和南非（1994）两个转型案例。
AI.findings: 1) Hutt并非种族隔离支持者，而是反种族隔离者；2) 津巴布韦转型缺乏宪法保障，导致经济崩溃和社会瓦解，验证了Hutt的预测；3) 南非转型虽有民主改革，但持续的结构性不平等和服务提供危机部分验证了Hutt的警告。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了Hutt的理论遗产，确立其作为分裂社会中民主转型宪法政治经济学先驱的地位，为理解民主转型中的制度设计提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于民主转型中宪法保障重要性的实证证据，警示缺乏制度保障的多数主义民主可能导致的负面后果，对分裂社会的政治改革具有参考价值。

title: Reproducibility of Social Science Research Under Privacy Noise
affiliations: , Carnegie Mellon University - H. John Heinz III School of Public Policy and Management and Carnegie Mellon University - H. John Heinz III School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Reproducibility of Social Science Research Under Privacy Noise

declarations.funderStatement: This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. 2319919.

detail.abstract: Privacy-preserving analytics such as differential privacy are designed to allow the analysis of sensitive datasets while protecting individuals’ privacy. Their deployment, however, has been controversial. Critics maintain that statistical noise injected to preserve privacy can degrade quality and feasibility of social science research. We select a benchmark of empirical results from 93 published social science studies and evaluate whether their findings replicate on privacy noise-infused datasets. Under privacy budgets typical in industry, around 91% of simulated findings still support the original claims at confidence level α = 0.1. Claims based on weaker original effect sizes are more likely to be nullified or sometimes reversed. We compare distortions caused by privacy noise to those due to measurement errors and other kinds of non-sampling errors common in social statistics, and we find that the marginal impacts of privacy protection are smaller. Moreover, discrepancies due to privacy noise are often much smaller than discrepancies observed in traditional replication and robustness studies. We point towards robust estimation techniques that can better account for noise—from data privacy protections or from data error—and enable social science research that is both rigorous and privacy-preserving.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了差分隐私等隐私保护技术对社会科学研究可复制性的影响，发现典型隐私预算下约91%的原始研究结果仍能保持统计显著性，隐私噪声的影响小于测量误差等其他非抽样误差。
AI.research_question: 隐私保护技术（如差分隐私）注入的统计噪声是否会显著影响社会科学研究的可复制性和研究质量？
AI.motivation: 隐私保护分析技术在实际部署中存在争议，批评者认为注入的统计噪声会降低社会科学研究的质量和可行性，需要实证评估这种影响的程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于差分隐私理论、统计可复制性理论、测量误差理论，以及社会科学研究中的非抽样误差框架。
AI.method: 选取93篇已发表社会科学研究的实证结果作为基准，在隐私噪声注入的数据集上模拟评估研究结果的复制情况，比较隐私噪声与测量误差等其他非抽样误差的影响差异。
AI.findings: 在典型行业隐私预算下，约91%的模拟结果仍支持原始研究结论（α=0.1）；原始效应量较弱的研究更容易被否定或反转；隐私保护带来的边际影响小于其他非抽样误差；隐私噪声导致的差异远小于传统复制和稳健性研究中观察到的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了隐私保护技术对社会科学研究可复制性影响的实证证据，建立了隐私噪声与测量误差等传统误差源的比较框架，挑战了隐私保护会严重损害研究质量的常见批评。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出稳健估计技术可以更好地处理隐私噪声和数据误差，使社会科学研究既能保持严谨性又能保护隐私；为研究者在隐私保护约束下设计研究提供了实证依据。

title: Terrorist Motivation: Commentary on the Anatomy of Flawed Science
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Terrorist Motivation: Commentary on the Anatomy of Flawed Science

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: In this commentary, I discuss the fallacy of pursuing research on terrorist motivation without a treatment control. I point out that without a control, there is no way to account for confounding influences, nor is it possible to identify the cause. By invoking published articles, which have identified a cause through the use of a treatment control, I argue that many of the factors deemed motivational in this special issue are actually dependent variables of this cause. Accordingly, focusing on motivations is a futile exercise, and scholars must use treatment controls to avoid producing flawed science.

AI.tldr: 该评论文章指出，在没有治疗对照组的情况下研究恐怖分子动机是谬误的，因为无法排除混杂因素和确定因果关系。作者认为许多被认定为动机的因素实际上是某个原因的因变量，因此聚焦动机研究是徒劳的，必须使用治疗对照组才能避免产生有缺陷的科学。
AI.research_question: 在没有治疗对照组的情况下研究恐怖分子动机是否科学有效？如何正确识别恐怖主义行为的真正原因？
AI.motivation: 作者观察到当前恐怖主义研究中存在方法论缺陷，许多研究在没有适当对照组的情况下探讨恐怖分子动机，导致无法区分真正原因和混杂因素，产生有缺陷的科学结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果推断理论、实验设计原理、治疗对照组在社会科学研究中的应用、混淆变量控制理论
AI.method: 评论性分析方法，通过引用已发表的使用治疗对照组识别原因的研究文章，对比分析当前恐怖主义动机研究的方法论缺陷。
AI.findings: 1. 没有治疗对照组的研究无法排除混杂因素的影响；2. 无法确定真正的因果关系；3. 许多被认定为恐怖分子动机的因素实际上是某个根本原因的因变量；4. 聚焦动机研究是徒劳的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了恐怖主义研究中方法论严谨性的重要性，强调了治疗对照组在因果推断中的必要性，挑战了当前恐怖主义动机研究的基本范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为恐怖主义研究者提供了方法论指导，建议在研究设计中必须包含治疗对照组，以避免产生有缺陷的科学结论，提高研究的科学性和政策相关性。

title: Local energy market business models: A comparative study of theory to practical deployments
affiliations: University of Bristol - Department of Computer Science, , , Centre for Environment and Sustainability - University of Surrey, The University of Manchester, ,  and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Local energy market business models: A comparative study of theory to practical deployments
detail.abstract: The recent interest in local energy systems and distributed energy business models has led to a proliferation of academic publications on peer-to-peer, transactive, and community self-consumption local energy business models, and to the deployment of practical pilot projects that implement these approaches. This article presents a comparative study of deployed local energy market projects versus the typology of business models derived from the academic literature. It highlights what the practical deployment projects have adapted from the theoretical business model typologies, where they differ, and observes the reasons for such divergences. Among other findings, we observe that all case studies and pilot projects in practice fall within a combination of two or more business model archetypes identified in the theoretical literature. This is most often caused by regulatory constraints and/or in pursuit of opportunities for additional revenue streams. Other common divergences between theory and practice include the need in practice to account for participant preferences beyond financial concerns, the ability of certain stakeholders to assume multiple roles within a business model, the absence of community-building functions in theoretical business models, along with their lack of integration of regulatory and physical constraints.Policy implications of such divergences are also considered, along with recommendations for key stakeholders to allow  successful deployment of future local energy projects.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了本地能源市场实践项目与学术文献中的商业模式类型，发现实践项目通常结合多种理论原型，主要受监管约束和额外收入机会驱动，并揭示了理论与实践的差异及其政策含义。
AI.research_question: 实践中的本地能源市场项目与学术文献中的商业模式类型相比，有哪些相似之处和差异？这些差异的原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着本地能源系统和分布式能源商业模式的兴起，学术文献中涌现了大量关于点对点、交易性和社区自消纳的本地能源商业模式研究，同时实践中也部署了许多试点项目。然而，理论与实践之间可能存在差距，需要系统比较以指导未来项目部署。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本地能源商业模式类型学（包括点对点、交易性、社区自消纳等原型），商业模式理论，能源系统转型理论。
AI.method: 比较研究法：分析已部署的本地能源市场实践项目与学术文献中提出的商业模式类型，识别两者的相似点和差异点，并探讨差异的原因。
AI.findings: 1. 所有实践案例和试点项目都结合了理论文献中两种或更多商业模式原型；2. 这种结合主要受监管约束和/或追求额外收入机会驱动；3. 其他常见差异包括：实践中需要考虑参与者超越财务的偏好、某些利益相关者能在商业模式中承担多重角色、理论商业模式缺乏社区建设功能、未整合监管和物理约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了本地能源商业模式理论与实践之间的系统性差异；2. 识别了理论模型需要改进的方面（如社区建设、监管整合）；3. 为商业模式类型学提供了实证验证和修正方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了考虑监管约束的建议；2. 为项目开发者提供了结合多种商业模式原型的实践指导；3. 为利益相关者提供了成功部署未来本地能源项目的具体建议；4. 强调了超越财务考量的参与者偏好管理的重要性。

reference: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/398032140_Building_Trust_Integrating_AI_Blockchain_and_Digital_Identity
title: Building Trust: Integrating AI, Blockchain, and Digital Identity
affiliations: , , Independent, MODUL University Vienna, , EU Blockchain Observatory and Forum, EU Blockchain Observatory and Forum, MODUL University of Vienna, , INATBA, University of Pavia and

detail.title: Building Trust: Integrating AI, Blockchain, and Digital Identity
detail.abstract: The convergence of Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) represents a significant step toward establishing a global benchmark for digital trust, rights-based governance, and competitiveness. Key Messages ● SSI as a Trust Anchor: SSI restores control over identity to citizens and organizations, reducing dependency on centralized intermediaries and opaque data brokers. ● AI as a driver of Intelligence and Automation: When trained on verifiable and provenance-rich data, AI improves risk detection, compliance, and decision-making at scale. ● Synergy: Together, SSI and AI form systems that are transparent, auditable, and human-centric, supporting resilience against fraud, identity manipulation, and systemic bias. ● Regulatory Alignment: The combined framework directly supports compliance with the GDPR, eIDAS 2.0, and the EU AI Act, while reinforcing the goals of the Digital Services Act, Digital Markets Act, Cyber Resilience Act, Data Governance Act, and Data Act. ● Societal Impact: Beyond technical gains, SSI + AI address critical challenges such as digital inclusion, accountability of autonomous agents, and protection against synthetic identities, enabling the safeguarding of democracy, empowering citizens, and unlocking economic opportunities. Strategic Relevance In a digital economy where identity defines access to finance, healthcare, education, and civic rights, the convergence of SSI and AI is not optional — it is foundational. Europe has the regulatory leadership, technological infrastructure, and governance culture to set global standards. This report offers a roadmap to operationalize this leadership.

AI.tldr: SSI与AI融合为数字信任、权利治理和竞争力建立全球基准，通过去中心化身份与可验证数据驱动智能系统，支持法规遵从并解决社会挑战。
AI.research_question: SSI与AI如何协同工作以建立数字信任、支持法规遵从并解决社会挑战？
AI.motivation: 在数字身份决定金融、医疗、教育和公民权利获取的数字经济中，需要透明、可审计、以人为本的系统来对抗欺诈、身份操纵和系统性偏见。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我主权身份理论、去中心化信任框架、可验证数据驱动的AI系统、权利治理模型、数字信任生态系统。
AI.method: 概念分析框架，基于现有法规（GDPR、eIDAS 2.0、欧盟AI法案等）的技术融合路径分析，战略路线图制定。
AI.findings: SSI作为信任锚点恢复身份控制，AI基于可验证数据提升风险检测和决策能力，两者结合形成透明、可审计、以人为本的系统，支持法规遵从并解决数字包容、自主代理问责等社会挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出SSI与AI融合的协同理论框架，建立数字信任、权利治理和竞争力的全球基准模型，为去中心化身份与智能系统的集成提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲提供实施路线图，支持GDPR、eIDAS 2.0、欧盟AI法案等法规遵从，增强数字包容、保护民主、赋能公民并释放经济机会，确立全球标准制定领导地位。

reference: Journal of Economic Interaction and Coordination, 0[10.1007/s11403-025-00466-y]
title: Impact of GDP-anchoring bias on macroeconomic dynamics through consumer and investment behaviour
affiliations: Autonomous University of Barcelona, Eindhoven University of Technology and ESCP Business School, Madrid campus

detail.title: Impact of GDP-anchoring bias on macroeconomic dynamics through consumer and investment behaviour

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Economic Interaction and Coordination, 0[10.1007/s11403-025-00466-y]

detail.abstract: We examine how information about GDP affects macroeconomic dynamics through the behavior of consumers and investors. To this end, we formulate a stylized macroeconomic simulation model in which agents respond to publicly available information about GDP growth. Their optimism or pessimism is driven by the discrepancy between observed and desired GDP growth while responses are boundedly rational in the sense that they exhibit anchoring bias regarding GDP growth expectations. GDP information affects agent choices regarding the allocation of income between consumption and savings, and indirectly regarding investment in productive capital versus R&D aimed at improving labor productivity. By embedding a business cycle into the model, we examine whether informational feedback loops can amplify economic fluctuations and affect long-term growth. The results indicate that behavioral responses to GDP information may generate asymmetric consumption patterns over the cycle and influence long-run growth. While simplified, the framework offers first insights into how a widely publicized economic indicator like the GDP can shape aggregate dynamics through belief-driven behavior. Our results suggest that current macroeconomic modeling and policy analysis might be biased as they neglect this behavioral impact of GDP.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个宏观经济模拟模型，研究GDP信息如何通过影响消费者和投资者的行为（基于锚定偏误的有限理性反应）来影响宏观经济动态，发现GDP信息可能放大经济波动并影响长期增长。
AI.research_question: GDP信息如何通过消费者和投资者的行为反应影响宏观经济动态（包括经济波动和长期增长）？
AI.motivation: 当前宏观经济模型和政策分析可能忽视了GDP信息对经济主体行为的直接影响，而GDP作为广泛公开的经济指标，可能通过影响人们的乐观/悲观情绪和决策来塑造总体经济动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有限理性理论，特别是锚定偏误（anchoring bias）理论，以及行为经济学中关于信息如何影响经济主体决策的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建了一个程式化的宏观经济模拟模型，模型中代理人根据观察到的GDP增长与期望增长之间的差异做出反应，分配收入在消费与储蓄之间，以及在生产性资本投资与研发投资之间。
AI.findings: 1. 对GDP信息的行为反应可能在周期中产生不对称的消费模式；2. 可能影响长期经济增长；3. 信息反馈回路可能放大经济波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为经济学中的锚定偏误理论引入宏观经济分析，展示了信息如何通过信念驱动的行为影响总体经济动态，为理解GDP信息的经济效应提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出当前宏观经济模型和政策分析可能存在偏差，因为它们忽视了GDP信息的行为影响；2. 为政策制定者提供了关于如何考虑GDP信息发布对经济影响的洞见。

title: Joint Non-Paper on the AI Act. France, Germany and Italy Reach Consensus
affiliations: Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) - LSTS, Interdisciplinary Research Group on Law Science Technology & Society

detail.title: Joint Non-Paper on the AI Act. France, Germany and Italy Reach Consensus

keywords: EU Digital Regulation And Platform Governance

detail.abstract:
The European Union has been discussing the adoption of a legislative act regulating Artificial Intelligence (AI) since 2021. This year, 2023, has been especially busy for all stakeholders involved in the trilogue meetings, which envisage the adoption of the first-ever EU Regulation on AI in 2024. Europe has been marking a more rigorous approach compared to the position of the United States, which advocates for a more permissive regulation. Although the G7 has agreed on a voluntary code of conduct1 for AI companies, the European Union continues to work on stricter legislation, classifying AI systems into four levels with different restrictions based on their capabilities. The European Commission initial draft of the AI Act includes a ban on systems which pose unacceptable risks for users and contravene EU values such as social scoring by governments, use of remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement purposes, with some exceptions, and systems that deploy harmful manipulative 'subliminal techniques'.
Nevertheless, the advances made until the end of 2023 have been put at stake by a recently leaked intergovernmental document2. On 20 November 2023, information was made public of a joint nonpaper3 proposed by France, Germany and Italy, which reveals the three major European countries’ position on the regulation of AI. The document has quickly made the news due to the proposed shift towards a less restrictive approach for foundation models.

AI.tldr: 欧盟AI法案制定过程中，德法意三国联合文件提议对基础模型采取更宽松的监管立场，这可能改变欧盟原本严格的AI监管路径。
AI.research_question: 德法意三国联合文件提出的基础模型监管立场如何影响欧盟AI法案的制定进程和监管方向？
AI.motivation: 欧盟正在制定首个AI监管法案，但德法意三国联合文件提议对基础模型采取更宽松的监管，这可能颠覆欧盟原有的严格监管路径，需要分析这一变化的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管趋同理论、多层级治理理论、利益相关者理论、技术监管框架
AI.method: 政策文件分析、比较分析法、案例研究（欧盟AI法案制定过程）、利益相关者分析
AI.findings: 德法意三国联合文件提议对基础模型采取更宽松的监管，这可能：1）削弱欧盟AI法案的严格性；2）影响欧盟与美国在AI监管上的差异；3）改变AI系统的四级分类监管框架；4）影响欧盟在AI领域的全球领导地位
AI.theory_contributions: 1）揭示了大型成员国在欧盟技术监管中的影响力；2）提出了技术监管中"严格vs宽松"的平衡问题；3）展示了全球AI监管竞争中的动态变化
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为AI企业提供监管趋势分析；2）为政策制定者提供多国立场协调的建议；3）帮助理解欧盟内部在技术监管上的分歧；4）为其他地区AI监管提供参考

title: Social Welfare Gains and Digital Societies: An Analysis through the Lens of Social Welfare Functions
affiliations: University of the People

detail.title: Social Welfare Gains and Digital Societies: An Analysis through the Lens of Social Welfare Functions
detail.abstract: This article examines how the rise of digital societies reshapes social welfare, using Sen's Social Welfare Function (SWF) and the capabilities approach as the core analytical lens. It argues that digitalization-through AI-driven systems, digital platforms and egovernment infrastructures-generates both substantial welfare gains and new forms of stratification. On the benefit side, digital mechanisms can expand individuals' capability sets by improving access to markets, education, health and public services, while reducing transaction costs and informational frictions. On the risk side, unequal digital access, opaque algorithms and weak governance frameworks can translate into systematic exclusion, capability deprivation and violations of equity axioms embedded in Sen's SWF. Conceptually, the paper links digital resources, conversion factors and digital capabilities to welfare outcomes, and shows how these relationships can be evaluated under conditions of inequality and uncertainty. Empirically illustrative sections discuss large-scale initiatives such as India's Aadhaar-Direct Benefit Transfer system, Estonia's X-Road and e-residency infrastructure, and personalized learning tools in high-income contexts, highlighting the tension between efficiency gains and inclusion risks. The article concludes by proposing a set of design and governance principles-focusing on equity, transparency, accountability and participatory oversight-to ensure that digital transformation translates into robust and fairly distributed welfare gains, rather than deepening existing social and economic divides.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字化社会如何重塑社会福利，以Sen的社会福利函数和能力方法为核心分析框架。研究发现数字化通过AI系统、数字平台和电子政务基础设施带来福利提升，但也产生新的分层现象，需要在效率与包容性之间寻求平衡。
AI.research_question: 数字化社会的兴起如何重塑社会福利？数字技术如何影响个人能力集合的扩展，以及如何产生新的社会分层和排斥？
AI.motivation: 随着数字技术（AI、数字平台、电子政务）的快速发展，社会正在经历深刻的数字化转型。这种转型既带来了提升社会福利的潜力，也引发了新的不平等和排斥风险，需要理论框架来理解和评估这些复杂影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Sen的社会福利函数（SWF）和能力方法。该框架强调个人能力集合的扩展作为福利的核心，并关注数字资源、转换因素和数字能力如何影响福利结果。
AI.method: 概念性分析结合实证案例研究。通过理论框架构建分析模型，并辅以印度Aadhaar-DBT系统、爱沙尼亚X-Road和电子居民基础设施、高收入国家的个性化学习工具等大规模数字倡议作为实证例证。
AI.findings: 数字化带来双重效应：一方面通过改善市场、教育、医疗和公共服务获取，降低交易成本和信息摩擦，扩展个人能力集合；另一方面，数字鸿沟、算法不透明和治理薄弱导致系统性排斥、能力剥夺，违反Sen社会福利函数中的公平公理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将Sen的能力方法应用于数字福利分析；2）建立数字资源、转换因素和数字能力与福利结果的概念联系；3）提出在不平等和不确定性条件下评估数字福利影响的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出一套设计和治理原则：关注公平、透明、问责和参与式监督，确保数字化转型转化为稳健且公平分配的福利收益，而非加深现有社会经济鸿沟。

title: Cashless Society, Financial Inclusion and Information Security in Nigeria: The Case for Adoption of Multifactor Biometric Authentication
affiliations: and

detail.title: Cashless Society, Financial Inclusion and Information Security in Nigeria: The Case for Adoption of Multifactor Biometric Authentication
detail.abstract: Cashless society is a system in which all purchases of goods and services are made by credit card or e-payments system. It is a policy that reduces the amount of physical cash that people carry around. Therefore, the system heavily rely on the alternative banking channels (contactless payments terminals) to achieve it purpose. The Central Bank of Nigeria announced its intention to transform Nigerian economy into cashless one in 2011. We argue that it is difficult, if not impossible for a cashless financial system to work under the present state of the Nigerian financial system. This cannot be overemphasized because forging growth in alternative payment system requires inclusivity, proper infrastructure and security of funds and information. The main objective of this study is to make a case for multifactor biometric authentication system in the Nigerian financial service industry. The study also highlight the level of financial inclusion as well as the security vulnerability of the existing system in Nigeria. Descriptive statistical technique of data analysis is employed for the secondary data from 2013-2018. The study concludes that electronic payments fraud has been on increase because of a weak security framework in the existing payment system in Nigeria. This is as the result of cashless policy needs for the inclusion of adults' population into the formal financial system to achieve an effective cashless economic society. The study is also of the opinion that the increase in the volume of fraud in the payment system and the losses of funds is related to the recent increase in the number of adults in the formal financial system in Nigeria. The study therefore recommends that policymakers (CBN) should embark on the search for the solution to the problem of information security in the Nigerian financial system. The study is recommending the multifactor biometric authentication for users as a remedy to the increased electronic payment system fraud in Nigeria.

AI.tldr: 该研究认为尼日利亚当前金融体系难以实现无现金社会，主要原因是金融包容性不足、基础设施薄弱和支付系统安全漏洞。研究建议采用多因素生物识别认证系统来解决电子支付欺诈问题。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚金融体系能否在现有条件下有效实施无现金政策？如何解决电子支付欺诈问题以促进无现金经济发展？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚央行2011年宣布向无现金经济转型，但现有金融体系存在金融包容性不足、基础设施薄弱和安全漏洞等问题，阻碍了无现金政策的有效实施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无现金社会理论、金融包容性理论、支付系统安全框架、生物识别认证理论
AI.method: 采用描述性统计分析技术，分析2013-2018年的二手数据
AI.findings:
1. 电子支付欺诈持续增加，原因是现有支付系统安全框架薄弱
2. 支付系统欺诈增加和资金损失与最近进入正规金融系统的成年人口增加有关
3. 无现金政策需要将成年人口纳入正规金融系统才能实现有效的无现金经济社会
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了无现金社会实施的条件框架：包容性、基础设施和安全性
2. 建立了金融包容性增长与支付系统安全脆弱性之间的理论联系
3. 为发展中国家无现金转型提供了理论分析框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 建议尼日利亚央行(CBN)寻求解决金融系统信息安全问题的方案
2. 推荐采用多因素生物识别认证系统作为解决电子支付欺诈的补救措施
3. 为政策制定者提供了具体的实施建议以促进无现金经济发展

title: Stability and Anonymity
affiliations: University of Innsbruck

detail.title: Stability and Anonymity
detail.abstract: In many-to-many matching markets, various concepts have been introduced to analyze stability. Most of these concepts are not straightforward to interpret. For instance, stability blocks may make members of a blocking coalition worse off. This paper argues that the differences between stability concepts stem from different implicit assumptions about anonymity in the market. By explicitly incorporating these anonymity assumptions into the market model, particularly using large markets, it is shown that many differences between stability concepts vanish. In these large markets, stability is a better-behaved solution concept: stability blocks lead to improvements for all members of a blocking coalition, unlike in finite markets. Furthermore, in large markets, an interpretation of each stability concept at the agents’ level can be given explicitly in a natural non-cooperative foundation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入匿名性假设，证明在大型市场中不同稳定性概念之间的差异会消失，且稳定性概念具有更好的行为特性。
AI.research_question: 在多对多匹配市场中，不同稳定性概念之间的差异如何解释？这些差异是否能在特定市场条件下消失？
AI.motivation: 现有匹配市场中的稳定性概念往往难以直观解释，例如稳定性阻碍可能导致联盟成员处境变差。需要理解这些概念差异的根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 匹配市场理论、稳定性概念、匿名性假设、大型市场理论、非合作博弈基础
AI.method: 通过将匿名性假设明确纳入市场模型，特别是使用大型市场模型，进行理论分析
AI.findings: 在大型市场中，不同稳定性概念之间的差异会消失；稳定性阻碍会使联盟所有成员受益（与有限市场不同）；可以在代理人层面给出每个稳定性概念的自然非合作基础解释
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了稳定性概念差异源于匿名性假设；证明了在大型市场中稳定性概念的统一性；为稳定性概念提供了非合作博弈基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为匹配市场设计提供了更直观的稳定性概念；帮助政策制定者理解不同稳定性标准的实际含义；为市场机制设计提供理论指导

title: Articulating the Fisheries OECM Criterion in Indonesia: A Case Study of Fisheries Area Access Management in Kolono Bay
affiliations: , , ,  and

detail.title: Articulating the Fisheries OECM Criterion in Indonesia: A Case Study of Fisheries Area Access Management in Kolono Bay
detail.abstract: Coastal ecosystems are faced with unsustainable practices that increase pressure and negatively impact ecosystem provisioning. The global response to this condition calls for action through the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) Aichi Target 11 and the Global Biodiversity Framework target to expand protection of coastal and marine areas to 30% through Other Effective Area-based Conservation Measures (OECM). This study aims to articulate the OECM criterion in the context of small-scale fisheries management in Indonesia, using the case study of Fishing Area Access Management in Kolono Bay. The assessment of Fisheries OECM criterion was conducted using the FAO (2022) guidelines with an evaluation approach based on ecological, social, and institutional variables. The results showed that Fisheries Area Access Management at Kolono Bay is a potential Fisheries OECM. This area requires governance strengthening to fully meet the Fisheries OECM criterion, which is managed by community-based fisheries.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了印度尼西亚Kolono湾渔业区域准入管理作为渔业OECM的潜力，发现其符合渔业OECM标准但需要加强治理
AI.research_question: 印度尼西亚小规模渔业管理中的渔业区域准入管理是否符合渔业OECM标准？
AI.motivation: 沿海生态系统面临不可持续实践的压力，CBD爱知目标11和全球生物多样性框架要求通过OECM扩大海洋保护区至30%，需要在小规模渔业管理中应用OECM标准
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物多样性保护理论、基于区域的保护措施理论、社区为基础的渔业管理理论
AI.method: 采用FAO（2022）指南，基于生态、社会和制度变量的评估方法，以Kolono湾渔业区域准入管理为案例研究
AI.findings: Kolono湾渔业区域准入管理是潜在的渔业OECM，但需要加强治理以完全满足渔业OECM标准
AI.theory_contributions: 将OECM标准应用于小规模渔业管理，为基于社区的渔业保护提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度尼西亚和其他发展中国家的小规模渔业管理提供OECM实施指南，支持CBD保护目标的实现

title: Financial Frictions and Geographical Diversification of National Homebuilders *

detail.title: Financial Frictions and Geographical Diversification of National Homebuilders *
detail.abstract: This paper examines how geographic diversification shapes pricing and resilience among U.S. homebuilders. Using comprehensive housing transaction data from 2009-2012, I show that diversified national builders adjust prices across markets and time sales strategically to manage liquidity under financial frictions. I develop and estimate an equilibrium model in which builders optimally set prices across locations to smooth cash flow when external financing is costly. The model implies that financial frictions reduced public builders' profit margins by 20%, and that broader geographic portfolios sustained home prices about 2.5% higher during the housing bust.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国住宅建筑商的地理多元化如何影响定价策略和市场韧性。通过2009-2012年住房交易数据，发现多元化全国性建筑商通过跨市场定价和时间销售策略来管理流动性，应对融资约束。估计的均衡模型显示融资摩擦使公共建筑商利润率降低20%，而更广泛的地理投资组合在房市低迷期维持房价约2.5%
AI.research_question: 地理多元化如何影响住宅建筑商的定价策略和市场韧性？建筑商如何通过跨市场定价和时间销售来管理流动性约束？
AI.motivation: 理解建筑商在融资约束下的经营策略，特别是地理多元化如何帮助建筑商在房市波动中维持稳定，这对房地产市场和金融稳定性有重要意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于融资约束理论，建筑商面临外部融资成本时，通过跨市场定价和时间销售来平滑现金流；地理多元化作为风险管理工具的理论框架
AI.method: 使用2009-2012年美国住房交易数据，构建并估计均衡模型，分析建筑商在融资约束下的最优定价策略
AI.findings: 多元化全国性建筑商通过跨市场定价和时间销售策略管理流动性；融资摩擦使公共建筑商利润率降低20%；更广泛的地理投资组合在房市低迷期维持房价约2.5%
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了建筑商在融资约束下的跨市场定价理论，阐明了地理多元化作为流动性管理机制的作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑商提供了在融资约束下的经营策略指导，为政策制定者理解房地产市场稳定性和金融风险提供了实证依据

title: The dark side of bank branch closures
affiliations: University of St Andrews Business School and

detail.title: The dark side of bank branch closures
detail.abstract: We study how bank branch closures affect local economic activity, using satellite-based nighttime lights (NTL) as a high-resolution proxy for changes in economic vibrancy at the census-tract level. Our sample covers over 11,000 US tracts in the period of 1994-2020. To isolate plausibly exogenous variation in branch closures, we exploit within-county, tract-level exposure to post-merger branch consolidation, that is, the closure of redundant branches arising from greater network overlap rather than from local economic conditions. The resulting IV estimates show that branch closures depress local economic activity, as proxied by changes in reduced nighttime lights intensity. The results reveal significant heterogeneity as they are most pronounced in communities with older populations, lower income, lower density, and lower Black population share, as well as in high-mobility counties. A spillover analysis further indicates that the effects of branch closures are highly localized, with significant impacts confined to adjacent tracts and dissipating rapidly over distance.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用卫星夜间灯光数据作为经济活力的高分辨率代理变量，分析银行网点关闭对地方经济活动的影响。研究发现，银行网点关闭会抑制地方经济活动，这种影响在不同社区存在显著异质性，并且具有高度局部化的空间溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 银行网点关闭如何影响地方经济活动？这种影响在不同社区特征下是否存在异质性？其空间溢出效应如何？
AI.motivation: 银行网点关闭是普遍现象，但其对地方经济的具体影响尚不明确。现有研究缺乏高分辨率、客观的经济活动衡量指标，且难以区分网点关闭是经济衰退的原因还是结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融可得性理论，银行网点提供重要的金融服务，其关闭可能通过减少信贷可得性、降低交易便利性、削弱社区经济活力等渠道影响地方经济。
AI.method: 使用卫星夜间灯光数据作为经济活力的高分辨率代理变量；采用工具变量法，利用银行合并后的网点整合（冗余网点关闭）作为外生冲击，控制内生性问题；样本涵盖1994-2020年美国11,000多个普查区。
AI.findings: 1. 银行网点关闭显著抑制地方经济活动（夜间灯光强度降低）；2. 影响在老年人口多、收入低、密度低、黑人比例低的社区以及高流动性县更为显著；3. 溢出效应高度局部化，仅影响相邻区域且随距离迅速衰减。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化银行网点关闭对地方经济的因果效应；2. 揭示了金融可得性影响经济活动的微观机制；3. 拓展了异质性分析框架，识别了不同社区特征的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供银行网点关闭影响评估工具；2. 帮助识别最易受影响的脆弱社区；3. 为银行合并监管和社区发展政策提供实证依据；4. 展示了卫星数据在金融地理研究中的应用价值。

title: Distinct but Linked: Spillovers Between Pension and Non-Pension Investments
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance and Management and Copenhagen Business School

detail.title: Distinct but Linked: Spillovers Between Pension and Non-Pension Investments

declarations.funderStatement: Pension Research Centre (PeRCent)

detail.abstract: More and more countries around the world switch from defined-benefit, pay-as-you-go pension systems to funded, defined-contribution systems. This implies substantial wealth accumulation, yet simultaneously exposes individuals to investment risk. While it seems natural to expect that individuals' investment decisions in pension and non-pension accounts are related, there is little empirical evidence. We compile a new microdataset on Danish savers and document how pension and non-pension investment decisions are linked. We find substantial positive spillover effects between risk-taking in pension and non-pension investments. High-return pension savers also earn the highest return on their non-pension savings, driven by active risk choices. Pension and non-pension investment choices are often made at the same time. An important reason for this are joint responses to individual and aggregate events. Additionally, there are direct spillover effects from changes in stock market policies to pension savings behavior, and vice versa.

AI.tldr: 丹麦养老金改革从确定收益制转向确定缴费制，导致财富积累但增加投资风险。研究发现养老金与非养老金投资决策存在显著正溢出效应，高回报养老金储户在非养老金投资中也获得更高回报，主要源于主动风险选择。投资决策常同时进行，受个体和宏观事件共同影响，且存在双向溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 个人的养老金投资决策与非养老金投资决策之间是否存在关联？如果有，这种关联的具体机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球许多国家从确定收益的现收现付养老金制度转向确定缴费的基金积累制，这导致个人财富积累增加但同时也面临投资风险。虽然理论上预期个人的养老金和非养老金投资决策应该相关，但缺乏实证证据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、投资组合理论、风险承担理论、溢出效应理论。研究基于投资决策一致性假设，探讨养老金与非养老金投资之间的风险承担溢出效应。
AI.method: 使用丹麦储户的微观数据集进行实证分析，通过观察个人在养老金和非养老金账户的投资决策，检验风险承担行为的相关性，分析投资决策的时间同步性，并识别个体和宏观事件对投资决策的共同影响。
AI.findings: 1. 养老金与非养老金投资风险承担存在显著正溢出效应；2. 高回报养老金储户在非养老金投资中也获得最高回报，主要源于主动风险选择；3. 养老金与非养老金投资决策常同时进行；4. 投资决策受个体和宏观事件的共同影响；5. 存在从股市政策变化到养老金储蓄行为的直接溢出效应，反之亦然。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提供了养老金与非养老金投资决策关联的实证证据；2. 揭示了投资决策中的风险承担溢出效应机制；3. 扩展了行为金融学在养老金投资领域的应用；4. 为理解个人投资决策的一致性提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计养老金制度提供参考；2. 帮助金融机构更好地理解客户的投资行为模式；3. 为个人投资者提供投资决策整合的启示；4. 对金融教育和投资者保护具有实践意义。

title: Trump-Era Cryptocurrency Policy Events and Bitcoin Returns: An Event Study Analysis
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: Trump-Era Cryptocurrency Policy Events and Bitcoin Returns: An Event Study Analysis
detail.abstract: This study examines whether Bitcoin's market responses to Trump-era political actions vary systematically by event type. Using 14 hand-curated events from July 2024 to December 2025, I employ a multi-factor event study framework categorizing events into four types: Regulatory Relief, Executive Actions, Market Access, and Political Symbolic. The analysis reveals a statistically significant collective market response to Trump-era cryptocurrency events, with mean cumulative abnormal returns of 2.22% over a three-day window (p=0.038), and 78.6% of events generating positive returns. Importantly, these returns differ significantly across event categories (F=4.44, p=0.032). Political Symbolic events generated the strongest responses (4.49%, p=0.059), followed by Regulatory Relief (2.21%, p=0.020), Market Access (2.51%), and Executive Actions (0.81%). The pattern of significant collective impact combined with meaningful type differentiation suggests that Bitcoin markets both respond to the general regulatory favorability signaled by Trump administration actions and systematically distinguish between different administrative mechanisms. Political Symbolic announcements elicited particularly strong reactions (p=0.046 vs. Executive Actions), while Regulatory Relief events showed perfect consistency with 100% positive outcomes. The findings support the "Trump trade" thesis at an aggregate level while demonstrating that markets discriminate among event types, with symbolic political gestures and regulatory clarity valued most highly by cryptocurrency investors.

AI.tldr: 研究显示比特币市场对特朗普时代加密货币相关政治事件有显著反应，平均累计异常收益率为2.22%，78.6%的事件产生正收益。不同事件类型（监管放松、行政行动、市场准入、政治象征）的反应存在显著差异，政治象征事件反应最强（4.49%），监管放松事件一致性最高（100%正收益）。
AI.research_question: 比特币市场对特朗普时代政治行动的反应是否因事件类型而存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府对加密货币的态度和政策变化对市场产生重要影响，但不同政治行动类型可能被市场以不同方式解读和反应，需要系统分析这些差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究法、市场效率理论、政治经济学、监管不确定性理论、加密货币市场行为
AI.method: 采用多因子事件研究框架，收集2024年7月至2025年12月期间14个手工整理的特朗普时代加密货币相关事件，将事件分为四类：监管放松、行政行动、市场准入、政治象征，分析三日内累计异常收益率。
AI.findings:
1. 特朗普时代加密货币事件整体产生显著市场反应，平均累计异常收益率为2.22%（p=0.038），78.6%事件产生正收益；
2. 不同事件类型反应存在显著差异（F=4.44，p=0.032）；
3. 政治象征事件反应最强（4.49%，p=0.059），其次是监管放松（2.21%，p=0.020）、市场准入（2.51%）和行政行动（0.81%）；
4. 政治象征事件与行政行动的反应差异显著（p=0.046）；
5. 监管放松事件一致性最高，100%产生正收益。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 验证了"特朗普交易"假说在加密货币市场的适用性；
2. 揭示了市场对不同政治行动类型的差异化反应机制；
3. 拓展了事件研究法在政治经济学和加密货币领域的应用；
4. 提供了政治信号与市场反应关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者提供事件驱动的交易策略参考；
2. 帮助政策制定者理解市场对不同政策工具的反应；
3. 为加密货币市场参与者提供风险管理依据；
4. 揭示了政治象征性声明对加密货币市场的特殊影响力。

title: Institutional Adoption of Cryptocurrency Exposure: An Analysis of U.S. Pension Fund and Endowment 13F Filings (2024-2025)
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: Institutional Adoption of Cryptocurrency Exposure: An Analysis of U.S. Pension Fund and Endowment 13F Filings (2024-2025)
detail.abstract: The approval of spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) in January 2024 provided a regulated pathway for conservative fiduciaries to gain exposure to digital assets. This study analyzes the early adoption patterns among U.S. public pension funds and university endowments by examining SEC Form 13F filings from Q1 2024 through Q3 2025. Tracking holdings in Bitcoin ETFs, an Ethereum trust, and equity proxies (MicroStrategy, Coinbase), we document the strategies of eleven early-adopting institutions. Our findings reveal three distinct adoption pathways: cautious experimentation (e.g., Brown University), strategic conviction (e.g., Harvard University), and tactical discipline (e.g., State of Wisconsin Investment Board). While the ETF structure was a necessary enabling condition, adoption was profoundly mediated by institutional governance, risk culture, and investment philosophy. The data shows that endowments allocated more aggressively, with Harvard's allocation reaching 0.84% of asset under management (AUM), while pensions remained more cautious. The case of the Wisconsin Investment Board demonstrates that fiduciary duty can be expressed not only through strategic allocation but also through active, disciplined portfolio management. The results demonstrate that institutional investment in contested asset classes is a multi-faceted process where quantitative portfolio theory, governance frameworks, and tactical execution intersect.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2024年比特币现货ETF获批后，美国公共养老基金和大学捐赠基金早期采用数字资产的模式，识别出三种不同的采用路径，并揭示了机构治理、风险文化和投资哲学在采用过程中的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 美国公共养老基金和大学捐赠基金在比特币现货ETF获批后，如何采用数字资产？有哪些不同的采用路径和影响因素？
AI.motivation: 2024年1月比特币现货ETF获批为保守的受托人提供了受监管的数字资产投资渠道，但机构投资者如何实际采用这些新工具尚不清楚，需要研究早期采用模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机构投资理论、受托责任理论、投资组合理论、创新采用理论、机构治理框架
AI.method: 通过分析SEC Form 13F文件（2024年Q1至2025年Q3），追踪11家早期采用机构对比特币ETF、以太坊信托和股票代理（MicroStrategy、Coinbase）的持仓情况。
AI.findings: 识别出三种采用路径：1）谨慎实验（如布朗大学）；2）战略信念（如哈佛大学）；3）战术纪律（如威斯康星州投资委员会）。捐赠基金配置更积极（哈佛达AUM的0.84%），养老基金更谨慎。ETF结构是必要条件，但采用过程受机构治理、风险文化和投资哲学深刻调节。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了机构投资理论，展示了在有争议资产类别中，定量投资组合理论、治理框架和战术执行的交叉作用；2）丰富了创新采用理论在机构投资领域的应用；3）深化了对受托责任表达方式的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为机构投资者提供数字资产采用的参考框架；2）帮助监管者理解机构采用模式；3）为资产管理公司设计产品提供洞察；4）展示了威斯康星投资委员会如何通过积极的投资组合管理履行受托责任。

title: Loan Loss Predictability from Macroeconomic Factors
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong (CityU), City University of Hong Kong (CityU), Columbia University - Columbia Business School and Cornell University - Samuel Curtis Johnson Graduate School of Management

detail.title: Loan Loss Predictability from Macroeconomic Factors
detail.abstract: We examine the extent to which bank loan losses can be predicted by macroeconomic factors, with a focus on the heterogeneity of the predictability. We develop an easily interpretable dynamic tree-based machine learning model to analyze this construct, which we term net charge-off predictability from macroeconomic factors (NPM). NPM demonstrates considerable cross-sectional and time-series heterogeneity. It generally increases with indicators of credit risk exposure, although its relationship with bank characteristics is often nuanced and non-linear. It rises (declines) during recession (expansionary) periods, indicating that macroeconomic factors are most relevant for predicting loan losses during downturns. In addition, the macroeconomic variables most predictive of future loan losses vary across banks and economic cycles. Exploring its applications, we find that higher NPM during recessions identifies banks that subsequently experience weaker financial and stock performance, amplify procyclicality, and face a higher likelihood of enforcement actions.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个基于动态树的机器学习模型(NPM)来预测银行贷款损失，发现预测性存在显著的横截面和时间序列异质性，在经济衰退期间预测性增强，且高NPM银行在衰退后表现更差。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济因素能在多大程度上预测银行贷款损失？这种预测性在不同银行和不同时期存在怎样的异质性？
AI.motivation: 理解宏观经济因素对银行贷款损失的预测能力对于银行风险管理、监管政策和金融稳定具有重要意义，但现有研究对这种预测性的异质性关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信用风险理论、宏观经济周期理论和机器学习预测理论，研究宏观经济冲击如何通过银行异质性特征影响贷款损失预测。
AI.method: 开发了一个易于解释的动态树基机器学习模型(NPM)，分析宏观经济因素对银行净核销的预测能力，并检验其横截面和时间序列异质性。
AI.findings: 1. NPM存在显著的横截面和时间序列异质性；2. NPM与信用风险暴露正相关，但与银行特征的关系复杂非线性；3. 衰退期间NPM上升，扩张期间下降；4. 最相关的宏观经济变量因银行和经济周期而异；5. 衰退期间高NPM银行后续财务和股价表现更差，顺周期性更强，面临监管行动风险更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了NPM概念框架；2. 揭示了宏观经济因素预测贷款损失的异质性机制；3. 拓展了信用风险预测理论；4. 丰富了银行异质性研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行风险管理提供预测工具；2. 为监管机构识别脆弱银行提供指标；3. 为投资者评估银行风险提供参考；4. 有助于制定逆周期监管政策。

title: Sustainable Development and Economic Diversification in Algeria: A Bibliometric Analysis (2010-2025)
affiliations: 8 Mai 1945 – Guelma University

detail.title: Sustainable Development and Economic Diversification in Algeria: A Bibliometric Analysis (2010-2025)
detail.abstract: This study utilized Scopus to examine patterns in scientific publications, co-authorship, institutional contributions, and shifts in the discipline's primary themes. Analytical techniques such as VOSviewer and Bibliometric have been employed to identify indicators of success and examine the structure of collaborative networks and word matching. They demonstrate that scientific research continues to improve. Contemporary research topics focus on utilizing renewable energy and ensuring environmental protection. Significant efforts are directed towards environmental policies, hybrid designs incorporating green energy, solar energy systems, and eco-friendly business practices. The collaboration network of co-authors highlights the partnership between leading Algerian institutions and experts. Additionally, international researchers are being brought together to collaborate in innovative ways. Although there has been considerable progress, much of the research in this area remains technology-centric. Taxation policies, green finance, closedloop economies, and governmental procedures have yet to be fully integrated. The study tells us more about what scientists in Algeria know about sustainability and diversity. It also finds areas where scientists from different fields can work together better and suggests future research and policy initiatives that will help the country move towards a more sustainable and diverse economy.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用Scopus数据库分析阿尔及利亚科学出版物模式，发现研究集中在可再生能源和环境技术，但缺乏税收政策、绿色金融等跨学科整合，建议加强多领域合作以推动可持续经济发展。
AI.research_question: 阿尔及利亚科学研究的出版模式、合作网络、机构贡献及学科主题演变如何？当前可持续发展研究存在哪些知识缺口和整合不足？
AI.motivation: 了解阿尔及利亚科学研究现状，识别可持续发展领域的知识结构、合作模式和研究重点，为促进跨学科整合和政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学理论、科学合作网络理论、可持续发展理论、知识生产与扩散理论。
AI.method: 使用Scopus数据库进行文献计量分析，结合VOSviewer和Bibliometric工具进行可视化网络分析、共现分析和主题演化分析。
AI.findings: 1. 阿尔及利亚科学研究持续进步；2. 当前研究聚焦可再生能源利用和环境保护；3. 主要研究方向包括环境政策、绿色能源混合设计、太阳能系统和环保商业实践；4. 合作网络显示阿尔及利亚主要机构与专家间的伙伴关系；5. 国际研究人员以创新方式合作；6. 研究仍以技术为中心，缺乏税收政策、绿色金融、循环经济和政府程序的整合。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了阿尔及利亚可持续发展研究的知识结构；2. 识别了科学合作网络的特征和模式；3. 提出了技术中心主义与跨学科整合的理论张力；4. 为发展中国家科学政策研究提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为阿尔及利亚科研机构提供合作网络优化建议；2. 识别了跨学科合作的机会领域；3. 为政策制定者提供研究重点和整合方向；4. 提出了促进可持续和多元化经济发展的未来研究议程；5. 为国际科研合作提供参考模式。

title: Data-Driven Causal Identification Using Structural Breaks
affiliations: University of Reading - ICMA Centre,  and Grenoble Ecole de Management

detail.title: Data-Driven Causal Identification Using Structural Breaks
detail.abstract: Identifying causal orders is essential for extracting policy-relevant information from time-series models and for obtaining reliable estimates of counterfactual scenarios. However, the identifying assumptions are often imposed a priori and rely on arbitrary modelling choices. This paper shows that structural breaks provide a powerful and general source of information for causal discovery. We first establish, in a simple bivariate setting, that if a variable x causes a variable y, then every structural break in the reduced-form dynamics of x must also be reflected in those of y, whereas the converse need not hold. We then extend this reasoning to multivariate systems, including SVARs, where the pattern of break co-movements restricts the admissible contemporaneous structures. Since structural break dates are typically unobserved, we employ a recent change-point detection algorithm to identify them. Monte Carlo simulations indicate that the procedure recovers the underlying break structure with good accuracy and, even when identification is not unique, substantially narrows the set of compatible causal graphs. An empirical application to a monetary system illustrates how the method can be used to study contemporaneous relations among macroeconomic variables.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用结构突变进行因果发现的新方法，通过分析变量间结构突变的共动模式来识别因果方向，无需先验假设。
AI.research_question: 如何利用结构突变信息来识别时间序列变量间的因果顺序？
AI.motivation: 传统因果识别方法依赖先验假设和任意建模选择，需要更客观的数据驱动方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结构突变理论的因果发现框架：如果x导致y，则x的结构突变必然反映在y中，反之则不一定成立。
AI.method: 1. 在双变量设定中建立结构突变共动原理；2. 扩展到多变量系统（包括SVAR）；3. 使用变化点检测算法识别未观测的结构突变日期；4. 通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证方法准确性。
AI.findings: 1. 方法能准确恢复底层突变结构；2. 即使识别不唯一，也能大幅缩小兼容因果图集合；3. 实证应用于货币系统展示了其在宏观经济变量同期关系研究中的实用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于结构突变的因果发现新理论框架，为时间序列因果识别提供了不依赖先验假设的客观方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了实用的因果发现程序；2. 提供了货币政策等宏观经济系统的实证分析工具；3. 为政策制定者提供了更可靠的因果推断方法。

title: Direct Injection Law-A New Trans-territorial Right or an Excessive and Unnecessary EU Copyright Law Concept

detail.title: Direct Injection Law-A New Trans-territorial Right or an Excessive and Unnecessary EU Copyright Law Concept
detail.abstract: This article argues that the distribution of program-carrying signals through a technical process called "direct injection"-as introduced by Directive 2019/789 of 17 April 2019 laying down rules on the exercise of copyright and related rights applicable to certain online transmissions of broadcasting organisations and retransmissions of television and radio programmes, and amending Council Directive 93/83/EEC, the so-called SatCab2 Directive-involves, for that process (a method of putting a signal into protected circulation), an assumption of a protected use of works if the broadcaster intends them to reach the public and they are ultimately communicated to the public by the distributor within a particular territory. In this sense, distribution using direct injection would create a new right to use a work within the right of communication to the public. The fundamental premise of the concept of direct injection is also the trans-territorial communication of works to the public, rather than just communication within a single territory, where it is primarily a physical activity, such as improving signal quality. However, the author of the article adopts a critical view of the new concept of direct injection in EU law and believes that the said Directive unjustifiably monopolises a non-public use of works that cannot be protected under the right of communication to the public, since only the broadcaster's intention to communicate those works to the public through a distributor should matter, not the technical process. Furthermore, the notion of direct injection pertains solely to the protection of exclusive rights and, therefore, to contractual remuneration in exchange for a licence (the right to use a work), and not, for example, to unwaivable, equitable, or statutory remuneration rights surviving the transfer in addition to the existing exclusive right of communication to the public.

AI.tldr: 欧盟《SatCab2指令》引入的"直接注入"技术流程，将广播信号传输视为受保护的公开传播行为，但作者认为这不当垄断了非公开使用，仅凭广播者意图就应构成公开传播，而非技术流程本身。
AI.research_question: 欧盟《SatCab2指令》中"直接注入"技术流程是否合理地将信号传输视为受版权保护的公开传播行为？
AI.motivation: 分析欧盟2019/789号指令引入的"直接注入"概念，探讨其是否过度扩展了版权保护范围，将技术流程不当纳入公开传播权范畴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 版权法理论，特别是公开传播权（right of communication to the public）的界定；技术中立原则；版权保护范围与限制的平衡。
AI.method: 法律文本分析；概念批判分析；比较法分析（欧盟指令与现有版权法原则的对比）。
AI.findings: 1. "直接注入"概念将技术流程视为公开传播，但作者认为这不当扩展了版权保护范围；2. 应基于广播者意图而非技术流程来判断是否构成公开传播；3. 该概念仅关注专有权利保护，忽视了不可放弃的法定报酬权等其他权利。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 批判性分析"直接注入"概念在版权法理论中的合理性；2. 强调技术中立原则在版权法中的重要性；3. 澄清公开传播权的构成要件应基于意图而非技术手段。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟版权法实施提供批判性视角；2. 提醒立法者避免过度技术化版权保护；3. 为广播组织和版权权利人提供法律适用指导。

title: The Value of Personalized Longevity Projection for Retirement Income
affiliations: , Pacific Life Insurance Company and

detail.title: The Value of Personalized Longevity Projection for Retirement Income
detail.abstract: Retirement planning often uses generic lifespan estimates, creating suboptimal decisions. This study shows that personalized longevity projections based on demographics and health attributes and derived from Cox proportional hazards models improve Social Security claiming strategies. Personalized longevity estimates applied to respondents of the University of Michigan Health and Retirement Study increased the average value of lifetime benefits by $9,000 (women) and $12,000 (men) relative to other approaches. Optimized claiming based on individual health/demographics attributes outperformed both standard actuarial assumptions and common recommended ages. The results demonstrate how personalized longevity assessments can enhance retirement income planning, financial security, and client-advisor alignment.

AI.tldr: 该研究显示，基于人口统计和健康属性的个性化寿命预测（使用Cox比例风险模型）能显著改善社保申领策略，相比其他方法可为男性和女性分别增加12,000美元和9,000美元的终身福利价值。
AI.research_question: 个性化寿命预测如何影响社会保障申领策略的优化效果？
AI.motivation: 传统退休规划使用通用的寿命估计，导致决策次优化。需要基于个人特征（人口统计和健康属性）的个性化寿命预测来改善退休收入规划。
AI.theoretical_framework: Cox比例风险模型用于构建个性化寿命预测；退休决策优化理论；社会保障申领策略评估框架。
AI.method: 使用密歇根大学健康与退休研究（HRS）的受访者数据，应用Cox比例风险模型生成个性化寿命估计，并比较不同申领策略下的终身福利价值。
AI.findings: 个性化寿命估计使女性平均终身福利增加9,000美元，男性增加12,000美元；基于个人健康/人口统计属性的优化申领策略优于标准精算假设和常见推荐年龄。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了基于个性化寿命预测的退休决策优化理论；证明了Cox模型在退休规划中的应用价值；建立了健康属性与退休决策的量化联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为财务顾问提供个性化退休规划工具；帮助个人做出更优的社会保障申领决策；提高退休收入安全性和客户-顾问一致性。

title: The Neo-Colonial Tendencies of FinTech: Evidence from Kenya and South Africa
affiliations: University of Johannesburg

detail.title: The Neo-Colonial Tendencies of FinTech: Evidence from Kenya and South Africa
detail.abstract: The character of uneven and combined development means metropolitan capital structures colonized economies. Accordingly, this paper attends to how Northern platforms aided by local intermediaries perpetuate neocolonial tendencies in the South. Engaging with African Marxist theorizing, the objective in the paper is to clarify the character of accumulation and class formation via FinTech platform enabled rent-seeking in Sub-Saharan Africa. A transnational case study of Kenya and South Africa firms and regulations is used to show how this kind of technology enables and perpetuates neocolonialism. I focus on how a mixture of market and non-market coercion structures the relationship between the Global North and South. As such, FinTech is poised to be another mechanism by which the global capitalist ruling class generates unfreedom faraway and exacerbates the global racial wealth gap.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了金融科技平台如何通过市场与非市场强制手段，在撒哈拉以南非洲地区延续新殖民主义，加剧全球种族财富差距。
AI.research_question: 金融科技平台如何通过租金寻租在撒哈拉以南非洲地区促进资本积累和阶级形成，并延续新殖民主义？
AI.motivation: 不平衡和综合发展的特征意味着大都市资本结构殖民了经济。北方平台在本地中介的帮助下，如何在南方延续新殖民主义倾向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非洲马克思主义理论，特别是关于不平衡和综合发展的理论，以及新殖民主义理论。
AI.method: 跨国案例研究，分析肯尼亚和南非的公司与监管体系。
AI.findings: 金融科技平台通过市场与非市场强制手段的结构化关系，使全球资本主义统治阶级能够在远方制造不自由，并加剧全球种族财富差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非洲马克思主义理论应用于金融科技研究，阐明了技术如何成为新殖民主义的工具，以及租金寻租在资本积累和阶级形成中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了金融科技平台在南非和肯尼亚等国家的实际运作机制，为政策制定者提供了理解技术如何延续不平等和殖民关系的视角。

title: Geopolitical Risks and the Resilience of Banks in the Banking Union:  A review of expertise from the ECON Committee’s Banking Union academic expert panel
affiliations: European Parliament

detail.title: Geopolitical Risks and the Resilience of Banks in the Banking Union:  A review of expertise from the ECON Committee’s Banking Union academic expert panel
detail.abstract: Geopolitical Risks and the Resilience of Banks in the Banking Union A review of expertise from the ECON Committee's Banking Union academic expert panel Geopolitical risk is a peculiar type of risk for banks and it has gained in prominence recently. Yet, it is hard to grasp, and even more so to quantify. Three papers by academic experts that we have commissioned on behalf of the ECON Committee now provide important insights on geopolitical risk. This thematic briefing reviews the results of the three papers. The papers show the importance of this risk and report on the available evidence and the policy measures in place. They also point to some problems and gaps in the transparency and management of this risk.

AI.tldr: 该简报回顾了三篇关于地缘政治风险对银行业影响的学术论文，指出地缘政治风险对银行的重要性、现有证据和政策措施，以及风险透明度和管理方面的问题
AI.research_question: 地缘政治风险如何影响银行业联盟中银行的韧性？现有证据和政策措施在管理地缘政治风险方面存在哪些问题和差距？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治风险对银行来说是特殊且日益重要的风险类型，但难以把握和量化。ECON委员会委托的三篇学术论文提供了重要见解，需要系统评估这些研究成果
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治风险理论、银行风险管理理论、银行业联盟监管框架、风险透明度理论
AI.method: 文献综述法，对ECON委员会委托的三篇学术专家论文进行系统性回顾和分析
AI.findings: 1. 地缘政治风险对银行的重要性日益凸显；2. 现有证据显示银行面临显著的地缘政治风险暴露；3. 已有相关政策措施但不够完善；4. 风险透明度和风险管理存在问题和差距

title: Analyzing the drivers and preferences of functional dairy food consumption: A socioeconomic perspective from Tamil Nadu
affiliations: ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi, INDIA, ICAR- National Dairy Research Institute, National Dairy Research Institute and National Dairy Research Institute - Department of Dairy Economics, Statistics & Management

detail.title: Analyzing the drivers and preferences of functional dairy food consumption: A socioeconomic perspective from Tamil Nadu

publicationDetails.detailsText:
https://doi.org/10.33785/IJDS.2025.v78i05.010
It is the DOI mentioned in the paper.

detail.abstract: In today's consumer market, individuals are subject to various stimuli such as advertising campaigns, popular magazines etc., which shape their marginal consumption propensity. However, as Economic Theory teaches us, this propensity does not necessarily translate into consumer spending. This is strongly affected by consumers' eating habits, individual circumstances and other contextual variables. This study, conducted in the Tamil Nadu state of India explores the consumer preferences and factors moderating the consumption of functional dairy foods (FDFs) based on the data collected from 160 respondents chosen from different sale locations. Socioeconomic profiles were analyzed using tabular and frequency analysis, while indices were constructed to assess consumer preferences using Likert scale. The Seemingly Unrelated Regression model was employed to identify factors moderating functional dairy food consumption. The findings highlight that safety/trustworthiness was the most valued attribute among consumers, followed closely by nutritional and health benefits. Despite being in the early stages of adoption, functional dairy foods, particularly fortified milk, demonstrate significant growth potential. Key determinants of consumption include family income, occupation, dietary habits, family size and geographic location.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了印度泰米尔纳德邦消费者对功能性乳制品的偏好及影响因素，发现安全性/可信度是最受重视的属性，其次是营养健康效益。家庭收入、职业、饮食习惯、家庭规模和地理位置是影响消费的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 消费者对功能性乳制品的偏好是什么？哪些因素调节功能性乳制品的消费？
AI.motivation: 尽管广告和媒体影响消费者的边际消费倾向，但实际消费行为受到饮食习惯、个人情况和情境变量的强烈影响。功能性乳制品作为新兴市场，其消费决定因素尚需深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论，研究考虑了社会经济因素、心理因素（如信任、健康意识）和情境因素对消费决策的影响。
AI.method: 从不同销售地点选取160名受访者收集数据。使用表格和频率分析社会经济特征，利用李克特量表构建指数评估消费者偏好，采用似不相关回归模型识别调节功能性乳制品消费的因素。
AI.findings: 安全性/可信度是消费者最重视的属性，其次是营养健康效益。功能性乳制品（特别是强化牛奶）虽处于早期采用阶段，但显示出显著增长潜力。消费的关键决定因素包括家庭收入、职业、饮食习惯、家庭规模和地理位置。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了消费者行为理论在功能性食品领域的应用，验证了信任、健康意识等心理因素与传统社会经济因素在消费决策中的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为功能性乳制品生产商和营销人员提供市场洞察，帮助他们针对不同消费者群体制定有效的产品开发和营销策略，重点关注安全性和健康效益的沟通。

title: Tokenized Bonds, Stablecoins, and Smart Contracts: What They Mean for How Central Banks Control Money
affiliations: Cracow University of Economics and Anambra State Polytechnic, Mgbakwu

detail.title: Tokenized Bonds, Stablecoins, and Smart Contracts: What They Mean for How Central Banks Control Money
detail.abstract: The rise of real-world asset (RWA) tokenization-converting property, bonds, or commodities into blockchain-based tokens-and its integration with decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols is altering how liquidity is created, credit is intermediated, and monetary signals propagate through the financial system. Rather than replacing central banks, these innovations are rerouting traditional channels: for example, tokenized Treasury bonds on Ethereum now serve as collateral in DeFi lending pools, effectively creating parallel money markets outside regulated banking. This paper investigates the mechanisms through which tokenization and DeFi interact withand strain-existing monetary and regulatory frameworks. Using a mixed-methods approach (quantitative analysis of on-chain RWA flows, plus interviews with central bankers, fintechs, and supervisors in the EU, Singapore, and Brazil), we ask: (1) How does RWA-backed liquidity in DeFi respond to interest rate changes compared to traditional repo markets? (2) To what extent do DeFi protocols substitute for-or complement-bank intermediation for SMEs? (3) Where do current regulatory perimeters fail to capture systemic linkages (e.g., stablecoin runs affecting tokenized bond markets)? Early evidence suggests that while RWA tokenization can improve market access, it also fragments liquidity and weakens conventional policy transmissionespecially when stablecoins (e.g., USDC) become de facto settlement layers. We propose a "functional equivalence" regulatory approach: supervise activities by economic function (e.g., maturity transformation, liquidity provision), not legal form. This work provides timely, empirically grounded input for central banks and regulators navigating the co-evolution of digital and traditional finance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了现实世界资产（RWA）代币化与DeFi结合如何改变金融体系中的流动性创造、信贷中介和货币政策传导机制，分析了其对现有货币和监管框架的影响，并提出基于"功能对等"的监管方法。
AI.research_question: 1. DeFi中RWA支持的流动性对利率变化的反应与传统回购市场相比如何？2. DeFi协议在多大程度上替代或补充了中小企业的银行中介？3. 当前监管边界在哪些方面未能捕捉系统性关联（如稳定币挤兑影响代币化债券市场）？
AI.motivation: 现实世界资产代币化与DeFi协议的结合正在改变金融体系的运作方式，创造平行货币市场，对传统货币政策和监管框架构成挑战，需要系统研究其机制和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融中介理论、货币政策传导机制、监管套利理论、功能对等监管原则
AI.method: 混合方法：对链上RWA流动的定量分析 + 对欧盟、新加坡和巴西的央行官员、金融科技公司和监管机构的访谈
AI.findings: RWA代币化虽然能改善市场准入，但也导致流动性碎片化并削弱传统政策传导，特别是当稳定币成为事实上的结算层时。DeFi协议与银行中介既有替代也有互补关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"功能对等"监管框架的理论基础，深化了对数字金融与传统金融协同演化机制的理解，丰富了金融中介和货币政策传导理论在数字环境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和监管机构提供了实证依据，建议采用基于经济功能而非法律形式的监管方法，帮助政策制定者应对数字金融与传统金融的协同演化挑战。

title: Incremental Risk Charge vs Default Risk Charge: Regulatory Design, Financial Interpretation, and Implementation Challenges

detail.title: Incremental Risk Charge vs Default Risk Charge: Regulatory Design, Financial Interpretation, and Implementation Challenges
detail.abstract: The transition from the Incremental Risk Charge (IRC) under Basel 2.5 to the Default Risk Charge (DRC) within the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) represents a fundamental reconfiguration of how trading-book credit risk is conceptualised, modelled, and capitalised. While IRC sought to capture both default and migration risk through a one-year simulation framework, FRTB restructures this treatment by separating migration and spread risks into the Credit Spread Risk Expected Shortfall (CSR ES) and isolating default risk within the DRC. This paper provides a comprehensive comparative analysis of IRC and DRC from regulatory, financial, and quantitative perspectives, examining how different jurisdictions-notably the United States versus FRTB-implementing regions such as the European Union and the United Kingdom-have adopted divergent approaches to trading-book credit risk capital. The analysis demonstrates that the shift from IRC to DRC is not merely a technical adjustment but a structural redefinition of risk attribution, capital aggregation, and supervisory philosophy. In particular, it alters the treatment of concentration, diversification, hedging recognition, and tail dependency, with direct implications for portfolio construction, internal capital allocation, and cross-border regulatory arbitrage. By integrating regulatory analysis with methodological scrutiny and practical implementation considerations, this paper illuminates the economic and prudential consequences of fragmenting credit risk into modular capital components and highlights the broader systemic implications of maintaining parallel IRC and DRC regimes across major banking jurisdictions.

AI.tldr: 本文对巴塞尔2.5框架下的增量风险资本(IRC)与交易账簿基本审查(FRTB)中的违约风险资本(DRC)进行了全面比较分析，探讨了从IRC到DRC的转变不仅是技术调整，更是风险归因、资本聚合和监管哲学的结构性重新定义。
AI.research_question: 从IRC到DRC的转变如何重新定义交易账簿信用风险的概念化、建模和资本化？不同司法管辖区（特别是美国与欧盟/英国）在实施交易账簿信用风险资本要求方面采取了哪些不同方法？
AI.motivation: 巴塞尔2.5框架下的IRC向FRTB框架下的DRC转变代表了交易账簿信用风险监管的根本性重构，这一转变对风险归因、资本计算和监管实践产生深远影响，需要从监管、金融和量化角度进行全面分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管资本理论、信用风险建模理论、风险归因理论、资本聚合理论、监管哲学理论
AI.method: 比较分析法：从监管、金融和量化三个角度对IRC和DRC进行综合比较分析；跨司法管辖区对比分析（美国vs欧盟/英国）；整合监管分析、方法论审查和实践实施考虑
AI.findings: 1. IRC到DRC的转变是结构性重新定义而非单纯技术调整；2. 改变了集中度、分散化、对冲识别和尾部依赖的处理方式；3. 不同司法管辖区采取了不同的实施方法；4. 对投资组合构建、内部资本配置和跨境监管套利有直接影响；5. 将信用风险分解为模块化资本组件具有经济和审慎后果
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对监管资本框架演变的理论理解；2. 提出了风险归因和资本聚合的结构性重新定义理论；3. 发展了跨司法管辖区监管差异的理论分析框架；4. 丰富了信用风险模块化分解的理论意义
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行投资组合构建和内部资本配置提供实践指导；2. 帮助监管机构理解不同实施方法的系统性影响；3. 为金融机构应对跨境监管差异提供参考；4. 揭示并行IRC和DRC制度的系统性影响

title: Stable Experimentation? An Analysis of Multi-Armed Bandit Problems with Bundling
affiliations: Illinois Institute of Technology - Stuart School of Business, IIT, Purdue University and Whitman College

detail.title: Stable Experimentation? An Analysis of Multi-Armed Bandit Problems with Bundling
detail.abstract: This paper introduces bundled experimentation problems and compares behavior in these problems to a classic (non-bundled) experimentation problem. We transform a two-decision four-armed bandit problem into two different bundling experimentation problems. The first bundling problem is a "stable" problem where each type of urn in the four-armed bandit problem becomes bundled with a known urn of the same quality. The second bundling problem is an "encouraged" problem where the urn types with larger exploration incentives in the four-armed bandit get bundled with urns with higher known reward rates. In our experiment, there should be no differences in the (expected) information generated from the first decision in each type of experimentation problem. However, we find that both types of bundling problems lead to more expected information generated than the non-bundled experimentation problem. Additionally, in contrast to theory, we find that subjects' second decision in a bundled bandit problem is influenced by the balls drawn from both of the initially chosen option's urns. These two results suggest that choice is not preserved when transforming a non-bundled experimentation problem into a bundled experimentation problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了捆绑实验问题，将四臂老虎机问题转化为两种捆绑实验问题（稳定型和激励型），发现捆绑问题比非捆绑问题产生更多预期信息，且第二个决策受两个初始选项的影响，表明选择在捆绑转换中不守恒。
AI.research_question: 当将非捆绑实验问题（四臂老虎机）转化为捆绑实验问题时，选择行为是否保持不变？捆绑如何影响信息生成和决策过程？
AI.motivation: 理解捆绑如何改变实验问题的决策行为，特别是在信息生成和后续决策方面，这对现实世界中的捆绑决策场景有重要启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多臂老虎机理论、实验经济学、决策理论、捆绑效应理论、信息价值理论
AI.method: 实验方法：将两决策四臂老虎机问题转化为两种捆绑实验问题（稳定型和激励型），通过受试者实验比较行为差异，分析信息生成和决策模式。
AI.findings: 1. 两种捆绑问题都比非捆绑问题产生更多预期信息；2. 受试者在捆绑老虎机问题中的第二个决策受两个初始选项的抽取结果影响；3. 选择在从非捆绑问题转化为捆绑问题时并不守恒。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了捆绑实验问题的新框架；2. 揭示了捆绑对信息生成和决策过程的系统性影响；3. 挑战了传统理论中关于选择守恒的假设；4. 为理解捆绑决策行为提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为产品捆绑、投资组合设计等实际决策场景提供启示；2. 帮助管理者设计更好的捆绑策略以促进信息获取；3. 对教育、医疗等领域的决策设计有参考价值；4. 为行为干预和政策设计提供实证依据。

title: New findings on the inversion of the 10Y-3M bond yield curve
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: New findings on the inversion of the 10Y-3M bond yield curve
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the informational content of the earliest phase of a yield-curve inversion by analysing the behaviour of the 10-year minus 3-month sovereign yield spread across 58 countries. We construct three duration metrics T0 (days from the first inversion to the minimum point of the spread), T1 (days from inversion to the return to positive territory) and Tn (total length of the inversion cycle and examine their relationship with subsequent equity market performance. The results show that Tesu0 consistently exhibits the strongest association with market drawdowns, suggesting that the speed and depth of the inversion’s initial decline contain meaningful predictive information. Furthermore, the analysis identifies a structural break around the 2007–2008 financial crisis, after which the dynamics of inversions and their connection to equity markets change significantly. Additional exploratory evidence links T0 to movements in major currency pairs, indicating that inversion dynamics may transmit through global risk-sentiment channels. Overall, the study introduces a novel metric that enhances the understanding of yield curve inversions and offers a new perspective for assessing future market stress.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析58个国家的10年期与3个月期国债收益率利差，研究了收益率曲线倒挂早期阶段的信息含量。研究发现，从首次倒挂到利差最低点的时间（T0）与后续股市下跌关联最强，且2008年金融危机后倒挂动态发生结构性变化。
AI.research_question: 收益率曲线倒挂早期阶段（特别是倒挂持续时间指标T0、T1、Tn）是否包含对未来股市表现的有用预测信息？
AI.motivation: 收益率曲线倒挂是经济衰退的重要预警信号，但现有研究主要关注倒挂是否发生，对倒挂过程本身的动态特征及其信息含量研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 收益率曲线理论（预期理论、流动性偏好理论）、市场效率理论、风险情绪传导机制。
AI.method: 构建三个倒挂持续时间指标：T0（首次倒挂到利差最低点的天数）、T1（倒挂到恢复正利差的天数）、Tn（整个倒挂周期的总天数）；使用58个国家的数据，分析这些指标与后续股市表现的关系；进行结构性断点检验（2008年金融危机前后）。
AI.findings: 1. T0指标与市场下跌的关联最强，表明倒挂初期下跌的速度和深度包含重要预测信息；2. 2007-2008年金融危机后存在结构性断点，倒挂动态及其与股市的关系发生显著变化；3. T0还与主要货币对波动相关，表明倒挂动态可能通过全球风险情绪渠道传导。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出新的倒挂持续时间指标，丰富了收益率曲线倒挂的理论框架；2. 揭示了倒挂过程动态特征的信息含量，超越了传统的二元倒挂指标；3. 识别了金融危机后倒挂动态的结构性变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者和政策制定者提供了更精细的倒挂监测指标；2. T0指标可作为评估未来市场压力的新视角；3. 有助于更准确地预测股市下跌风险。

title: From Simulations to Simplicity: A Formula for Safe Withdrawal Rates
affiliations: Samasthiti Advisors

detail.title: From Simulations to Simplicity: A Formula for Safe Withdrawal Rates
detail.abstract:
Planning how much retirees can safely withdraw each year is one of the most important and confusing question in personal finance. The answer usually depends on running thousands of investment simulations, because market returns vary every year and the order in which good and bad years occur can dramatically change retirement outcomes. These simulations are powerful, but they can be complex and difficult for most people to use or interpret.

This paper aims to make the idea of Safe Withdrawal Rates (SWR) much more accessible. Instead of asking every advisor or investor to run their own Monte Carlo simulation, we run a large set of simulations across many different combinations of equity allocation and retirement duration. From this rich dataset, we create a simple equation that closely matches the simulation results.

This equation allows advisors, planners, and retirees to estimate the SWR for any combination of retirement duration and equity allocation quickly and transparently, without the need for undertaking simulations or using a specialised software. The goal of this paper is to provide an easy-to-use formula that translates complex simulations into a simple, practical rule of thumb. The formula is accurate, intuitive, and designed to support better retirement-income decisions in the Indian context.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个简单公式来估算安全提款率，替代复杂的蒙特卡洛模拟，使退休规划更易用
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个简单、准确的公式来估算不同退休年限和股票配置下的安全提款率，避免复杂的模拟计算？
AI.motivation: 退休规划中的安全提款率计算通常需要复杂的蒙特卡洛模拟，这对大多数投资者和顾问来说难以使用和解释，需要更易用的方法
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全提款率理论、退休收入规划理论、投资组合理论、蒙特卡洛模拟方法
AI.method: 运行大量蒙特卡洛模拟，涵盖不同股票配置和退休年限组合，从模拟结果中推导出简单公式
AI.findings: 开发出一个能准确匹配模拟结果的简单方程，可以快速估算任何退休年限和股票配置下的安全提款率
AI.theory_contributions: 将复杂的蒙特卡洛模拟结果转化为简单数学公式，简化了安全提款率的理论计算框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为顾问、规划师和退休人员提供了易用的工具，无需专业软件即可估算安全提款率，特别适用于印度市场环境

title: The Local Nature of Housing Markets: New Evidence
affiliations: University of Reading

detail.title: The Local Nature of Housing Markets: New Evidence
detail.abstract: This research examines whether much of the variation in house price changes is mainly driven by local or national factors. Employing a novel data containing both capital appreciation and income component in the U.S. Metropolitan Statistical Areas, results show that macroeconomic factors, absorbed by time fixed effects, account for 59% of the variation in capital gains and 4% of the variation in rental yields. Overall, this empirical study is an important complement to the prior literature assuming that the nature of housing markets is primarily local, particularly evidenced in the cross-sectional income returns. The results provide implications for balanced national development and portfolio diversification strategy.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用美国都市区数据，发现宏观经济因素（时间固定效应）解释了房价资本收益变异的59%，但仅解释了租金收益率变异的4%，表明住房市场同时受全国性和地方性因素影响。
AI.research_question: 房价变化的主要驱动因素是地方性因素还是全国性因素？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常假设住房市场本质上是地方性的，但缺乏对全国性因素影响的实证检验。理解房价变化的驱动因素对区域发展和投资策略有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房市场理论（地方市场特性 vs 全国宏观经济影响），资产定价理论，区域经济学。
AI.method: 使用美国都市统计区（MSAs）的新数据集，包含资本增值和租金收入两个组成部分。采用固定效应模型，通过时间固定效应捕捉宏观经济因素，空间固定效应捕捉地方因素。
AI.findings: 1. 宏观经济因素解释了资本收益变异的59%；2. 宏观经济因素仅解释了租金收益率变异的4%；3. 住房市场同时受全国性和地方性因素影响，但租金收益主要受地方因素驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了"住房市场本质上是地方性"的传统假设；2. 提供了住房市场同时受全国性和地方性因素影响的实证证据；3. 区分了资本收益和租金收益的不同驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平衡国家发展政策提供依据；2. 为房地产投资组合多样化策略提供指导；3. 帮助投资者理解不同房地产收益来源的风险特征。

title: Analysis of the Need for Pizzaluv-Math Learning Media So that Students Can Easily Learn the Limits of Trigonometric Functions
affiliations: , Muhammadiyah University of Magelang, , PGRI Wiranegara University and PGRI Wiranegara University

detail.title: Analysis of the Need for Pizzaluv-Math Learning Media So that Students Can Easily Learn the Limits of Trigonometric Functions
detail.abstract: This research aims to analyze the need for innovative project-based learning media, namely "Pizzaluv-Math," to facilitate students' understanding of the concept of limits of trigonometric functions. "Pizzaluv-Math" integrates mathematical challenges into the pizza-making process, with each pizza ingredient representing a different aspect of the limits of trigonometric functions. This research uses a mixed methods approach consisting of qualitative and quantitative analysis. At the needs analysis stage, semi-structured interviews and classroom observations were conducted with 50 students and ten mathematics teachers from three high schools. The interviews focused on students' experiences with trigonometric functions and their perceptions of the learning process, while the observations aimed to identify specific areas of difficulty in understanding trigonometric function limits. The results of interviews and observations were analyzed using thematic analysis. After developing the learning media, a trial was carried out using a pre-test, a post-test, and a survey to measure the effectiveness of "Pizzaluv-Math." Quantitative data were analyzed using paired t-tests and descriptive statistics. The findings show that many students need help understanding trigonometric function limits and more exciting and interactive learning media. "Pizzaluv-Math" has proven effective in increasing students' understanding of complex mathematical concepts and significantly contributing to mathematics education.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了名为"Pizzaluv-Math"的创新项目式学习媒体，通过披萨制作过程帮助学生理解三角函数极限概念，混合方法研究证明其有效性。
AI.research_question: "Pizzaluv-Math"项目式学习媒体如何促进学生对三角函数极限概念的理解？
AI.motivation: 许多学生在理解三角函数极限概念方面存在困难，且缺乏有趣、互动的学习媒体，需要开发创新的教学工具来改善数学教育。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目式学习理论、建构主义学习理论、数学教育中的具体化学习理论。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：定性分析（50名学生和10名教师的半结构化访谈、课堂观察、主题分析）和定量分析（前测、后测、调查、配对t检验、描述性统计）。
AI.findings: 1. 学生在三角函数极限概念理解上存在显著困难；2. 缺乏有趣互动的学习媒体；3. "Pizzaluv-Math"能有效提高学生对复杂数学概念的理解；4. 该媒体对数学教育有重要贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了项目式学习在数学教育中的应用；2. 验证了具体化学习理论在抽象数学概念教学中的有效性；3. 为数学教育创新提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了有效的三角函数极限教学媒体；2. 提供了可复制的项目式学习设计模式；3. 为数学教师提供了实用的教学工具；4. 改善了学生对抽象数学概念的学习体验。

title: THE CRIMINALIZATION OF DISSENT A Systematic Analysis of Sedition, UAPA, and Anti-Terror Laws in Democratic India (2014-2024)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: THE CRIMINALIZATION OF DISSENT A Systematic Analysis of Sedition, UAPA, and Anti-Terror Laws in Democratic India (2014-2024)
detail.abstract: India, the world's largest democracy, has witnessed a dramatic escalation in the use of laws criminalizing dissent during the period 2014-2024. This research paper presents the first comprehensive empirical analysis of sedition (Section 124A IPC, now Section 152 BNS) and Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) prosecutions, examining 10,440 UAPA arrests, 800+ sedition cases, and their outcomes against the backdrop of India's genuine security challenges and constitutional commitments.

AI.tldr: 本文对印度2014-2024年间煽动叛乱法（第124A条IPC，现第152条BNS）和《非法活动预防法》（UAPA）的起诉进行了首次全面实证分析，涵盖10,440起UAPA逮捕和800多起煽动叛乱案件，探讨其在印度真实安全挑战和宪法承诺背景下的执行情况。
AI.research_question: 印度2014-2024年间煽动叛乱法和《非法活动预防法》的起诉模式、执行效果及其与印度安全挑战和宪法承诺的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 作为世界上最大的民主国家，印度在2014-2024年间见证了将异议刑事化的法律使用急剧增加，需要对这些法律的执行情况进行系统性实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主与国家安全平衡理论、法律执行实证分析框架、异议权与国家安全冲突理论
AI.method: 实证分析方法，基于10,440起UAPA逮捕案件和800多起煽动叛乱案件数据的定量分析，结合印度安全挑战和宪法承诺的背景分析
AI.findings: 首次全面揭示了印度2014-2024年间煽动叛乱法和UAPA的实际执行规模、模式和结果，提供了这些法律在民主与国家安全平衡中的实际应用数据
AI.theory_contributions: 为民主国家中异议权与国家安全平衡的理论研究提供了重要的实证基础，填补了印度相关法律执行系统性研究的空白
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、法律实践者和公民社会提供了关于印度异议刑事化法律实际执行的详细数据，有助于更平衡的法律改革和民主实践
