title: Investigating the Influence of Ease of Doing Business over Foreign Direct Investment Inflows Mediated By Firm Creation and Moderated By Financial Sector Development
affiliations: S.V.M. Institute of Management Studies and Institute of Management Studies, University of Peshawar

detail.title: Investigating the Influence of Ease of Doing Business over Foreign Direct Investment Inflows Mediated By Firm Creation and Moderated By Financial Sector Development
detail.abstract: A decent level of foreign direct investment (FDI) is something every country would certainly endeavour to receive. However, it has been historically observed that some countries receive much more FDI than others. One reason for this could be the ease with which a foreign company can start or operate its business in a host economy. The current work scrutinises the impact of ease of doing business (EDB) on FDI in Pakistan with the mediating role of firm creation and the moderating effect of financial sector development. The population of this study included people who were practically engaged in the decision-making process in businesses in Pakistan. They are Entrepreneurs, Business Owners, Managers and Financial Officers. A sample of 373 respondents is analysed using Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) through SmartPLS-4 statistical package. It’s found that EDB has a significant positive direct and indirect impact on inward FDI through firm creation and a negative moderating effect through financial sector development. These findings strongly support the hypothesis that an attractive business climate, which is determined by streamlined laws, clear-cut procedures, and effective institutional structures, favours the capacity of a nation to attract more foreign investors. To the policymakers, these findings highlight the need for improving the regulatory environment and financial infrastructure. This will enable the host nation to utilise the enhanced FDI inflows for promoting long-term economic progress, development and growth of their country.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了巴基斯坦营商环境便利度（EDB）对外国直接投资（FDI）的影响，发现EDB通过企业创建对FDI产生显著正向直接和间接影响，而金融部门发展则起到负向调节作用。
AI.research_question: 营商环境便利度（EDB）如何影响巴基斯坦的外国直接投资（FDI），企业创建的中介作用和金融部门发展的调节作用是什么？
AI.motivation: 各国都希望获得足够的外国直接投资，但不同国家吸引FDI的能力存在差异。一个可能原因是外国企业在东道国开展业务的便利程度。研究旨在探讨巴基斯坦营商环境对FDI的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度理论、投资环境理论和中介调节模型，研究探讨EDB、企业创建、金融部门发展与FDI之间的理论关系。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法，样本包括373名巴基斯坦企业家、企业主、经理和财务官员等商业决策者。使用SmartPLS-4统计软件进行结构方程模型（SEM）分析。
AI.findings: 1. EDB对FDI有显著正向直接影响；2. EDB通过企业创建对FDI产生正向间接影响；3. 金融部门发展对EDB-FDI关系有负向调节作用；4. 良好的商业环境（简化法规、明确程序、有效制度结构）有助于吸引更多外国投资者。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了EDB通过企业创建影响FDI的中介机制；2. 揭示了金融部门发展在EDB-FDI关系中的负向调节作用；3. 丰富了制度环境与FDI关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者强调改善监管环境和金融基础设施的重要性；2. 提供吸引FDI的具体政策建议；3. 帮助巴基斯坦利用增加的FDI流入促进长期经济发展和增长。

title: Welfare Effects of Passive Partial Ownership in Differentiated Bertrand Duopoly with Optimal Technology Licensing
affiliations: and Indian Statistical Institute - Economic Research Unit

detail.title: Welfare Effects of Passive Partial Ownership in Differentiated Bertrand Duopoly with Optimal Technology Licensing
detail.abstract: We study a technologically asymmetric, differentiated Bertrand duopoly where the technologically superior firm is a passive partial owner of its rival, and technology transfer occurs through optimal two-part licensing. We show that technology is always transferred in equilibrium, and that passive partial ownership uniformly reduces consumer surplus but can enhance social welfare when product differentiation is low and technological asymmetry is high. The analysis highlights a key trade-off between competitive intensity and efficiency gains from technology diffusion, offering new insights into the welfare and antitrust implications of partial ownership arrangements.

AI.tldr: 本文研究技术不对称的差异化Bertrand双寡头市场中，技术优势企业被动部分持有竞争对手股份，并通过最优两部制许可进行技术转移的情况。研究发现技术总是会在均衡中转移，被动部分所有权会降低消费者剩余，但在产品差异化低且技术不对称高时可提高社会福利。
AI.research_question: 在技术不对称的差异化Bertrand双寡头市场中，当技术优势企业被动部分持有竞争对手股份并通过两部制许可进行技术转移时，这种所有权安排如何影响技术转移、消费者剩余和社会福利？
AI.motivation: 部分所有权安排在企业间日益普遍，特别是在技术不对称的情况下。理解这种安排如何影响技术转移、市场竞争和社会福利，对反垄断政策和监管具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 差异化Bertrand双寡头模型、技术不对称理论、被动部分所有权理论、两部制技术许可理论、消费者剩余和社会福利分析框架
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建技术不对称的差异化Bertrand双寡头模型，分析被动部分所有权下的均衡结果，比较不同参数（产品差异化程度、技术不对称程度）下的消费者剩余和社会福利变化
AI.findings: 1. 技术总是会在均衡中转移；2. 被动部分所有权总是降低消费者剩余；3. 当产品差异化程度低且技术不对称程度高时，被动部分所有权可以提高社会福利；4. 存在竞争强度与技术扩散效率增益之间的关键权衡
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了被动部分所有权下技术转移的必然性；2. 识别了消费者剩余与社会福利对部分所有权反应的不同条件；3. 提出了竞争强度与效率增益之间的权衡框架；4. 为部分所有权安排提供了新的理论分析视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为反垄断机构评估部分所有权安排提供分析框架；2. 指出监管应关注产品差异化程度和技术不对称程度；3. 为企业在技术许可和股权安排决策提供参考；4. 强调在特定条件下部分所有权可能具有社会福利提升效应

title: TEN YEARS OF TURKIYE-EGYPT RELATIONS Confrontation to Reconciliation

detail.title: TEN YEARS OF TURKIYE-EGYPT RELATIONS Confrontation to Reconciliation
detail.abstract: The paper examines Turkiye-Egypt relations in the context of the changing Arab World politics since the Arab Spring in 2011. The Arab Spring was the watershed moment for the Arab World’s politics in which the Arab states, Tunisia, Libya, Syria, and Egypt either collapsed or descended into civil war. In this context, Turkiye became one of the most critical external actors in the region due to the success of the Turkish Model of Democracy, which mixed with Islamic values and economic growth. Turkiye’s relations with Arab governments, particularly Egypt, became problematic during the Arab Spring. After the removal of President Hosni Mubarak, Turkiye aspired to increase its influence in the political transition of Egypt by supporting the Muslim Brotherhood, which threatened the longevity of the ruling government in Egypt. The paper scrutinises the changing dynamics of Egypt and Turkiye relations since the Arab Spring, which witnessed the ideological convergence to confrontation and reconciliation due to domestic and regional factors.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了2011年阿拉伯之春以来土耳其与埃及关系的演变，探讨了从意识形态趋同到对抗再到和解的动态变化，以及国内和地区因素对这一关系的影响。
AI.research_question: 阿拉伯之春以来，土耳其与埃及关系如何演变？哪些国内和地区因素导致了这种关系从意识形态趋同到对抗再到和解的转变？
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯之春是阿拉伯世界政治的分水岭，导致多个阿拉伯国家崩溃或陷入内战。土耳其凭借其融合伊斯兰价值观和经济发展的"土耳其民主模式"成为该地区重要的外部行为体，但其与埃及等阿拉伯国家的关系在阿拉伯之春期间变得复杂，需要深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 地区政治转型理论；2. 意识形态趋同与对抗理论；3. 外部行为体干预理论；4. 国内政治与外交政策互动理论；5. 和解与冲突解决理论。
AI.method: 定性案例研究分析，基于历史文献、政策文件、官方声明和区域政治分析，采用过程追踪方法考察土耳其-埃及关系的演变轨迹。
AI.findings: 1. 阿拉伯之春初期，土耳其与埃及因意识形态趋同而关系密切；2. 土耳其支持穆斯林兄弟会干预埃及政治过渡，导致两国关系恶化；3. 国内政治变化和地区地缘政治因素促使两国关系从对抗走向和解；4. 土耳其的"民主模式"影响力在地区政治转型中具有双重效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了阿拉伯世界政治转型中外部行为体干预的理论框架；2. 发展了意识形态趋同-对抗-和解的动态关系模型；3. 丰富了国内政治与外交政策互动的理论解释；4. 为理解后阿拉伯之春时代地区关系演变提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解土耳其-埃及关系演变提供参考；2. 揭示了外部干预在阿拉伯国家政治转型中的风险；3. 为地区冲突管理和和解进程提供经验教训；4. 有助于预测中东地区未来地缘政治动态。

title: Synergistic and inhibitory mechanisms of CO2 mineralization in fly ash–tailings backfill under different conditions
affiliations: University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing and University of Science and Technology Beijing

detail.title: Synergistic and inhibitory mechanisms of CO2 mineralization in fly ash–tailings backfill under different conditions
detail.abstract: In this study, a carbon-negative backfill strategy utilizing industrial solid wastes has been proposed. The feasibility of using fly ash-based cementitious materials and mine tailings as backfill media in metal mines was demonstrated through multi-condition experiments. Systematic experiments revealed that under high-pressure dynamic conditions (0.5 MPa), the addition of NaHCO3 enhanced the carbon sequestration ratio (K) to 2.211% by intensifying HCO3- mass transfer. This performance surpassed the results achieved with NaCl and NH4Cl under same conditions. In the absence of any additives, the peak carbon sequestration ratio (K) reached 1.421%, synchronizes with the maximum pH 6.63 under a pressure of 0.5 MPa. However, further increases in pressure induced H+-driven passivation, limiting the sequestration efficiency. Extended grinding duration from 25 to 50 minutes boosts K by 52%, while prolonging the mineralization time from 0.5 to 1.0 hours resulted in a 25-fold gain. Hybrid systems composed of 80% tailings and 20% cement exhibited ambient-condition synergy, achieving a carbon sequestration ratio (K) of 1.304% through Ca2+ release and CO32- ion-bridge formation. However, under high-pressure conditions, an anti-synergistic effect was observed, necessitating the use of staged mineralization protocols. XRD and SEM–EDS analyses confirmed the formation of Ca- and Mg-carbonates as well as surface passivation phenomena, while TG–DTG results established the relative efficacy of additives in the order: NaHCO3 > NaCl > NH4Cl. This study introduces a novel carbon-negative backfilling approach supported by a quantitative dataset, offering new guidance for integrating carbonation-based valorization into sustainable mine tailings management.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种利用工业固体废物（粉煤灰基胶凝材料和尾矿）作为充填介质的碳负性充填策略。通过多条件实验发现，在高压动态条件下，添加NaHCO3可将碳封存率提升至2.211%，优于NaCl和NH4Cl。混合系统（80%尾矿+20%水泥）在常压下表现出协同效应，但高压下出现反协同效应，需采用分阶段矿化方案。
AI.research_question: 如何利用工业固体废物（粉煤灰基胶凝材料和尾矿）开发碳负性充填策略？不同添加剂和工艺条件对碳封存效率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 金属矿山需要可持续的尾矿管理方案，同时应对气候变化挑战。利用工业固体废物进行碳负性充填既能处理废弃物，又能实现碳封存，具有双重环境效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于碳矿化理论，通过碳酸盐形成实现碳封存；涉及质量传递、离子桥形成、表面钝化等化学过程；探讨添加剂对HCO3-质量传递的强化作用。
AI.method: 多条件实验设计：高压动态条件（0.5 MPa）测试；不同添加剂（NaHCO3、NaCl、NH4Cl）对比；研磨时间（25-50分钟）和矿化时间（0.5-1.0小时）优化；混合系统（80%尾矿+20%水泥）测试；使用XRD、SEM-EDS、TG-DTG进行材料表征。
AI.findings: 1. NaHCO3在高压下碳封存率最高（2.211%）；2. 无添加剂时最大碳封存率1.421%（pH 6.63）；3. 研磨时间延长52%提升碳封存率52%；4. 矿化时间延长25倍增益；5. 混合系统常压下协同效应（1.304%），高压下反协同效应；6. 形成Ca/Mg碳酸盐和表面钝化现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了工业固体废物碳负性充填的理论框架；2. 揭示了高压条件下H+驱动钝化机制；3. 阐明了添加剂对HCO3-质量传递的强化机理；4. 提出了分阶段矿化协议的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一种新型碳负性充填技术方案；2. 建立了添加剂选择标准（NaHCO3 > NaCl > NH4Cl）；3. 提出了工艺优化参数（研磨时间、矿化时间）；4. 为矿山尾矿可持续管理提供了具体指导；5. 提供了定量数据集支持工程应用。

title: Russia's Creative Economy Outcomes and Development Vectors Following the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum 2025
affiliations: Skolkovo School of Management, Skolkovo School of Management, SKOLKOVO Moscow School of Management, Skolkovo School of Management, Skolkovo School of Management, Skolkovo School of Management, Skolkovo School of Management, Skolkovo School of Management and Skolkovo School of Management

detail.title: Russia's Creative Economy Outcomes and Development Vectors Following the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum 2025
detail.abstract:
This study provides the first systematic analysis of how Russia’s creative industries are conceptualized, discussed, and strategically positioned in the public–policy and business discourse of the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF) 2025. Drawing on transcripts of 42 panel discussions and applying a combined methodology of NLP-based discourse analysis, semantic clustering, and expert interpretation, the report identifies key development vectors shaping the national creative economy.


Findings show a structural shift from perceiving creative industries as a cultural field toward recognizing them as an emerging economic sector grounded in intellectual property, export potential, and technological innovation. The discourse highlights several cross-cutting themes: the centrality of human capital, the growing role of regional specialization, the integration of digital platforms and AI into creative production, and the increasing importance of national cultural identity as a competitive advantage in global markets. Despite positive expectations, the analysis reveals systemic barriers, including talent shortages, uneven regional development, insufficient investment mechanisms, and weak measurability of economic outcomes.


The paper proposes a set of policy and institutional measures—investment instruments, export support, interdisciplinary education models, and cluster development—that could enhance Russia’s ability to meet its stated goal of increasing the creative sector’s contribution to GDP from 4.1% to 6% by 2030. The findings contribute to the global debate on how creative economies evolve in emerging markets and how cultural assets can be leveraged for sustainable economic growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统分析了俄罗斯创意产业在圣彼得堡国际经济论坛(SPIEF)2025年公共政策和商业讨论中的概念化、讨论和战略定位。通过分析42场小组讨论的文本，结合NLP话语分析、语义聚类和专家解读，识别出塑造国家创意经济的关键发展向量。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯创意产业在圣彼得堡国际经济论坛(SPIEF)2025年的公共政策和商业讨论中是如何被概念化、讨论和战略定位的？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯设定了到2030年将创意产业对GDP的贡献从4.1%提高到6%的目标，但缺乏对创意产业在政策和企业讨论中如何被理解和定位的系统分析。本研究填补了这一空白，为理解创意经济在俄罗斯的发展提供实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创意经济理论、话语分析理论、新兴市场创意产业发展理论、文化经济学理论
AI.method: 基于42场SPIEF小组讨论的文本分析，采用NLP话语分析、语义聚类和专家解读相结合的方法论
AI.findings: 研究发现从将创意产业视为文化领域转向将其视为基于知识产权、出口潜力和技术创新的新兴经济部门的结构性转变。关键主题包括：人力资本的中心地位、区域专业化日益重要、数字平台和AI融入创意生产、民族文化认同作为全球市场竞争优势的重要性。同时揭示了系统性障碍：人才短缺、区域发展不均衡、投资机制不足、经济成果可测量性弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场创意经济发展理论提供实证案例，深化了对文化资产如何转化为经济价值的理解，拓展了创意产业话语分析的方法论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一套政策制度措施：投资工具、出口支持、跨学科教育模式、集群发展，帮助俄罗斯实现2030年创意产业GDP占比目标。为政策制定者、企业和投资者提供了具体行动建议。

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了全球南方媒体专业人士如何在系统性民主危机中捍卫民主价值观。研究发现这场危机并非偶然，而是由殖民遗产、新闻政治经济学和日益加剧的两极分化共同造成的结构性现象。论文通过印度、菲律宾、巴西、尼日利亚和肯尼亚的案例研究，展示了政治行为体如何利用这些脆弱性破坏民主。媒体面临三重攻击：导致媒体被俘获的经济不稳定、有罪不罚助长的身体暴力，以及通过法律和数字控制实施的国家压制。尽管如此，媒体仍通过事实核查联盟、技术应用和新闻实践去殖民化等策略进行抵抗。论文结论认为，保护民主需要在全球南方建立协调、多层次、独立且符合当地背景的媒体生态系统。
AI.research_question: 全球南方的媒体专业人士如何在系统性民主危机中捍卫民主价值观？
AI.motivation: 全球南方国家正面临系统性民主危机，这种危机不是偶然的，而是由殖民遗产、新闻政治经济学和日益加剧的两极分化共同造成的结构性现象。政治行为体正在利用这些脆弱性破坏民主，媒体面临经济不稳定、身体暴力和国家压制的三重攻击。了解媒体如何在这种环境下捍卫民主价值观对于保护全球南方的民主至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 结构性危机理论：民主危机是结构性而非偶然现象
2. 殖民遗产理论：殖民历史对当代政治经济结构的影响
3. 政治经济学理论：新闻产业的政治经济结构分析
4. 媒体生态系统理论：多层次、协调的媒体系统建设
AI.method: 案例研究方法，选取印度、菲律宾、巴西、尼日利亚和肯尼亚五个全球南方国家作为研究对象，分析媒体专业人士在这些国家面临的挑战和采取的应对策略。
AI.findings:
1. 媒体面临三重攻击：经济不稳定导致媒体被俘获、有罪不罚助长的身体暴力、通过法律和数字控制实施的国家压制
2. 政治行为体利用殖民遗产、新闻政治经济学和两极分化等结构性脆弱性破坏民主
3. 媒体通过多种策略进行抵抗：事实核查联盟、技术应用、新闻实践去殖民化
4. 成功的抵抗需要协调、多层次、独立且符合当地背景的媒体生态系统
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了全球南方民主危机的结构性解释框架
2. 发展了媒体抵抗理论，强调在系统性危机中的策略性应对
3. 扩展了去殖民化理论在新闻实践中的应用
4. 丰富了媒体生态系统理论，强调协调、多层次和本土化的重要性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为全球南方媒体专业人士提供了具体的抵抗策略和工具
2. 为国际组织和民主支持者提供了保护媒体自由的实践指南
3. 为政策制定者提供了建设健康媒体生态系统的建议
4. 为媒体组织提供了在危机中保持独立性和专业性的操作方法

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了印度"部落"概念的演变，从英国殖民时期的负面标签到当代学术和政府话语中的争议性术语，分析了其历史根源和当代影响。
AI.research_question: 印度"部落"概念是如何从英国殖民时期的负面建构演变为当代学术和政府话语中的争议性术语的？
AI.motivation: 印度部落人口占总人口的8.2%，但"部落"这一术语自英国殖民时期就被赋予了野蛮、落后、犯罪等负面含义，这一历史建构至今仍在学术和政府话语中延续，需要批判性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后殖民理论、批判性话语分析、身份政治理论、殖民知识建构理论
AI.method: 历史文献分析、话语分析、档案研究、文本分析（基于Census数据和学术文献）
AI.findings:

title: Quasi-Indexer Institutional Ownership, Information Leakage, And the Economic Value of Innovation
affiliations: The University of Seoul and

detail.title: Quasi-Indexer Institutional Ownership, Information Leakage, And the Economic Value of Innovation
detail.abstract: We examine how quasi-indexer institutional ownership (QIO) affects corporate innovation value. Quasi-indexers monitor minimally but prefer timely, credible disclosure, altering firms' information environments and heightening proprietary risks. Using a market-based patent-value measure from stock-price reactions to patent-grant events and quasi-exogenous Russell index reconstitution variation, we find that higher QIO causally reduces newly granted patent value. This effect stems from disclosure-induced spillovers that erode innovation rent appropriation, not patent output or citation changes. The negative impact concentrates in industries with intense product-market competition, rapid information diffusion, and weak appropriability. These findings reveal passive ownership's unintended consequences for proprietary information and innovation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了准指数机构投资者（QIO）如何影响企业创新价值。研究发现，更高的QIO会通过信息披露引发的溢出效应降低新授权专利的价值，这种负面影响在竞争激烈、信息扩散快、专有性弱的行业中尤为明显。
AI.research_question: 准指数机构投资者（QIO）如何影响企业创新价值？
AI.motivation: 准指数投资者虽然监控较少，但偏好及时、可信的信息披露，这会改变企业的信息环境并增加专有信息风险。需要研究这种被动所有权对企业创新价值的具体影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息披露理论、专有信息风险和机构投资者治理理论，探讨QIO通过信息披露渠道影响创新价值获取的机制。
AI.method: 使用基于股票价格对专利授权事件反应的市场化专利价值度量，并利用罗素指数重构的准外生变化进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 更高的QIO会因果性地降低新授权专利的价值，这种效应源于信息披露引发的溢出效应侵蚀了创新租金获取，而非专利产出或引用量的变化。负面影响集中在产品市场竞争激烈、信息扩散迅速、专有性弱的行业。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了被动所有权对专有信息和创新的意外后果，拓展了机构投资者治理理论，强调了信息披露的双刃剑效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、企业管理者和政策制定者提供了关于被动投资对创新影响的实证证据，有助于理解不同行业背景下信息披露策略的权衡。

title: Intermediary Option Pricing

detail.title: Intermediary Option Pricing
detail.abstract: I propose a novel inventory risk for option dealers ("gap risk"), which helps explain salient features of the option risk premium. I define "gaps" as equity price changes over nights or weekends, when reduced equity market liquidity impedes continuous delta-hedging, thus leading to unhedgeable inventory risk. Gaps function like large jumps, even if prices move continuously. Using comprehensive option trade data, I estimate intermediaries' option inventory and find substantial exposure to gap risk. This finding helps explain why the option risk premium is heavily concentrated over nights and weekends. Supporting a causal impact of intermediary gap risk on the option risk premium, I show that the emergence of overnight equity trading around 2006, led to significantly less option risk premium over week-nights relative to weekends, particularly in options that appear in intermediaries' inventory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的期权做市商库存风险（"缺口风险"），即股票价格在夜间或周末的变动导致无法进行连续Delta对冲的风险。这种风险解释了期权风险溢价主要集中在夜间和周末的现象。
AI.research_question: 期权风险溢价为何主要集中在夜间和周末？做市商的缺口风险如何影响期权定价？
AI.motivation: 传统期权定价模型难以解释期权风险溢价在时间上的不均匀分布，特别是为何风险溢价主要集中在市场关闭的夜间和周末时段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 缺口风险理论：当股票市场流动性降低（如夜间和周末）时，做市商无法进行连续Delta对冲，导致无法对冲的库存风险，这种风险类似于大跳跃风险。
AI.method: 使用全面的期权交易数据估计中介机构的期权库存，分析其缺口风险暴露程度。利用2006年左右出现的夜间股票交易作为自然实验，比较周末和夜间风险溢价的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 做市商存在显著的缺口风险暴露；2. 期权风险溢价主要集中在夜间和周末；3. 2006年夜间股票交易出现后，夜间风险溢价相对于周末显著减少，特别是在做市商库存中的期权。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"缺口风险"这一新概念，解释了期权风险溢价的时间分布特征，为理解做市商库存风险对期权定价的影响提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者更好地理解期权定价的时间特征，为做市商的风险管理提供指导，特别是针对无法连续对冲时段的库存风险管理。

detail.abstract: The rise of real-world asset (RWA) tokenization-converting property, bonds, or commodities into blockchain-based tokens-and its integration with decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols is altering how liquidity is created, credit is intermediated, and monetary signals propagate through the financial system. Rather than replacing central banks, these innovations are rerouting traditional channels: for example, tokenized Treasury bonds on Ethereum now serve as collateral in DeFi lending pools, effectively creating parallel money markets outside regulated banking. This paper investigates the mechanisms through which tokenization and DeFi interact with-and strain-existing monetary and regulatory frameworks. Using a mixed-methods approach (quantitative analysis of on-chain RWA flows, plus interviews with central bankers, fintechs, and supervisors in the EU, Singapore, and Brazil), we ask: (1) How does RWA-backed liquidity in DeFi respond to interest rate changes compared to traditional repo markets? (2) To what extent do DeFi protocols substitute for-or complement-bank intermediation for SMEs? (3) Where do current regulatory perimeters fail to capture systemic linkages (e.g., stablecoin runs affecting tokenized bond markets)? Early evidence suggests that while RWA tokenization can improve market access, it also fragments liquidity and weakens conventional policy transmission-especially when stablecoins (e.g., USDC) become de facto settlement layers. We propose a "functional equivalence" regulatory approach: supervise activities by economic function (e.g., maturity transformation, liquidity provision), not legal form. This work provides timely, empirically grounded input for central banks and regulators navigating the co-evolution of digital and traditional finance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究现实世界资产（RWA）代币化与DeFi结合如何改变金融体系，发现虽然能改善市场准入，但也导致流动性碎片化并削弱传统政策传导，提出按经济功能而非法律形式监管的"功能等效"方法。
AI.research_question: 1. RWA支持的DeFi流动性对利率变化的反应与传统回购市场相比如何？2. DeFi协议在多大程度上替代或补充银行对中小企业的中介作用？3. 当前监管边界在何处未能捕捉系统性关联（如稳定币挤兑影响代币化债券市场）？
AI.motivation: 现实世界资产代币化与DeFi协议的结合正在改变流动性创造、信贷中介和货币信号传导的方式，这些创新正在重新定向传统渠道，需要研究其与现有货币和监管框架的互动关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代币化金融理论、DeFi协议设计、货币传导机制、监管套利理论、功能等效监管框架。
AI.method: 混合方法：RWA链上流动性的定量分析，加上对欧盟、新加坡和巴西的央行官员、金融科技公司和监管机构的访谈。
AI.findings: 早期证据表明，RWA代币化虽然能改善市场准入，但也导致流动性碎片化并削弱传统政策传导，特别是当稳定币（如USDC）成为事实上的结算层时。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"功能等效"监管框架的理论基础，强调按经济功能而非法律形式进行监管，为理解数字与传统金融共同演化提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和监管机构提供了及时、基于实证的决策参考，帮助他们应对数字金融与传统金融共同演化带来的挑战，特别是在监管边界模糊和系统性风险识别方面。

title: Vague Knowledge: Information without Transitivity and Partitions
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology, Department of Accounting

detail.title: Vague Knowledge: Information without Transitivity and Partitions
detail.abstract: I relax the standard assumptions of transitivity and partition structure in economic models of information to formalize vague knowledge—non-transitive indistinguishability over states. I show that vague knowledge, while failing to partition the state space, remains informative by distinguishing some states from others. Moreover, it can only be faithfully expressed through vague communication with blurred boundaries. My results provide microfoundations for the prevalence of natural language communication and qualitative reasoning in the real world, where knowledge is often vague.

AI.tldr: 该论文放松了经济学信息模型中的传递性和划分结构标准假设，形式化了模糊知识（状态间的非传递性不可区分性）。作者证明模糊知识虽然不能划分状态空间，但仍具有信息价值，并能通过模糊沟通表达。这为现实世界中普遍存在的自然语言沟通和定性推理提供了微观基础。
AI.research_question: 模糊知识如何影响经济决策和信息传递？模糊知识能否在非传递性不可区分性的情况下仍提供有价值的信息？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的知识往往是模糊的，但传统经济学模型假设信息具有传递性和划分结构，这与自然语言沟通和定性推理的实际不符。需要建立能够解释模糊知识的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学、知识表示理论、模糊逻辑、非传递性关系理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过放松传统假设（传递性和划分结构），形式化模糊知识的概念，并分析其信息属性和沟通要求
AI.findings: 1. 模糊知识虽然不能划分状态空间，但仍能区分某些状态；2. 模糊知识只能通过具有模糊边界的沟通方式忠实表达；3. 这解释了自然语言沟通在现实世界中的普遍性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了模糊知识的形式化定义；2. 建立了非传递性不可区分性的理论框架；3. 为自然语言沟通和定性推理提供了微观经济基础；4. 扩展了信息经济学对模糊信息的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助理解现实世界中的沟通行为；2. 为处理模糊信息的决策模型提供理论基础；3. 解释了为什么定性推理在实际决策中普遍存在；4. 为设计更贴近现实的沟通机制提供洞见

title: Tailoring Tails within the mixture model framework
affiliations: University of Cape Town (UCT)

detail.title: Tailoring Tails within the mixture model framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare

detail.abstract: In earlier publications we have proposed method for efficiently and accurately computing conditional expected values and generating synthetic market data. The techniques were based on Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM). In this paper we extend the methods to incorporate modelling fat tailed distributions. In particular we consider two variants of the modelling setup which allows for extending the GMM framework to increase the tail probability of an existing GMM and consider distributional families that are fat tailed. The main goal is to keep the semi-analytic tractability and ease of simulation. In this paper we show that for the introduced models the tractability of the GMM approach is maintained while the scope of applicability is widened.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了基于高斯混合模型（GMM）的条件期望值计算和市场数据生成方法，通过引入两种变体模型来处理厚尾分布，同时保持了半解析可处理性和模拟便利性。
AI.research_question: 如何扩展基于高斯混合模型（GMM）的条件期望值计算和市场数据生成方法，以有效建模厚尾分布，同时保持方法的半解析可处理性和模拟便利性？
AI.motivation: 现有基于GMM的方法虽然高效准确，但无法充分捕捉金融数据中的厚尾特征，限制了其在真实市场环境中的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高斯混合模型（GMM）框架，厚尾分布理论，条件期望计算理论，概率分布扩展方法。
AI.method: 提出两种GMM扩展变体：1）增加现有GMM尾部概率的方法；2）采用厚尾分布族的方法。保持半解析可处理性和模拟便利性。
AI.findings: 所提出的扩展模型在保持GMM方法可处理性的同时，成功拓宽了其适用范围，能够有效建模厚尾分布。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了GMM框架以处理厚尾分布；2）提出了两种保持半解析可处理性的厚尾建模方法；3）丰富了条件期望计算的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为金融风险管理提供更准确的市场数据生成工具；2）增强了对极端市场事件的建模能力；3）保持了计算效率和模拟便利性，便于实际应用。

reference: Fostering human creativity and critical thinking in the age of artificial intelligence for a better future, pp. 100-104
title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AIs) INFLUENCE ON DECISION MAKING
affiliations: Bheemi Reddy Institute of Management Science, SRN Adarsh College and Bheema Institute of Technology & Science

detail.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AIs) INFLUENCE ON DECISION MAKING

publicationDetails.detailsText: Fostering human creativity and critical thinking in the age of artificial intelligence for a better future, pp. 100-104

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is shaping the decision making process among various domains like health care, business, education and manufacturing. The aim of the study is to investigate trust of academicians in AI in different academic tasks. A structured questionnaire was designed to assess various AI indicators. The data was collected through the online responses using convenience sampling. Collected data is analysed through Jamovi (version 2. 3.28). The study statistically proved that AI familiarity correlates with trust (p=0.001), it means increased familiarity with the AI leads to greater trust in its decision-making.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过问卷调查发现，学者对人工智能的熟悉程度与其对AI决策的信任度呈正相关关系（p=0.001），即越熟悉AI的学者对其决策越信任。
AI.research_question: 学者在不同学术任务中对人工智能的信任程度如何？AI熟悉度是否影响学者对AI决策的信任？
AI.motivation: AI正在医疗、商业、教育、制造等多个领域影响决策过程，但学者群体对AI在学术任务中的信任度尚不明确，需要研究了解这一关键用户群体的态度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型、信任理论、人机交互理论，重点关注熟悉度与信任之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用结构化问卷评估多个AI指标，通过便利抽样在线收集数据，使用Jamovi（版本2.3.28）进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 研究统计证明AI熟悉度与信任呈正相关（p=0.001），即对AI越熟悉，对其决策的信任度越高。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在学术环境中熟悉度与AI信任的正相关关系，为技术接受和信任理论在AI领域的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构和AI开发者提供了重要启示：通过增加学者对AI的熟悉度可以提升他们对AI工具的信任和采纳，有助于AI在学术领域的有效应用。

title: The Ethical Foundations of Economics: Beyond the Myth of Value-Free Social Science
affiliations: Afrindependent Institute

detail.title: The Ethical Foundations of Economics: Beyond the Myth of Value-Free Social Science
detail.abstract: This paper challenges the prevailing claim that economics and other social sciences can or should be “value-free”—a notion rooted in Western positivist, materialist, and utilitarian philosophical frameworks. These frameworks, by excluding ethics from theory and policy formulation, have produced a legacy of dehumanizing, coercive, and often destructive systems. The result is an academic and policy tradition that enables fraud, force, and exploitation under the veneer of scientific neutrality. Africonomics offers a human-centered alternative: a principled approach that affirms the centrality of truth, justice, and nonaggression in human relations and institutions. Instead of treating humans as mechanistic, amoral actors, Africonomics recognizes the dignity, agency, and ethical discernment inherent to human nature. This paper demonstrates that ethical foundations are not only compatible with scientific rigor but essential to it. Without them, economics becomes pseudoscience, and its models lead to systemic injustice, economic disarray, and social decay. An ethically grounded economics, aligned with natural-moral law, can fulfill its proper purpose of advancing justice, prosperity, and peaceful human relations within and among societies. Africonomics provides the philosophical and moral foundation for such an approach and charts a transformative path forward for African nations and the world.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了经济学和社会科学应"价值中立"的主流观点，认为西方实证主义、物质主义和功利主义框架排除了伦理考量，导致了非人化、强制性和破坏性的制度。作者提出Africonomics作为以人为本的替代方案，强调真理、正义和非侵略原则在人类关系和制度中的核心地位，认为伦理基础不仅与科学严谨性兼容，而且是其必要条件。
AI.research_question: 经济学和其他社会科学是否能够或应该保持"价值中立"？伦理基础是否与科学严谨性兼容？Africonomics如何为非洲国家和世界提供替代性的经济哲学框架？
AI.motivation: 西方实证主义、物质主义和功利主义哲学框架将伦理排除在理论和政策制定之外，导致了非人化、强制性和破坏性的制度。这种"价值中立"的学术和政策传统在科学中立的外表下助长了欺诈、强制和剥削。需要一种以人为本的替代方案来纠正这一缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 对西方实证主义、物质主义和功利主义哲学框架的批判；2. Africonomics理论框架，强调以人为本、伦理基础和自然道德法；3. 真理、正义和非侵略原则作为人类关系和制度的核心；4. 人类尊严、能动性和伦理辨别力的承认。
AI.method: 哲学分析和理论论证方法，通过批判现有理论框架并提出替代性理论框架来进行论证。论文采用规范性分析而非实证研究，通过逻辑推理和哲学论证来支持其主张。
AI.findings: 1. "价值中立"的经济学和社会科学导致了非人化、强制性和破坏性的制度；2. 伦理基础不仅与科学严谨性兼容，而且是其必要条件；3. 没有伦理基础的经济学成为伪科学，其模型导致系统性不正义、经济混乱和社会衰退；4. Africonomics提供了以人为本的替代方案，能够促进正义、繁荣和和平的人类关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了经济学和社会科学"价值中立"的主流范式；2. 提出了Africonomics作为替代性理论框架；3. 论证了伦理基础与科学严谨性的兼容性和必要性；4. 建立了以人为本的经济学哲学基础；5. 为非洲国家和世界提供了转型路径的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了伦理基础的经济学框架；2. 为非洲国家提供了适合其文化背景的发展路径；3. 为解决系统性不正义、经济混乱和社会衰退提供了理论指导；4. 为促进正义、繁荣和和平的人类关系提供了实践方向；5. 为学术界和政策界提供了反思和改革现有制度的理论基础。

title: Money and Banking
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Money and Banking
detail.abstract: This module provides an in-depth exploration of money, banking, and financial systems, with strong emphasis on Rwanda’s rapidly transforming financial sector. Students examine traditional and modern concepts of money, the structure and regulation of financial institutions, and national monetary policy operations as implemented by the National Bank of Rwanda (BNR). The module integrates global theoretical frameworks with Rwandan policy realities such as financial inclusion initiatives, digital payment ecosystems, exchange rate policy, and financial sector reforms under Vision 2050.

AI.tldr: 该模块深入探讨货币、银行和金融体系，重点关注卢旺达快速转型的金融部门，将全球理论框架与卢旺达政策现实相结合。
AI.research_question: 如何将全球货币银行理论框架应用于卢旺达金融部门的转型实践？
AI.motivation: 卢旺达金融部门正在快速转型，需要将全球金融理论与当地政策现实相结合，以支持金融包容性、数字支付生态系统和金融部门改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统与现代货币概念、金融体系结构理论、金融机构监管理论、货币政策操作理论、金融包容性理论。
AI.method: 模块化教学法，结合理论讲授与卢旺达案例研究，分析卢旺达国家银行（BNR）的政策操作和实践。
AI.findings: 全球金融理论框架可以有效地应用于卢旺达金融转型实践，特别是在金融包容性倡议、数字支付生态系统、汇率政策和金融部门改革方面。
AI.theory_contributions: 将全球货币银行理论与发展中国家金融转型实践相结合，丰富了金融发展理论在非洲新兴经济体的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卢旺达金融部门改革提供理论指导，支持Vision 2050战略实施，培养理解全球理论与本地实践的金融专业人才。

title: Reconstructing Algorithmic Trading in the Age of Generative AI: Implications for Market Structure, Regulation, and Epistemology
affiliations: Externado de Colombia University

detail.title: Reconstructing Algorithmic Trading in the Age of Generative AI: Implications for Market Structure, Regulation, and Epistemology
detail.abstract:
Accepted for publication at Revista Emercatoria December 2025

The purpose of this article is to analyse how generative artificial intelligence (Gen AI)– defined here as systems capable of producing novel outputs, such as text, code, or data, through machine learning– is transforming algorithmic trading. Gen AI enhances computational efficiency but also reconfigures the epistemological (theories of knowledge), institutional (market structures and actors), and regulatory (rules and oversight) foundations of financial markets. We contend that Gen AI ushers in a shift from price as a representation of economic fundamentals to price as a recursive output of machine-to-machine simulation. Drawing on lessons from financial machine learning, critical legal theory, political economy, and the sociology of finance, we study how generative models– such as transformer-based architectures (deep learning models initially developed for natural language processing) and synthetic data engines (tools generating artificial datasets)– reshape the logic of price discovery, liquidity provision, and risk assessment. Our analysis shows that Gen – AI intensifies market abstraction, undermines traditional regulatory assumptions, and consolidates informational power among a narrow elite of technologically sophisticated actors. It sheds light on epistemic opacity, feedback loops, and algorithmic reflexivity. These features compromise both market intelligibility and regulatory legitimacy. We also pay particular attention to how these dynamics exacerbate global inequalities. This happens through infrastructure asymmetries and imports regulatory templates that marginalize the global south.We conclude by urging the implementation of new regulations that prioritize clarity, accountability, and digital control. We suggest reforms such as public model registries, participatory audits, and open algorithmic infrastructure to restore democratic oversight in markets increasingly run by code. Our goal is to reposition algorithmic trading as a central arena for debates about value, governance, and economic reality in synthetic finance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析生成式人工智能如何改变算法交易，从价格作为经济基本面表征转向机器间模拟的递归输出，加剧市场抽象化、削弱传统监管假设，并巩固技术精英的信息权力，同时加剧全球不平等。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何改变算法交易，并重构金融市场的认识论、制度和监管基础？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在提升计算效率的同时，正在重塑金融市场的知识理论、市场结构和监管框架，需要系统分析其对价格发现、流动性提供和风险评估逻辑的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合金融机器学习、批判法律理论、政治经济学和金融社会学，分析生成式模型（如基于Transformer的架构和合成数据引擎）如何重塑金融市场逻辑。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于多学科视角（金融机器学习、批判法律理论、政治经济学、金融社会学）对生成式AI在算法交易中的影响进行系统性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 生成式AI加剧市场抽象化，使价格从经济基本面表征转变为机器间模拟的递归输出；2. 削弱传统监管假设；3. 巩固技术精英的信息权力；4. 产生认识论不透明性、反馈循环和算法自反性；5. 通过基础设施不对称和监管模板进口加剧全球不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出生成式AI驱动的算法交易从"价格作为基本面表征"到"价格作为机器模拟递归输出"的范式转变；2. 揭示算法交易中的认识论不透明性和算法自反性；3. 将算法交易重新定位为合成金融中价值、治理和经济现实辩论的核心领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议实施优先考虑透明度、问责制和数字控制的新监管框架；2. 提出具体改革措施：公共模型注册表、参与式审计、开放算法基础设施；3. 呼吁恢复由代码运行的市场的民主监督。

title: Does the new quality productivity enhance the trade and investment promotion effect of the construction of   China pilot free trade zone?
affiliations: Guangxi University, Guangxi University,  and

detail.title: Does the new quality productivity enhance the trade and investment promotion effect of the construction of   China pilot free trade zone?
detail.abstract: Constructing the foreign trade and investment index of the pilot free trade zone (PFTZ) to measure the foreign trade and investment of the cities in the zone, it is found that the foreign trade and investment of the cities in the zone of China Pilot Free Trade Zone show a steady upward trend, with the highest level in the eastern coastal cities, followed by the inland cities, and lastly the cities along the borders. Based on the theoretical analysis and research hypothesis of the relationship between the construction of the pilot free trade zone and the city's foreign trade and investment, as well as the role of the new quality productivity in it, the generalized synthetic control method is used to evaluate and find that the construction of the pilot free trade zone has a significant promoting effect on the expansion of the foreign trade and investment activities of the cities in the area. Further empirical analysis with the adjustment effect model shows that the development of new quality productivity, including the new quality labor force, new quality labor object and new quality production means, significantly improves the promotion effect, and the new quality labor force has the largest effect. The study also found that there is regional variability in the promotion effect of new quality productivity, and the promotion effect of new quality productivity is more significant in the eastern coastal region. In addition, the promotion effect of the three components of new quality productivity is also regionally heterogeneous. Finally, based on the above analysis, the study proposes to accelerate the construction of the pilot free trade zone to promote the further development of foreign trade and investment in the cities in the zone; to promote the development of new quality productivity; and to strengthen regional development and coordination based on the differentiated characteristics of different regions.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了自贸试验区外贸投资指数，发现中国自贸试验区城市外贸投资呈稳步上升趋势，东部沿海最高，内陆次之，边境城市最低。研究发现自贸试验区建设对区内城市外贸投资活动有显著促进作用，新质生产力（新质劳动力、新质劳动对象、新质生产手段）显著增强这一促进作用，其中新质劳动力作用最大。效应存在区域异质性，东部沿海地区更显著。
AI.research_question: 自贸试验区建设如何影响区内城市的外贸投资活动？新质生产力在其中扮演什么角色？这种影响是否存在区域差异？
AI.motivation: 随着中国自贸试验区建设的推进，需要评估其对区内城市外贸投资的实际影响，并探讨新质生产力在其中的作用机制，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自贸试验区建设与城市外贸投资关系的理论分析，以及新质生产力（包括新质劳动力、新质劳动对象、新质生产手段）在其中作用的研究假设。
AI.method: 构建自贸试验区外贸投资指数；使用广义合成控制法评估自贸试验区建设对城市外贸投资的影响；采用调节效应模型分析新质生产力的作用。
AI.findings: 1. 自贸试验区城市外贸投资呈稳步上升趋势，东部沿海最高，内陆次之，边境城市最低；2. 自贸试验区建设对区内城市外贸投资有显著促进作用；3. 新质生产力显著增强这一促进作用，其中新质劳动力作用最大；4. 新质生产力的促进作用存在区域异质性，东部沿海地区更显著；5. 新质生产力三个组成部分的促进作用也存在区域异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了自贸试验区外贸投资指数；2. 验证了自贸试验区建设对城市外贸投资的理论机制；3. 揭示了新质生产力在自贸试验区建设与外贸投资关系中的调节作用；4. 发现了区域异质性效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议加快自贸试验区建设以促进外贸投资发展；2. 建议推动新质生产力发展；3. 建议根据不同区域差异化特征加强区域发展与协调。

title: Do global investors weather the storm? Evidence from mainland China and Hong Kong stock markets
affiliations: Independent, Xiamen University Malaysia Campus, Xiamen University Malaysia and Faculty of Business Administration and Accountancy, Khon Kaen University

detail.title: Do global investors weather the storm? Evidence from mainland China and Hong Kong stock markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: This study is supported by the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia through the Fundamental Research Grant Scheme (FRGS) (Project number: FRGS/1/2020/SS01/XMU/02/1), and by the Xiamen University Malaysia Research Fund (Grant No: XMUMRF/2024-C13/ISEM/0047)

detail.abstract: This study examines the influence of extreme weather events on stock market behavior in China, focusing on the Shanghai and Hong Kong Stock Exchanges. This article’s hypothesis is that local weather affects individual investors in Shanghai more significantly due to their short-term, speculative trading habits. In contrast, institutional investors in Hong Kong are less influenced by short-term considerations due to their long-term strategies and access to resources. The Glosten-Jagannathan-Runkle Generalized AutoRegressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GJR-GARCH) estimator can test the hypothesis under different market conditions and volatility clustering. The analysis utilizes daily financial and meteorological data from January 1, 2009, to December 31, 2023. The GJR-GARCH estimator incorporates variables such as air pressure, humidity, sunshine hours, and temperature. The results show that extreme weather has a more pronounced effect on the Shanghai market than the Hong Kong market. Furthermore, extreme weather events influence stock turnover and volatility more than stock returns, reflecting shifts in investment behavior. The hypothesis is further tested to determine whether it remains valid during bull and bear markets, which are emotionally charged periods. The hypothesis still holds, albeit with less pronounced effects. Thus, extreme weather can impact stock market performance, with the composition of investors playing a significant role.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨极端天气事件对中国股市行为的影响，重点关注上海和香港证券交易所。研究发现，由于上海个人投资者的短期投机交易习惯，当地天气对他们的影响更为显著；而香港的机构投资者因长期策略和资源获取能力，受短期因素影响较小。极端天气对股票成交量和波动性的影响大于对收益率的影响。
AI.research_question: 极端天气事件如何影响中国股市行为？这种影响在上海和香港市场之间是否存在差异？投资者构成（个人投资者vs机构投资者）是否在天气对股市影响中起调节作用？
AI.motivation: 理解极端天气对金融市场的影响日益重要，特别是在气候变化背景下。中国作为全球第二大经济体，其股市行为受天气影响的研究相对有限。上海和香港市场具有不同的投资者结构，为研究天气对不同类型投资者行为的影响提供了理想对比。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论（特别是情绪影响投资决策）、投资者异质性理论、市场微观结构理论。研究基于"天气影响投资者情绪，进而影响交易行为"的核心逻辑框架。
AI.method: 采用GJR-GARCH（Glosten-Jagannathan-Runkle广义自回归条件异方差）模型，纳入气压、湿度、日照时数、温度等气象变量。使用2009年1月1日至2023年12月31日的日度金融和气象数据，分别对上海和香港市场进行分析，并在牛市和熊市期间进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1. 极端天气对上海市场的影响比香港市场更显著；2. 极端天气对股票成交量和波动性的影响大于对股票收益率的影响；3. 在牛市和熊市期间，假设仍然成立但效应减弱；4. 投资者构成在天气对股市影响中起重要调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了行为金融学在天气效应领域的应用；2. 提供了投资者异质性在天气影响股市中的理论解释；3. 丰富了新兴市场金融行为研究；4. 为天气与金融市场关系的理论模型提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供天气风险管理的参考；2. 为市场监管者理解市场波动提供新视角；3. 为资产管理公司制定投资策略时考虑天气因素提供依据；4. 为气候风险纳入金融风险评估提供实证基础。

title: Attention as Currency: Rethinking Relevant Market Analysis in Digital Competition Law
affiliations: O. P. Jindal Global University - Jindal Global Law School (JGLS) and O. P. Jindal Global University, Jindal Global Law School

detail.title: Attention as Currency: Rethinking Relevant Market Analysis in Digital Competition Law
detail.abstract:
Digital platforms today operate largely on zero-price business models where users do not pay with money, but with their time and attention. Traditional competition law tools, especially price-based tests such as the SSNIP, therefore struggle to capture market power and competitive harm in these markets. This paper argues that attention, rather than price or data, is the true unit of competition in digital ecosystems and should be treated as an independent and relevant market for antitrust analysis.

The paper first explains how attention functions as a scarce and tradeable economic resource and why the conventional characterisation of platforms as two-sided markets obscures real competitive dynamics. It then critiques the proposed alternatives to SSNIP, particularly the SSNIC and SSNDQ tests, and shows how their theoretical foundations remain flawed in zero-price and attention-driven markets. Building on these gaps, the paper proposes a fresh analytical framework centred on three new tools: the SSAINT (Small but Significant Attention Increase Non-Transient Test) for market definition, the Attention Elasticity of Substitution (AES) for measuring competitive pressure, and the Attention Switching Cost Index (ASCI) for assessing user lock-in.

Through case studies including WhatsApp, Google Android, and Meta/Giphy, the paper demonstrates how an attention-based approach better captures ecosystem dominance, network effects, and non-price harms that conventional tools often miss. It concludes by suggesting that competition law must formally recognise attention as an economic currency if it is to remain effective in regulating digital platform power

AI.tldr: 该论文提出注意力是数字生态系统中的真正竞争单位，应作为独立的相关市场进行反垄断分析。作者批判了传统的价格测试工具（如SSNIP）在零价格商业模式中的局限性，并提出了基于注意力的新分析框架：SSAINT测试用于市场界定、AES用于测量竞争压力、ASCI用于评估用户锁定。
AI.research_question: 在数字平台采用零价格商业模式的背景下，如何有效识别市场力量和竞争损害？注意力是否应被视为独立的竞争单位和相关市场？
AI.motivation: 传统竞争法工具（特别是基于价格的测试如SSNIP）难以捕捉零价格数字市场中的市场力量和竞争损害，因为这些平台用户不支付金钱而是支付时间和注意力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力作为稀缺可交易经济资源；批判传统双边市场理论对真实竞争动态的遮蔽；批判SSNIC和SSNDQ等替代测试的理论缺陷。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，提出三个新工具：SSAINT（市场界定）、AES（竞争压力测量）、ASCI（用户锁定评估）；通过WhatsApp、Google Android、Meta/Giphy等案例研究验证。
AI.findings: 注意力为基础的方法能更好地捕捉生态系统主导地位、网络效应和非价格损害；传统工具往往忽视这些方面；注意力应被视为经济货币。
AI.theory_contributions: 将注意力确立为数字生态系统中的核心竞争单位；提出全新的注意力基础分析框架；挑战传统双边市场理论在数字平台中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争执法机构提供实用的注意力基础分析工具；帮助更好地监管数字平台权力；通过案例研究展示新框架的实际应用价值。

title: Impact of biochar and inorganic fertilizers rates on yield and yield components of maize at Bako Western Ethiopia
affiliations: Ethiopian Institute of Agricultural Research, Haramaya University, Haramaya University and Ethiopian Institute of Agricultural Research

detail.title: Impact of biochar and inorganic fertilizers rates on yield and yield components of maize at Bako Western Ethiopia
detail.abstract: Soil acidity is a major constraint to maize production in western Ethiopia, where maize serves as the principal staple crop. This problem severely limits yield, threatening food security and farmers’ livelihoods. To mitigate soil acidity and enhance maize productivity, this study evaluated the combined application of biochar and inorganic fertilizers. A two-year field experiment (2023/24 and 2024/25) was conducted at Bako, western Ethiopia, using a randomized complete block design (RCBD) arranged in a factorial with three replications. Treatments included three rates of biochar (0, 5, and 10 t ha⁻¹), nitrogen (0, 46, and 92 kg ha⁻¹), and phosphorus (0, 34.5, and 69 kg ha⁻¹ P₂O₅). Key agronomic parameters were measured to assess treatment effects. The results revealed that the combined application of biochar and inorganic fertilizers significantly enhanced maize growth and yield. The treatment with 5 t ha⁻¹ biochar, 92 kg N ha⁻¹, and 69 kg P₂O₅ ha⁻¹ produced the highest grain yield (7.2 t ha⁻¹), leaf area index (3.3), number of kernels per ear (462.2), thousand-kernel weight (428.3 g), and total biomass (23.7 t ha⁻¹). The synergistic use of biochar and fertilizers improved soil fertility and reduced acidity, leading to increased productivity. These findings highlight the potential of integrated nutrient management combining biochar and inorganic fertilizers to improve maize yield and soil fertility in acidic soils of western Ethiopia. The application of 5 t ha⁻¹ biochar with 92 kg N and 69 kg P₂O₅ per hectare is recommended as the optimal combination for maize production in acid-prone areas. Extension and demonstration activities are essential to promote farmer awareness and adoption of this integrated approach.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了生物炭与无机肥料联合施用对埃塞俄比亚西部酸性土壤中玉米生产的影响。研究发现，5 t ha⁻¹生物炭、92 kg N ha⁻¹和69 kg P₂O₅ ha⁻¹的组合处理能显著提高玉米产量和土壤肥力，是该地区酸性土壤玉米生产的最佳推荐方案。
AI.research_question: 生物炭与无机肥料联合施用如何影响埃塞俄比亚西部酸性土壤中的玉米生长和产量？
AI.motivation: 土壤酸度是埃塞俄比亚西部玉米生产的主要限制因素，严重制约产量，威胁粮食安全和农民生计。需要寻找有效的土壤改良和生产力提升方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于土壤改良和养分管理理论，特别是生物炭改善土壤理化性质、提高养分利用效率的作用机制，以及综合养分管理在酸性土壤改良中的应用。
AI.method: 采用随机完全区组设计（RCBD）的两年田间试验（2023/24和2024/25），在埃塞俄比亚西部Bako进行。处理包括三个生物炭水平（0、5、10 t ha⁻¹）、三个氮水平（0、46、92 kg ha⁻¹）和三个磷水平（0、34.5、69 kg P₂O₅ ha⁻¹），三次重复。测量关键农艺参数评估处理效果。
AI.findings: 生物炭与无机肥料联合施用显著提高玉米生长和产量。5 t ha⁻¹生物炭、92 kg N ha⁻¹和69 kg P₂O₅ ha⁻¹处理获得最高产量（7.2 t ha⁻¹）、叶面积指数（3.3）、每穗粒数（462.2）、千粒重（428.3 g）和总生物量（23.7 t ha⁻¹）。协同作用改善了土壤肥力并降低了酸度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为酸性土壤改良提供了生物炭与无机肥料协同作用的实证证据，丰富了综合养分管理理论在热带酸性土壤中的应用，揭示了生物炭改善土壤环境和提高养分利用效率的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 推荐5 t ha⁻¹生物炭、92 kg N ha⁻¹和69 kg P₂O₅ ha⁻¹作为埃塞俄比亚西部酸性土壤玉米生产的最佳组合。建议通过推广和示范活动提高农民对这一综合方法的认识和采用率，以改善粮食安全和农民生计。

detail.abstract: In addition to aggressive tariffs, the prevailing view is that the second Trump administration's restrictions on China will be broader and more aggressive, including export controls on technologies such as semiconductors, restrictions on Chinese investment in the US (particularly in technology, critical infrastructure, healthcare, agriculture, energy, and commodities), restrictions on US companies investing in China, and restrictions on access to government procurement markets. Indeed, President Trump, who took office on January 20, imposed 10% tariffs on China from February 4, with another 10% to follow on March 4. In response, China added 15% tariffs on US coal and LNG products, and 10% tariffs on crude oil, agricultural machinery, heavy vehicles, and pickup trucks on February 10, and is considering retaliatory measures targeting agricultural and food products, according to Chinese state media. In response to these US regulatory measures, China has maintained a relatively consistent position. China wishes for a mutually beneficial and winwin relationship with the US, and should not choose confrontation and conflict. In line with this stance, when the US announces sanctions against China, China has taken reactive and defensive measures in response. (The rest omitted.)

title:
Skies of Suspicion
Global Chemtrail Narratives in an Age of Anxiety
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
Skies of Suspicion
Global Chemtrail Narratives in an Age of Anxiety
detail.abstract:
Chemtrail conspiracy theories persist not because they possess explanatory power,
but because they convert environmental uncertainty and psychological vulnerability
into structured narratives of intentional control. Across continents̶from Brazil to
Germany, Kenya to India̶ordinary contrails are reinterpreted as evidence of
chemical spraying, population engineering or state-orchestrated climate
manipulation. This article examines why these beliefs endure despite overwhelming
scientific consensus. Drawing on recent studies from MIT Media Lab, Ipsos Global,
and the Cambridge Conspiracy Cognition Project, it argues that the proliferation of
chemtrail narratives emerges at the intersection of digital algorithmic amplification,
institutional mistrust, and growing climatic anxiety. High-arousal misinformation
spreads through social platforms at rates nearly quadruple that of neutral content,
allowing visually dramatic contrail images to flourish within online echo chambers.
Psychological research indicates that conspiratorial ideation increases during
periods of uncertainty, where individuals prefer narratives of deliberate
orchestration over confronting randomness or lack of control. The chemtrail theory
thus functions as an emotional coping mechanism: a symbolic framework that
transforms fear of environmental instability into accusations of human agency. The
article explores this dynamic as a global cultural phenomenon, tracing how
communities engage in collective meaning-making that reinforces belief systems
through shared decoding rituals. Ultimately, chemtrail persistence reveals a broader
crisis in public reasoning, where societal fragmentation and digital noise erode the
authority of scientific explanation, allowing conspiratorial worldviews to thrive
under the illusion of mastery, clarity, and control.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了"化学尾迹"阴谋论为何持续存在，认为其并非因其解释力，而是因为它将环境不确定性和心理脆弱性转化为有意的控制叙事。文章分析了数字算法放大、制度不信任和气候焦虑如何共同推动这些信念的传播。
AI.research_question: 为什么化学尾迹阴谋论在压倒性科学共识下仍然持续存在？
AI.motivation: 化学尾迹阴谋论在全球范围内持续存在，从巴西到德国、肯尼亚到印度，普通凝结尾迹被重新解释为化学喷洒、人口工程或国家主导的气候操纵的证据。这种现象反映了公众推理的危机，需要理解其背后的社会心理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合数字算法放大理论、制度不信任理论、气候焦虑心理学以及阴谋认知理论，分析化学尾迹信念作为情感应对机制的功能。
AI.method: 综合分析法，借鉴MIT媒体实验室、益普索全球调查和剑桥阴谋认知项目的研究成果，结合心理学研究和数字传播分析。
AI.findings: 1. 高唤醒度的错误信息在社交平台上的传播速度是中性内容的近四倍；2. 视觉上引人注目的凝结尾迹图像在在线回音室中蓬勃发展；3. 不确定性时期阴谋思维会增加；4. 化学尾迹理论作为情感应对机制，将环境不稳定的恐惧转化为对人类能动性的指责。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了化学尾迹信念作为全球文化现象的分析框架；2. 揭示了数字算法放大、制度不信任和气候焦虑的交叉作用机制；3. 发展了阴谋论作为情感应对机制的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为应对错误信息传播提供策略建议；2. 帮助理解公众科学认知的障碍；3. 为科学传播和公共教育提供洞见；4. 揭示了社会碎片化和数字噪音如何侵蚀科学解释的权威性。

detail.title: National Budget 2026 (Bulgaria): Higher Salaries in Higher Education, but No Structural Reform -"Helicopter Money"
detail.abstract: This paper critically examines the funding model of Bulgarian higher education in the context of the draft National Budget 2026. Although the budget allocates approximately €767 million to the sector-an increase of nearly 12% compared to 2025-the additional resources are directed primarily toward salaries and recurrent expenditures, without accompanying structural reform. The analysis identifies three systemic weaknesses: (1) the ineffective funding model of state universities, which fails to link subsidies to quality and labor market relevance; (2) persistently low research productivity, reflected in Bulgaria's absence from prestigious international rankings, weak citation impact, and limited technology transfer; and (3) the lack of alignment between university output and labor market demand, resulting in oversupply in low-cost fields and shortages in STEM and medical specialties. The paper argues that increased allocations without reform constitute "helicopter money" and do not enhance efficiency. It recommends three major reforms: (i) replacing the outdated "money follows the student" principle with performance-based financing tied to quality and employability; (ii) strengthening research standards through amendments to the Law on the Development of Academic Staff and raising doctoral requirements; and (iii) aligning higher education provision with labor market needs by operationalizing the National Map of Higher Education. Without such measures, Bulgaria risks continued marginalization in global academic competition and limited contribution of publicly funded science to national economic development.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了保加利亚高等教育在2026年国家预算草案中的资金模式，指出尽管预算增加了12%，但资金主要用于工资和经常性支出，缺乏结构性改革。文章识别了三个系统性弱点：无效的大学资助模式、低研究生产率、高等教育产出与劳动力市场需求不匹配。建议实施绩效导向的资助、加强研究标准、调整高等教育供给与劳动力市场对接。
AI.research_question: 保加利亚高等教育资金模式在2026年国家预算草案背景下存在哪些系统性弱点？如何通过结构性改革提高高等教育效率和劳动力市场相关性？
AI.motivation: 尽管2026年国家预算草案为高等教育部门分配了7.67亿欧元（比2025年增加近12%），但这些额外资源主要流向工资和经常性支出，没有伴随结构性改革。这引发了关于资金使用效率和高等教育系统整体绩效的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高等教育资助理论、绩效导向资助模式、劳动力市场与高等教育对接理论、研究生产率理论、公共资金效率理论
AI.method: 批判性政策分析、预算文件分析、系统性弱点识别、比较分析（国际排名、引用影响、技术转移）、劳动力市场需求与供给匹配分析
AI.findings: 识别出三个系统性弱点：1) 国立大学无效的资助模式，未能将补贴与质量和劳动力市场相关性挂钩；2) 持续低下的研究生产率，表现为在国际排名中缺席、引用影响弱、技术转移有限；3) 大学产出与劳动力市场需求不匹配，导致低成本领域供过于求，STEM和医学专业短缺。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了高等教育资助理论在转型经济体的应用；2) 提出了"直升机资金"概念，描述无结构性改革的资金增加；3) 建立了资金模式、研究生产率和劳动力市场对接之间的系统性联系框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 建议用基于绩效的资助取代过时的"资金跟随学生"原则；2) 建议通过修订《学术人员发展法》和提高博士要求来加强研究标准；3) 建议通过实施国家高等教育地图来调整高等教育供给与劳动力市场需求。

detail.abstract: India is undergoing a rapid digital transformation, driven by rising internet penetration, mobile connectivity, and the expansion of digital financial ser- vices. At the heart of this transformation is Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), a set of digital systems which includes Aadhaar (digital ID), UPI (digital pay- ments), and DigiLocker (digital data storage). These systems serve as the foundation for various digital services, improving financial inclusion, streamlining governance, and enhancing access to social benefits. The government has actively promoted digitalization through initiatives like Dig- ital India, a nationwide program launched in 2015 to expand digital infra- structure, improve online service delivery, and promote digital literacy. How- ever, while these advancements promise inclusive growth, they also raise concerns about the persistence of (digital) inequalities. Gaps in access, af- fordability, and digital literacy continue to exclude large sections of the pop- ulation, particularly in rural areas and among women. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 印度正在经历快速数字化转型，但数字公共基础设施（DPI）在促进包容性增长的同时，也加剧了数字不平等问题，特别是在农村地区和女性群体中。
AI.research_question: 印度数字公共基础设施（DPI）如何影响社会包容性？数字化转型在促进经济增长的同时，如何加剧或缓解数字不平等？
AI.motivation: 印度正在经历由互联网普及、移动连接和数字金融服务扩张驱动的快速数字化转型。政府通过"数字印度"等项目积极推动数字化，但数字不平等问题依然存在，特别是在农村地区和女性群体中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字包容性理论、数字鸿沟理论、数字公共基础设施（DPI）理论、社会技术系统理论
AI.method: 基于文献综述和案例研究的方法，分析印度数字公共基础设施（Aadhaar、UPI、DigiLocker）的实施效果，评估其对金融包容性、治理效率和社会福利的影响。
AI.findings: 数字公共基础设施改善了金融包容性、简化了治理流程、增强了社会福利获取，但数字不平等问题依然存在，表现为接入差距、可负担性问题和数字素养不足，特别是在农村地区和女性群体中。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字公共基础设施理论，提出了数字包容性与数字不平等并存的矛盾现象，丰富了发展中国家数字化转型的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了优化数字公共基础设施设计的建议，强调了解决数字不平等问题的重要性，为其他发展中国家提供了数字化转型的参考案例。

detail.abstract: The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) announced last year that the average global temperature has risen by more than 1.5°C compared to the late 1800s, the pre-industrial era. This exceeds the 1.5°C target set by the 2015 Paris Agreement. Adding to these concerns, the Korea Hy- drographic and Oceanographic Agency reported that the average sea level along the Korean coast has risen by approximately 3.03 mm per year over the past 30 years, with the pace accelerating in recent years. This faster-than-expected progression of climate change makes it one of the most urgent global challenges, requiring international cooperation. (The rest omitted.)

detail.abstract: Earlier this year, following the inauguration of the second Trump administra- tion, one of the most consequential policy decisions was the announcement of significant cuts and halts to expenditures by the United States Agency for International Development (USAID). In addition, the administration initi- ated a sweeping reconstruction that included the integration of USAID into the Department of State and the layoff of thousands of USAID employees and contractors worldwide. As the United States remains the world’s largest donor country, these measures—driven by domestic political debates, fiscal constraints, and shifting foreign policy priorities—have sent shockwaves through the global development community, leaving many recipient coun- tries and crisis zones facing acute uncertainty regarding both ongoing and future support. Several European countries have also announced ODA budget cuts.1 For example, France announced cuts totaling 2.1 billion eu- ros, which is equivalent to a 37% reduction compared to the 2024 figure. Germany’s draft budget proposed a reduction of 836 million euros, repre- senting a 12% decrease from 2024 levels. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 特朗普第二任期宣布大幅削减美国国际开发署预算并将其并入国务院，加上欧洲国家也削减官方发展援助，导致全球发展援助体系面临重大冲击，受援国和危机地区面临不确定性。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府削减美国国际开发署预算并将其并入国务院的政策决策，以及欧洲国家同步削减官方发展援助，对全球发展援助体系产生了何种影响？
AI.motivation: 美国作为全球最大援助国，其政策变化对全球发展援助体系具有决定性影响。特朗普第二任期宣布大幅削减USAID预算并将其并入国务院，加上欧洲主要援助国也削减ODA预算，这一系列变化对全球发展援助格局产生了深远影响，需要系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际发展援助理论、援助有效性理论、援助政治经济学、国际关系理论中的霸权稳定论、国内政治对外交政策影响理论
AI.method: 政策分析、比较案例分析（美国与欧洲国家）、预算数据分析、受影响国家评估
AI.findings: 1. 美国大幅削减USAID预算（具体数字未提供）并将其并入国务院，导致全球发展援助体系出现结构性变化；2. 法国削减21亿欧元（37%）、德国削减8.36亿欧元（12%），欧洲主要援助国同步削减；3. 这些措施导致受援国和危机地区面临严重的资金不确定性；4. 政策变化源于国内政治辩论、财政约束和外交政策优先事项转变
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了援助政治经济学理论，分析国内政治如何影响国际发展援助政策；2. 深化了霸权稳定论在援助领域的应用，探讨主导援助国政策变化对全球体系的影响；3. 提出了援助政策"连锁反应"理论，分析主要援助国政策变化如何引发其他国家的跟随效应
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为受援国提供政策预警，帮助其应对援助资金减少的挑战；2. 为国际发展组织提供战略调整建议；3. 为政策制定者提供关于援助政策连锁效应的实证依据；4. 为危机地区的人道主义援助规划提供参考

detail.abstract: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy * The opinions, findings, conclusions, and recommendations expressed in this article are those of the author(s) and do not necessarily reflect the official policy or position of KIEP. In November 2020, 81 million Americans voted for Joe Biden while 74 million voted for Donald Trump. Yet ask voters from each side what happened that night, and you will hear two irreconcilable stories. For Biden voters, democracy prevailed despite unprecedented attempts to undermine it. For many Trump voters, democracy was subverted through systematic fraud. Five years later, these parallel narratives have not converged—they have hardened into opposing religions. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了2020年美国大选后形成的两种对立叙事如何演变成类似宗教的信仰体系，以及这种政治极化对民主制度的影响。
AI.research_question: 2020年美国大选后形成的两种对立叙事如何演变成类似宗教的信仰体系？这种政治极化对民主制度有何影响？
AI.motivation: 2020年美国大选后，拜登支持者和特朗普支持者形成了两种完全不可调和的政治叙事，这些叙事在五年后不仅没有趋同，反而固化为类似宗教的对立信仰体系，这对民主制度的健康运行构成了严重威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治极化理论、叙事建构理论、社会认同理论、民主制度理论、宗教社会学理论（将政治信仰类比为宗教信仰）
AI.method: 定性分析：文本分析（政治言论、媒体报道）、叙事分析、案例研究（2020年美国大选及其后续发展）、比较分析（两种对立叙事的形成和演变）
AI.findings: 1. 两种对立叙事已固化为类似宗教的信仰体系，具有排他性和不可调和性；2. 这种极化现象对民主制度的共识基础构成严重威胁；3. 政治叙事超越了事实层面，成为身份认同的核心要素；4. 五年时间不仅没有弥合分歧，反而加深了裂痕。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了政治叙事宗教化的理论框架；2. 深化了对政治极化机制的理解；3. 拓展了民主制度危机理论；4. 为理解当代政治认同的形成提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了应对政治极化的参考；2. 揭示了民主制度面临的现实挑战；3. 为媒体和公民社会提供了促进对话的策略建议；4. 对选举制度和政治沟通改革具有启示意义。

detail.abstract: Political rhetoric surrounding tariffs often promotes a deceptively simple narrative, along the lines of: “They’re taxes on foreign countries that fill our Treasury.” This line appeals to the public imagination, conjuring im- ages of wealth flowing into national coffers at the expense of overseas competitors. However, this claim misrepresents how tariffs function and obscures the real economic consequences—consequences that econo- mists have long warned about and that recent empirical research has clearly confirmed. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了关税的政治修辞与现实经济影响之间的差距，指出政治宣传常将关税描绘为"对外国征税以充实国库"的简单叙事，但这掩盖了关税的真实经济后果。
AI.research_question: 关税的政治修辞如何歪曲其实际经济功能？这种修辞与现实经济影响之间存在怎样的差距？
AI.motivation: 政治话语中关于关税的简单化叙事（如"对外国征税以充实国库"）在公众中广泛流传，但这种表述严重歪曲了关税的实际运作机制，掩盖了经济学家长期警告的真实经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学理论、国际贸易理论、公共经济学、修辞分析与经济政策传播理论。
AI.method: 理论分析结合实证研究综述，分析关税的政治修辞与现实经济影响之间的差距。
AI.findings: 关税的政治修辞创造了一种误导性的简单叙事，将关税描绘为对外国的税收和国库收入来源，但这掩盖了关税实际上主要由国内消费者承担、扭曲贸易模式、降低经济效率的真实后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了经济政策修辞与现实经济机制之间的系统性脱节，为理解政治话语如何塑造公众对复杂经济政策的认知提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者、媒体和公众更准确地理解关税的实际经济影响，促进基于证据的经济政策讨论，减少误导性政治修辞对政策决策的影响。

title: Everyday Governance of NbS: How Local Knowledge, Customary Authorities and State Agencies Co-produce Riparian Restoration in the Densu River Basin
affiliations: , Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Ghana and Cranfield University

detail.title: Everyday Governance of NbS: How Local Knowledge, Customary Authorities and State Agencies Co-produce Riparian Restoration in the Densu River Basin
detail.abstract: The effective implementation of nature-based solutions (NbS) in river basins relies critically on navigating complex institutional mechanisms within contexts, typically defined by legal pluralism. This study examines the everyday governance of riparian restoration in Ghana’s Densu River Basin (DRB), a vital ecosystem under severe degradation from illegal mining and pollution. Moving beyond simplistic top-down analyses, we employ a qualitative interpretive case study approach, analyzing interviews from 30 participants across three distinct, yet interacting, governance systems: statutory agencies, customary authorities, and local communities. We utilize a conceptual framework based on the three dimensions of power—structural, instrumental, and discursive—to explain how environmental outcomes are co-produced. Findings reveal a core tension: while high local mobilization and resilient social networks drive synergistic action, corrosive antagonism undermines long-term sustainability. This antagonism stems from the state’s selective use of structural power for exclusion and its consistent use of discursive power to marginalize Local Ecological Knowledge (LEK) as "superstition". fostering a profound legitimacy crisis. We propose a Pluralist Governance Interaction Model, arguing that the success of NbS is conditional upon institutionalizing power-sharing. This requires specific structural reforms, such as permanent committee seats for women and youth and epistemological parity between scientific and traditional knowledge systems, to transform resource asymmetry into durable, equitable environmental co-management.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨加纳Densu河流域基于自然的解决方案实施中的治理挑战，发现结构性排斥和话语权边缘化导致合法性危机，提出通过制度化的权力分享和认识论平等来促进可持续的共管治理。
AI.research_question: 在加纳Densu河流域的法律多元主义背景下，日常治理机制如何影响基于自然的解决方案（NbS）的实施效果？
AI.motivation: NbS的有效实施依赖于复杂的制度机制，而现有研究多采用简单的自上而下分析，忽视了法律多元主义背景下不同治理系统间的互动及其对环境影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于权力的三个维度：结构性权力、工具性权力和话语权，构建分析框架来解释环境结果的共同生产机制。
AI.method: 定性解释性案例研究，分析来自三个相互作用的治理系统（法定机构、传统权威、地方社区）30名参与者的访谈数据。
AI.findings: 研究发现核心张力：虽然地方动员和社会网络驱动协同行动，但腐蚀性对抗削弱长期可持续性。这种对抗源于国家选择性使用结构性权力进行排斥，以及持续使用话语权将地方生态知识边缘化为"迷信"，导致深刻的合法性危机。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"多元治理互动模型"，认为NbS成功取决于制度化的权力分享，强调需要将资源不对称转化为持久、公平的环境共管。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议具体结构性改革：为妇女和青年设立永久委员会席位，实现科学与传统知识系统的认识论平等，以促进可持续的流域治理。

title: Restoring Objective Morality: The Africonomics Refutation of Western Consequentialist Philosophies
affiliations: Afrindependent Institute

detail.title: Restoring Objective Morality: The Africonomics Refutation of Western Consequentialist Philosophies
detail.abstract: This paper examines and refutes the dominance of Western consequentialist philosophies—particularly utilitarianism, materialism, and positivism—that have shaped economics, the broader social sciences, and state policy across the modern world. These frameworks, based on outcome-based reasoning, are fundamentally flawed and dehumanizing. They reduce human beings to instruments of state or collective objectives, denying their inherent dignity, moral agency, and natural rights. Africonomics restores objective morality as the foundation of ethics and social sciences, grounding human action, social order, and governance in natural-moral law principles. By demonstrating that ethical capacity is intrinsic to human life, this paper reestablishes the inseparable unity between morality and civilization. It advances Africonomics as a human-centered, morally grounded alternative to the Western consequentialist and statist paradigm. By affirming the primacy of objective moral principles over expedient outcomes, Africonomics charts a path toward a truly civilized world rooted in respect for human dignity, liberty, and agency.

detail.abstract: As South Korea (hereafter Korea) heads toward its presidential election on June 3, there is growing attention—both at home and abroad—to how the next administration will chart the country’s foreign policy. The strategic landscape has become increasingly volatile, shaped by President Donald Trump’s unilat- eral approach to alliances, intensifying U.S.-China rivalry, and the erosion of multilateral norms. The next president will confront an unprecedentedly com- plex set of foreign policy challenges. While it is too early to predict the contours of the new administration’s approach, one thing seems certain: the Indo-Pa- cific will remain central to Korea’s external engagement. title: Post-Colonial Trade Across European and Non-European Colonizers
affiliations: Ghent University and Ghent University

detail.title: Post-Colonial Trade Across European and Non-European Colonizers
detail.abstract: Existing studies on post-colonial trade have primarily focused on the British and French colonizers, leaving limited evidence on other colonial powers.  Using a more comprehensive colonial history dataset covering all colonial relationships, we examine the impact of global colonial history on trade. We find that both European and non-European colonizers have positive trade effects with former colonies. However, the magnitude and persistence of these effects are substantially larger for non-European powers. While some non-European colonizers exhibit the same trade erosion following independence as their European counterparts, others seem to retain strong colonial linkages.

title: Bank Credit and Trade Credit: A New Perspective from Bank Regulatory Penalties
affiliations: Dongbei University of Finance and Economics, Dongbei University of Finance and Economics, Dongbei University of Finance and Economics (DUFE), Dongbei University of Finance and Economics and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Bank Credit and Trade Credit: A New Perspective from Bank Regulatory Penalties
detail.abstract: Prior research offers mixed findings on the relationship between bank credit and trade credit. Using a novel dataset of bank regulatory penalties in China from 2012 to 2022, this paper re-examines the substitution hypothesis between bank credit and trade credit. We find that firms in cities with more frequent bank penalties significantly increase their use of trade credit. Penalties constrain bank credit supply and lower firms’ overall financing costs, prompting a shift from bank credit toward trade credit. This effect is weaker for firms with limited bargaining power over suppliers and stronger when executives have relevant financial experience. Firms with higher inventories and lower operating cash flows respond more actively, as do those in regions with higher social trust and less banking competition. Overall, the findings offer new evidence for the substitution hypothesis by highlighting the role of bank regulatory penalties as a shock to credit supply.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用中国2012-2022年银行监管处罚数据，重新检验银行信贷与商业信用之间的替代假说。研究发现，银行监管处罚会限制银行信贷供给、降低企业融资成本，促使企业从银行信贷转向商业信用。
AI.research_question: 银行监管处罚如何影响银行信贷与商业信用之间的替代关系？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对银行信贷与商业信用关系存在不一致的发现，需要新的视角和证据来重新检验替代假说。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行信贷与商业信用替代假说、信贷供给约束理论、企业融资成本理论
AI.method: 使用中国2012-2022年银行监管处罚的新数据集，实证分析银行处罚对企业使用商业信用的影响
AI.findings: 1. 银行处罚频次高的城市中，企业显著增加商业信用使用；2. 处罚通过约束银行信贷供给、降低融资成本促使企业转向商业信用；3. 供应商议价能力弱的企业效应较弱；4. 高管有金融经验的企业效应更强；5. 高库存、低经营现金流的企业反应更积极；6. 高社会信任、低银行竞争地区的企业效应更明显
AI.theory_contributions: 为银行信贷与商业信用替代假说提供新证据，强调银行监管处罚作为信贷供给冲击的作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解银行监管对实体经济融资的影响提供参考，为企业融资决策提供指导

title: The Corruption Tax: When a Few Bad Actors Make Everyone Pay
affiliations: OP Jindal Global University

detail.title: The Corruption Tax: When a Few Bad Actors Make Everyone Pay
detail.abstract: This paper develops a Bayesian model of credence-good markets in developing economies plagued by layered corruption: consumer theft, firm adulteration, and regulatory bribery. Consumers observe noisy quality signals and form tempered Bayesian posteriors about hidden adulteration, where parameter \(\gamma\) captures resistance to negative evidence. Even with low initial dishonesty, tempering sustains high-equilibrium adulteration rates, generating a systemic ``corruption tax" that raises prices and lowers realised quality, a burden borne primarily by honest firms and consumers. We characterise equilibrium conditions under which corruption persists or collapses, and use numerical simulations to show that transparent regulation, improved detection technologies, and reduced consumer skepticism sharply lower fraudulent behavior. The analysis underscores how small dishonest acts trigger self-reinforcing distrust, highlighting the critical role of transparency and credible enforcement in restoring market efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个贝叶斯模型，分析发展中经济体信用品市场的多层腐败问题（消费者偷窃、企业掺假、监管贿赂）。研究发现即使初始不诚实程度很低，消费者对负面证据的抗拒也会维持高均衡掺假率，形成系统性"腐败税"，主要由诚实企业和消费者承担。透明监管、改进检测技术和减少消费者怀疑能显著降低欺诈行为。
AI.research_question: 在发展中经济体的信用品市场中，多层腐败（消费者偷窃、企业掺假、监管贿赂）如何相互作用并形成均衡？什么因素决定腐败的持续或崩溃？
AI.motivation: 发展中经济体的信用品市场普遍存在多层腐败问题，但现有研究缺乏对这些腐败层如何相互作用的系统性分析。理解这种腐败动态对于制定有效的市场治理政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯学习模型，消费者通过有噪声的质量信号形成后验信念；多层腐败理论（消费者、企业、监管三方）；均衡分析框架；腐败税概念。
AI.method: 理论模型构建：建立贝叶斯学习框架，消费者观察有噪声的质量信号并形成后验信念；均衡分析：推导腐败持续或崩溃的条件；数值模拟：分析透明监管、检测技术改进和消费者怀疑减少对欺诈行为的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 即使初始不诚实程度很低，消费者对负面证据的抗拒（参数γ）也会维持高均衡掺假率；2. 形成系统性"腐败税"，提高价格并降低实际质量，主要由诚实企业和消费者承担；3. 透明监管、改进检测技术和减少消费者怀疑能显著降低欺诈行为；4. 小规模不诚实行为会触发自我强化的不信任循环。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将多层腐败纳入统一的贝叶斯分析框架；2. 提出"腐败税"概念，量化腐败对市场效率的系统性影响；3. 识别腐败持续或崩溃的均衡条件；4. 揭示消费者信念形成在腐败动态中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供具体干预方向：透明监管、改进检测技术、减少消费者怀疑；2. 强调透明度和可信执法在恢复市场效率中的关键作用；3. 帮助理解小规模腐败如何演变为系统性问题的机制；4. 为发展中经济体的市场治理提供实证指导。

title: The 34% IRR Global Public Good: Early Investment in Direct Air Capture as Wright's Law Option Economics for Climate Stabilization
affiliations: Carbon Finance Labs

detail.title: The 34% IRR Global Public Good: Early Investment in Direct Air Capture as Wright's Law Option Economics for Climate Stabilization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I work for Carbon Finance Labs and owned by Oxy Low Carbon Ventures which also owns 1PointFive a direct capture company.
declarations.ethicsApproval: na
declarations.funderStatement: none. self activity over thanksgiving break.

detail.abstract: Early investment in direct air capture (DAC) represents a global public good with extraordinary returns. Applying venture capital option economics to Wright's Law learning curves, we find that accelerated DAC investment generates a 34% internal rate of return (IRR) when comparing $400 billion in early investment (2025-2035) against $6.2 trillion in avoided deployment costs through 2060. This return accrues as a global public good: reduced costs for achieving climate targets benefit all nations regardless of who funds the initial learning. We model country-level investment allocations proportional to GDP and find that the United States ($105B), European Union ($70B), and China ($67B) would bear the primary burden under equitable sharing. Returns manifest through two channels: (1) direct economic multiplier effects of 1.5x during construction and ongoing operations, and (2) avoided climate damages of $38 trillion annually by 2050 under business-asusual warming. A GDP-weighted $400B global investment generates estimated returns of $237B in direct economic activity plus $2-6T in avoided climate damages-a combined return exceeding 500% over 25 years.

AI.tldr: 早期投资于直接空气捕获(DAC)作为全球公共品具有超高回报。应用风险投资期权经济学和Wright定律学习曲线，研究发现加速DAC投资在2025-2035年投入4000亿美元，相比2060年前避免的6.2万亿美元部署成本，可获得34%的内部收益率。这种回报作为全球公共品：降低实现气候目标的成本使所有国家受益，无论谁资助初始学习。
AI.research_question: 早期投资于直接空气捕获(DAC)作为全球公共品，其经济回报如何？加速DAC投资能否产生显著的经济效益和气候效益？
AI.motivation: DAC技术对于实现气候目标至关重要，但当前部署成本高昂。需要研究早期投资的经济合理性，以激励各国共同投资这项全球公共品。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险投资期权经济学、Wright定律学习曲线、全球公共品理论、成本效益分析框架
AI.method: 应用风险投资期权经济学结合Wright定律学习曲线进行建模分析，模拟国家层面的投资分配（按GDP比例），评估直接经济效益和避免的气候损失
AI.findings: 1. 早期DAC投资可获得34%的内部收益率；2. 4000亿美元投资可避免6.2万亿美元部署成本；3. 美国、欧盟、中国将承担主要投资责任；4. 投资产生1.5倍直接经济乘数效应；5. 到2050年可避免每年3.8万亿美元气候损失；6. 25年综合回报率超过500%
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将风险投资期权经济学应用于气候技术投资评估；2. 建立DAC作为全球公共品的投资回报分析框架；3. 量化学习曲线对气候技术成本降低的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供DAC投资的经济依据；2. 提出基于GDP的公平投资分配方案；3. 展示早期投资对降低长期气候成本的杠杆作用；4. 为国际气候融资提供具体投资建议

title: Macroeconomic Consequences of the Spanish Transition to Democracy
affiliations: SUNY at Binghamton, Department of Economics and Binghamton University

detail.title: Macroeconomic Consequences of the Spanish Transition to Democracy
detail.abstract: This paper uses the multiple outcome synthetic control method to study themacroeconomic consequences of the Spanish transition to democracy that startedafter Francisco Francos death in 1975. We employ the Cobb-Douglas productionfunction and construct the counterfactuals for GDP, TFP, capital, and labor. We find that GDP per worker and TFP increased almost immediately after the transition; however, total employment declined, and GDP per capita initially decreased as a result. Actual GDP per capita caught up with the counterfactual by the late 1980s and exceeded it by about 15% during the 1990s.

AI.tldr: 本文使用多重结果合成控制法研究西班牙1975年后民主转型的宏观经济后果，发现工人人均GDP和TFP立即增长，但总就业下降，人均GDP初期下降，到1980年代末才追上反事实水平，1990年代超过约15%。
AI.research_question: 西班牙民主转型（1975年后）对宏观经济产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 研究政治体制转型（从独裁到民主）对经济表现的影响，特别是西班牙这一重要案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于柯布-道格拉斯生产函数理论框架，分析GDP、TFP、资本和劳动力等宏观经济变量。
AI.method: 多重结果合成控制法，构建GDP、TFP、资本和劳动力的反事实情景。
AI.findings: 1. 工人人均GDP和TFP在转型后几乎立即增长；2. 总就业下降；3. 人均GDP初期下降；4. 实际人均GDP在1980年代末追上反事实水平，1990年代超过约15%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政治体制转型对经济影响的理论提供了实证证据，展示了民主转型对宏观经济变量的复杂影响模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解政治转型的经济后果提供参考，特别是就业与人均GDP的短期权衡关系。

title: The Timing of Blockchain Adoption for Corporate Social Responsibility Verification under Competition
affiliations: Tianjin University of Finance and Economics, Tianjin University of Finance and Economics and Tianjin University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: The Timing of Blockchain Adoption for Corporate Social Responsibility Verification under Competition
detail.abstract: This study examines strategic blockchain investment timing for Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) verification in competitive markets under uncertainty. We develop a dynamic game-theoretic model integrating real options theory to analyze how firms choose between substantive and symbolic CSR and when to adopt blockchain for authentication. Our findings demonstrate that: (1) Competitor's greenwashing delays the firm's own blockchain investment under low market uncertainty due to increased option value of waiting, yet accelerates adoption under high uncertainty as firms race to verify claims and resolve consumer confusion. (2) A unique strategic equilibria across adoption scenarios are shaped by cost asymmetry, investment costs, and initial market size, with high investment costs paradoxically enabling cost-disadvantaged firms to preempt leaders. (3) Blockchain transparency reshapes CSR competition by enabling early adopters to pressure rivals toward substantive CSR, shifting market equilibrium toward authenticity. A case study using electric vehicle industry data validates our theoretical framework, offering strategic insights for managing CSR transparency under competitive pressure.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在竞争市场不确定性下，企业进行区块链投资用于CSR验证的战略时机选择。通过整合实物期权理论的动态博弈模型，分析了企业在实质性CSR和象征性CSR之间的选择，以及何时采用区块链进行认证。
AI.research_question: 在竞争市场不确定性下，企业如何选择区块链投资时机用于CSR验证？企业如何在实质性CSR和象征性CSR之间进行战略选择？
AI.motivation: 随着CSR重要性日益增加，企业面临如何验证其CSR承诺真实性的挑战。区块链技术提供了透明验证的可能性，但投资时机和战略选择在竞争环境中存在不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态博弈理论、实物期权理论、CSR战略理论（实质性CSR vs 象征性CSR）、竞争战略理论
AI.method: 开发了整合实物期权理论的动态博弈模型，分析企业战略选择；使用电动汽车行业数据进行案例研究验证理论框架
AI.findings: 1. 竞争对手的"漂绿"行为在低市场不确定性下延迟企业区块链投资，但在高不确定性下加速投资；2. 成本不对称、投资成本和初始市场规模塑造独特的战略均衡；3. 区块链透明度重塑CSR竞争，推动市场向真实性转变
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将实物期权理论应用于CSR区块链投资时机分析；2. 发展了CSR验证的动态博弈模型；3. 揭示了竞争环境下CSR透明度战略的新理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供CSR区块链投资时机决策指导；2. 帮助管理者理解竞争压力下的CSR透明度战略；3. 为政策制定者提供监管CSR验证的参考

title: Estimation of Welfare Effects in Hedonic Difference-in-Differences The Case of School Redistricting∗
affiliations: University of Kentucky, South Dakota State University and University of Kentucky

detail.title: Estimation of Welfare Effects in Hedonic Difference-in-Differences The Case of School Redistricting∗

keywords: School Quality JEL Classification Codes: H4

detail.abstract: Difference-in-differences (DID) estimation that identifies the capitalization of amenities through changes in housing prices has been widely used. However, there are concerns about how to interpret the estimates of capitalization from DID as changes in welfare. We demonstrate theoretically and empirically how this divergence between capitalization and welfare arises, showing that it stems from violations of the Stable Unit Treatment Value Assumption (SUTVA) and the time-constant gradient assumption (TCGA). Following Banzhaf (2021), we estimate the capitalization of school redistricting in a DID framework that incorporates general equilibrium effects. When comparing estimates from our generalized DID model to the conventional DID model, we find significant differences in both the capitalization effects and welfare changes associated with the school redistricting.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了传统双重差分法在估算便利设施资本化效应时的局限性，指出资本化与福利变化之间的差异源于SUTVA和TCGA假设的违反，并通过包含一般均衡效应的广义DID模型重新评估了学区重划的资本化和福利效应。
AI.research_question: 如何解释双重差分法估算的便利设施资本化效应与福利变化之间的差异？这种差异是否源于SUTVA和TCGA假设的违反？
AI.motivation: 虽然DID方法被广泛用于通过房价变化识别便利设施的资本化效应，但如何将这些资本化估计解释为福利变化存在疑问。需要理清资本化与福利之间的理论关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Banzhaf (2021)的理论框架，分析稳定单位处理值假设(SUTVA)和时间恒定梯度假设(TCGA)在DID模型中的重要性，以及这些假设违反如何导致资本化与福利估计的差异。
AI.method: 采用包含一般均衡效应的广义双重差分模型，与传统DID模型进行对比，实证分析学区重划的资本化和福利效应。
AI.findings: 广义DID模型与传统DID模型的估计结果存在显著差异，表明传统方法可能错误估计了学区重划的资本化效应和相关的福利变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上阐明了资本化与福利差异的来源，明确了SUTVA和TCGA假设在解释DID估计中的关键作用，为理解便利设施资本化的福利含义提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的学区重划福利效应评估方法，强调了考虑一般均衡效应的重要性，有助于更合理的教育资源配置决策。
